original: Roads are vital to any city. Nearly every building must be placed along a road to function properly.  @PPlace roads by selecting the 'Road' button from the @86Control&Panel. As you place the road, you might notice that it changes appearance. The city's engineers take care to match the quality of the road with the quality of the area. So, in the areas of your city that can boast of high @119appeal, the roads will be quite attractive. In industrialized areas and other low-appeal areas, the roads will be rougher. The city's engineers are always on top of the changes of appeal in your city and will always make sure that an area's roads are in keeping with its appeal. @PAll the roads in the city do not necessarily need to be connected to each other. You can, for example, set up an industrial area in one part of your city and a residential area in another, separate, unconnected part. The buildings in the industrial area will still have access to the city's labor pool as long as there are no obstructions, like an unbridged body of water, between the industrial area and the residential area. @PYou do need to make sure, however, that buildings that depend upon each other to operate are connected to each other by a road. For example, if a @16Drama&School is not connected to a @17Theater by a road, the Drama School will never be able to provide actors to the Theater. Similarly, manufacturers such as @33Armories, @47Wineries, and @46Olive&Presses must be connected by a road to a supplier of the raw material each needs. This supplier can either be a @10Storehouse, @11Trading&Post or @12Pier that is storing the needed good, or an industry that produces the raw material. @PWhile most of your city's residents can only walk on roads, a few notable exceptions can walk off-road, across open terrain. Immigrants can cut across open land to reach your city's housing, and emigrants do not need roads to leave your city. Vagrants, too, can leave the road. Other walkers who are not always restricted to roads include miners, lumberjacks, stonecutters, growers, tenders, metallurgists, hunters, superintendents and artisans. @PIf an earthquake strikes your city, you can build a road over a crack to bridge it. @PIt might be helpful to read the entries on @30Roadblocks and @91walkers to understand how people move across your city. You might also want to read the entry on @19Avenues&and&Boulevards to learn about these special roads.
text: @P道路對城市而言是非常重要的，大多數建築都應該建造在道路兩旁。  @P你可以選擇 @86控制面板 中的'道路'放置道路。隨著城市的發展，特別是 @119環境 的改善，工程師會把道路建造得更加漂亮。 @P城裡的道路不一定非要相互連接，你甚至可以把工業區和生活區分開建設。只要兩個區之間沒有例如河流之類的障礙就行。 @P不過相互依存的建築之間應該以道路相連。如果 @16戲劇學院 沒有和 @17劇場 連接，那麼戲劇學院就無法為劇場提供演員。此外， @33防具鋪 、 @47酒坊 和 @46油坊 必須和原料提供場所相連，例如 @10貨棧 、 @11貿易站 和 @12貿易港 。 @P城裡的平民只能在道路上行走，不過居民在遷移時可以穿越空地。此外，流浪漢、礦工、伐木工人、採石工人、園丁和工匠也可以離開道路行走。 @P如果發生地震，你可以在斷裂區修建道路穿越斷裂區。 @P你可以參閱 @30路障 、 @91行人 、 @19大道和林蔭道 。

original: Your workers are drawn from the city's common housing. @PTo build common housing, first select the Population Tab on the Control Panel, then click on the Common Housing button. You can designate common housing plots one at a time by clicking the mouse button, or designate large areas of common housing by holding the mouse button down and dragging. All housing plots must have direct access to a road. @P@115Immigrants will build houses on the plots you've designated, provided that conditions in your city are acceptable. New immigrants can only afford to build the most meager of homes, the Hut. People who live in Huts forage for food from the land and can barely keep a roof over their heads. As soon as you provide the residents of a Hut with food from an @8Agora, they will improve their dwelling, transforming it into a Shack.  @PTo further develop Shacks, provide their residents with water from a @49Fountain and access to some kind of diversion. Residents of Greece like cultural diversions, and residents of Atlantis like scientific diversions. The Shack dwellers will make improvements to their homes, turning them into Hovels. To improve the city's housing even further, provide Hovels with fleece, and they'll become Homesteads. Homesteads become Tenements when you provide their residents with access to multiple types of cultural or scientific diversions.  With a supply of @46olive&oil, Tenements will become Apartments. Finally, provide Apartment dwellers with even more culture (or science in Atlantis), and they will improve their homes into Townhouses.  Townhouses are the nicest homes commoners can build, and no amount of additional goods or services will transform a common house into an elite house.  @PAs a house develops, it can generally accommodate more people. Greek households residing in Hovels or better types of common housing will contribute @104rabble to fight for the city. Atlantean households living in Hovels or better provide @142archers to the military.  @PSometimes, residents of a house will not improve their dwelling even though you have provided everything they want. If the @119appeal of the area is too low, residents will refuse to make improvements to their home. @PAll the goods you provide to a common house are consumed by the people who live there.  All common houses must be resupplied with goods regularly or they may devolve to a more primitive state.  If, for example, an Apartment runs out of olive oil, it will devolve into a Tenement, and some of the Apartment's residents might be forced to move out because a Tenement cannot accommodate as many people. If a common house, such as an Apartment, runs out of something basic, such as food, it will devolve all the way back to a Hut! Housing can also lose access to clean water and to cultural or scientific diversions if not regularly passed by a water bearer or culture walker (or scientist, if you're in Atlantis).  @PPeople who live in common housing will always be workers. They will never become part of the elite class.
text: @P只有建造民房才會有工人。 @P在控制面板中選擇人口標簽，然後點擊民房的圖標，你可以建造單個民房，也可以拖動鼠標選擇在一大片區域裡造滿民房。民房必須建在道路邊。 @P不久， @115遷移 來的居民會在這些區域建造民房，由於他們還比較貧窮，所以只能住在茅屋裡。當你建成 @8市場 後，他們會把茅屋建成棚屋。  @P此後，當你建成 @49噴泉 和其它一些文化設施後，居民們會把棚屋建成小屋。當你為他們提供羊毛後，小屋會變成簡屋。建成更多文化設施後，簡屋會變成合院。得到 @46橄欖油 後，合院會變成公寓。建成更多文化設施後，公寓會變成樓宇。樓宇是平民所能居住的最高級的居所了，民房不能變成高級住宅。  @P民房擴建後，可以支持更多的人口。小屋以上等級的民房可以提供 @104民兵 。 @P如果 @119環境 沒有改善，民房的人口是不會增加的。 @P你要定期為人們提供食物和資源，否則民房的等級會降低。例如，如果公寓得不到橄欖油，就會變成合院。由於合院可以住的人較少，所以會有一些人被迫離開。同樣，如果缺少食物、水和文化設施，有些高級住房甚至會恢復成最初的茅屋。  @P住在民房裡的人都是平民，不會成為貴族。

original: The city's finest residents live in elite housing. These people do not work, but some members of each household are warriors who fight for the city. Elite Greek residents serve as @105hoplites and @106horsemen. Elite Atlantean residents serve as @142spearmen and @142charioteers. Elite households also pay more taxes than residents of @6common&housing. @PTo designate an elite housing plot, you must first have supplies of food, fleece and olive oil stored in the city. You must also find an area of the city that has sufficient @119appeal. Once you have everything you need, and have a suitable location along a road, select the Population Tab, click the Elite Housing button, and place the Elite House.  As long as conditions are acceptable in the city, @115immigrants will soon move in. @PThe simplest elite house, the Residence, does not support the warrior class.  However, if you provide the Residence with armor from an @8Agora, and access to more cultural or scientific diversions, its occupants will transform their home into a Mansion, and some of them will become warriors. In Greece, they will become hoplites, and in Atlantis they will become spearmen. @PFor the residents of a Mansion to make further improvements to their home, supply them with wine from an Agora. In addition, supply Greek Mansions with more types of cultural diversions, and Atlantean Mansions with more scientific pursuits. The Mansion will become a Manor, and will house even more warriors.  @PThe highest level of housing is the Estate. In addition to having everything the residents of a Manor have, Greek Estate residents must obtain horses from an Agora peddler, and must be able to enjoy competitions at a @18Stadium. Because they can afford to keep their own horses, men who live in Estates fight for the city as horsemen. @PTo achieve the highest level of housing in Atlantis, make sure that the residents have everything that Atlantean Manor-dwellers have, plus a supply of chariots from an Agora. They will also expect to be educated by curators from a @138Museum. Some of the residents of Atlantean Estates fight as charioteers. @PAs an elite house develops, it can accommodate more residents.   @PResidents of elite housing do not think twice about abandoning their homes if conditions in their neighborhood change. If food, fleece and olive oil are not delivered or if access to cultural or scientific diversions is lost, residents will move out. In addition, if something happens to decrease the @119appeal of the neighborhood, the upper class residents will leave to seek out a neighborhood that better suits their refined taste. When residents abandon their home, it deteriorates quickly and becomes quite run-down. Elite residents will move back in if you restore the neighborhood to its former glory and make sure that it has continual access to food, fleece, olive oil and cultural or scientific pursuits. @PElite housing can devolve if it runs out of anything its residents deem necessary.  If, for example, a Manor or Estate runs out of wine, it will deteriorate into a Mansion. An elite dwelling can also deteriorate if its household loses men in battle.  When an elite soldier dies, his armor and, if he has one, his horse or chariot are also lost, and his home may devolve as a result. @PElite homes have their own water supplies, and do not need water from a @49Fountain.
text: @P高級住宅專供貴族居住。他們之中的許多人會作為 @105步兵 和 @106騎兵 參加戰鬥，他們付的稅也比住在 @6民房 裡的平民高。 @P要建造高級住宅，你必須有足夠的食物、羊毛和橄欖油，而且城市要有良好的 @119環境 。在人口標簽中點擊高級住宅的圖標， @115遷移 來的居民很快就會到達。 @P最低等級的是豪宅，不過不能招募戰士。如果你從 @8市場 上得到了盔甲，並且建造一些文化設施，豪宅就會變成官邸，某些居民會成為步兵。 @P如果你從 @8市場 上得到了酒，並且再建造一些文化設施，官邸就會變成莊園，有更多的居民會變成步兵。  @P如果你從市場上買到了馬，而且建成了 @18露天運動場 ，就可以建造領地，從此你就擁有了騎兵。 @P住宅等級越高，可以居住的居民越多。   @P如果缺少食物、羊毛、橄欖油，或者城市的 @119環境 惡化，高級住宅的居民就會離開這個城市。 @P高級住宅如果缺少了物資就會降級。例如，如果莊園或領地缺少了酒，就會變成官邸。如果一戶人家有戰士在戰場上犧牲了，住宅也會降級。士兵犧牲後，他們的馬匹和盔甲就丟失了。 @P高級住宅有自己的水源，不需要 @49噴泉 的水。

original: The Agora provides a place for vendors to set up shop, and the Agora itself employs a peddler to distribute the vendors' goods to houses in the surrounding neighborhood.  There are two types of Agora: the Common Agora and the Grand Agora.  @L@LCOMMON AGORAS @PThe Common Agora has room to host up to three Vendor's Stalls. To place a Common Agora, select the Distribution Tab, click on the 'Agora' button and choose Common Agora from the list that pops up. One of the long outer edges of the Common Agora must be placed directly on top of a road.  The Agora will rotate automatically to sit correctly on the road you've chosen. You'll know when you've picked an appropriate spot when you see a green ghost of the Agora. @L@LGRAND AGORAS @PThe Grand Agora can host up to six Vendor's Stalls. To place a Grand Agora, select the Distribution Tab, then click on the Agora button. From the list that appears, choose Grand Agora. You will see a red footprint of the building. Position the building so that a road runs lengthwise down its center. The Agora will rotate automatically to sit correctly on the road you've chosen. You'll know when you've found a good spot when the red footprint turns into a green ghost of the Grand Agora.  @L@LVENDOR'S STALLS @PThere are seven Vendor's Stalls in all: the Food Vendor's Stall, Fleece Vendor's Stall, Oil Vendor's Stall, Arms Vendor's Stall, Wine Vendor's Stall, Horse Trainer's Stall and Chariot Vendor's Stall. Only Greek Agoras may host the Horse Trainer's Stall, and only Atlantean Agoras may host a Chariot Vendor's Stall. You can place these stalls in any order you choose.  To place an individual Vendor's Stall, choose one from the list that appears when you click the Agora button. Then, position the Vendor's Stall over the Agora until its footprint turns green, and click your mouse button. @POnce the Vendor's Stall is in place and accesses the city's labor pool, a vendor will emerge in search of supplies. The food vendor will search for food in a nearby Granary, in a trading facility that is importing food, or in a trading facility that normally exports food, but is currently not selling.  The horse trainer will proceed directly to a Horse Ranch to procure horses, and the chariot vendor will go directly to a Chariot Factory for chariots.  The other types of vendors proceed to nearby Storehouses, or to trading facilities that are importing what they need, to obtain their respective goods.  When the Agora is supplied with goods, a peddler is dispatched to wander the city's streets, distributing food and goods to any houses he happens to pass. @L@LAGORA INVENTORY @PTo obtain more information about an Agora, right-click on it. In the screen that appears, you will see a button for each Vendor's Stall, representing which items the Agora can store and distribute. Each button indicates the Stall's current stocks, with a word or brief phrase updating you on the current status of the Stall, its vendor, or its good. The possibilities are: @L@@P'No Vendor.' If you have not built a vendor for a particular item, this phrase appears. @L@PBuying.' If the Stall currently has nothing in stock, but its vendor is out buying goods, the word 'Buying' will appear. @L@P'No Goods.'  This appears when the Stall has not yet sent out a vendor to procure goods. @L@P'No Supply' appears if the vendor cannot find a source of the good he or she deals in. @L@P'Too Distant.'  If the facility storing the supplies a vendor needs is too far away from the Agora, 'Too Distant' will be displayed.   @L@P'Stockpiled.'  This appears when you have designated that the corresponding item be stockpiled throughout the city.  In such cases, the vendor cannot procure additional supplies, but the Agora's peddler can continue to distribute whatever stocks the vendor already has on hand. @L@P'Distributing' appears if the Stall has a supply of the item on hand, and the peddler is out distributing goods to customers. @L@P'No Labor' appears if there aren't enough workers at the Agora for it to function properly. @L@P'Not Buying' appears if you have instructed the vendor not to buy an item. You can give a vendor this order by clicking on the Stall button corresponding to the good you don't want to buy.  Click on 'Not buying' to rescind the order.
text: @P市場是買賣的場所，分爲兩種：普通市場和高級市場。  @L@L普通市場 @P普通市場可以有三個貨攤。在儲存與銷售標籤中選擇'市場'，點擊'普通市場'，市場必須正對道路。你可以選擇市場的朝向。 @L@L高級市場 @P高級市場可以有六個貨攤。在儲存與銷售標籤中選擇'市場'，點擊'高級市場'。 @L@L貨攤 @P市場裏最多可以有六種貨攤，他們分別賣：食物、羊毛、橄欖油、武器、酒和馬。從選單中選擇貨攤後放在市場中即可。 @P貨攤擺好後，商販會尋找貨物來源。如果市場連接糧倉，那麼買食物的商販就可以在糧倉得到食物。得到食物後小販會挨家挨戶地去出售食物。 @L@L市場的存貨 @P在市場上點擊右鍵可以看到各個貨攤的圖標，你可以看到貨攤的庫存，旁邊會有描述文字： @L@@P'沒有貨攤'。 你沒有擺放這個貨攤。 @L@P'購買貨物'。 攤主去進貨了。 @L@P'沒有貨物'。 沒有貨物，而且攤主沒有去進貨。 @L@P'沒有貨源'。 找不到貨物來源。 @L@P'距離太遠'。 供貨場所離市場太遠。   @L@P'囤積貨物'。 你已經把這種貨物儲存起來，攤主進不到貨，不過仍然會出售手頭的貨物。 @L@P'銷售貨物'。 商販在外面出售貨物。 @L@P'沒有工人'。 市場裏沒有足夠的工人。 @L@P'停止購買'。 你讓貨攤不得進某種貨物。點擊'停止'就可以讓貨攤無法購買某種貨物，點擊'銷售貨物'取消。

original: Granaries store the food your city produces or imports to feed your people.  @PTo build a Granary, select the Distribution Tab, then click the Granary button. Place the Granary where you want it and make sure that it is built along a road. @PYou can get a rough idea of what is stored in a Granary by looking in its fill holes. To see exactly how much food is stored in a Granary, right-click on it. In the panel that pops up, each type of food obtainable by your city is listed, along with the quantity currently stored in the Granary. From this panel, you can also issue orders to your Granary. The orders you can issue are: @L@PAccept. By default, the Granary is set to Accept deliveries up to its full capacity for all types of food. All deliveries are accepted on a first come, first served basis until the Granary is entirely full. If you want, you can use the scroll buttons to adjust the stock limit for each food type, to limit how much of that food type the Granary will accept. For example, if you tell a Granary to accept 16 loads of wheat, it will continue to accept wheat deliveries until it is storing 16 loads. @L@PGet. Click on the word 'Accept,' and it will change to 'Get.' When instructed to get, the Granary's deliverymen will seek out the item from other Granaries, Storehouses, or trading facilities that are importing the item until the stock limit is reached.  @L@PEmpty. Click on the word 'Get,' and it will change to 'Empty.' When told to empty a food, the Granary's deliverymen will try to relocate all stocks of that food type to other storage facilities. The deliverymen will try to find other Granaries, Trading Posts or Piers that are accepting the food. In the case of wheat, the Granary deliverymen will also try to take the good to a Storehouse or Horse Ranch. The stock limit number is irrelevant here; the Granary deliverymen will attempt to get rid of the entire inventory of the food item. @L@PDon't Accept. Click on the word 'Empty,' and the phrase 'Don't Accept' will appear. When a Granary is instructed not to accept something, it will turn away any new deliveries of the item, but it will not empty its current stock of the item. Food vendors can still procure food so designated at Granaries, as can deliverymen from other Granaries instructed to 'Get' the food item.
text: @P糧倉是儲存糧食的建築。  @P建造糧倉時，在儲存與銷售標籤中點擊“糧倉”按鈕，記住要把糧倉建在道路邊。 @P你可以根據外觀大致看出糧倉裏有多少糧食。如果要看詳細數據，可以在糧倉上點擊鼠標右鍵。此外，你還可以發佈一些指令： @L@P接受。接受某些食物，一直接受到裝滿爲之，但是你也可以設定每種食物的最高儲存量。 @L@P取得。工人會到其它糧倉或工場去運來某種食物，一直運到你所決定的最高儲存量爲止。  @L@P清空。把某種糧食完全轉移到其它糧倉或農場。 @L@P不接受。不接受某種食物，但是商販或其它糧倉可以從這個糧倉得到食物。

original: The Storehouse stores items produced and used by the city. The Storehouse can store any good except for urchins, fish, carrots, onions, cheese and meat.  @PThe Storehouse is an important building in your city. It stores the goods your citizens need to improve their homes, so that vendors can pick them up. It also stores raw materials for industries. When an industry needs a raw material that is stored in a Storehouse, deliverymen employed by the Storehouse will transport the item to the industry. The Storehouse also stores finished goods manufactured by industries.  To build a Storehouse, select the @79Distribution&Tab and click on the 'Storehouse' button. @PAs goods are delivered, you will see them piling up in the Storehouse. Each instance of the item you see in the Storehouse represents one load.  A Storehouse can hold up to eight different items - 32 loads in total. Because sculptures are so large, a Storehouse can hold only eight of them at most.  To see how much of each item the Storehouse has on hand, and to issue the Storehouse orders, right-click on it. @PWhen you right-click on a Storehouse, you'll see how many loads of goods the Storehouse is storing along with how many more loads it can store. You'll also see how much of each item the Storehouse has on hand. From this screen, you can also issue orders to the Storehouse. The orders are: @L@P'Accept.' When given this order, the Storehouse will accept an item up to its stock limit. You can set the stock limit by using the scroll buttons next to the stock limit number. @L@P'Get.' Click on the word 'Accept,' and the Storehouse order will change to 'Get.' When ordered to get an item, the Storehouse will send out its deliverymen to pick up the item from another Storehouse or trading facility until the stock limit has been reached.  @L@P'Empty.' Click on the word 'Get' and the word 'Empty' will appear. When told to empty an item, the deliverymen will look for any destination that will accept it, whether it be a manufacturer, another Storehouse or a trading facility. @L@P'Don't Accept.' Click on 'Empty' and the phrase 'Don't Accept' will appear. When told not to accept an item, the Storehouse will refuse any new deliveries of the item. It will continue to store and distribute the existing stock, though.  @L@PClick 'Don't Accept' to return the orders to 'Accept.' Keep clicking to cycle through all of these choices.
text: @P貨棧可以儲存除了：海膽、魚、胡蘿卜、洋蔥、奶酪和獸肉以外的所有物資。  @P要建造貨棧，在儲存與銷售標簽中點擊'貨棧'。 @P貨棧可以儲存8類共32批貨物。不過由於雕像比較大，所以最多只能存放8個雕像。如果要看貨棧的存貨清單以及發布指令，可以在貨棧上點擊鼠標右鍵。 @P你不但可以看到所有貨物的清單，而且可以發布以下指令： @L@P'接受'。 接受所有的物資，一直接受到裝滿為之，但是你也可以設定每種物資的最高儲存量。 @L@P'取得'。 工人會到其它貨棧或工場購買某種物資，一直買到你所決定的最高儲存量為止。  @L@P'清空'。 把某種糧食完全轉移到其它貨棧或工場。 @L@P'不接受'。 不接受任何物資，但是小販或其它貨棧可以從這個貨棧得到物資。  @L@P點擊後可以轉換各個命令。

original: Each Trading Post is dedicated to a particular city, and holds all the goods that can be imported from or exported to that city. @PTo build a Trading Post, select the @79Distribution&Tab.  Then, click on the 'Trade' button and select the Trading Post for the city with which you wish to trade. Place the Trading Post in your city, and make sure it is along a road so that it functions properly. @PRight-click on a Trading Post for information about the city to which it is dedicated, and the items it trades. If the corresponding city is not currently trading with you, or if it has been destroyed, this is indicated at the top of the screen. Beneath this is a list of goods, if any, you can import from the city in question, along with how much each good costs per load. To instruct the Trading Post to buy an item, click on the button next to the item until it reads 'Buying.' Then, tell the Trading Post how much to buy by adjusting the stock limit using the scroll buttons at the far right. To stop buying an item altogether, click on 'Buying' to change the order to 'Not Buying.' Continued clicking alternates between these choices. @PWhen the trader arrives at the Trading Post, he will sell as much of the item as he can until the specified stock limit is reached. Keep in mind that a trader can only carry a limited amount of goods with him at one time, so he might not be able to meet your stock limit. Once the trader drops off his goods, a deliveryman from the Trading Post will begin distributing the supplies around the city. If the good in question is a raw material, the deliveryman will first try to find industries that require the supply. If he can find none, he'll try to take the goods to a @10Storehouse or, in the case of food, a @9Granary that is accepting the good. If that fails, he'll leave the goods in the Trading Post. @PThe items you can export to the Trading Post's city are listed below the imports, along with how much the trader will pay you for each item. To export an item, click on the button next to the item until it reads 'Selling.' Then, tell the Trading Post how much of the export you want to keep on hand for sale, by setting the stock limit using the scroll buttons on the far right. When you instruct the Trading Post to start selling an item, a deliveryman will leave the Trading Post to retrieve supplies of the item until the stock limit has been reached. If the stock ever dips below the limit, the deliveryman will do what he can to replenish the stock. @POnce an item has been set aside in a Trading Post to be sold, no one in the city can use it. Vendors cannot procure the goods, and they will never be distributed to industry.  The goods also cannot be used to fulfill outstanding requests on your city or to provision a Hero's Hall. Quantities of items so reserved are displayed on the Distribution tab's goods list in yellow, in the 'selling' column to the right of the good's name. If you find you need to use goods currently reserved for sale, right-click on the trading facility in question, and change the order for this good from 'Selling' to 'Not Selling'. The item will then be usable by all who need it, but will no longer be exported. @PFor more on trade, click @117here.
text: @P每個貿易站對應一個城市，貿易站裡存放著進出口的物資。 @P要建造貿易站，在儲存與銷售標簽中選擇'貿易'，然後點擊'貿易站'，接著選擇相對應的城市。貿易站要建在道路邊上，方便貿易往來。 @P在貿易站上點擊右鍵可以看到與相關城市的貿易狀況。如果對方沒有和你展開貿易，或者對方城市已經被毀滅，那麼你可以在屏幕上方看到提示。在它下方是貿易物資的數量，如果要購買物資，你可以點擊'購入'，然後決定進口數量。 @P商人到達後你就會得到所要的物資，不過商人的貨運量是有限的，所以有時往來一次是不夠的。得到物資後商販就會把物資發送到城市裡。如果物資是原材料，則把它們送到加工場，如果找不到加工場，就送進 @10貨棧 或 @9糧倉 ，如果貨棧或糧倉已滿，就只能留在貿易站了。 @P進口貨物的下方是出口貨物以及出口價格。要出口貨物時，點擊'售出'，然後決定出售數量。 @P當貨物被送進貿易站並決定出售時，商販、市民或加工場就都無法再得到這些貨物，甚至神明的聖所都無法得到這些貨物，這些貨物的數量在清單中以黃色顯示。如果要取消出售命令，選擇'停止'即可。 @P更多信息，請點擊 @117此處 。

original: A Pier is dedicated to a particular city and holds all the goods that can be imported from or exported to that city. @PTo build a Pier, click on the Distribution Tab.  Then, click on the Trade button and select the Pier for the city with whom you wish to trade. The Pier must be along a straight section of coast. When you've found a good spot, you'll see a green ghost of the building. @PA Pier must also have unimpeded access to deep water. You can build a Pier on a narrow inlet or even an inland body of water, but trade ships will not be able to reach it. @PRight-clicking on a Pier brings up a panel of information about its city, and the items it trades. If the city is not currently trading with you or if it has been destroyed, this is indicated at the top of the screen. Beneath this is a list of goods you can import from the city in question, along with how much each good costs per load. To instruct the Pier to buy an item, click on the button next to the item until it reads 'Buying.' Then, tell the Pier how much to buy by adjusting the stock limit using the scroll buttons at the far right. To stop buying an item altogether, click on 'Buying' until it reads 'Not Buying.' @PWhen the trade ship arrives at the Pier, it will sell you as much of the item as it can up to the specified stock limit.  Keep in mind that a ship can hold only a limited quantity of trade goods, so it might not be able to meet your stock limit. Once the trade ship drops off its goods, a deliveryman from the Pier will begin distributing these supplies around the city. If the good in question is a raw material, the deliveryman will first try to find industries that require the item. If he can find none, he'll try to take the goods to a @10Storehouse or, in the case of food, a @9Granary that is accepting the food item. If that fails, he'll leave the goods at the Pier. @PThe items you can export to the Pier's city are listed below the imports, along with how much the trader will pay you for each load of the item. To export an item, click on the button next to it until it reads 'Selling.' Then, tell the Pier how much of the item you want to keep on hand for sale, by setting the stock limit, using the scroll buttons on the far right. As soon as you instruct the Pier to start selling an item, a deliveryman will leave the Pier and retrieve the item until the designated stock limit has been met. If the Pier's stocks of the item ever dip below the designated limit, the deliveryman will do what he can to replenish the stocks. @POnce an item has been set aside in a Trading Post to be sold, no one in the city can use it. Vendors cannot procure the goods, and they will never be distributed to industries.  These goods also cannot be used to fulfill outstanding requests on your city or to provision a Hero's Hall.  Quantities of items so reserved are displayed on the Distribution tab's goods list in yellow, in the 'selling' column to the right of the good's name.  @PFor more on trade, click @117here.
text: @P每個貿易港對應一個城市，貿易港裡存放著進出口的物資。 @P要建造貿易港，在儲存與銷售標簽中選擇'貿易'，然後點擊'貿易港'，接著選擇相對應的城市。貿易港要建在岸邊，如果建在狹長的水道中，一定要有足夠大的出口好讓船只通過。 @P在貿易港上點擊右鍵可以看到與相關城市的貿易狀況。如果對方沒有和你展開貿易，或者對方城市已經被毀滅，那麼你可以在屏幕上方看到提示。在它下方是貿易物資的數量，如果要購買物資，你可以選擇'購入'，然後決定進口數量。要取消時選擇'停止'。 @P商船到達後你就會得到所要的物資，不過商船的貨運量是有限的，所以有時往來一次是不夠的。得到物資後商販就會把物資發送到城市裡。如果物資是原材料，則把它們送到加工場，如果找不到加工場，就送進 @10貨棧 或 @9糧倉 ，如果貨棧或糧倉已滿，就只能留在貿易港了。 @P進口貨物的下方是出口貨物以及出口價格。要出口貨物時，點擊'售出'，然後決定出售數量。 @P當貨物被送進貿易港並決定出售時，商販、市民或加工場就都無法再得到這些貨物，甚至神明的聖所都無法得到這些貨物，這些貨物的數量在清單中以黃色顯示。  @P更多信息，請點擊 @117此處 。

original: Colleges inculcate philosophers with the latest theories. Once the philosophers have been schooled, they leave the College to work at a @14Podium. @PTo build a College, select the @82Culture&Tab from the @86Control&Panel. Click on the Philosophy button, and choose College. Colleges must be placed along a road. @PTo see the philosophers at work in your city, press the 'See Philosophers' button on the Culture tab. You'll see the philosophers walking through the city's streets, and all other walkers will temporarily disappear. You'll also see columns in front of the city's housing. The higher the column, the more recently the household has been enlightened by a philosopher. @PPhilosophers from Colleges can help you win the @112pan-Hellenic&Games. @PPhilosophy is not studied in Atlantis or its colonies.
text: @P學者從大學畢業後，就可以到 @14講壇 工作。 @P要建造大學，在 @86控制面板 中選擇 @82文化標簽 、知識，然後點擊'大學'。大學必須建造在路邊。 @P你可以點擊'查看學者'按鈕查看學者的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近受到過學者的指導。 @P學者會參加 @112泛希臘競賽 。

original: Philosophers from a @13College pontificate from the heights of a Podium. @PTo build a Podium, select the @82Culture&Tab from the @86Control&Panel. Click on the Philosophy button, and choose Podium. Podiums must be built on a road in order to function. They also must be connected by a road to a College. When a Podium is working, you'll see a philosopher expounding his beliefs to a crowd of awed onlookers. Philosophers from the Podium will also begin roaming the streets, bringing their knowledge to the members of every house they pass. @PTo see the philosophers at work in your city, press the 'See Philosophers' button on the Culture tab. You'll see the philosophers walking through the city's streets, and all other walkers will temporarily disappear. You'll also see columns in front of the city's housing. The higher the column, the more recently the household has been enlightened by a philosopher. @PThe more Podiums you have in a city, the more Colleges you'll need. If you notice that a Podium has not hosted a presentation for a while but it has a full staff of workers, then you probably need another College. The closer a Podium is to a College, the longer the Podium's lecture will run. @PPhilosophers are also key participants in @112Pan-Hellenic&Games. @PPhilosophy is not studied in Atlantis or its colonies.
text: @P學者從 @13大學 畢業後就到講壇上工作。 @P要建造講壇，在 @86控制面板 中選擇 @82文化標簽 、知識，然後選擇講壇。講壇必須建在路邊，而且這條路要連接大學。學者有時在講壇上演講，有時會到大街上傳播知識。 @P你可以點擊'查看學者'按鈕查看學者的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近受到過學者的指導。 @P講壇建得越多，需要的大學也越多。講壇離大學越近，學者演說的時間就越長。 @P學者會參加 @112泛希臘競賽 。

original: The Gymnasium trains athletes who walk the city's streets, making sure that the city's residents are in good shape. @PTo build a Gymnasium, select the @82Culture&Tab from the @86Control&Panel. Then, click on the 'Gymnasium' button. A Gymnasium must be built along a road to function properly. You'll know when a Gymnasium is working if you see athletes exercising in the yard. @PGymnasiums also train competitors for the @18Stadium, if your city has one. Competitors are the cream of the athletic crop and thrill the masses with their prowess. A Gymnasium will only train a competitor if there is a Stadium in the city. @PTo see the athletes at work in your city, press the 'See Athletes' button on the Culture Tab. You'll see athletes walking through the city's streets, and all other walkers will temporarily disappear. You'll also see columns in front of the city's housing. The higher the column, the more recently the house has been visited by an athlete. @PAthletes and competitors also participate in @112Pan-Hellenic&Games. @PAthletics are not pursued in Atlantis or its colonies.
text: @P體育館裡訓練出的運動員會穿行於大街小巷，查看各處的居民情況。 @P要建造體育館，在 @86控制面板 中選擇 @82文化標簽 ，然後點擊'體育館'。體育館要建在道路邊，如果它運作正常，你會看到運動員在訓練。 @P體育館還為 @18露天運動場 訓練高級運動員。 @P你可以點擊'查看運動員'按鈕查看運動員的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近受到運動員的拜訪。 @P運動員會參加 @112泛希臘競賽 。

original: Drama Schools teach actors the fine craft of acting. After they complete their tutelage, actors leave the Drama School and proceed to a @17Theater to perform.  @PTo build a Drama School, select the @82Culture&Tab, then click on the Drama button. Choose Drama School, and click on the spot in your city where you want to construct the building. Make sure that the Drama School is built along a road so that it can function properly.  @PTo see the actors at work in your city, press the 'See Actors' button. You'll see the actors walking through the city's streets, and all other walkers will temporarily disappear. You'll also see columns in front of the city's housing. The higher the column, the more recently the household has been entertained by an actor. @PActors from a Drama School can help you win @112Pan-Hellenic&Games. @PDramas are not performed in Atlantis or its colonies.
text: @P從戲劇學院畢業後，演員就會進入 @17劇場 進行表演。  @P要建造戲劇學院，選擇 @82文化標簽 ，點擊'戲劇學院'。戲劇學院要建造在道路邊。  @P你可以點擊'查看演員'按鈕查看演員的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近看過演員的表演。 @P演員會參加 @112泛希臘競賽 。

original: Actors from a @16Drama&School perform great works of tragedy and comedy at a Theater. @PTo build a Theater, first select the @82Culture&Tab, and then click on the Drama button. Choose Theater from the list. Place the Theater along a road so that it functions properly, and make sure that the road connects the Theater to a Drama School. @PIn addition to needing workers to run the ticket office and concessions, a Theater needs actors from a Drama School to put on performances. When a Theater is fully operational, you'll see the actors putting on a play. Actors will also begin circulating through the neighborhood, bringing cultural benefits to the residents of any house that they pass. @PThe more Theaters you have in a city, the more Drama Schools you'll need. If you notice that a Theater has not put on a show for a while but it has a full staff of workers, then you probably need another Drama School. The closer a Theater is to a Drama School, the longer the Theater's play will run. @PTo see the actors at work in your city, press the 'See Actors' button. You'll see the actors walking through the city's streets, and all other walkers will temporarily disappear. You'll also see columns in front of the city's housing. The higher the column, the more recently the household has been entertained by an actor. @PActors also participate in the @112Pan-Hellenic&Games. @PDrama is not performed in Atlantis or its colonies.
text: @P從 @16戲劇學院 畢業後，演員會進入劇場表演。 @P要建造劇場，選擇 @82文化標簽 ，點擊'戲劇'，選擇'劇場'。劇場要在道路邊，同時這條道路還要連接戲劇學院。 @P劇場需要工人來維護，還需要戲劇學院的演員來演出。演出時你會看到演員的動作。此外，演員還會經常到社區去表演。 @P劇場建得越多，需要的戲劇學院也越多。劇場離戲劇學院越近，演員演出的時間就越長。 @P你可以點擊'查看演員'按鈕查看演員的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近看過演員的表演。 @P演員會參加 @112泛希臘競賽 。

original: At the Stadium, competitors display their great athletic prowess. @PTo build a Stadium, choose the @82Culture&Tab and click on the Stadium button. A Stadium must be built on clear land and must be built along a road so that it can function properly. A city can have only one Stadium. @PIn addition to workers, a Stadium also needs trained competitors from a @15Gymnasium. Make sure that the Stadium is connected to a Gymnasium by a road, or else the competitors won't be able to get to the Stadium. When a Stadium has everything it needs, you'll see competitors performing amazing feats to the delight of the crowd. Competitors will also emerge from the Stadium to roam the city's streets, telling of their deeds and bringing culture to the residents of all the houses they pass. To see all your competitors, press the 'See Competitors' button on the Culture Tab. You'll see all your competitors walking around the city, as well as the Stadium and Gymnasiums. You'll also see columns in front of the city's housing. The higher the column, the more recently the house's residents have been thrilled by a passing competitor. @PYou also need a Stadium if your city is to have any hope of hosting its own Games. You will earn the privilege of hosting your own Games if your contestants win the @112Olympian&Games and if you have a Stadium in your city. When you host the Games, other cities throughout Greece will think more highly of you, and your popularity within your own city will increase as well. @PCompetitions are not held in Atlantis or its colonies.
text: @P高級運動員在露天運動場進行訓練和比賽。 @P要建造露天運動場，選擇 @82文化標簽 ，點擊'露天運動場'。露天運動場必須建在道路邊，一個城市只能有一個露天運動場。 @P露天運動場需要工人來維護，還需要 @15體育館 的高級運動員。露天運動場必須有道路和體育館相連。露天運動場有比賽時，你會看到一些高級運動員在做運動。此外，高級運動員還會到街區傾聽大眾的聲音，傳播體育知識。你可以點擊'查看高級運動員'按鈕查看高級運動員的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近受到高級運動員的拜訪。 @P如果你贏得了 @112奧林匹克運動會 ，或者你建成了露天運動場，就可以在自己的城市舉辦大型比賽。此時你的聲望值會大大提高。

original: Boulevards and Avenues must be built on top of existing @5roads.  They boost the @119appeal of the surrounding area. @PAn Avenue is a double-wide road with one side decorated with trees and benches. To build an Avenue, choose the Aesthetics Tab, click the Beautification button and choose Avenue. A red footprint of a single section of Avenue will appear. Place the footprint over the road where you'd like to place the avenue.  When the green ghost of the Avenue appears, click and drag along the road to place the Avenue. Any buildings that you place along the decorated side of the Avenue will still have access to the road. @PA Boulevard is similar to an Avenue, except that it is a triple-wide road. A Boulevard is placed in the same manner as an Avenue. Just make sure that the existing road runs down the center of the Boulevard's footprint.
text: @P林蔭道和大道必須造在 @5道路 的上方。它們會改善附近地區的 @119環境 。 @P大道比一般道路寬一倍，路的一邊種植樹木。建造大道時選擇環境標簽，點擊'美化'，選擇'大道'。 @P林蔭道比一般道路寬兩倍，建造方式和大道一樣，注意要有足夠的空間。

original: Parks enhance the @119appeal of any location. @PTo build a Park, choose the Aesthetics Tab and click the Beautification button. From the list, choose Park.  You can create large Parks by holding the mouse button down and dragging. @PParks do not need access to roads, and can be built on any clear land.
text: @P公園可以改善城市的 @119環境 。 @P要建造公園，選擇環境標簽，點擊'美化'，選擇'公園'，你可以用鼠標拖動的形式決定公園的大小。 @P公園不需要建在路邊。

original: Recreational Areas are fun places for people to relax. They increase the @119appeal of any location. @PThere are several different types of Recreational Areas. They are the Bench, the Tall Obelisk, the Short Obelisk, the Bird Bath, the Flower Garden, the Orrery, the Topiary, the Dolphin Sculpture, the Spring, the Hedge Maze, the Gazebo, the Shell Garden, the Baths, the Stone Circle and the Fish Pond.   @PRecreational Areas do not need to be built along a road. Build them by selecting the Aesthetics Tab and clicking the Recreational Areas button. Then, choose the Recreational Area you'd like to build from the list provided.
text: @P休息區可以改善城市的 @119環境 。 @P休息區有幾種類型。長凳是小型，中型的是花園和露臺，大型是曲徑，魚塘是巨型。  @P要建造休息區，選擇環境標簽，點擊'休息區'，選擇要建造的類型。休息區不需要建在路邊。

original: Graceful Columns and Archways increase the @119appeal of any neighborhood. @PTo build a Column, first select the Aesthetics Tab and then click the Beautification button. Then, select the type of Column you'd like to place from the list provided. Point to where you would like the Column to appear, and click to place it. Columns do not need to be built along a road. An archway forms when Columns are placed next to each other. @PYou can choose from three types of column: Corinthian, Doric and Ionic.
text: @P圓柱會改善附近的 @119環境 。 @P要建造圓柱，選擇環境標簽，點擊'美化'，選擇要建造的類型。圓柱不需要建在路邊。 @P圓柱有三種：科林斯式、多利安式和埃爾尼克式。

original: Commemorative Monuments are awarded when you or your citizens do something noteworthy. A @87message will notify you when you can build a Commemorative Monument. @PWhen a Commemorative Monument is available for placement, you will see the Commemorative Monument button when you click on the Aesthetics Tab. Commemorative Monuments are donated to the city by some of the wealthier residents or other parties, so the you incur no expense when building them. Commemorative Monuments increase the @119appeal of their surroundings and do not need access to a road. @PThere are several different types of Commemorative Monument, and each celebrates a particular achievement. If your philosophers win the Isthmian Games or your actors win the Pythian Games, you'll be able to build a Scholar Monument. You'll be able to build an Athlete Monument if your city wins the Nemean or Olympian Games. @PYou'll also be awarded a Commemorative Monument when you make your mark in the world. After you successfully found a colony, you'll be able to build a Colony Monument when you return to your home city. If you conquer another city, you'll receive the Conquest Monument. And, if you form a new alliance with another city, you'll be awarded the Diplomacy Monument. @PSignificant achievements attained on your home soil are not ignored. If you win a significant victory at home, fending off an enemy attack, you'll earn a Victory Monument. As your city grows and attains certain population milestones, you'll be able to build a Population Monument. And, if your citizens are happy with you for a long period of time, you'll be awarded a Happiness Monument. @PFinally, you will be rewarded with a Commemorative Monument for successfully interacting with gods and heroes. If a hero slays a monster on your city's soil, you'll be able to build a Hero Monument. And, if you successfully complete a quest on behalf of a god, you will be able to build a God Monument. The size of the God Monument you'll get to build depends on the magnitude of the deed you complete for the god. @PTo see how many Commemorative Monuments you have in your city, click on the Aesthetics Tab. You'll see all of the city's Commemorative Monuments listed.
text: @P當你完成了某項事跡後，會收到讓你建造紀念碑的 @87消息 。 @P你可以建造紀念碑的時候，環境標簽裡會出現一個紀念碑選項。紀念碑是由富人們捐款的，所以不花費你的錢，它可以改善附近的 @119環境 ，而且不需要建在路邊。 @P紀念碑有多種類型，每種紀念碑紀念一個事跡。如果你的學者贏得了埃斯米亞競賽或者演員贏得了普西恩競賽，你就可以建造學者紀念碑；如果運動員贏得了納米爾競賽或者奧林匹克競賽，你就可以建造運動員紀念碑。 @P當你建立新的殖民地時，你可以建造殖民地紀念碑；如果你征服了另一座城市，可以建造征服紀念碑；如果你和其它城市結盟，可以建造外交紀念碑。 @P如果你在戰鬥中獲得了輝煌的勝利，就可以建造勝利紀念碑；如果城市人口達到一定數量，就可以建造人口紀念碑；如果你的人民在很長一段時間內都擁護你，就可以建造喜慶紀念碑。 @P如果一個英雄在你的領地上殺死了怪物，你就可以建造英雄紀念碑；如果你完成了神明交給你的任務，就可以建造神明紀念碑，紀念碑的大小決定於任務完成的程度。 @P你可以點擊環境標簽看看城市裡有多少紀念碑。

original: The Palace is among the most important buildings in any city. Without it, you cannot raise your citizen army nor can you collect taxes. Each city can have only one Palace. @PTo build a Palace, click on the Administration Tab, and then click on the Palace button. A red footprint of the Palace will appear. You can rotate the footprint by pressing the 'r' key. Point to the spot in your city where you would like to build your Palace. If the red footprint turns green, you can click it into place. If the footprint stays red, something is obstructing it. You can try clearing the obstruction with the shovel accessed by means of the @86clear&button. Make sure to build the Palace along a road. @POnce the Palace is placed, you can also collect taxes.  In order to actually collect taxes, however, you'll need to build @26Tax&Offices.  @PYou'll also be able to call the city's resident soldiers to arms after you've built a Palace. As soon as your city has some companies of soldiers, you'll see their standards placed around the Palace. You can tell what types of companies they are by looking at the symbol on the top of each standard. A @104rabble company's standard features a fist gripping a rock. The @105hoplites' standard is topped with a helmet, and the @106horsemen's standard is topped with a horse.  @PIn addition, the city's @31Towers cannot be manned, unless there is a Palace in the city. Towers must also be connected to the Palace by a road in order to function. In Greece, @32Trireme&Wharves cannot build triremes without a Palace, and in Atlantis, @143Frigate&Wharves cannot build frigates. @PEveryone likes to live near the Palace, which increases the appeal of the surrounding neighborhood.
text: @P每個城市只能建造一所宮殿，它是城市裡最重要的建築之一。如果沒有宮殿，你就無法指揮軍隊，也無法收稅。 @P要建造宮殿，進入管理標簽，點擊'宮殿'的按鈕，然後選擇建造地點，你可以用R建來旋轉。如果出現紅色，你就需要用 @86消除 功能中的鏟子把附近的東西清理掉。宮殿要建造在道路邊。  @P宮殿建成後你就可以收稅了，不過先要建造 @26稅務所 。 @P宮殿建成後，各支部隊的旗幟就會出現在宮殿周圍，你可以根據旗幟來判斷這是什麼類型的部隊。 @104民兵 部隊的旗幟上有一只握住石頭的手。 @105步兵 的旗幟上有個頭盔。 @106騎兵 的旗幟上有匹馬。  @P建成宮殿後，你還可以控制 @31塔樓 ，並且讓 @32三層船碼頭 開始建造戰艦。塔樓必須以道路和宮殿相連。 @P宮殿可以改善附近的環境。

original: Superintendents from the Maintenance Office help to prevent buildings from catching fire or collapsing. @PTo build a Maintenance Office, select the @80Hygiene&and&Safety&Tab and click on the Maintenance Office button. Maintenance Offices must be built along a road. @POnce a Maintenance Office is operational, it will send out superintendents to keep nearby buildings safe. As a superintendent passes by a building, he checks it for fire hazards and structural damage. @PTo see your superintendents at work, click on the 'See Hazards' button on the Hygiene and Safety Tab. You'll see the city's superintendents walking through the streets. You'll also see columns on the buildings indicating how likely it is to collapse or catch fire. The higher the column, the higher the probability that the building will be damaged. As the superintendent passes by buildings, this column will shrink. If you notice particular buildings in your city seem prone to hazards, you might want to build additional Maintenance Offices in the area.
text: @P維修所的管理員可以防止房屋著火或倒塌。 @P要建造維修所，選擇 @80衛生與安全標簽 ，點擊'維修所'按鈕。維修所必須建在道路邊。 @P維修所建成後，會有管理員開始查看房屋，消除火災隱患以及修補房屋。 @P要查看險情，在衛生與安全標簽中點擊'查看險情'，你還可以根據房屋邊的圓柱查看發生險情的可能，圓柱越高，發生險情的可能性越大，而被管理員查看後圓柱會降低。

original: Clerks from the Tax Office circulate through the streets collecting tax money from the city's residents. @PTo collect taxes, you must first have a functioning @24Palace in the city. Then, click on the Administration Tab and choose the Tax Office button. The Tax Office must be built upon clear land and be built along a road. @POnce there is a Palace in the city and the Tax Office is placed, clerks begin to go door-to-door collecting taxes. To see where your clerks are and which houses have paid taxes, click on the 'See Taxes' button on the Administration tab. The housing in your city will be replaced with columns indicating how frequently they are passed by a clerk. The higher the column, the more often the clerk passes. You'll also see a stack of coins in front of each house, which indicates how much its residents have contributed to your coffers for the year. @PTo set the tax rate, click on the Administration Tab and use the scroll buttons underneath 'Tax Rate' to change the rate. You can also set a tax rate by right-clicking on the Tax Office. @PFor more on taxes in Zeus, click @120here.
text: @P稅務所的稅務官會為你收稅。 @P要收稅時，你先得建造 @24宮殿 ，然後在管理標簽中選擇建造稅務所。稅務所必須建在空地上，而且要在道路邊。 @P此時稅務官會開始收稅，你可以點擊管理標簽中的'查看稅收'，房屋邊的圓柱高，代表剛收過稅。此外，房屋前的金幣圖案代表居民們給你的捐款。 @P要調整稅率，進入管理標簽調節'稅率'下的滾動條，或者在稅務所上點擊右鍵。 @P更多信息，請點擊 @120此處 。

original: Watchmen from the Watchpost patrol the city's streets, keeping @123unrest in check. @PTo build a Watchpost, click on the @80Hygiene&and&Safety&Tab and then click on the Watchpost button. Then, point to the spot in your city where you want the Watchpost. The building must be built along a road. @POnce the Watchpost is working, it will begin sending watchmen out on patrol. As watchmen pass by housing, they reduce the chance that any of the houses' residents will become @123outlaws. @PYou can see your watchmen at work by clicking on the 'See Unrest' button in the Hygiene and Safety Tab. You'll see your watchmen, along with the city's noblemen and any outlaws. You'll also see columns on some houses indicating the degree of unrest among its residents. The higher the column, the higher the chance that an outlaw will emerge from the house and hit the city's streets. @PIf a watchman runs across an outlaw, the watchman will promptly apprehend the villain and remove him from the city's streets. Watchmen will also attack invaders that come into the city, but the lightly armed watchman is usually ineffectual against an organized, trained army.
text: @P了望臺裡的督察官會維持城市的 @123治安 。 @P要建造了望臺，點擊 @80衛生與安全標簽 中的'了望臺'按鈕。了望臺必須建造在道路邊。 @P了望臺建成後，督察官會四處巡查，以防 @123罪犯 的出現。 @P你可以按衛生與安全標簽中的'查看治安'查看治安情況，房屋邊的圓柱越高，代表出現罪犯的可能性越高。 @P督察官如果在街上看到罪犯，就會處罰他們。此外，他也會攻擊入侵者，但是他的攻擊力比較低。

original: Areas of land separated by water can be linked together with a Water Crossing. @PTo build a Water Crossing, click on the Administration Tab and choose Water Crossing. A red footprint of the two ends of the Water Crossing will appear. To successfully span an area of water, both ends of the Water Crossing must be on straight pieces of coast. You'll know when you've picked an appropriate spot when you see a green ghost of the Water Crossing.  There are large and small Water Crossings; the city's architects will automatically choose the appropriate size for the distance being spanned. @PYou cannot build two Water Crossings directly next to each other.
text: @P浮橋可以連接河的兩岸。 @P要建造浮橋，進入管理標籤選擇'浮橋'。浮橋的兩邊都必須是河岸，你在選擇位置時它會自動調整。 @P你不能把兩座浮橋靠在一起。

original: Farms provide food for the city's people and horses. There are Wheat, Carrot and Onion Farms, but not all areas of Greece can support all three types of crops. @PTo plant a Farm, select the Husbandry Tab and click on the Farm button. Choose a Farm from the list presented, and a red footprint of the Farm will appear. All Farms must be built in meadowland, which are denoted by purple flowers. Guide your mouse to a meadow, and when you see a green ghost of the Farm, click to place it. Farms must be built along a road. @PCarrot and Onion Farms provide food suitable for consumption by your citizens, and for exportation. When the Farm has been harvested, a deliveryman will bring the harvest to a @9Granary or to a @11Trading&Post or @12Pier if you are exporting the food. If you are exporting food, the deliveryman will first try to bring his load to a trading facility before he brings it to a Granary.  @PIn addition to providing food for people, Wheat Farms also provide fodder for horses in a @34Horse&Ranch. If you have a Horse Ranch in the city, the Wheat Farm's deliveryman will try to bring his load of wheat there first. If you are exporting wheat, his next stop will be a trading facility. His last choice is a Granary. @PMake sure Farms are connected to a Granary, Horse Ranch, Pier or Trading post - whatever the food's final destination is - by a road. Otherwise, the Farms' deliverymen will stand around, dumbfounded, because they cannot get to the place the food needs to go.
text: @P農場為人們提供食物。遊戲中有小麥農場、洋蔥農場和胡蘿卜農場，不過並非所有的地方都能種植這些農作物。 @P要建造農場，點擊農業標簽中的'農場'按鈕，農場必須建在草地上，草地以紫色的花表示。農場要建在道路邊。 @P胡蘿卜和洋蔥除了可以作為人們的糧食，還可以出口。送貨工會把農作物送進 @9糧倉 ，如果要出口，則送進 @11貿易站 或 @12貿易港 。  @P除了作為口糧，小麥還可以作為 @34馬場 的馬匹的飼料。如果你的城裡有馬場，送貨工會優先把小麥送入馬場，如果你要出口小麥，他就會把小麥送進貿易站或貿易港，如果以上這些地方都不能送，他就會把小麥送進糧倉。 @P請確保農場有道路和糧倉、馬場、貿易港或貿易站連接。

original: Roadblocks help guide the city's roaming @91walkers. @PTo build a Roadblock, click the Roadblocks button, which is always available next to the Build Roads button on the Control Panel. Roadblocks must be placed directly over @5roads. You'll know when you've picked a good spot when you see a green ghost of the Roadblock. @PRoaming walkers such as noblemen, peddlers, water bearers, healers, watchmen, superintendents, athletes and clerks have no way of knowing where you want them to go, but they can be guided with Roadblocks. When they encounter a Roadblock, they turn around.  @PRead the help entry for @91walkers to learn the difference between roaming walkers and walkers with a specific destination in mind.  @PIt's usually a good idea to separate the industrial sectors of your city from your residential neighborhoods with Roadblocks. That way, roaming walkers who provide services to the city's housing won't go wandering off into an industrial sector where they provide no benefit. Just be sure to build Maintenance Offices in your industrial sectors to make sure that your industries don't collapse or catch fire.
text: @P路障用來指引 @91行人 。 @P要放置路障，點擊控制面板中的'路障'按鈕。路障必須放在 @5道路 上。 @P貴族、挑水工、醫師、管理員、運動員、商販、督察官和稅務官等看到路障就會改變行進的方向。  @P你可以參見 @91行人 這一節。  @P路障是非常有用的，例如，如果你把生活區和工業區隔開，那麼在生活區工作的人就不會因為跑到工業區而無所事事了。

original: Fortifications help to defend the city from invading forces. The three types of Fortification are the Wall, the Tower and the Gatehouse. @L@LWALL @PWalls are the most basic line of defense. To build a Wall, select the Military Tab, then click on the Fortifications button. From the list that appears, choose Wall. Then, click on the location in your city where you want to build a Wall. You can build a large stretch of Wall at one time by clicking and dragging your mouse. You can build Walls as thick or as thin as you like. Walls do not need to be built along a road. @L@LGATEHOUSE @POf course, you can't completely encircle your city with Walls, otherwise immigrants and trade caravans couldn't get in, and emigrants couldn't get out. Gatehouses allow people whose intentions are good to enter and leave the city. To build a Gatehouse, select it from the list that appears when you click the Fortifications button. Then, center the Gatehouse over a road. You might need to press the 'r' button to rotate the Gatehouse so that it is facing the direction you want. When you've positioned the Gatehouse where you want it, and when the red footprint has turned into a green ghost of the Gatehouse, click to put in place. In order for a Gatehouse to be effective, make sure Walls connect to both ends. @91Walkers who roam the city will turn around when they encounter a Gatehouse, but walkers with a specific destination will pass through. @L@LTOWER @PTowers bring a little offense to your defensive Fortifications. Towers must be built on Walls that are at least double-thickness. In addition, Towers must be built along a road to find guards to man them, and they also must be connected to the @24Palace by a road. In fact, before you can even man a Tower, you must have a Palace in the city.  @PTo man the city's Towers, click on the Military Tab. On the Control Panel, you'll see a small icon of a pair of Towers. Next to this icon is a button that reads 'Not Manning.' Click on this button, and the Towers in your city will be manned with archers, provided that the Towers have access to the Palace via a road. Click on the button again to send the sentries back home. @PIn Greece, Tower archers will fire arrows at any invaders that come close to their Tower. Wall sentries will emerge from Towers to patrol the adjacent Walls, provided these Walls are at least double-thickness. @PIn Atlantis, Towers equipped with @127orichalc can launch Atlantean Fire, which burns its target upon contact. A Tower that launches Atlantean Fire is stronger than one that does not. Towers armed with this deadly weapon are decorated with orichalc.
text: @P防御設施包括城墻、塔樓和門樓。 @L@L城墻 @P要建造城墻，在軍事標簽中的'防御設施'中選擇城墻。你可以用拖放鼠標的方式一次建造大批城墻，城墻不一定要建在路邊。 @L@L門樓 @P如果你用城墻把城市圍起來，就會妨礙人口和物資的流動，所以你需要建造門樓來進行控制。要建造門樓，在軍事標簽中的'防御設施'中選擇門樓，選擇位置時按R鍵可以旋轉，門樓的兩旁要靠城墻。 @91行人 遇到門樓會返回，但有特殊使命的人會穿過門樓。 @L@L塔樓 @P塔樓必須建在至少雙層厚的城墻上，而且要和道路及 @24宮殿 連接。  @P要讓士兵進入塔樓，可以在軍事標簽的控制面板中找到一個叫'不駐扎士兵'的按鈕，點擊一下後，如果宮殿已經和塔樓相連，弓箭手就會駐扎進塔樓。再點擊一下，他們就會離開。 @P塔樓裡的弓箭手會自動攻擊靠近的敵人。如果城墻有兩層以上厚，士兵還會進行巡邏。

original: Each Trireme Wharf serves an associated @103trireme. @PTo build a Trireme Wharf, select the Military Tab and click on the Military Workshops button. From the list that appears, choose Trireme Wharf. A red footprint of the Trireme Wharf will appear. @PTrireme Wharves must be placed along the water, on a straight section of coastline. Run the red footprint along the coastline until you see a green ghost of the Trireme Wharf. Click to put the building into place. @PIn order for the Trireme Wharf to build a trireme, there must be a @24Palace in the city. The Trireme Wharf must also be built along a road, and have a supply of wood and armor to build a trireme, and outfit its marines. Once these conditions have been satisfied, the Trireme Wharf's workers will build and later man the trireme. @PIt requires a lot of people to build and man a trireme.  If you're not ready to build the trireme yet, because, for example, you lack the necessary wood or armor, you may release the Wharf's workers so that they may be employed by other industries. To do this, right click on the Wharf, then click the 'Send Wharf workers home' button at the bottom of the panel.  To recall the workers to build the trireme, click the same button, which now says, 'Staff this Trireme Wharf'.   @PClick @103here to find out which orders you can give to a trireme.
text: @P每個三層船碼頭停靠一艘 @103三層船 。 @P要建造三層船碼頭，在軍事標簽中的'軍事設施'中選擇'三層船碼頭'。 @P三層船碼頭必須建在岸邊。 @P要讓碼頭建造三層船，你必須建造 @24宮殿 ，而且三層船碼頭要連接道路，這樣它才能夠得到足夠的木材來造船，足夠的盔甲來裝備士兵。 @P建造和駕駛三層船需要許多人力物力，如果你的物資暫時沒有到位，可以讓建造的工人暫時去干其它事情，此時你可以右鍵點擊三層船碼頭，然後點擊'解散工人'，以後可以點擊這個按鈕召回這些工人，此時它叫作'召集工人'。   @P點擊 @103此處 可以看到三層船的相關指令。

original: The Armory produces the armor used by some of your military forces. In Greece, @105hoplites, @106horsemen and @103triremes need armor to function.  In Atlantis, @142spearmen, @142charioteers and @144frigates must be equipped with armor. @PTo build an Armory, select the Military Tab and then click on the Military Workshops button. From the list that appears, choose Armory. @PArmories must be built on clear land and be built along a road. They also need a supply of bronze from a @43Foundry, @10Storehouse, @11Trading&Post or @12Pier to make armor. Make sure that the Armory is connected by a road to its supply of bronze. @POnce the Armory has finished making a suit of armor, a deliveryman from the Armory will first try to find a wharf that needs it. If you are ruling in Greece, the deliveryman looks for a @32Trireme&Wharf. If Atlantis is your home, the deliveryman looks for a @143Frigate&Wharf. If he can't find a wharf, he'll bring it to a Trading Post or Pier that is exporting armor. If there are none, then he'll bring it to a Storehouse, where arms vendors pick up the armor and bring it back to the Agora for distribution through the city's neighborhoods. Make sure that the Armory is connected by a road to the one of the deliveryman's destinations.
text: @P防具鋪生產 @105步兵 、 @106騎兵 和 @103三層船 所需要的盔甲。 @P要建造防具鋪，在軍事標簽中的'軍事設施'中選擇'防具鋪'。 @P防具鋪必須建造在空地上，而且要通過道路連接 @43鑄造場 、 @10貨棧 、 @11貿易站 或者 @12貿易港 以得到青銅。 @P當防具鋪打造好盔甲後，送貨工會優先把它送進 @32三層船碼頭 ，如果那兒不需要，則送進準備出口的貿易站或貿易港，如果那裡也不需要，就送進貨棧，以後在市場上出售。防具鋪至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。

original: The Horse Ranch raises the livestock used by the Greek city's horsemen in battle. In Atlantis, the Horse Ranch provides the animal that will pull mighty war @141chariots and race at the @139Hippodrome. @PTo build a Horse Ranch, select the Military Tab, and click the Military Workshops button. Then, select Horse Ranch from the list that appears. You can rotate the Horse Ranch by pressing the 'r' key. @PThe Horse Ranch must be built on clear land and have access to a road in order to function. It also needs a supply of wheat from a @29Wheat&Farm, @10Storehouse, @11Trading&Post or @12Pier to feed its livestock. The Horse Ranch cannot receive wheat from a Granary.  Make sure that the Horse Ranch is connected by a road to its supply of wheat. @PWhen horses are fully grown, the building that needs the animal will send someone to the Horse Ranch to pick them up.  In Greece, a horse trainer from an @8Agora leads horses back to his stall for distribution to @7elite&housing. In Atlantis, a chariot hostler from a Chariot Factory will retrieve the horses the Factory needs, and a handler from the Hippodrome will fetch the animals to race.  @PMake sure that the Horse Ranch is connected by a road to the horses' destination. Otherwise the horse trainer, chariot hostler or handler won't be able to reach the Horse Ranch.
text: @P馬場為騎兵提供馬匹。 @P要建造馬場，在軍事標簽中的'軍事設施'中選擇'馬場'。 @P馬場必須建造在空地上，而且要連接道路。此外，它還要連接 @29小麥農場 、 @10貨棧 、 @11貿易站 或者 @12貿易港 以得到小麥。馬場不能從糧倉得到小麥。 @P馬成年之後， @8市場 裡會有商販把馬賣給 @7高級住宅 的居民讓他們成為騎兵。記住，馬場要和市場以道路相連。

original: Olive Trees produce olives from which olive oil may be obtained with an @46Olive&Press. @PTo plant an Olive Tree, select the Husbandry Tab and click the Orchards button. From the list that appears, choose Olive Tree. Olive Trees must be placed on a purple-tufted meadowland. Olive Trees do not need to be next to a road. @POnce some trees are planted, you'll need a @37Growers'&Lodge to dispatch growers to prune the trees and harvest the olives. Olive Trees grow the quickest when they are frequently tended by growers. Olives are harvested in January and February.
text: @P橄欖樹的橄欖經過 @46油坊 加工後就變成了橄欖油。 @P要種植橄欖樹，在農業標簽的'果園'中點擊'橄欖樹'。橄欖樹必須建在草地上，不一定要在路邊。 @P橄欖樹種植好後，你需要建造 @37園丁小屋 ，讓園丁栽培和採摘橄欖。橄欖在一月和二月採摘。

original: Grapes can be turned into wine at a @47Winery, and are grown on Grapevines. @PTo plant a Grapevine, select the Husbandry Tab and click on the Orchards button. From the list that appears, choose Grapevine. Grapevines must be planted in meadows, which you can identify by their purple flowers. Grapevines do not need access to a road. @PTo maintain the Grapevine and harvest grapes, you'll need a @37Growers'&Lodge. The Growers' Lodge sends out growers that care for the Grapevines and harvest them when the time comes. Grapevines that are frequently maintained by growers ripen the quickest. Grapevines are harvested in October and November.
text: @P葡萄藤上種植出的葡萄可以在 @47酒坊 裡釀成酒。 @P要種植葡萄藤，在農業標簽的'果園'中點擊'葡萄藤'。葡萄藤必須建在草地上，不一定要在路邊。 @P葡萄藤種植好後，你需要建造 @37園丁小屋 ，讓園丁栽培和採摘葡萄。葡萄在十月和十一月採摘。

original: Growers from the Growers' Lodge tend to the city's @36Grapevines and @35Olive&Trees.  @PTo build a Growers' Lodge, select the Husbandry Tab, and click on the Orchards button. Choose Growers' Lodge from the list provided. The Growers' Lodge must be placed on clear land and needs to be built along a road in order to operate. It can be placed on any buildable land and does not need to be placed on meadow.  @POnce the Growers' Lodge has employees, growers will go out to the city's Grapevines and Olive Trees to prune and maintain them. When harvest time comes, a team of growers will pick the ripe fruit and bring it back to the Lodge. @PAt the Lodge, the fruit is prepared for use. Once a load of olives is ready, the Lodge's deliveryman will first seek out an @46Olive&Press that needs olives. If he can't find one, he'll look for a @12Pier or @11Trading&Post that is exporting the item. Finally, he'll look for a @10Storehouse that is accepting the item. Make sure that the Growers' Lodge is connected to one of these destinations by a road or else the deliveryman won't be able to move. @PSimilarly, when a load of grapes is ready, the deliveryman will first look for a @47Winery that needs grapes. If there are none in the city, he'll then try to find a Trading Post or Pier that is exporting the item. If that fails, he'll look for a Storehouse that can accept the grapes. Again, the Growers' Lodge must be connected to the grapes' destination by a road.
text: @P園丁會栽培和種植 @36葡萄藤 和 @35橄欖樹 。  @P要建造園丁小屋，在農業標簽的'果園'中點擊'園丁小屋'。園丁小屋可以建在任何空地上，但是要連接道路。  @P園丁小屋建成後，園丁就會栽培葡萄或橄欖，在收獲季節他們就會進行採摘。 @P當他們的小屋裝滿橄欖後，送貨工會把它們送到需要橄欖的 @46油坊 ，如果那兒不需要，則送進準備出口的貿易站或貿易港，如果那裡也不需要，就送進貨棧。園丁小屋至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @P當他們的小屋裝滿葡萄後，送貨工會把它們送到需要葡萄的 @47酒坊 ，如果那兒不需要，則送進準備出口的貿易站或貿易港，如果那裡也不需要，就送進貨棧。園丁小屋至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。

original: Fisheries and Urchin Quays provide seafood to the city's residents. @L@LFISHERY @PTo build a Fishery, select the Husbandry Tab, and choose the Land and Sea button. From the list that pops up, choose Fishery. You'll see a red footprint of the building. @PFisheries must be placed on clear land along a straight section of coastline. When you've found a valid location, you'll see a green ghost of the Fishery. Click the mouse button to set the Fishery in place. A Fishery needs to be built along a road. @PMake sure that the Fishery has unblocked access to deep water, or fishing boats will not reach the fishing grounds. If the Fishery is placed along a narrow strait, the fishing boat might not be able to get to the fishing grounds. @PThe workers at the Fishery first build a boat from whatever supplies they have on hand. Once the boat is done, it sets sail looking for fish. You can see schools of fish in the water, darting about. Once the fisherman has hauled in the catch, he brings it back to the Fishery where it is prepared for use. Once it's ready, the Fishery's deliveryman will bring the fish to where it needs to go. If you are exporting fish, the Deliveryman will seek out the appropriate @12Pier or @11Trading&Post. If you are not exporting fish, or if the Pier or Trading&Post is not accepting any more, the deliveryman will bring the fish to a @9Granary. Make sure that the Fishery is connected by a road to the fish's final destination. @L@LURCHIN QUAY @PTo build an Urchin Quay, select the Husbandry Tab, and then click on the Land and Sea button. Select Urchin Quay from the list that appears, and you'll see a red footprint of the building. @PWhen building an Urchin Quay, keep in mind that the Quay's waders cannot cross deep sections of water. They must be able to trace a path along the shoreline to the urchin beds. You can spot the urchin beds - they make little ripples in the water. In addition, an Urchin Quay must be built on clear land along a straight section of coastline. When you've found a suitable coastline location, the red footprint will turn into a green ghost of the Quay. Be warned, though, that just because you can place an Urchin Quay in a particular location does not mean that its workers will be able to get to the urchins. An Urchin Quay also needs to be built along a road. @POnce the Urchin Quay is operational, waders head out to the urchin beds to harvest the sea creatures. Workers at the Urchin Quay prepare the urchins for use and load them in the deliveryman's cart. The Deliveryman will then bring the urchins to where they need to go, provided that the destination is connected to the Urchin Quay by a road. If you are exporting the good, the deliveryman will seek out the appropriate Trading Post or Pier and drop off the urchins. If you are not exporting the item, or if the Trading Post or Pier cannot accept any more of the item, the deliveryman will bring the urchins to a Granary.
text: @P漁場和海膽加工場為城市提供海產。 @L@L漁場 @P要建造漁場，點擊農業標簽中的'陸地和海洋'按鈕，然後選擇'漁場'。 @P漁場必須建在岸邊，而且要連接道路。 @P你要確保漁場的漁船能接近魚群，如果你把漁場建在狹窄的水道裡，漁船可能開不出去。 @P漁場建成後，工人們會建造漁船，漁船會出海打漁並帶回海產。送貨工會把海產送進準備出口的 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 ，如果那裡不需要，就送進 @9糧倉 。漁場至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @L@L海膽加工場 @P要建造海膽加工場，點擊農業標簽中的'陸地和海洋'按鈕，然後選擇'海膽加工場'。 @P海膽加工場要建在岸邊，你可以在畫面上看到海膽，它們的所在水域會有漣漪。海膽加工場要和道路相連。 @P海膽加工場建成後，漁船會出海打撈海膽並且帶回海膽加工場。送貨工會把海膽送進準備出口的貿易港或貿易站，如果那裡不需要，就送進糧倉。海膽加工場至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。

original: Shepherds from the Carding Shed tend your flocks of @95sheep. @PTo build a Carding Shed, select the Husbandry Tab, and click on the Herding button. From the list that appears, select Carding Shed. A Carding Shed must be placed on clear land and be built along a road. You do not need to place a Carding Shed on a meadow. @POnce the Carding Shed has employees, shepherds go out and guard the flock. When the time comes, a shepherd will shear fleece from the sheep and bring it back to the Carding Shed. At the Carding Shed, the fleece is prepared for use and loaded into the deliveryman's cart. @POnce the deliveryman has a full cartload of fleece, he looks for a building that is accepting the fleece. If you are exporting fleece, the deliveryman first looks for a @11Trading&Post or @12Pier that is accepting the item. If you are not exporting fleece, or if a Trading Post or Pier is not accepting any more of it, the deliveryman will bring the fleece to a @10Storehouse. Make sure that the Carding Shed is connected by a road to the fleece's final destination. @POnce it is in a Storehouse, a fleece vendor picks up the item and brings it back to the @8Agora for distribution to the city's housing.
text: @P羊毛場的牧羊人會飼養 @95綿羊 。 @P要建造羊毛場，選擇農業標簽中的'牧場'，然後點擊'羊毛場'。羊毛場不一定要建在草地上，但要建在空地上而且和道路相連。 @P羊毛場的牧羊人會飼養綿羊並且剪羊毛。 @P送貨工會把羊毛送進準備出口的 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 ，如果那裡不需要，就送進 @10貨棧 。羊毛場至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @P羊毛商販會把貨棧的羊毛送進 @8市場 。

original: Goatherds from the Dairy milk @95goats and make cheese for the city's residents, or for exportation. @PTo build a Dairy, select the Husbandry Tab, and click on the Herding button. Choose Dairy from the list provided, and a red footprint of the building will appear. You can build the Dairy on any clear, buildable land. It does not have to be in a meadow. Make sure to place the Dairy along a road so that it functions properly. @POnce the Dairy has workers, it sends out goatherds to tend to the goats. When the goats are ready to give milk, the goatherds milk them and bring the milk back to the Dairy. Workers at the Dairy use the milk to make cheese, then load the wheels of cheese into the deliveryman's cart. @POnce the deliveryman has a full load in his cart, he looks for a place that will accept the cheese. The deliveryman's destination must be connected to the Dairy by a road. If you are exporting cheese, he will look for the appropriate @12Pier or @11Trading&Post. If you are not exporting cheese, or if a Pier or Trading Post is not accepting any more of the item, the deliveryman will bring the cheese to a @9Granary. A food vendor will pick up cheese from a Granary and bring it back to the @8Agora so that the peddlers can distribute it to housing.
text: @P奶品場的牧羊人會擠 @95山羊 的奶，然後制成奶酪。 @P要建造奶品場，選擇農業標簽中的'牧場'，然後點擊'奶品場'。奶品場不一定要建在草地上，但要建在空地上而且和道路相連。 @P擠完山羊的奶後，工人們會把它制成奶酪。 @P送貨工會把奶酪送進準備出口的 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 ，如果那裡不需要，就送進 @9糧倉 。商販會把糧倉的奶酪送進 @8市場 。奶品場至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。

original: Lumberjacks at the Timber Mill cut down trees and hew them into planks. Wood is used to build @32triremes and @143frigates and is also needed to build @110Sanctuaries, @73Pyramids&and&other&monumental&structures. @PTo build a Timber Mill, select the Industry Tab, and click on the Raw Materials button. From the list that pops up, choose Timber Mill. A Timber Mill must be built on clear land and have access to a road in order to access the city's labor pool. The Timber Mill does not need to be near the forest, but the closer the Timber Mill is to the trees, the more efficient it will be.  @PMake sure the lumberjacks from the Timber Mill can get to the forest. Lumberjacks do not need roads to get to the forest, but if there is an unbridged body of water or other impassable terrain separating the Timber Mill from the forest, they will not be able to do their jobs.  @POnce the Timber Mill is working and the lumberjacks have brought the rough timber back from the forest, workers at the Timber Mill will cut planks from the logs and load them on to a cart.  @POnce the cart is full of planks, the deliveryman will look for a place to bring the wood. If you are ruling in Greece, he will look for a Trireme Wharf that needs the wood to build a ship. If Atlantis is your home, then he will look for a Frigate Wharf that needs wood. If you are exporting wood, he then looks for a @12Pier or @11Trading&Post that is accepting wood. If you are not exporting wood, or if no trade facility can accept the wood, the ox cart driver will try to deliver the wood to a @10Storehouse. Make sure that the Timber Mill is connected by a road to the wood's final destination. Otherwise, the deliveryman will stand still, searching in vain for a place to deliver the wood.
text: @P伐木場為你提供木材，木材用來建造 @32三層船碼頭 和 @110聖所 。 @P要建造伐木場，選擇工業標簽的'原材料'按鈕，然後點擊'伐木場'。伐木場要建在空地上而且和道路相連。伐木場不一定要建在森林邊，但它離森林越近，效率越高。  @P雖然伐木工不一定要從道路到達森林，但是如果路上有障礙，他們就會無法到達森林。  @P伐木工會把砍伐的木材帶回伐木場並送上牛車。  @P牛車會把木材送進準備出口的 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 ，如果那裡不需要，就送進 @10貨棧 。伐木場至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。

original: Workers from the Masonry Shop turn massive blocks of marble into manageable slabs, which are then used to construct @110Sanctuaries, @73Pyramids&and&other&major&buildings, or sold as an exported good. @PTo build a Masonry Shop, choose the Industry Tab, and click on the Raw Materials button. From the list provided, choose Masonry Shop. The Masonry Shop must be built on clear land and along a road.  @POnce the Masonry Shop receives employees, it sends out a team of stonecutters to the quarry site. A quarry looks like a large, flat whitish-gray rock.  As the stonecutters hew stone from the quarry, a pit will form.  Once the stonecutters pry out a huge block of marble, it is brought back to the Masonry Shop.  @PAt the Masonry Shop, workers chisel out usable slabs of marble from the rough block. Once a slab is ready, it is loaded onto a cart. If you are exporting marble, the deliveryman will look for a @11Trading&Post or @12Pier that is accepting the material. If you are not trading marble, or if no trade facilities can accept it, the deliveryman will bring the marble to a @10Storehouse.  @PThough not absolutely necessary, it's a good idea to place the Masonry Shop near the quarry site. The closer the Masonry Shop is to the quarry, the more efficient the quarrying process will be. @PThe Lodge's cart never delivers marble directly to a construction site. If artisans needs marble, deliverymen from the Storehouse will bring the material to the construction site.
text: @P石料加工廠的工人采集大理石，用來建造 @110聖所 或者出口。 @P要建造石料加工廠，選擇工業標簽的'原材料'按鈕，然後點擊'石料加工廠'。石料加工廠要建在空地上而且和道路相連。  @P石料加工廠的工人會到採石場采集大理石，帶回石料加工廠加工後送上牛車。  @P牛車會把大理石送進準備出口的 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 ，如果那裡不需要，就送進 @10貨棧 。  @P石料加工廠不一定要建在採石場邊，但它離採石場越近，效率越高。 @P要建造聖所時，送貨工會從貨棧搬運石料到建築場地。

original: At the Foundry, copper ore is smelted into bronze ingots, which are used by the @48Sculpture&Studio and @33Armory. Bronze can also be exported. @PTo build a Foundry, select the Industry Tab, and then click on the Raw Materials button. From the list provided, choose Foundry. The Foundry must be built on clear land and along a road. It is also a good idea to build the Foundry near a source of copper. You can see the copper ore, which looks like little copper nuggets, lying amongst rocks. The closer the Foundry is to the copper, the more efficient the Foundry will be. @POnce the Foundry has employees, it sends copper miners out to retrieve some copper ore. The copper miners return to the Foundry with the copper, where it is smelted, and alloyed with readily available tin, to make bronze. As the bronze is produced, it is loaded into a deliveryman's cart. @POnce the deliveryman has a full cart of bronze, he looks for a place that can accept it. He first checks to see if there are any Sculpture Studios or Armories that need the supply in the city. If there are none, and if you are exporting bronze, he will then look for a @11Trading&Post or @12Pier that is accepting the material. If you are not exporting the material, or if there are no trading facilities that can accept the bronze, he'll bring it to a @10Storehouse that can accept it. Make sure that the Foundry is connected by a road to the bronze's final destination.
text: @P鑄造場把銅礦鑄造成青銅，供 @48鑄像場 和 @33防具鋪 使用或者出口。 @P要建造鑄造場，選擇工業標簽的'原材料'按鈕，然後點擊'鑄造場'。鑄造場要建在空地上而且和道路相連。此外，鑄造場離銅礦越近效率越高。 @P工人開采銅礦後帶回鑄造場把它們冶煉成青銅。 @P送貨工會把青銅送進準備出口的 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 ，如果那裡不需要，就送進 @10貨棧 。鑄造場至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。

original: At the Mint, silver ore is smelted and used to strike coins, called drachmas, which are then added to your treasury. @PTo build a Mint, select the Industry Tab, and click on the Raw Materials button. Choose Mint from the list that appears. @PA Mint must be built on clear land and along a road. It is also a good idea to build the Mint relatively close to the source of silver ore. You can see the silver ore, which looks like little silver nuggets, lying amongst rocks. @POnce the Mint has employees, it sends out miners to harvest the silver ore and bring it back to the Mint. At the Mint, coins are struck. When the workers are finished, the drachmas will be added to your treasury.
text: @P鑄幣場可以把銀礦鑄造成銀幣。 @P要建造鑄幣場，選擇工業標籤的'原材料'按鈕，然後點擊'鑄幣場'。 @P鑄幣場要建在空地上而且和道路相連。此外，鑄幣場離銀礦越近效率越高。銀礦在畫面上以一些小塊的銀色石頭表示。 @P工人開採到銀礦後會帶回鑄幣場，鑄造成銀幣後送進國庫。

original: The Artisans' Guild employs skilled artisans who build @110Sanctuaries, @73Pyramids&and&other&large&buildings. @PTo build an Artisans' Guild, choose the Mythology Tab, and then click on the Artisans' Guild button. Artisans' Guilds must be built on clear land and have access to a road. Also, the closer an Artisans' Guild is to a construction site, the more efficient the construction process will be. @POnce the Artisans' Guild has employees, and once a construction project has been sited, the artisans will get to work. Artisans proceed from the Artisans' Guild to the construction site and await the delivery of the materials they need, be it slabs of marble, planks of wood, sculpture or orichalc.  Once enough of the needed material is available in a @10Storehouse, a deliveryman from the Storehouse will transport it to the construction site.  Deliverymen from Trading Posts or Piers importing these items will also bring supplies over to the site.
text: @P工匠行的工匠可以建造 @110聖所 。 @P要建造工匠行，點擊神話標簽中的'工匠行'按鈕。工匠行要建在空地上而且和道路相連。此外，工匠行離聖所的建造地越近效率越高。 @P工匠行建成並且聖所建造地決定後，工匠會到聖所的建造地等待木材、石料和雕塑等原材料。當 @10貨棧 中有這些原材料時，送貨工就會把它們送到聖所建造地。貿易港和貿易站的送貨工業也會把進口的原材料直接送到聖所建造地。

original: @35Olives are crushed into olive oil at the Olive Press. @PTo build an Olive Press, select the Industry Tab, and then click on the Workshops button. From the list that appears, chose Olive Press. @PAn Olive Press must be built over clear land and along a road. It also needs a supply of olives from a @37Growers'&Lodge, @10Storehouse, @12Pier or @11Trading&Post. Make sure that the Olive Press is connected by a road to its source of olives. @POnce the Olive Press has workers and olives, the workers begin the process of making olive oil. After it is poured into jugs, the olive oil is loaded onto a cart. When there is a full cartload, the Olive Press' deliveryman will look for a place that can accept the olive oil. @PIf you are exporting the good, the deliveryman will first try to take the olive oil to a Pier or Trading Post. If you are not exporting olive oil, or if the trading facilities that are exporting it cannot accept any more, the olive oil is taken to a Storehouse. Make sure that the Olive Press is connected by a road to the olive oil's final destination.  @PAn oil vendor will retrieve the oil from the Storehouse and bring it back to the @8Agora. Then, the Agora's peddler will distribute it to houses.
text: @P油坊用 @35橄欖 榨油。 @P要建造油坊，點擊工業標簽中的'工業設施'，然後選擇'油坊'。 @P油坊要建在空地上而且和道路相連，它需要 @37園丁小屋 、 @10貨棧 、 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 提供的橄欖。油坊至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @P從橄欖中榨出橄欖油後，它們會被送上運貨車。 @P送貨工會把橄欖油送進準備出口的貿易港或貿易站，如果那裡不需要，就送進貨棧。油坊至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。  @P商販會把貨棧的橄欖油帶到 @8市場 上販賣。

original: Vintners crush @36grapes into wine at the Winery. @PTo build a Winery, choose the Industry Tab, and click on the Workshops button. Then, choose Winery from the list that appears. @PA Winery must be built on clear land and along a road. It also needs a supply of grapes from a @37Growers'&Lodge, @10Storehouse, @12Pier or @11Trading&Post. Make sure that the Winery is connected by a road to its source of grapes. Once they have everything they need, the Winery's vintners will begin crushing the grapes. @PAs the vintners fill amphorae full of wine, they load the amphorae onto a cart. When there is a full cartload, a deliveryman from the Winery will look for a place to accept the wine. @PIf you are exporting wine, the deliveryman will first look for a Pier or Trading Post that is accepting the good. If you are not exporting wine, or if the trading facilities that are exporting it cannot accept any more, the deliveryman will bring the wine to a @10Storehouse. Make sure the Winery is connected by a road to the wine's final destination. @PA wine vendor will retrieve the wine from the Storehouse and bring it back to the @8Agora. The peddler from the Agora will do his best to make sure that the @7elite&housing demanding wine receives a supply.
text: @P酒坊可以把 @36葡萄 釀成葡萄酒。 @P要建造酒坊，點擊工業標簽中的'工業設施'，然後選擇'酒坊'。 @P酒坊要建在空地上而且和道路相連，它需要 @37園丁小屋 、 @10貨棧 、 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 提供的葡萄。酒坊至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @P釀出葡萄酒後，它們會被送上運貨車。 @P送貨工會把葡萄酒送進準備出口的貿易港或貿易站，如果那裡不需要，就送進 @10貨棧 。酒坊至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @P商販會把貨棧的葡萄酒帶到 @8市場 上販賣給 @7高級住宅 的居民。

original: The Sculpture Studio casts fine bronze sculpture for Sanctuaries and other construction projects, or for exportation. @PTo build a Sculpture Studio, choose the Industry Tab, and click on the Workshops button. Select Sculpture Studio from the list that appears. @PA Sculpture Studio must have access to a road so that it can access the city's labor pool.
