It must also receive a supply of bronze from a @43Foundry, @10Storehouse, @12Pier or @11Trading&Post. Make sure that the Sculpture Studio is connected by a road to its source of bronze. @POnce they have everything they need, the artists at the Sculpture Studio begin fashioning a sculpture. When the sculpture is complete, it is loaded onto a cart. The deliveryman then tries to find a place that can accept the sculpture. The sculpture's destination must be connected by a road to the Studio. @PIf you are exporting sculpture, the deliveryman will first try to bring the work of art to a Trading Post or Pier that is exporting it. If you are not exporting sculpture, or if the exporting trade facility cannot accept any more of it, the deliveryman will bring the sculpture to a Storehouse. @PWhen @45artisans at a construction site are ready to place a piece of sculpture, a deliveryman from a Storehouse will transport the work of art to the artisans. Sculpture is not directly delivered from a Sculpture Studio to a construction site.
text: @P鑄像場建造的雕像可以用來建造聖所或出口。 @P要建造鑄像場，點擊工業標簽中的'工業設施'，然後選擇'鑄像場'。 @P鑄像場要和道路相連，它需要 @43鑄造場 、 @10貨棧 、 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 提供的青銅。鑄像場至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @P當雕像完工後，會被送上牛車。 @P送貨工會把雕像送進準備出口的貿易港或貿易站，如果那裡不需要，就送進貨棧。鑄像場至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @P當建造聖所的 @45工匠 需要雕像時，送貨工會從貨棧運來雕像。

original: Fountains provide clean drinking water to the city's @6common&housing. @PTo build a Fountain, select the Hygiene and Safety Tab, and then click on the Fountain button. A Fountain must be built along a road. @POnce a Fountain is operational, it sends out water bearers to the surrounding area. As the water bearers pass by common housing, they fill each house's cistern with clean water. You can watch your water bearers at work and see how much water each common household has by clicking on the 'See Water' button, on the Hygiene and Safety tab. You'll see the city's water bearers going about their tasks, and you will also see blue columns on the city's housing. If the column is high, then the house's cistern has plenty of water, because it has recently been visited by a water bearer. If the column is low, the house has used up much of the water in its cistern, and has not been passed by a water bearer recently. If a house runs out of clean water, it could devolve into a more primitive domicile.
text: @P噴泉為 @6民房 的居民提供飲水。 @P要建造噴泉，選擇衛生與安全標簽，點擊'噴泉'按鈕，噴泉必須建造在路邊。 @P噴泉造完後，挑水工會把水帶給周圍的居民。你可以點擊'查看飲水'調查居民的飲水情況，房屋前的藍色圓柱越高，居民的飲用水就越多。如果房屋缺少飲用水，就會降級。

original: Healers from an Infirmary help to ensure that your citizens' @118hygiene practices are sound, and that people are healthy. @PTo build an Infirmary, select the Hygiene and Safety Tab and click on the Infirmary button. The Infirmary must have access to a road so that it can access the city's labor pool. @POnce an Infirmary is functioning, it sends out healers to wander the surrounding area. As a healer passes by a house, he administers to the mildly sick, and improves the hygiene practices of the residents inside.  You can watch your healers at work by clicking on the 'See Hygiene' button on the Hygiene and Safety tab. You'll see your healers walking the streets, and you'll also see columns on each of the city's houses. If the column is low, then the residents inside aren't very healthy. If you notice an area that seems to be at particular risk, you might want to build more Infirmaries in the area.
text: @P診所的醫師可以確保居民的 @118衛生 狀況。 @P要建造診所，選擇衛生與安全標簽，點擊'診所'按鈕，診所必須建造的路邊。 @P診所建成後醫師會四處檢查房屋的衛生狀況。你可以按'查看衛生'觀看醫師的工作情況，房屋前的圓柱越高，居民的衛生狀況越好。

original: When you build Aphrodite's Haven, your city becomes a grander place to live.  Its neighborhoods become much more @119appealing, and no one will want to emigrate. To learn about sanctuary construction, click @110here. @PIn order for Aphrodite's Haven to function, priests must perform regular sacrifices. A priest from the Sanctuary will seek out a goat, cattle or sheep. If there are no goats or sheep in the city, the priest will use food for the sacrifice. If too much time passes without a sacrifice being performed at the Haven, it will stop functioning and all benefits it provides will be lost. @PSometimes, Aphrodite herself will appear in your city. As she passes houses, she sanctifies them, adding new residents to them.  If Ares, Hephaestus, Hermes or Dionysus invades your city, Aphrodite will convince them to leave the city without doing it any harm. You can also pray to Aphrodite. If she grants your prayer, your city will be blessed with more people. Sometimes, if she thinks your city needs more people to properly fawn all over her, Aphrodite will grant this blessing of her own accord.
text: @P建成愛芙羅黛蒂聖所後，周圍的 @119環境 會大大改善，而且從此不會再有居民從城裡遷走。關於建造聖所的介紹，請點擊 @110此處 。 @P要讓愛芙羅黛蒂聖所發揮作用，祭司必須定期用綿羊或山羊祭祀。如果城裡沒有綿羊或山羊，他們就會用食物代替。如果很長一段時間內祭司都沒有祭祀，愛芙羅黛蒂聖所為你帶來的所有好處都會消失。 @P有時愛芙羅黛蒂會親自光臨你的城市，她所到之處民房會增加人口。此外，如果阿瑞斯、赫菲斯托斯、荷米斯或狄俄尼索斯入侵你的城市，愛芙羅黛蒂會勸說他們和平離開。此外，如果愛芙羅黛蒂對你感到滿意，會增加城市的人口。

original: The Oracle of Apollo allows you to see into the future.  The seers at the oracle will alert you to an event that will happen in one year's time. Sometimes, the seers will take it upon themselves to notify you of an upcoming event.  Apollo inspires your competitors in the @112Pan-Hellenic&Games to excel to new heights. To learn about constructing a Sanctuary, click @110here. @PIn order for the Oracle of Apollo to operate, priests must perform regular sacrifices. Priests will leave the Oracle in search of @95goats, cattle or @95sheep to sacrifice. If there are no goats or sheep in the city, the priests will sacrifice food. @POcassionally, Apollo himself will appear in your city. If you are ruling in Greece, he may sanctify the @17Theaters, @15Gymnasiums, @14Podiums and @18Stadium he passes, allowing them to provide more actors, athletes, philosophers and competitors to spread culture to the unwashed masses. If Atlantis is your home, then Apollo may sanctify your @133Bibliothekes, @137Laboratories, @134Observatories and @138Museum. While these buildings are sanctified, scientists are able to develop astounding new ideas quicker than before. @PYou can consult the oracle to see into the future.  @PFinally, you can also pray to Apollo for assistance. If Apollo grants your prayer, he will cure any plague in the city and improve city @118hygiene. Sometimes, Apollo will grant this blessing on his own, if your city is struck down by a plague.
text: @P阿波羅聖所讓你能看到未來，聖所裡的先知會預告一年之內會發生的事情。此外，阿波羅還會提高你的高級運動員在 @112泛希臘競賽 中的成績。關於建造聖所的介紹，請點擊 @110此處 。 @P要讓阿波羅聖所發揮作用，祭司必須定期用 @95綿羊 或 @95山羊 祭祀。如果城裡沒有綿羊或山羊，他們就會用食物代替。 @P有時阿波羅會親自光臨你的城市，他能讓所到之處的 @17劇場 、 @15體育館 、 @14講壇 和 @18露天運動場 提供更多的演員、運動員、學者和高級運動員。 @P你可以向先知詢問將來的事情。  @P此外，你還可以向阿波羅祈禱，如果他接受了你的祈禱，就會治療城裡的瘟疫，提高 @118衛生 水平。有時當你被瘟疫所困擾時，阿波羅會主動幫助你消除瘟疫。

original: When you build Ares' Fortress, he will loan you two companies of his fiercest warriors, to help defend the city, or serve on your military campaigns abroad. You can control Ares' warriors just like you would any other soldiers. Click @110here to learn about constructing a Sanctuary. @PPriests from Ares' Fortress must conduct regular sacrifices for the Fortress to function. The priests will go out in search of sheep, cattle or goats. If they can't find either of these, they will look for food to sacrifice. As long as the Fortress is functioning, it will bring benefits to the city. @PAres will sometimes make an appearance in the city accompanied by his Dragon. If the Dragon is hungry enough, he'll eat an enemy of yours, whether it be man or beast. @PYou can also pray to Ares. When Ares answers your prayer, he will accompany your soldiers to fight abroad. Sometimes, you won't have to ask Ares to accompany your troops into battle in distant lands. He'll do it just because he feels like it - the God of War loves a good conquest.
text: @P當你建成阿瑞斯聖所後，他會借給你兩組戰士，你可以隨意指揮這些戰士。關於建造聖所的介紹，請點擊 @110此處 。 @P要讓阿瑞斯聖所發揮作用，祭司必須定期用綿羊或山羊祭祀。如果城裡沒有綿羊或山羊，他們就會用食物代替。只要阿瑞斯聖所存在，它就會發揮作用。 @P阿瑞斯有時會騎龍出現在城裡，如果他的龍餓了，就會吃掉你的敵人。 @P如果阿瑞斯接受了你的祈禱，他會陪伴你去國外作戰。有時你不用祈禱他也會自動幫助你。

original: When you build Artemis' Menagerie, Artemis grants two companies of Amazons loyal to her, to fight for you. Any hunters you have in the city will also be endowed with greater skill and will hunt more efficiently. To find out how to build a Sanctuary, click @110here. @PIn order for Artemis' Menagerie to bring benefits to the city, priests must conduct regular sacrifices. They will seek out sheep, cattle or goats to sacrifice. If they can't find any, they will sacrifice food. @PThe Amazons Artemis loans you are controlled like any other troops. You can use them to defend the city, or send them on campaigns abroad. @PSometimes, Artemis herself will appear in the city, and sanctify some of your @69Hunting&Lodges. While sanctified, the hunters from the Hunting Lodge will be able to kill more boar than usual. Artemis will also slay any predator she runs across.  @PYou can pray to Artemis, and if she grants your prayer, she will bring some meat to the city's Granaries. Make sure that Perseus has access to a road. Heroes are always in high demand, so you will not be able to build Perseus' Hall unless you need his help for a specific task. @POnce you've built Perseus' Hall, you'll need to meet fulfill several requirements before Perseus will come to the city. Perseus is always wrapped up in the affairs of the gods, so he expects your city, too, to honor the gods.  Right-click on Perseus' Hall to see what you need to do to make your city worthy of the hero's presence. Once you've fulfilled all the requirements, a button that reads 'Send for Perseus' will appear. Click on the button, and Perseus will come to the city. @PSome quests may only be achieved by Perseus. Perseus can also effectively protect your city against attacks by Kraken and Medusa. He's also willing to fight other @92monsters, but some of your warriors may need to join in the fight if he is to be successful. Perseus will help to defend your city from an invading army and will even try his best to defeat an invading god.
text: @P要建造珀耳修斯府邸，在神話標簽中選擇'英雄府邸'，點擊'珀耳修斯府邸'，珀耳修斯府邸必須建在道路邊。英雄要四處作戰，所以不到必須的時候，你是無法建造珀耳修斯府邸的，但是一旦他進入了你的城市，就會待到一關的結束。 @P光建造珀耳修斯府邸是不夠的，要珀耳修斯到你的城市，你必須達到某些要求，你可以右鍵點擊珀耳修斯府邸觀看這些要求。達到要求後，可以點擊'邀請珀耳修斯'。 @P珀耳修斯是對付海妖和美杜莎的專家。他也能夠消滅其它 @92怪獸 ，但可能需要你派一些戰士協助。他可以保衛你的城市，也可以外出進攻你的敵人。

original: To lure Theseus to the city, first build Theseus' Hall. Choose the Mythology Tab, and click the Hero's Hall button. From the list that appears, choose Theseus' Hall.  Heroes are always in high demand, so you will only be able to build Theseus' Hall if you need his help for a specific task.  Theseus' Hall must have access to a road, and he will only live in the best neighborhoods, so be sure his Hall is near the city's Palace. To see if you've placed Theseus' Hall close enough to the Palace, right-click on the Hall. A list of requirements will appear. If Theseus' Hall is close enough to the Palace, that particular requirement will be checked off. @PBefore Theseus will come to your city, you must meet all of the requirements listed on the Hall's right-click panel. When you've met them, a button that reads 'Send for Theseus' will appear. Click on this button, and Theseus will come to the city. @PCertain quests can only be achieved by Theseus.  Theseus is also quite effective in fighting the Minotaur and Calydonian Boar. He's willing to fight other @92monsters, but may be defeated without help from some of your warriors. Theseus will help to defend your city from an invading army and will even try his best to defeat an invading god.  You can also send him abroad to fight.
text: @P要建造忒修斯府邸，在神話標簽中選擇'英雄府邸'，點擊'忒修斯府邸'，忒修斯府邸必須建在道路邊。由於忒修斯府邸要建在環境好的地方，所以要把它建在宮殿邊上。英雄要四處作戰，所以不到必須的時候，你是無法建造忒修斯府邸的，但是一旦他進入了你的城市，就會待到一關的結束。 @P光建造忒修斯府邸是不夠的，要忒修斯到你的城市，你必須達到某些要求，你可以右鍵點擊忒修斯府邸觀看這些要求。達到要求後，可以點擊'邀請忒修斯'。 @P忒修斯是對付牛頭怪彌諾陶洛斯和野豬卡利多尼恩的專家。他也能夠消滅其它 @92怪獸 ，但可能需要你派一些戰士協助。他可以保衛你的城市，也可以外出進攻你的敵人。

original: Hunters from a Hunting Lodge go out in search of @102wild&boar, @151deer or both. @PTo build a Hunting Lodge, choose the @77Husbandry&Tab and click on the Land and Sea button. Choose Hunting Lodge from the list that appears. @PThe Hunting Lodge must have access to a road so that it can access the city's labor pool. Once the Hunting Lodge has a staff, it sends out hunters who slay prey and bring it back to the lodge to be carved into sides of meat. Once the meat is ready, the Hunting Lodge's deliveryman will take the meat to a @9Granary or, if you are exporting the item, a @12Pier or @11Trading&Post. Make sure the Hunting Lodge is connected by a road to the meat's destination. @PYou don't necessarily need to build a Hunting Lodge close to the prey. The closer the Lodge is to the animals, however, the more efficient the hunt will be.
text: @P獵人小屋的獵人會去捕獵 @102野豬 。 @P要建造獵人小屋，選擇 @77農業標簽 中的'陸地和海洋'，然後點擊'獵人小屋'。 @P獵人小屋必須建在路邊。打到野豬後，獵人會把它們帶回小屋制成獸肉，然後送貨工會把獸肉送進準備出口的 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 ，如果那裡不需要，就送進 @9糧倉 。獵人小屋至少要和以上這些地方中的一個以道路連接。 @P你不一定要把獵人小屋造在野豬群邊上，但獵人小屋離野豬群越近，效率越高。

original: When you honor Atlas by building his Sanctuary, he watches over your construction industry, making it more efficient. Stonecutters are able to chisel both @42white and @131black&marble more quickly, and each @45Artisans'&Guild sends out twice as many artisans to construction sites. @PIn order for the Pillar of Atlas to fully function, priests must perform regular sacrifices. Atlas prefers to receive goats, sheep or cattle as sacrifice, but will settle for food from your Granary if no animals are available. @PAtlas himself may wander your city's streets from time to time. As he strolls along, he may sanctify the @41Timber&Mills and @127Refineries that he passes. A sanctified Timber Mill or Refinery will be more productive than usual. @PYou can also pray to Atlas. If Atlas answers your prayer, he will speed up a construction project in your city. After he blesses a construction site, any materials that were en route to the site will magically appear, and the materials will last longer. Artisans will not have to wait for goods to be delivered to the construction site as long as the effects of your prayer continue. Once the effects wear off, construction returns to normal. Atlas may grant this blessing of his own accord if he notices that he can be of service.
text: 目前沒有關於這個主題的幫助信息。

original: After the Orchard of Hera is complete, a stand of @149Orange&Trees will appear in front of her Sanctuary. These Orange Trees can be tended and harvested by tenders from an @109Orange&Tenders'&Lodge. If you honor Hera with a Sanctuary, she will also cause an increase to the birth rate, and your population will grow even if no one is immigrating to your city. And, if your city is the unfortunate target of Zeus' wrath, Hera will stand up to her husband and turn him away, saving your city from hardship. @PPriests must offer up sacrifices to the goddess if the Orchard of Hera is to function properly. Priests prefer to offer Hera goats, sheep or cattle, but will offer her food from a Granary in a pinch. @PSometimes, Hera may visit your city. As she walks the city's streets, she may sanctify the @108Corrals and Orange Tenders' Lodges that she passes. While these buildings are sanctified, they will produce more food than usual. @PFinally, you can offer up a prayer to Hera. If Hera answers your prayer, she will add supplies to all of the city's Agoras. If she notices that your Agoras are running low on supplies, she may grant this blessing on her own.
text: 目前沒有關於這個主題的幫助信息。

original: Without Poseidon, Atlantis would have been some lonely continent in the middle of the ocean instead of a thriving powerhouse. When Atlanteans honor Poseidon with a Sanctuary, they build the Citadel of Poseidon. @PThe Citadel of Poseidon is a large and elaborate structure and features a gorgeous statue of the Ruler of the Sea. When the Citadel of Poseidon is complete, the god sees to it that workers from Fisheries and Urchin Quays have no problems finding seafood. When the god's Sanctuary is in the city, both of these industries work faster. The great god also sends Kraken, the ferocious monster, to guard the city's waters from enemies. @PIn order for the Citadel to function properly, priests must conduct regular sacrifices. Priests will go in search of sheep, goats or cattle to sacrifice to the god. If they can't find any suitable animals, they will take food from the Granary. @PPoseidon may decide to pay your city a visit after you've constructed his Citadel. As he walks...er, paddles...around your streets, he may sanctify the city's Fisheries, Urchin Quays and Horse Ranches. While a building is sanctified, it is more productive than usual.  @PIf you lack food, pray to Poseidon. If he answers your prayer, he will bring a bountiful supply of seafood to a Granary. If the god notices that you are low on food, he may bring you food of his own volition.
text: 目前沒有關於這個主題的幫助信息。

original: Large and beautiful buildings are a testament to the advancements of Atlantean culture. Generically, all these buildings are called Pyramids.  The types of Pyramid are @153Pyramids, @155Monuments&to&the&Sky, @154Shrines to a specific god, the @156Altar&of&Olympus, the @157Temple&of&Olympus, the @158Pyramid&of&the&Pantheon, the @159Observatory&Kosmika and the @160Museum&Atlantika. @PAll of these buildings are built in a similar way, though each requires different resources. Click on the name of a specific edifice above to find out what resources you need to build it. In addition to the proper supplies, you also need artisans from an @45Artisans'&Guild.  @PTo place one of these buildings, select the Aesthetics Tab and then click the 'Pyramids' button. Choose the building you would like to construct, then guide the building's footprint to the spot in the city where you'd like to place it. If the footprint turns green, you've picked a suitable location. Click the mouse button to set the foundation of the building in place.  If the footprint is red, then something is preventing you from building in the selected location. You can either try clearing away any obstructions or find a new location. @PYou can rotate the footprint by pressing the 'r' button. You can also freeze the footprint if you press the 'm' button. While the footprint is frozen, you can scroll your view normally.  You'll be able to see if there is something obstructing the building and see how it fits in with its surroundings. @PAfter you place the structure, you'll notice that there is a plank on one of the edges. This plank must be connected to a road so that artisans and the needed supplies can reach the building. @PYou can halt construction at any time by right-clicking on the construction site and clicking the 'Halt Construction' button. Artisans will finish up their current tasks and then return to the Guild or find another construction project that needs their services. @PAs long as you have artisans and the materials that you need, construction should run smoothly. The workers will take it upon themselves to build necessary support structures, like Lifts, to aid their progress. If you notice that construction has stopped, right-click on the Pyramid to find out what the problem is. You can also see a general Pyramid construction status report by selecting the @85Aesthetics&Tab. Click on the small magnifying glass to see even more information about your construction projects.
text: 目前沒有關於這個主題的幫助信息。

original: Before Atalanta will set foot in your city, you must build her Hero's Hall and outfit it with her favorite accoutrements. You'll see the list of her demands when you right-click on the Hero's Hall.  As you meet each demand, it will be checked off. @POnce you've met the requirements, right-click on the Hero's Hall and click on the 'Summon Atalanta' button. The famed huntress will make her way to your city. @PYou'll need Atalanta's services to fulfill certain quests.  She is also quite adept at fighting the Harpies and the Sphinx. You can also send Atalanta to fight abroad.
text: 目前沒有關於這個主題的幫助信息。

original: The Overview Tab highlights the general state of affairs in your city. You can see at a glance how @122popular you are with your citizens, the city's stored @116food levels, the @121employment situation, the city's @118hygiene and @123unrest levels, how your @120finances are fairing compared to last year, and whether there are any military threats to the city. You can also see if any other leaders have made @111requests of you, and how many more months you have to fulfill them. Any Quests that gods have issued will also be listed here. For a closer look, click on the Magnifying Glass button and you'll see more detailed information on the state of your city. @PAt the top of the Overview Tab are two buttons that will give you special views of your city. Click on 'See Roads,' and all the buildings in the city will flatten, leaving just the roads behind. The 'See Roads' button helps you plan your road network and can help you to see if there are any problems with the current arrangement of roads. @PThe 'See Problems' button will reveal any building or walker in the city that is not working properly. It will show which of the city's houses are at risk for a range of problems, including whether it is vacant, about to devolve, about to catch fire or collapse, or about to produce a criminal. This view will also show which of the city's industries are lacking sufficient raw materials, don't have enough workers or are about to become damaged. You'll also see which Sanctuaries need sacrifices. In addition to identifying problems with buildings, this view highlights deliverymen who are stuck for some reason, whether it be because they cannot get to their destination by a road, or because their destination cannot accept their goods. Any buildings that have already collapsed or are on fire will also be highlighted when you press the 'See Problems' button.    @PThe Overview Tab always displays a small overview map of your city, so that you can see more of your city at one time. To display this map on all tabs simultaneously, click the overview map tab at the top the @86Control&Panel.
text: @P總覽標簽可以讓你看到城市的各種數據。你可以看到自己的 @122聲望 、城裡儲存的 @116食物 、 @121雇傭工人 情況、 @118衛生 情況、 @123治安 情況、 @120財政 情況以及是否有敵人對你構成威脅。你可以看看是否有人 @111請求 你做什麼事情，以及你還剩多少時間去完成委托。如果點擊放大鏡按鈕，你可以看到更詳細的介紹。 @P在總覽標簽的上方有兩個特殊按鈕。'查看道路'可以讓所有建築消失，讓你能仔細查看道路的建設情況。 @P'查看問題'可以查看房屋、工業生產和工人的各種問題。    @P總覽標簽裡還有一幅城市的總覽地圖，如果要在所有的標簽裡顯示這幅地圖，可以點擊 @86控制面板 上方'總覽地圖'按鈕。

original: The Population Tab helps you to manage the city's population levels. @PWhen you've selected the Population Tab, you will see two buttons that you can use to designate housing plots, one for @6common&housing and one for @7elite&housing. You'll also see information on the current trends in immigration. The summary tells you how many more people the city's housing can accommodate. It also tells you whether or not people want to come to your city, and how many immigrants arrived in the last month. If people are leaving the city or if immigration is being limited, the summary will tell you so, and why. @PYou can see which houses are in danger of running out of supplies - and thus in danger of devolving - by clicking the 'See Supplies' button at the top of the @86Control&Panel. When you click this button, icons representing each house's supplies appear. If a house lacks an item or is in danger of running out of it, the icon for that item will have a flashing red background. @PFor a closer look at the city's population, click on the Magnifying Glass button. A graph will appear that shows how the city's population has grown or shrunk over time. Click on the 'View Society Graph' button, and a graph that shows the city's population by soldier type will appear.
text: @P人口標簽可以讓你管理城市裡的居民。 @P在人口標簽裡你可以建造 @6民房 和 @7高級住宅 。你可以看到當前移民的信息，它可以告訴你城市還能接受多少人口、人們是否想來到你的城市以及上個月有多少新移民到來。 @P你可以點擊 @86控制面板 中的'查看供應'查看各種住宅所需的資源供應情況，如果一所住宅缺少某項資源，就會以紅色的背景顯示出來。 @P點擊放大鏡後，你可以看到城市人口的變更圖，點擊'查看社會'後可以看到戰鬥人員的數量變化。

original: The Husbandry Tab provides information on food availability in your city, and helps you manage the city's farms and other agriculture buildings. You can build husbandry buildings using the build buttons located on the bottom third of the Control Panel. For more information on any of the husbandry buildings and livestock, consult the @1Table&of&Contents and look up a specific building or animal. @PThe Husbandry Tab shows you at a glance how many people your current food production and importation can support, and whether you are producing enough food to feed your current population. It also shows you how many months worth of food you have stored in the city's @9Granaries. @PFor a closer look at food production, click on the Magnifying Glass button. You will see a list of each type of food-producer, how many cartloads of food each produces per month, and how many people the food can feed. @PTo see all the Husbandry structures in your city, click on the 'See Husbandry' button at the top of the Control Panel. All non-husbandry structures will be temporarily flattened. If there is a problem at any of your husbandry structures, an icon will appear next to the building. Hold the mouse over the icon, and balloon help will describe what the issue is.
text: @P農業標簽可以讓你查看和管理城裡的食物及農業建築。關於農業建築和牲畜的介紹，可以查詢 @1目錄 。 @P你可以看到城裡的食物生產可以維持多少人的生活，你還可以看到目前 @9糧倉 裡儲藏的食物可以支持多少時間。 @P點擊放大鏡後，你可以看到農業設施的列表，它們的產量以及可以支持的人口數量。 @P你可以點擊控制面板上方的'查看農業'來查看所有農業設施，如果某個設施有問題，邊上會出現一個圖標，把鼠標放在上面就可以看到問題說明。

original: From the Industry Tab, you can manage all of the city's industries. To build an industrial building, use the build buttons located in the bottom third of the Control Panel. If you have questions about a specific industry, consult the @1Table&of&Contents for the entry on that specific industry. @PFrom the Industry Tab, you can set the wage level you wish to pay your workers. By default, wages are set to Normal. You can adjust the wages to Very High, High, Normal, Low, Very Low, or None. Be aware, though, that if you set wages too low, your workers will become upset, and your @122popularity could plummet as a result. The Industry Tab also tells you how many workers the city employs and how many more, if any, are needed. If there is unemployment in the city, the unemployment rate is shown here. @PFor more in-depth control over your city's industries and workers, click on the Magnifying Glass. The screen that appears is divided into two sections.  In the upper section, you can dictate which categories or 'sectors' of the city's working buildings are staffed first, in the case of a labor shortage. Decide which sectors are most important to suit your current needs, and assign a priority accordingly using the scroll buttons. The priorities you can assign are very high, high, moderate, low and none. As you adjust the priority levels, you'll see the number of workers assigned to each sector shift. @PThe industries currently in your city are displayed in the lower section of the panel. You can shut an industry down by clicking on it.  This can be especially helpful in times of worker shortages. When you shut down an industry, the workers from that industry find new jobs in other sectors of the city. Click on the shut down industry again to reactivate it.  @PFinally, click the 'See Industry' button to see all the industries in your city. If any of them are not functioning properly, an icon will appear over the building. Hold your mouse over the icon, and balloon help will describe the problem.
text: @P工業標簽可以讓你建造、查看和管理城裡的工業設施。關於工業設施的詳細介紹可以查詢 @1目錄 。 @P你可以設置工人的工資水平。注意，如果你把工資設定得太低，你的 @122聲望 就會降低。你可以看到目前工人的數量以及所需工人的數量。如果城裡有人失業，你也可以看到失業率。 @P點擊放大鏡後，畫面分成兩部分。在上半部分你可以決定某些建築在得到工人及物資時的優先級。 @P城裡的工業設施列在下半部分，如果工人短缺，你可以關閉某些設施，那裡的工人會去其它地方勞動。點擊被關閉的設施後可以讓它重新開工。  @P你可以點擊控制面板上方的'查看工業'來查看所有工業設施，如果某個設施有問題，邊上會出現一個圖標，把鼠標放在上面就可以看到問題說明。

original: The Distribution Tab provides information about the various commodities currently in your city, or obtainable by your city.  This tab gives valuable information on your imports and exports, and can also help you manage your city's distribution system. @PThe bottom third of the Control Panel contains the Distribution Tab's build buttons. To learn more about a specific Distribution Building, consult the @1Table&of&Contents. @PIn the top section of this tab, items obtainable by the city and not currently being imported or exported are shown. Items being imported or exported are shown in the two areas below this.  Clicking on an item instructs the city's storage facilities to stockpile the item, making it unusable for any purpose.  Stockpiled items will not be exported, nor delivered to industries that might need them. Also, the city's @8Agoras will not be able to pick up the stockpiled item, although peddlers can still distribute any that the Agoras already have in stock. You might want to stockpile an item if you need it to save it up to meet a request or to draw a hero to the city. When an item is being stockpiled, it appears in yellow, and in parenthesis. @PFor a closer look at your trade relations, click on the Magnifying Glass button. All the items obtainable in your city are listed in the panel that appears. Alongside each item is the price for which the good can be bought or sold. The panel also shows which items you are importing and exporting, and with which cities you are trading. If you click on a city name, the panel will close and your view will be centered on that city's trade facility. @PTo see all the city's Distribution structures, click on the 'See Distribution' button. You'll see all of the city's Agoras, Granaries, Storehouses, and trading facilities, as well as the city's housing. You'll be able to see if any Distribution buildings aren't working properly. If they aren't, an icon will appear next to the building. Hold the cursor over the icon, and balloon help will describe the problem. You'll also see the city's housing and icons of the items each household can use. If the background of the icon is flashing red, then the house has run out of or is about to run out of the item.
text: @P儲存與銷售標簽讓你查看和管理城裡的物資以及進出口物資的情況。 @P關於各種生產設施的詳細介紹，可以查詢 @1目錄 。 @P畫面上方顯示的是目前城裡有的，而且停止進口或出口的物資。它的下方顯示要進口和要出口的物資。點擊物資後它就會被囤積起來，無法被使用、被出售，也無法出口。被囤積的貨物邊上會出現括號，而且變成黃色。 @P點擊放大鏡後，你可以看到城裡所有的物資列表，它們的邊上列出出售或購買的價格。此外，你還可以看到要進出口的貨物列表和要與之進行貿易的城市。如果你點擊城市名稱，你的屏幕就會直接顯示該城市的貿易設施。 @P你可以點擊'查看儲存與銷售'來查看城裡的市場、糧倉、貨棧、貿易設施和房屋的情況。如果某個設施有問題，邊上會出現一個圖標，把鼠標放在上面就可以看到問題說明。此外，你還可以看到與房屋相關的物資的圖標，如果一個圖標的背景變成紅色而且開始閃動，就表示這間房屋缺少這種物資。

original: The Hygiene and Safety Tab helps you keep an eye on your citizens' hygiene and personal safety. The Hygiene and Safety buildings are the @50Infirmary, @49Fountain, @27Watchpost and @25Maintenance&Office. Click on any of these building names for more information on them. @PThe Hygiene and Safety Tab provides an update on the city's @118hygiene, and the @123unrest levels of the city's houses. For more detailed information, click on the Magnifying Glass. At the top of the panel you'll see a description of the current level of hygiene in the city, followed by summaries of how many people have access to the services of a healer, and how many people are able to eat regularly. It also tells whether plague has broken out recently, as well as how many houses are currently infected by plague. The lower half of the panel lists how many Maintenance Offices and Watchposts are working in the city. It also lists how many outlaws have wreaked havoc on the city recently. @PTo track a particular safety threat, use one of the four buttons located at the top of the Control Panel. Click on the 'See Water' button to watch your city's water bearers at work. You'll also notice blue columns in front of the city's housing. The higher the column, the more recently the house has been supplied with water by a water bearer. If a household runs out of water, their house may devolve. @PClick on the 'See Hygiene' button to see the city's healers walking through the streets and to see which houses practice good hygiene. The higher the column in front of a house is, the more recently a healer has visited. @PClick on the 'See Hazards' button to see which of the city's buildings are at risk for catching fire or collapsing. You'll also see the city's superintendents making their way through the city, fixing buildings. As a superintendent passes a building, he makes sure the building won't catch fire or collapse. @PFinally, click the 'See Unrest' button to make sure that the city's residents are well-behaved and to watch the city's watchmen make their rounds. When you select 'See Unrest', you'll see a columns in front of each of the city's houses. The higher the column, the more likely it is that the house will produce an @123outlaw. As a watchman passes by housing, he makes sure the people inside are keeping on the straight and narrow, and prevents outlaws from hitting the streets.
text: @P這個標簽幫助你維護人民的衛生和安全。衛生與安全建築包括 @50診所 、 @49噴泉 、 @27了望臺 和 @25維修所 。 @P這個標簽裡的功能可以提高城市的 @118衛生 和 @123治安 等級。點擊放大鏡後，你可以在控制面板上方看到當前城市的衛生等級，下面列出有多少人需要去醫師那兒看病，多少人可以衣食無憂，最近是否發生瘟疫，多少房屋被瘟疫感染。下半部分列出了城裡有多少了望臺和維修所以及城裡有多少罪犯。 @P點擊'查看飲水'可以查看挑水工的工作情況。房屋前面的圓柱越高，代表飲水越充分。如果房屋長期得不到飲水，就會降級。 @P點擊'查看衛生'可以查看醫師的工作情況。房屋前面的圓柱越高，代表衛生狀況越好。 @P點擊'查看險情'可以查看管理員的工作情況。房屋前面的圓柱越高，代表安全狀況越好。 @P點擊'查看治安'可以查看督察官的工作情況。房屋前面的圓柱越高，代表出現 @123罪犯 的可能性越高。

original: The Administration Tab helps you to manage your city's finances and control taxation. On the lower third of the Control Panel, you'll see the Administration buildings that you can construct. The buildings are the @24Palace and @26Tax&Office. In Greece, you can also build the @28Water&Crossing. In Atlantis, buttons for @161Bridges and @139Hippodromes. For more information on any of these buildings, click on the links in the previous sentences. @PThe Administration Tab shows you at a glance the city's tax collection practices. You can see the city's current tax rate and how many tax drachmas you are currently collecting. It also shows you how many people in the city are registered for the tax, and how many drachmas have gone uncollected due to people not being visited by a clerk. You can adjust the tax rate by using the scroll buttons at the top of the panel. The tax rate levels are outrageous, very high, high, normal, low, very low and none. While setting a higher tax rate will obviously yield more drachmas, the city's residents will tire quickly of paying exorbitant taxes. Your popularity could plummet, and your citizens could emigrate. @PTo see which houses are currently paying taxes, click on the 'See Taxes' button. You'll see the city's clerks walking through the streets. You'll also see columns in front of the city's housing, indicating how recently a clerk has passed by. The higher the column, the more recently the clerk has visited, indicating that you don't need to worry about the house missing a tax payment. If a household has paid any taxes, you'll see a stack of coins in front of its dwelling. The higher the stack of coins, the more taxes have been paid. You can hold the cursor over the column or stack of coins for more specific information. If you notice that a particular neighborhood has not been paying taxes, you might want to build a Tax Office in the area. @PThe Administration Tab also briefly updates you on your income and expenditures for the year to date. For more detailed information, click on the Magnifying Glass button. A complete financial report appears in the screen that pops up, comparing the previous year's financial performance to the current year's. If you're losing money, this report can reveal the city's largest expenditures. Then, you can adjust your spending policies accordingly. @PFor more information, consult the @120money entry.
text: @P管理標簽讓你控制城市的財政和稅收。你可以建造的建築包括： @24宮殿 、 @26稅務所 和 @28浮橋 。 @P你可以看到當前稅額、稅率、當前交稅的人數以及應收但還沒有收到的稅款。你可以點擊按鈕調整稅率的高低，如果把稅率調高，可以增加收入，但是會導致人們的不滿，許多人會遷離你的城市。 @P點擊'查看稅收'後，你可以看到稅務官的工作情況。房屋前面的圓柱高，代表稅務官不久前剛去收過稅。此外，房屋邊上還有一堆錢幣的圖案，錢幣越多，代表交的稅也越多，你可以把鼠標放在錢堆上觀看詳細信息。如果一片區域都沒有交過稅，你應該在那附近建造稅務所。 @P管理標簽裡還為你列出從年初到當前的收入和開支，點擊放大鏡後，你可以看到詳細的資產負債表。 @P詳細信息參見 @120稅收與財政 。

original: The Culture Tab will help you keep an eye on your city's cultural centers, all of which may be built from the Culture Tab. For more information on a particular building, consult the @1Table&of&Contents. @PIf the @112Pan-Hellenic&Games have begun in Greece, then the Culture Tab shows you at a glance how you are likely to fare in each of them. If the Pan-Hellenic Games have not begun, then the Culture Tab will show how good the city's access is to the various forms of cultural diversions. If you notice that your city is lacking in a particular type of cultural pursuit, or is likely to fare poorly in one of the Pan-Hellenic Games, use the buttons at the top of the tab to see which areas of the city could benefit from more culture centers. The 'See Philosophers' button, on the Culture tab, shows you all your philosophers at work. Columns in front of the city's housing indicate whether or not a philosopher has visited lately. The higher the column, the more recent the philosopher's visit. The 'See Athletes' button lets you see the city's athletes and identify which houses they have recently visited. Click on the 'See Actors' button to see the city's actors walking through the streets, bringing the joys of the theater to the houses they pass. Columns in front of housing indicate how recently a house has been entertained by an actor. The 'See Competitors' button shows you the city's competitors and which houses have benefited from their amazing skills. Finally, the 'See All Culture' button combines each of the three above views, and shows how much overall culture each house has access to. @PClick on the Magnifying Glass button for a more detailed look at culture in your city. You'll see how good city-wide coverage is for each culture type. If the Pan-Hellenic Games have begun in Greece, then you'll also receive advice on how to increase your chances doing well in next Pan-Hellenic Games.
text: @P文化標簽讓你管理城市裡的文化設施，詳細建築的介紹請到 @1目錄 查找。 @P如果 @112泛希臘競賽 開始，你可以在文化標簽裡看到一些資料。如果泛希臘競賽沒有開始，你可以在這個標簽裡看到城市裡文化設施的普及程度。如果城裡缺少某一種文化設施，你的選手在競賽中就可能失去優勢。你可以點擊'查看學者'按鈕查看學者的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近受到過學者的指導。你可以點擊'查看運動員'按鈕查看運動員的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近受到運動員的拜訪。你可以點擊'查看演員'按鈕查看演員的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近看過演員的表演。你可以點擊'查看高級運動員'按鈕查看高級運動員的工作情況，此時其他行人都會暫時消失。此外，民房前的圓柱高，表示裡面的居民最近受到高級運動員的拜訪。點擊'查看所有文化'後可以查看所有文化的總和效果。 @P點擊放大鏡後你可以看到各種文化的影響範圍。如果泛希臘競賽展開，你會得到一些提示。

original: The Mythology Tab helps you keep track of @93gods, @94heroes and @92monsters in your city. To build Sanctuaries, Hero's Halls and Artisans' Guilds, use the buttons that appear on the lower third of the Control Panel. For specific information regarding any of these buildings, consult the @1Table&of&Contents. @PThe Mythology Tab lists which Sanctuaries you've built or are building in the city. While you are building a Sanctuary, the Mythology Tab will let you know which supply it needs next to continue construction. When the Sanctuary is complete, the Mythology Tab will update you on the Sanctuary's current activity. Click on the activity to go to the Sanctuary and see for yourself what is going on. If you click on the god's name, and the god is currently in your city, you will be taken directly to the god so you can see what the Olympian is up to. @PThe Mythology Tab also updates you on the less-than-friendly gods and monsters in your city. When they arrive in your city, their names will be listed in yellow. Click on their names, and you will be taken to where they are wreaking havoc. @PYou can also click the 'See Immortals' button to view all of the gods, monsters, heroes and Sanctuaries in your city. @PFor more information on the gods and heroes in your city, click on the Magnifying Glass button. You will see which gods are currently being worshiped in the city, and whether they are willing to answer your prayer. There is also a list of the other gods you can worship, but haven't built a Sanctuary for yet. You'll also see which heroes are in the city. Finally, gods unfriendly to your city are listed. Click on any name to go directly to that personage.
text: @P神話標簽是有關 @93神明 、 @94英雄 和 @92怪獸 的。你可以在此建造聖所、英雄府邸和工匠行。詳細內存參見 @1目錄 。 @P神話標簽裡列出了正在建造和已經建成的聖所。建造聖所的時候，神話標簽裡會列出所需的物資。建成後，神話標簽裡會出現當前聖所活動的信息，如果某個神明在你的城裡，在這裡可以直接點擊查找。 @P敵對的神明或怪獸出現在城裡後，會在神話標簽裡以黃色顯示，可以直接點擊查找。 @P你也可以按'查看諸神'查看所有的神明、怪獸、英雄和聖所。 @P點擊放大鏡後，你可以看到你所供奉的神明的列表，而且可以看到哪些神明是可以供奉但沒有建造聖所的。你還可以看到英雄和敵對的神明。點擊後可以直接到達他們的所在地。

original: The Military Tab helps you to keep track of your soldiers and ships. Consult the @1Table&of&Contents to learn more about the specific military buttons. @PThe Military Tab updates you at a glance to your military's current activities. Each of the city's companies and ships is represented by an icon. The Military Tab will tell you which of your companies and ships have been called to arms and are ready to defend the city, which are abroad and which are standing down. To find out the name of each company, hold your cursor over an icon and the name will appear. Click on an icon to go directly to the company's standard or to the ship. @PYou can also call all of your soldiers to arms from the Military Tab, provided you've positioned their standards in the field. Simply click the 'Call All' button.  The button will change to read 'All called', and all your soldiers will leave their homes and go to their standards. To send them home, click the same button, which now reads 'All Called'. If all the companies' standards are at the Palace, then the phrase 'At Palace' will appear. You can issue similar orders to your ships and @31Towers. Click on 'Crew Ships' to call the crews to their vessels. Click the same button, now called 'All Crewed', to send them back home. If you don't have ships, the phrase 'No Ships' will appear. For Towers, click 'Not Manning' to call the sentries to their posts. The button's label changes to 'Manning', which sends the Tower guards back home if clicked. 'No Towers' will appear if you haven't yet built Towers. @PAbove the Magnifying Glass button is a button with a helmet on it. Click on this helmet to toggle auto-defend on and off. When auto-defend is on, your generals will handle all the tactical decisions for you in battle. With auto-defend off, you are in complete control of giving orders to your troops. For more on the orders you can give, choose a soldier type: @104rabble, @105hoplites @106horsemen, @145archers, @146spearmen and @147charioteers. @PClick on the Magnifying Glass button for a closer look at your military. In the screen that pops up, all of your companies are listed by type, and your ships are listed as well. In addition, if any mercenary troops have been loaned to you by other cities for defense, they are listed here. Finally, if Ares' or Artemis' warriors are helping you, they will be listed here as well. @PNext to each company name is a description of its current status. The statuses for companies are At Home, Still, Marching, Going Home, Fleeing, Fighting and Abroad. Sometimes, the statuses are displayed on a button.  In such cases, clicking the button issues an order. If a company is At Home, you can click on 'At Home' to call them to arms. A Still company has been called to arms, but is not yet fighting. To send this company home, click on 'Still'. If a company is Marching, you can click on the 'Marching' button to send them home. If a company is under orders to return home, you can click the 'Going Home' button to re-muster the soldiers. Finally, you can send home a company that is Fighting by clicking on the 'Fighting' button.  @PSimilarly, some of the ship statuses double as orders. When a vessel is without a crew, clicking on 'unmanned' will call the crew to the ship. If a ship has a crew but is still anchored at its Wharf, clicking on 'Anchored' will send the crew home. If a ship is sailing, clicking on the 'Sailing' button will send the ship's crew home. If a ship is disembarking its crew and sending them home, clicking on the 'Disembarking' button will call the crew back to the ship. Finally, if the ship is currently fighting, clicking on the 'Fighting' button will send the crew home. A vessel can also be returning to the Wharf, under repair or abroad.
text: @P軍事標簽可以幫助你管理和控制軍事單位。詳細建築和單位的介紹請到 @1目錄 查找。 @P城裡的部隊和 @103三層船 都會用一個小圖標表示，你可以看到哪些軍事單位已經作好戰鬥準備、哪些在境外戰鬥、哪些在站崗。點擊後可以直接到達他們的所在地。 @P點擊'召集'後，你可以讓所有的士兵進入戰鬥崗位，再點擊一下可以讓他們都復員。如果所有士兵的戰鬥崗位都在宮殿，則會出現'在宮殿'的按鈕。三層船和 @31塔樓 也有類似的命令。點擊'召集'後，水兵會上船。如果你沒有三層船，就會看到'沒有戰艦'的提示。對於塔樓，如果點擊'不駐扎士兵'，塔樓裡的士兵就會回到各自的崗位，如果點擊'駐扎士兵'，士兵就會進入塔樓。如果你沒有塔樓，就會看到'沒有塔樓'的提示。 @P在放大鏡的按鈕上方有個頭盔圖標的按鈕，可以讓你決定是否讓士兵自動防御，如果選擇自動防御，戰鬥時你的將軍會自行決定戰術，如果取消自動防御，所有戰術都由你來控制。兵種介紹參見 @104民兵 ,  @105步兵 或 @106騎兵 。 @P點擊放大鏡可以看見軍隊列表，包括其它城市借給你的雇傭兵和神明給你的戰士。 @P戰士的當前狀態包括：在家中、待命、前進中、回家、撤退中、戰鬥中、城外。有時士兵邊上會有一個按鈕，你可以通過這個按鈕對士兵下命令。  @P如果三層船沒有船員，點擊'沒有船員'按鈕可以召集船員。如果船上有船員但是停泊在碼頭，點擊'待命'可以讓船員回家。如果三層船在航行，點擊'航行中'可以讓船員回家，點擊'下船中'可以讓船員再上船。戰鬥中，點擊'戰鬥中'按鈕可以讓三層船退出戰鬥。

original: The Aesthetics Tab helps you to manage how visually appealing the city's different neighborhoods are and helps you keep track of an Atlantean city's Pyramids and other monumental structures.  At the bottom of the Control Panel, you'll see buttons for the types of aesthetic structure you can build.  The buttons are the Beautification Structures button, the Recreational Areas button and the Commemorative Monuments button.  The Commemorative Monuments button appears only when you have been awarded a Commemorative Monument but haven't built it yet. For specific information on each of the aesthetic structures, consult the @1Table&of&Contents. @PIf you are in Atlantis, you may also see the Pyramid button here. For more on Pyramids and other large structures, click @73here. @PThe Aesthetics tab also lists all the Commemorative Monuments you currently have in the city.  In addition, in Atlantis the tab lists the pyramids that you are building in the city. The information on the Control Panel will give you a brief overview of the current status of your pyramids. For more information on your pyramids and Commemorative Monuments, click the small Magnifying Glass button. More specific information regarding the current state of your pyramids will appear. You can also click on the name of a Commemorative Monument to center your view on a representative example of the monument in your city. @PAt the top of the Control Panel is the 'See Appeal' button. Click it, and the land in your city will be replaced with colored blocks.  The lighter the block, the more appealing the area is.  How appealing an area is has no effect on your city's industries, but makes a big difference in your city's residential areas.  @PFor more on aesthetics in general, click @119here.
text: @P環境標簽可以讓你美化你的城市。控制面板下方會有'美化建築'、'休息區'和'紀念碑'三個按鈕。關於美化建築的詳細介紹，參見 @1目錄 。 @P點擊'查看環境'後，屏幕上的區域顏色越淺，代表環境越好。環境只對住宅區有影響。  @P詳細信息點擊 @119此處 。

original: The Control Panel provides all the tools you need to build and run a city. Each of its tabs deals with a different facet of building and running a city. As you click on each tab, the information on the Control Panel changes.  @PThe Control Panel changes depending on if you are ruling an Atlantean city or a Greek city. If you are leading a Greek city, the @82Culture&Tab will appear on the Control Panel. In an Atlantean city, the @150Science&Tab appears instead. The other tabs on the Control Panel are the @76Population&Tab, the @77Husbandry&Tab, the @78Industry&Tab, the @79Distribution&Tab, the @80Hygiene&and&Safety&Tab, the @81Administration&Tab, the @83Mythology&Tab, the @84Military&Tab, the @85Aesthetics&Tab and the @75Overview&Tab.  @PAt the top of the Control Panel, you'll see two other tabs.  Click on the left tab, and the above mentioned category tabs will each display information to help you manage your city.  Click on the right tab, and the Control panel will always display a small @75Overview&Map of your city.   @PIn the lower portion of the Control Panel, (right next to the Overview Tab) are four buttons that are always available to you. They are the Build @5Roads button, the Place Roadblock button, the Clear Land button and the Undo button. Click on the Build Roads button to build roads in your city. With the Place Roadblock button, you can place roadblocks to guide your city's roaming walkers.  Use the Clear Land button if you want to demolish a building or remove other obstructions from the land. The Undo button allows you to undo your most recent action. You can only undo your last action while the button is lit. @PBelow these buttons is a space for four 'Go To' buttons that appear when certain situations occur in your city. Clicking on a button will bring you to the site of the occurrence. The first slot is reserved for hazards and catastrophes. Clicking it will bring you to the site of the most recent trouble. The @97Hazard&buttons include fire, earthquake, tidal wave, landslide, lava, collapsed building and blocked road. The second slot is reserved for outbreaks of plague.  If someone or something invades the city, then an @99Invasions&button appears. A button will appear here if an enemy, monster or unfriendly god invades the city. Finally, if a hero or friendly god has come to the city, an @100Arrival&button will appear. This button will also appear when a hero returns to a city after a quest or soldiers return from a campaign abroad. @PYou'll also see a @87Messages button on the Control Panel. Click on this button, and a list of all the messages you've received will appear. Click on any message name to read it, or right-click on it to erase it. @PBeneath the Messages button and Go To buttons is the Condensed Message Box. As messages arrive, a brief synopsis of the message will be displayed in the Condensed Message Box. Use the up and down arrows to scroll through the brief synopses of all your messages. To read the full version of the currently displayed message, simply click anywhere on the Condensed Message Box.  @PBelow the Condensed Message Box are three more buttons that will help you manage your city. The first button is the Review Goals button. Clicking on this button will bring up a list of objectives required to complete the current episode. You also use this screen to set aside goods for a colony or the parent city. Next to the Review Goals button is the Rotate City button. Click on the left side of the button to rotate the city counter-clockwise. Click on the right side of the button to rotate the city clockwise. Clicking on the center of the button will reorient your view due north. Next to the Rotate City button is the @88View&World&button. Clicking this button will bring up a map of the world.
text: @P你要通過控制面板上的標簽才能實現各種遊戲功能。詳細信息，參見： @76人口標簽 、 @77農業標簽 、 @78工業標簽 、 @79儲存與銷售標簽 、 @80衛生與安全標簽 、 @81管理標簽 、 @82文化標簽 、 @83神話標簽 、 @84軍事標簽 、 @85美學標簽 、 @75總覽標簽 。  @P屏幕頂上的左邊按鈕可以顯示一些管理信息，右邊的按鈕可以顯示 @75小地圖 。   @P控制面板下方有四個按鈕：建造 @5道路 、放置路障、清除、撤消。路障可以用來指導行人的行進路線，'清除'用來清除障礙物，'撤消'可以取消做錯的事情。 @P下面有四個查看按鈕，在發生事件時可以直接點擊查看。 @P控制面板上還有個消息按鈕，可以查看所有發給你的消息。 @P下面是個簡略消息區，點擊後可以看到消息的全文。  @P最下面還有三個按鈕，第一個可以查看任務目標，第二個可以旋轉視角，最後一個是查看 @88大地圖 。

original: When a significant event happens in your city or around Greece, you will be sent a message. A synopsis of the message will appear in the Condensed Message Box, at the bottom of the Control Panel. Use the up and down arrows next to the Box to scroll through the synopses for all your messages.  You can read a full version of the currently selected message by clicking on the Condensed Message Box, or by clicking on the Message button. When you click on the Message button, a list of the messages you have received will appear. Click on the title of any of the messages to read it, or right-click on it to erase it from the list. @PYou can control how you receive messages by selecting Messages from the Options Menu. A list of the types of messages you receive appears in the panel that pops up. You can choose to receive messages in each category in their 'Full' form, as pop-up messages, in their 'Condensed' form only, or to not receive them at all. When you receive a message as a 'Full' pop-up, a panel will appear when the message arrives, pausing the game, and drawing your attention directly to the message. A condensed version of the message will also appear in the Condensed Message Box. If you choose to receive a message as Condensed only, you will not immediately see the full pop-up, play will continue unimpeded, and a synopsis of the message will appear in the Condensed Message Box. Finally, you can turn a message category off completely to not receive its messages at all.
text: @P當你的城市或希臘其它城市發生了重大事件，你會收到消息，消息顯示在控制面板下方。左鍵點擊消息的簡略介紹後就可以觀看全文，右鍵點擊則會把消息從列表中刪除。 @P你可以在選項菜單中選擇接收消息的方式。如果選擇'完整'，消息收到時遊戲會暫停，顯示完整消息。如果選擇'簡略'，消息收到時不會暫停遊戲，只會出現在簡略消息區。如果選擇'關閉'，將收不到任何消息。

original: Clicking the World View button brings you to the World Map. From the World Map, you can engage in a variety of activities with other cities and leaders in the world.  @PThe World Map shows you the cities in the world, including your own. The icons around the cities on the map reveal basic information about them. The number of shields indicates how large a military force the city has. The more shields, the larger the city's military power. The coins stacked by the city indicate how strong its economy is. If the city can trade with you, you'll see a route drawn to your city.  Sea routes are shown in blue, land routes in brown. If the city is a rebelling colony or vassal, you'll see a flickering torch. @PYour relationship with each city is also indicated on the map. The city you are currently governing, whether it be your @111parent&city or a @111colony you are establishing, displays a large square banner.  Your @111vassals and established colonies each fly a smaller version of this standard.  Your @111allies fly a small banner, while @111rivals and @111distant&cities don't display any banners.  If a city has been tragically destroyed by a @92monster, you'll see the ruins of the former city. Enchanted places, the dank lairs that monsters call home, also appear on the map. @PIf there are armies or navies on the move, you'll see them on the World Map. In addition, if heroes are out and about, you'll see them on the world map, too. @PClicking on a city will display more detailed information about it in the panel to the right. At the top of the panel, the city's name will be displayed, along with the city's relationship to you, and the name of its leader. Just below the leader's name is the City History button, which looks like an open scroll. Click on this button to see a history of your interactions with this leader.  Most entries are marked by a 'thumbs up' or 'thumbs down' icon, telling you whether the event raised the leader's opinion of you, or caused it to fall. Below the open scroll is a button which shows the leader's current attitude toward you. Click on the attitude button for specific advice on how to improve the leader's attitude. @PIn the center of this panel you'll see any goods the selected city needs or produces.  If you are engaged in trade with the city, you will see how much of each good the city wishes to buy and sell, and how much of each you have exported or imported for the year. If you click on the Orders button, you'll see the selected city's @12Pier or @11Trading&Post panel, where you can issue trade instructions. If you are not trading with the city, you can still see which goods the city needs and produces. These tell you what kinds of gifts the city would appreciate receiving from you, and what items you may be able to obtain from the city via requests, raids, demands or even conquest. @PIf you've selected an active colony, ally or rival, you'll see several Action buttons at the bottom of the panel, which you can use to interact with the city. Click the button with the pair of hands on it to make a request or demand of another city. Demands are made of rivals; requests are made of all other cities. When you click the button, a list of the items you can request or demand from the city pops up. Make your choice, and when you return to your city you will be notified whether are not your request or demand was met. @PClick on the button with the pack donkey on it to fulfill the city's outstanding request. If there is more than one outstanding request, a panel will appear when you click this button. Choose the request you would like to fulfill. If the outstanding request is for military assistance, a panel listing your available forces will pop up. You'll see the action that the requesting city wants your troops to take. Select the forces you want to enlist by clicking on them, then click the Dispatch button. @PTo give a gift to a city, click the button with the coins on it. Choose a gift from the list that pops up.  Leaders most appreciate gifts of items that their city needs, and don't care all that much for gifts of items their city already produces. @PClick on the button with the soldier hiding behind some brush to raid a city. It's easier to successfully raid another city than it is to conquer it, but the rewards aren't as great. After you click on the button, you'll see a panel allowing you to select the raiding party, and give orders regarding what item you would like it to plunder.  Click on the Select Plunder button to choose what you want your soldiers to steal from the city. Then, select which forces you want to carry out the deed, and click the Dispatch button to send them on their way.  Each soldier or ship can only carry a certain amount of plunder back to your city, so the more forces you send, the more rewarding the raid will be. If the city cannot be accessed by water, you cannot dispatch ships as part of the raiding party. @PFinally, click on the button that has soldiers on it to attempt to conquer the selected city or, in the case of a vassal or colony, to quell a rebellion. When you click the attack button, you'll see a panel allowing you to enlist military forces for the attempted conquest. From this panel, select the companies and ships you'd like to enlist for your military campaign, and click dispatch.  If the city cannot be accessed by water, you cannot dispatch ships as part of the attack force. @PTo cycle through the cities on the world map, click on the arrows that are to the right and left of the City History button. And, to return to your city, click on the Back to City button.
text: @P點擊'大地圖'按鈕後，你可以看到希臘及周邊地區的全地圖，你可以在大地圖上和其他城市進行貿易和外交。 @P大地圖上的城市標記可以讓你了解這個城市的概況。盾牌數代表軍事力量，金幣數代表經濟實力，如果該城市可以和你的城市進行貿易，會有一條路通往你的城市，藍色代表海路，棕色代表陸路。如果該城市造反或者是附庸城，會有一個閃動的火炬圖案。 @P你的 @111母城 或正在建設的 @111殖民地 顯示為較大的正方形旗幟。你的 @111附庸城 或已建立的殖民地顯示為較小的正方形旗幟。你的 @111盟國 旗幟更小，你的 @111敵城 或 @111遠方城市 不顯示旗幟。如果城市被 @92怪獸 摧毀，就會顯示為廢墟。此外，怪獸的洞穴也會出現在大地圖上。 @P你在大地圖上還可以看到軍隊和英雄的圖標。 @P點擊城市圖標後你可以看到城市的介紹，如果點擊'城市歷史'，你就會看到自己的城市和這個城市的外交歷史，在城市領袖的窗口中，大拇指向上的事件代表該事件在外交上有正面影響，向下則相反。點擊'態度'按鈕後你可以得到關於增加其他領袖對你的好感的建議。 @P在控制面板的中間部分你可以看到這個城市能生產或者需要進口的物資。如果你要和這個城市進行貿易，可以看到各種詳細資料。如果你點擊'訂購'，就可以進入該城市的 @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 進行訂購。 @P如果你選擇的是殖民地，盟國或敵人，控制面板底部會出現一些功能按鈕。點擊雙手的按鈕，可以請求對方運送需要的物資。回到自己的城市後你會收到對方的回答。 @P點擊驢子的按鈕可以完成其它城市的請求。如果是軍事方面的請求，你可以看到具體要求，然後決定要派出的軍隊。 @P點擊金幣的按鈕可以給這個城市送禮物，其它城市一般只會對自己無法生產的東西感興趣。 @P點擊士兵躲在草叢裡的那個圖標可以搶劫這個城市，搶劫的難度要低於占領。你可以決定參與搶劫的部隊以及要搶劫的物品。如果該城市在內陸，你不能派三層船去搶劫。 @P點擊右下角的圖標就可以嘗試占領這座城市或者鎮壓叛亂。如果該城市在內陸，你不能派三層船去進攻。 @P你可以按控制面板上方的箭頭切換城市，也可以按最下方的按鈕回到自己的城市。

original: Click this button to rotate the view of your city. Click on the left side to rotate the view counter-clockwise, and click on the right side to rotate it clockwise. Clicking on the center of the button reorients your view due north. Rotating the city can be very helpful if any particularly tall buildings in the city are obscuring your view.
text: @P如果你的視線被大型建築擋住了，可以用旋轉地圖的方法來解決。點擊按鈕的中間部分可以恢復成上方朝北的標準模式。

original: Click on the Review Goals button to see what you need to do to complete the episode you are playing. Each of your goals will be listed as well as an update on your progress of each goal. If you've completed a goal, it will be checked off.  You also use this screen to set aside goods for a colony or the parent city and send a hero on a quest, if they are episode goals.
text: @P點擊'查看任務'按鈕可以看到在一關中需要完成的任務，已完成的任務會被打勾。

original: The people moving around in your city are called walkers.  Walkers emerge from the buildings you place, and are generally guided by the road network you create.  There are several different walkers, but just about all of them can be grouped into two categories: roaming walkers and destination walkers. @PRoaming walkers patrol the city with no particular destination in mind. Generally these are service walkers who provide some benefit to every house or other building they walk by. The city's roaming walkers are the nobleman, peddler, water bearer, healer, watchman, superintendent, athlete and clerk. Roaming walkers have no way of knowing where you want them to go, but you can guide them with @30Roadblocks.  Roaming walkers cannot pass through Roadblocks. @PMany walkers, such as deliverymen carting goods to and from buildings, have a specific destination in mind, and are called destination walkers.  These walkers include the food vendor, fleece vendor, oil vendor, arms vendor, wine vendor, horse trainer, chariot vendor, shepherd, goatherd, grower, tender, hunter, stonecutter, metallurgist, miner, lumberjack, artisan, soldier, immigrant, emigrant, vagrant and deliveryman. These walkers do not need you to guide them, so they pass right through Roadblocks. @PSome walkers have specific destinations in mind sometimes, but are roamers at other times. For example, an actor is a destination walker when going from the @16Drama School to the @17Theater, but is a roaming walker the rest of the time.  @PMost walkers need roads to walk upon, but in order to do their jobs effectively some need to leave the road and walk across open terrain. These walkers are the goatherd, shepherd, grower, tender, hunter, stonecutter, metallurgist, miner, lumberjack, artisan, soldier, immigrant, emigrant, vagrant, deliveryman getting supplies, and superintendent putting out a fire.
text: @P在城裡走來走去的都叫作行人。 @P一類行人是沒有固定目的地的，例如貴族、商販、挑水工、醫師、督察官、管理員、運動員和稅務官。如果你加了 @30路障 ，就可以控制他們的行走路線。他們無法越過路障。 @P另外一類行人有他們的目的地。例如送貨工、食品商販、羊毛商販、橄欖油商販、兵器商販、葡萄酒商販、訓馬師、牧羊人、園丁、獵人、採石工人、銀礦礦工、銅礦礦工、伐木工、工匠、士兵、移民、流浪漢。他們可以越過路障。 @P學者、高級運動員和演員要視具體情況而定。當學者從 @13大學 去 @14講壇 、演員從 @16戲劇學院 去 @17劇場 、高級運動員從 @15體育館 去 @18露天運動場 的時候，他們可以越過路障。在其它情況下他們無法越過路障。 @P大多數行人都要在道路上行走，不過有些可以穿越不同的地形，他們是：牧羊人、銀礦礦工、銅礦礦工、伐木工、工匠、士兵、移民、流浪漢、送貨工和管理員。

original: Monsters can cause significant trouble if they are your enemies, but can also help protect you if they are your friends. In all, there are sixteen monsters that you'll encounter in your travels through Greece and Atlantis. @PSometimes, monsters are in the service of @93gods, but other times they operate independently. Any hero can fight a monster, but each hero has a better chance against certain monsters than others. You can also use your military forces to battle monsters. The monsters you may encounter are: @L@LCYCLOPS @PThe hulking, one-eyed Cyclops uses a club as a weapon against his enemies, and he can also throw fire balls. If he is not working independently, his master is Zeus. Odysseus has the best chance of defeating the Cyclops. @L@LKRAKEN @PThe foul Kraken rises up from the sea to wreak havoc on you or for you. He uses his poisonous tentacles to attack and can also spit magic bolts. He usually works for Poseidon, but he can also work independently. Perseus is the Kraken's most feared foe. @L@LCERBERUS @PCerberus, the three-headed hound of the Underworld, uses his sharp bite to attack his enemies. He can also spit fireballs. If he's not working on his own, he will be in the service of Hades. Hercules has the best chance of defeating him. @L@LMEDUSA @PMedusa, the Gorgon, turns people to stone just by looking at them. She can also launch magic bolts from her eyes. If she's not causing trouble on her own, Medusa may be in service of Demeter. Perseus is skilled at doing battle with her. @L@LHYDRA @PThe many-headed Hydra attacks using his stinging bites and can also spit magic bolts. He usually takes his orders from Athena. Hercules has the best chance of vanquishing the beast. @L@LCALYDONIAN BOAR @PThe Calydonian Boar gores people with his tusks and will also spit fireballs. He most often works for Artemis. The hero Theseus has the upper hand against the Calydonian Boar. @L@LSCYLLA @PThe six-headed Scylla bites and launches magic bolts. She usually works for Apollo, and the hero Odysseus has the best chance of defeating her. @L@LDRAGON @PThe fierce Dragon breaths fire and bites when attacking. Generally, he takes orders from Ares. Jason has the best chance of defeating an angry Dragon. @L@LTALOS @PTalos, a bronze man fashioned by Hephaestus, fights using his sword and can also throw fireballs. He most often takes orders from his maker. He is most vulnerable to the hero Jason. @L@LHECTOR @PHector, the famous Trojan warrior, fights with a spear and can also shoot arrows from his bow. He generally does Aphrodite's bidding. Achilles has the best chance of defeating him. @L@LMINOTAUR @PThe half-man, half-bull Minotaur fights with a big axe and magic bolts. He most often works for Hermes. Theseus has the best chance of defeating him. @L@LMAENADS @PMaenads are women who have gone mad from indulging in Dionysus' cult of the vine.  They fight with their bare hands and can also throw magic bolts. Achilles has the best chance of defeating them. @L@LSPHINX @PThe deadly Sphinx kills anyone who cannot answer her mysterious riddle correctly. She can also fire magic bolts. She does Hera's bidding, but will also work independently. Atalanta is clever enough to solve the riddle and kill the Sphinx. @L@LCHIMERA @PThe hideous Chimera is a mish-mash of different creatures, combined together into one ugly monster. She enjoys breathing fireballs to kill things. She works in the service of Atlas, but she'll also destroy things on her own. Bellerophon knows what to do to kill this monster. @L@LECHIDNA @PEchidna, the mother of some of the most dastardly monsters, always works on her own. Her magic bolts are the death of many. Bellerophon knows how to dispatch this monster. @L@LHARPIES @PThe Harpies are ravenous, winged monsters fond of firing magic bolts at unsuspecting people, animals and things. No one, not even a god, can control the Harpies, so they always work independently. Atalanta has the best chance of defeating them.
text: @P怪獸可以是你的朋友，也可以成為你的敵人。遊戲中有12種怪獸。 @P怪獸有時為神明服務，有時自己獨立行動。你可以派軍隊或要求英雄去對付怪獸，特定的英雄對付特定的怪獸會有奇效。怪獸包括： @L@L獨眼巨人 @P獨眼巨人用大棒和火球攻擊，他的主人是宙斯。奧德修斯是對付獨眼巨人的專家。 @L@L海妖 @P他用觸手和閃電攻擊，主人是波賽東。珀耳修斯是對付海妖的專家。 @L@L地獄惡犬刻耳柏洛斯 @P它用巨齒和火球攻擊，主人是黑帝斯。赫爾克利斯是對付它的專家。 @L@L美杜莎 @P她能把人石化，而且眼睛會放魔法，她的主人是狄蜜特。珀耳修斯是對付美杜莎的專家。 @L@L九頭蛇許德拉 @P九頭蛇許德拉用巨齒和魔法攻擊，主人是雅典娜。赫爾克利斯是對付它的專家。 @L@L野豬卡利多尼恩 @P野豬卡利多尼恩用獠牙和火球魔法攻擊，主人是阿緹蜜絲。忒修斯是對付它的專家。 @L@L六頭女妖斯庫拉 @P六頭女妖斯庫拉用巨齒和魔法攻擊，她的主人是阿波羅。奧德修斯是對付六頭女妖斯庫拉的專家。 @L@L巨龍 @P巨龍噴火攻擊，主人是阿瑞斯。伊阿宋是對付它的專家。 @L@L塔洛斯 @P塔洛斯用劍和魔法攻擊，主人是赫菲斯托斯。伊阿宋是對付它的專家。 @L@L赫克托耳 @P赫克托耳是特洛伊最強悍的戰士，用長矛和弓箭攻擊，主人是愛芙羅黛蒂。阿基裡斯是對付他的專家。 @L@L牛頭怪彌諾陶洛斯 @P牛頭怪彌諾陶洛斯用戰斧和魔法攻擊，主人是荷米斯。忒修斯是對付它的專家。 @L@L酒神侍女 @P酒神侍女是酒神狄俄尼索斯的侍女，她們徒手攻擊，同時也懂得魔法。阿基裡斯是對付她們的專家。

original: The Gods are everywhere. Sometimes, they are your friends and other times they are a little less than friendly.  Here are the gods that you're bound to run into sooner or later, in order of their strength: @L@LZEUS @PZeus, the Ruler of Heaven, is the most powerful of all the gods. To find out how he can help you, read the entry on @62Zeus'&Stronghold. Zeus can also be a formidable enemy. He can curse many of your buildings, rendering them useless. He might even employ his Cyclops to wreak havoc on your city. @L@LPOSEIDON @PPoseidon, Ruler of the Sea, presides over buildings that depend on water. To see how he can help you, read the entry on @61Promontory&of&Poseidon. If Poseidon is your enemy, watch out for his Kraken. He can also curse your @38Fisheries and @38Urchin&Quays. In Atlantis, he can curse your @143Frigate&Wharves, and in Greece he can curse your @32Trireme&Wharves. And, just to make things even more interesting, he also interrupts sea trade. @L@LHADES @PHades is the Ruler of the Underworld, and can provide many benefits to your city should you choose to worship him. To see what benefits Hades can bring you if you worship him, click @58here.  If Hades ever has a reason to invade your city, he'll curse your @43Foundries and @44Mints and will carry off all the walkers on the city's streets to the Underworld with him, depriving the city of their services until they can be replaced. Hades is also not above unleashing @92Cerberus on your city.  @L@LHERA @PHera, Queen of Heaven, can be a wonderful friend if you choose to worship her. To find out how she expresses her friendship, read the entry on the @71Orchard&of&Hera. If Hera views you as a threat, then she is sure to cause trouble. One of her favorite tricks is to turn people into cattle. Continuing with the bovine theme, she also likes to curse @108Corrals. To top things off, she will also make everyone else in the world think less of you. She can also unleash the @92Sphinx on your city. @L@LDEMETER @PDemeter, Goddess of Fertility, rules over all fertile land. Click @56here to see how Demeter can benefit you if you decide to worship her.  If she has a reason to cause you harm, she will render your farms infertile for a few months. She also might enlist @92Medusa to attack your city, and turn your citizens to stone.  @L@LATHENA @PAthena, Goddess of Warriors, Crafts and Wisdom, can be a tremendous aid to cities that worship her.  Click @55here to see how Athena can help your city, should you decide to worship her.  If she is your enemy, Athena can cause a world of hurt for your city. She will weaken your city's @31defenses and curse your @35olive&trees. She could also unleash the @92Hydra upon your city, if she is truly out to get you.  @L@LARTEMIS @PArtemis is the Goddess of Hunters. To see how she can help you if you choose to worship her, click @54here.  If Artemis ever has reason to lash out at you, she will attack your city with an army of Amazons, curse your @69Hunting&Lodges, and restore any wolf packs in the area to full strength. She also could unleash the @92Calydonian&Boar to attack your city.   @L@LAPOLLO @PApollo, the God of Prophecy and Healing, can bring many benefits your city, should you decide to worship him.  Click @52here to find out what Apollo can do for you.  If Apollo opposes you, he may invade your city, cursing your @50Infirmaries, and causing widespread plague.  If you are ruling in Greece, he may also curse your cultural institutions, rendering them temporarily inactive. In Atlantis, he may curse your science buildings. He might also choose to unleash @92Scylla upon your city. @L@LATLAS @PAtlas, the Bearer of the World and First High King of Atlantis, can be extremely helpful if you choose to worship him. Click @70here to read about the benefits that Atlas can bring. If the strong god decides to be your enemy, then your construction-related industries are in trouble. He curses @131Black&Marble&Workshops and @42Masonry&Shops, making all the marble that they have on hand too brittle to use. Plus, no more marble can be quarried while the buildings are cursed. As if that weren't bad enough, he also curses @45Artisans'&Guilds. All the artisans mysteriously disappear, and they won't reappear until the curse is lifted. Plus, any citizens that he lays eyes upon will be turned to stone. If he doesn't feel like rampaging himself, Atlas will send @92Chimera to wreak havoc. @L@LARES @PAres, God of War, can be a powerful friend.  Click @53here to see how Ares can help you, should you decide to worship him.  If he is your enemy, Ares may invade your city with some of his fiercest warriors, or even unleash his @92Dragon to do you harm.   @L@LHEPHAESTUS @PHephaestus, Smith of Heaven, can be a great benefit, when he feels warmly towards you.  Click @59here to see how Hephaestus might help you, should you choose to worship him.  If Hephaestus is your enemy, he may invade your city, setting buildings on fire, and crippling your @33Armories and @48Sculpture&Studios with his curse. He could also unleash his hideous man of bronze, @92Talos, to attack your city.  @L@LAPHRODITE @PAphrodite, Goddess of the Tender Passions, can be a wonderful boon to any leader.  Click @51here to see what good she can do for you.  Aphrodite isn't always friendly, though. If her interests differ from yours, she may attack your city, and lead away all the walkers that provide benefits to your city. She even lures away a portion of the city's population. If she doesn't feel like punishing your city herself, she'll enlist @92Hector to attack.  @L@LHERMES @PHermes, Messenger of the Gods, can be a wonderful friend. Click @60here to learn about the benefits Hermes can bring to your city.  If he opposes you, however, Hermes may appear in your city, stealing money and disrupting trade. He might also unleash the @92Minotaur to cause trouble for you.  @L@LDIONYSUS @PDionysus, God of the Vine, can be a fun guy to have as a friend.  To find out just what he's willing to do for you, click @57here.  If, however, Dionysus has reason to oppose you, and invades your city, he'll invite all your walkers to a party that they just can't resist. When the walkers leave your city, all the people and buildings that rely on their services will have to go without until they can be replaced. Dionysus will also curse your @36Grapevines, making grapes wither and die. Sometimes, Dionysus will unleash one or two @92Maenads, crazy women, on the city.  @L@PImmortals often need help from a mortal to achieve a goal or retrieve a certain item. When a god needs your help, he or she may ask you to undertake a quest.
text: @P神明擁有無與倫比的力量，他們可以是你的朋友，也可能成為你的敵人。 @L@L宙斯 @P宙斯是眾神之主。如果要宙斯幫助你，參見 @62宙斯聖所 。如果宙斯成為你的敵人，他可以讓許多建築失去功能，讓商人遠離你的城市。還可以放出獨眼巨人攻擊你的城市。 @L@L波賽東 @P波賽東，海洋之神。如果要波賽東幫助你，參見 @61波賽東聖所 。如果波賽東成為你的敵人，會詛咒 @38漁場 、 @38海膽加工場 和 @32三層船碼頭 ，讓商船遠離你的城市，還可以放出海妖攻擊你。 @L@L黑帝斯 @P黑帝斯是地獄之神。如果要黑帝斯幫助你，參見 @58黑帝斯聖所 。如果他成為你的敵人，就會詛咒你的 @43鑄造場 和 @44鑄幣場 ，還會把所有的行人帶進地獄。此外，他還會讓 @92地獄惡犬刻耳柏洛斯 攻擊你的城市。  @L@L狄蜜特 @P狄蜜特，農業女神。如果要狄蜜特幫助你，參見 @56狄蜜特聖所 。如果她成為你的敵人，會讓你的農場好幾個月顆粒無收，還會讓 @92美杜沙 攻擊你的城市，把人變成石頭。  @L@L雅典娜 @P雅典娜，戰爭和智慧女神。如果要雅典娜幫助你，參見 @55雅典娜聖所 。如果她成為你的敵人，會降低你的城市的 @31防御力 ，詛咒你的 @35橄欖樹 。此外，她還會派出 @92九頭蛇 攻擊你的城市。  @L@L阿緹蜜絲 @P阿緹蜜絲，狩獵女神。如果要阿緹蜜絲幫助你，參見 @54阿緹蜜絲聖所 。如果阿緹蜜絲成為你的敵人，會派出女戰士攻擊你的城市，詛咒你的 @69獵人小屋 ，讓狼群到處肆虐。此外，她還會派出 @92野豬卡利多尼恩 攻擊你的城市。   @L@L阿波羅 @P阿波羅，太陽神。如果要阿波羅幫助你，參見 @52阿波羅聖所 。如果他成為你的敵人，會詛咒你的 @50診所 ，讓瘟疫肆虐。他能讓文化設施暫時無法使用，還會派出 @92六頭女妖斯庫拉 攻擊你的城市。  @L@L阿瑞斯 @P阿瑞斯，戰爭之神。如果要阿瑞斯幫助你，參見 @53阿瑞斯聖所 。如果他成為你的敵人，就會派出他手下的戰士甚至派出 @92巨龍 攻擊你的城市。  @L@L赫菲斯托斯 @P赫菲斯托斯，火神和冶煉之神。如果要赫菲斯托斯幫助你，參見 @59赫菲斯托斯聖所 。如果他成為你的敵人，他會讓城市起火，詛咒 @33防具鋪 和 @48鑄像場 ，甚至派出 @92塔洛斯 攻擊你的城市。 @L@L愛芙羅黛蒂 @P愛芙羅黛蒂，愛與美的女神。如果要愛芙羅黛蒂幫助你，參見 @51愛芙羅黛蒂聖所 。如果她成為你的敵人，會帶走城裡的一些行人和居民，甚至派出 @92赫克托耳 攻擊你的城市。  @L@L荷米斯 @P荷米斯，眾神的信使，商業之神。如果要荷米斯幫助你，參見 @60荷米斯聖所 。如果他成為你的敵人，會減少你的資產，影響貿易，甚至派出 @92牛頭怪彌諾陶洛斯 攻擊你的城市。  @L@L狄俄尼索斯 @P狄俄尼索斯，酒神。如果要狄俄尼索斯幫助你，參見 @57狄俄尼索斯聖所 。如果他成為你的敵人，會帶走許多行人，詛咒你的 @36葡萄藤 ，甚至派出他那瘋狂的侍女攻擊你的城市。  @L@P神明有時候會要求你為他們完成一些任務。

original: Heroes roam the world in search of adventure, always looking to help out when they're needed. If one hears that you are facing a troublesome situation, the hero will probably be willing to help you out if you build a Hero's Hall. The Heroes you may encounter are @63Achilles, @64Hercules, @67Perseus, @68Theseus, @66Odysseus, @65Jason, @74Atalanta and @107Bellerophon. @PHeroes' services are in great demand throughout the world, so you can only build a Hero's Hall if you truly need the hero's help.  Additionally, Hero's Halls are dismantled at the end of an episode, when the hero is no longer needed in the city. @PIf there is a monster in your city, the hero will fight the foul foe without orders from you.  If you need to send a hero on a Quest to retrieve an item, click on the @75Overview Tab.  You'll see the Quest listed.  If the needed hero is in the city, a green light will appear next to the quest.  Click on this light, select the appropriate hero on the 'Enlist Forces' panel, and click 'Dispatch' to send the hero on his or her way.  You can also send a hero on a Quest by right clicking the appropriate Hero's Hall.  If the hero is needed for a Quest, the quest will be listed there on a button.  Click the button to send the Hero.  Alternatively, you can click the Goals Button on the @86Control&Panel. Click on the button that appears next to the Quest on the Goals panel to send the hero.
text: @P如果你為英雄建造了府邸，就可以得到英雄的幫助。遊戲裡的英雄包括： @63阿基裡斯 、 @64赫爾克利斯 、 @67珀耳修斯 、 @68忒修斯 、 @66奧德修斯 和 @65伊阿宋 。 @P英雄要四處作戰，所以不到必須的時候，你是無法建造英雄府邸的，但是一旦他們進入了你的城市，就會待到一關的結束。

original: Sheep and goats live in meadows, where they are tended by shepherds and goatherds. @PTo begin raising sheep or goats, you first need herders. Shepherds, who tend sheep, come from a @39Carding&Shed. Goatherds come from a @40Dairy. Once the appropriate building is in place, you can begin raising livestock. Choose the animal you want to raise from the list that appears after you click on the Husbandry Tab's Herding button. Then, guide your cursor to a meadow, which is you can identify by its purple flowers. When you see a green ghost of the animal, you'll know you've chosen a good spot.  Click to place a single sheep or goat. @PSheep and goats graze on a certain section of meadow until they've eaten all the edible vegetation on it. They then move to an adjacent area of meadow, provided it has vegetation for them to eat.  All meadow vegetation eventually regrows.  Because meadowland always remains fertile, you can still place farms and other husbandry structures on meadowland that has been consumed by animals. @PEspecially lucky sheep and goats will be sacrificed to the gods. Priests from a Sanctuary will come into the fields to retrieve the sheep and goats destined for greater glory.
text: @P綿羊和山羊在草地上，由牧羊人看護。 @P要養綿羊和山羊，你首先要建造 @39羊毛場 和 @40奶品場 。選擇農業標簽中的'牧場'，選擇要養的牲畜，然後放置到草地上去。 @P綿羊和山羊吃光一片草地上的草後會到附近的草地上去吃草，草被吃掉後，草地上仍然可以建造農場和其它農業建築。被吃掉的草以後還會慢慢長出來。 @P有時候聖所的祭司會用羊祭祀神明。

original: Citizen soldiers defend your city from invaders, and undertake your military campaigns abroad. They'll also try their best against monsters, and if you have enough of them, they just might succeed against these supernatural foes. @PThere are three types of soldiers in most Greek cities: rabble, hoplites and horsemen.  Rabble come from @6common&housing. They wear no armor and use whatever they can find around them as weapons - they normally just throw rocks. To learn about the tactics they use, click @104here. Hoplites live in @7elite&housing and are the mainstay of the military. They are armored, carry spears, and fight in phalanxes. To learn how to maneuver your hoplites, click @105here. Finally, horsemen come from your most elite housing. For information on the tactics they use in battle, click @106here.
text: @P士兵有三種：民兵、步兵和騎兵。民兵來自 @6民房 ，一般只能扔扔石頭，詳細介紹請點擊 @104此處 。步兵來自 @7高級住宅 ，他們穿盔甲，使用長矛，列陣作戰，詳細介紹請點擊 @105此處 。騎兵也來自高級住宅，詳細介紹請點擊 @106此處 。

original: This slot on the @86Control&Panel is used to displays the Hazard 'Go To' button. When a catastrophe occurs in your city, clicking on the icon that appears in this slot takes you directly to the site of the problem. The icons that can appear here include @25Fire, @125Earthquake, @125Tidal&Wave, @125Landslide, @125Lava, @25Collapsed&Building and @126Blocked&Road.
text: @P當城裡發生災難時，你可以在 @86控制面板 中點擊這個按鈕查看。災難包括 @25火災 、 @125地震 、 @125洪水 、 @125山崩 、 @125火山爆發 、 @25建筑倒塌 和 @126道路被封鎖 。

original: When your city experiences a significant @118hygiene problem, specifically an outbreak of plague, a button appears on the @86Control&Panel. Clicking on the button will bring you directly to ground zero of the plague.
text: @P當城裡出現 @118衛生 問題，特別是瘟疫時，你可以 @86控制面板 中點擊這個按鈕查看。

original: When someone or something unfriendly invades your city, a button showing the invader appears on the Control Panel. Clicking on the button will bring you directly to the site of the problem. The types of invaders you may see here are enemy soldiers, monsters and unfriendly gods.
