text: @P敵軍入侵的時候你可以點擊這個按鈕查看。

original: When a hero arrives, your soldiers return home or a friendly god pays your city a visit, a button appears on the Control Panel. Clicking on the button takes you directly to the site of the arrival.
text: @P自己的士兵返回時，或者英雄和神明來訪時可以點擊這個按鈕查看。

original: Wolves prey on sheep, goats and cows that are not well-guarded. Shepherds are responsible for guarding sheep, goatherds look after goats, and bulls keep a watchful eye on cows. As long as your flocks and herds are vigilantly watched by shepherds, goatherds and bulls, wolves won't dare to make off with a sheep, goat or cow. But, if a wolf senses that an animal is vulnerable, he'll help himself to a tasty snack.
text: @P如果你的山羊和綿羊周圍沒有牧羊人看護，它們可能會被狼喫掉。

original: The wild boar can be hunted for food. To hunt the wild boar, you'll need to build a @69Hunting&Lodge. @PThe city's hunters are always very careful when stalking the wild boar. While they are tasty, they are also quite dangerous. Sometimes, a wild boar will take a hunter completely by surprise and attack him.
text: @P建造 @69獵人小屋 後就可以開始打野豬了。 @P請注意，獵人狩獵野豬時可能會有危險。

original: The trireme is a powerful, quick and agile war vessel that helps to defend your city's shores, and can be used on some of your military campaigns abroad. @PTo move the Trireme, click on it and then click on the location you would like it to move to. To issue the Trireme orders, click on it, then use one of the orders buttons that will appear on the Control Panel. The orders are: @L@PCALL CREW TO SHIP/SEND CREW HOME. This order tells the ship's crew to come aboard, or to go home, depending on what they are currently doing. Keep in mind that while issuing the 'Send Crew Home' command returns the trireme to the wharf, and disbands its crew, it does not instruct the trireme's Wharf to repair the ship. If you want repairs performed on the ship, you'll have to issue the 'Carry Out Repairs' order. @L@PDEFEND LOCATION. When given this order, the ship's captain will hold his vessel in one location, and defend this location against any attackers that come near.  @L@PATTACK ALL ENEMIES. When given this order, the ship's captain will aggressively seek out any enemy and attack it. The captain chooses which enemies to attack following a fixed set of priorities. First he'll seek out enemy transports which are currently carrying soldiers, to try to destroy them before their soldiers can reach land. If there are no such vessels, he looks for enemy warships to attack. Failing that, he'll order his trireme close to shore to attack any enemy soldiers that might have landed. Finally, if there are no enemy soldiers within his reach, he'll attack empty enemy transports. @L@PPATROL AREA. When given this order, the trireme's captain will patrol your city's waters, attacking any enemies he encounters.  @L@PCARRY OUT REPAIRS. Clicking this button will send the trireme back to its Wharf to be repaired. If the ship is severely damaged, the trireme captain will take it upon himself to return to the Wharf for repairs. @L@PGO TO SHIP. Clicking this button centers your view on the trireme.   @PYou cannot issue military commands while the game is @3paused. @PYou can select more than one trireme at a time and issue all of them the same orders. First, select a single trireme. When the cursor changes, click and drag your mouse. You'll notice that a box appears. Adjust this box by clicking and dragging your mouse so that the box contains all the triremes you want to select/ Then, let go of the mouse button and order away! @PAfter you've selected a fleet of triremes, you can assign a hotkey to the fleet. With the fleet selected, hold down the CTRL and press 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5.  When you want to recall the fleet, simply press the ALT key plus the number you assigned it to.
text: @P三層船用來打海戰。 @P要移動三層船，在目的地點擊一下即可。選中三層船後會有如下的命令按鈕： @L@P召集船員/解散船員。船回到碼頭後不會自動修理，你要點擊'回城修理'才行。 @L@P堅守原位。  @L@P全力進攻。進攻有優先級。最優先進攻的是運載士兵的運輸船，其次是戰船，再次是岸邊的士兵，最後是空的運輸船。 @L@P巡航。巡航中三層船會自動攻擊進入視野範圍內的敵軍目標。  @L@P回城修理。艦船返回碼頭進行修理。如果在戰鬥中損傷嚴重，艦長也會自己下這個命令。 @L@P查看艦船。   @P遊戲 @3暫停 時無法指揮三層船戰鬥。

original: Rabble come from the city's @6common&housing. Residents of common housing will begin fighting for the city as soon as they are living in houses that are at least at the Hovel level, and you have erected a Palace.  @PTo select a company of Rabble, click on its standard or click on any of the men in the company. When you do, the @86Control&Panel will change, displaying the company's status. You'll see the company's name, along with the current morale of its men. If a company's morale dips too low, its men will refuse to fight. You'll also see a brief description of what the company is currently doing.  @PAbove the status information is a series of buttons that you use to position the company and give it orders. The buttons you'll see are: @PGO TO COMPANY BUTTON. Clicking on the Go To Company button will center your view on the company's standard. @PROTATE COMPANY BUTTON. The Rotate Company button indicates which direction the company is currently facing. Clicking on the button will rotate the company. @PMUSTER COMPANY/SEND HOME BUTTON. The Muster Company/Send Home button lets you call your soldiers to arms (muster) or send them home, depending on which they are currently doing. @PUSE DEFENSIVE TACTICS. When Rabble have been told to defend an area, they hold their position and throw rocks at a distant enemy. If the enemy comes close to them, they find whatever primitive weapon they can and fight hand-to-hand. @PUSE OFFENSIVE TACTICS. When told to employ an offensive tactic, Rabble will attack any nearby enemy. @PEMPLOY SPECIAL TACTICS. The special tactic employed by Rabble is the skirmish. Rabble will throw rocks at a distant enemy. When that enemy comes too close, the Rabble will fall back and continue throwing rocks.  If no enemies are nearby after the skirmish, the Rabble company returns to its standard. @PSHOW ALL FORCES. Clicking on the Magnifying Glass brings up a list of @84all&your&military&forces. From there, you can issue general instructions to all of your military forces. @PYou cannot issue military commands while the game is @3paused.
text: @P民兵來自升級到'小屋'以上等級的 @6民房 ，此外你還要先建造宮殿。 @P選中民兵部隊後， @86控制面板 上會出現部隊狀態，包括名稱、士氣和當前任務。如果士氣太低，部隊可能會拒絕戰鬥。  @P你可以對民兵下達以下的命令： @P查看部隊。 @P旋轉部隊。決定當前部隊的朝向。 @P召集部隊/解散部隊。 @P使用防御戰術。敵人在遠處時用石頭攻擊，靠近後用簡單的武器肉搏。 @P使用進攻戰術。自動攻擊附近的敵人。 @P使用特殊戰術。敵人在遠處時用石頭攻擊。如果敵人靠近，民兵就後退，仍然用石頭攻擊。擊退敵人後他們會回到原來的崗位。 @P顯示所有部隊。讓你查看所有 @84軍事單位 ，直接發布命令。 @P遊戲 @3暫停 時無法指揮民兵戰鬥。

original: @PHoplites come from the city's @7Mansions and @7Manors. @PTo select a phalanx of hoplites, click on its standard or click on any of the soldiers in the company. When you do, the Control Panel will change, displaying the company's status. You'll see the company's name, along with the current morale of its men. If a company's morale dips too low, its hoplites will refuse to fight. You'll also see a brief description of what the company is currently doing.  @PAbove the status information is a series of buttons that you use to position the company and give it orders. The buttons you'll see are: @PGO TO COMPANY BUTTON. Clicking on the Go To Company button will center your view on the company's standard. @PROTATE COMPANY BUTTON. The Rotate Company button indicates which direction the company is currently facing. Clicking on the button will rotate the company. @PMUSTER COMPANY/SEND HOME BUTTON. The Muster Company/Send Home button lets you call your soldiers to arms and send them home. What the company is currently doing governs which command clicking this button will issue. If the company is already mustered, then clicking the button will send the men home. If the company is at home, then clicking the button will call the soldiers to arms. @PUSE DEFENSIVE TACTICS. When employing defensive tactics, hoplites will stand their ground, and attack anything that comes close to them with their spears. @PUSE OFFENSIVE TACTICS. When told to use offensive tactics, hoplites move together, attacking with their spears. @PEMPLOY SPECIAL TACTICS. The hoplites' special tactic is the wedge, which is good for breaking defensive formations. The soldiers organize themselves into a wedge shape to attack enemies. @PSHOW ALL FORCES. Clicking on the Magnifying Glass brings up a list of @84all&your&military&forces. From there, you can issue general instructions to your entire military. @PYou cannot issue military commands while the game is @3paused.
text: @P步兵來自 @7官邸 和 @7莊園 。 @P選中步兵部隊後，控制面板上會出現部隊狀態，包括名稱、士氣和當前任務。如果士氣太低，部隊可能會拒絕戰鬥。  @P你可以對步兵下達以下的命令： @P查看部隊。 @P旋轉部隊。決定當前部隊的朝向。 @P召集部隊/解散部隊。 @P使用防御戰術。敵人接近後才開始進攻。 @P使用進攻戰術。組隊進攻，用長矛攻擊，盾牌防護。 @P使用特殊戰術。步兵組織成鍥形攻勢，攻擊敵人的防御陣線。 @P顯示所有部隊。讓你查看所有 @84軍事單位 ，直接發布命令。 @P遊戲 @3暫停 時無法指揮步兵戰鬥。

original: @PHorsemen come from the city's @7Estates. @PTo select a company of horsemen, click on its standard or click on any of the soldiers in the company. When you do, the Control Panel will change, displaying the company's status. You'll see the company's name, along with the current morale of its men. If a company's morale dips too low, its men will refuse to fight. You'll also see a brief description of what the company is currently doing.  @PAbove the status information is a series of buttons that you use to position the company and give it orders. The buttons you'll see are: @PGO TO COMPANY BUTTON. Clicking on the Go To Company button will center your view on the company's standard. @PROTATE COMPANY BUTTON. The Rotate Company button indicates which direction the company is currently facing. Clicking on the button will rotate the company. @PMUSTER COMPANY/SEND HOME BUTTON. The Muster Company/Send Home button lets you call your soldiers to arms or send them home, depending on which they are currently doing. @PUSE DEFENSIVE TACTICS. When horsemen have been told to defend an area, they remain on their horses and fight from horseback if an enemy comes within range. @PUSE OFFENSIVE TACTICS. When told to use offensive tactics, horsemen will charge the enemy in an attempt to break their formations, after which they'll stay and fight from horseback. From there, you can issue general instructions to your entire military. @PYou cannot issue military commands while the game is @3paused.
text: @P騎兵來自 @7領地 。 @P選中騎兵部隊後，控制面板上會出現部隊狀態，包括名稱、士氣和當前任務。如果士氣太低，部隊可能會拒絕戰鬥。  @P你可以對騎兵下達以下的命令： @P查看部隊。 @P旋轉部隊。決定當前部隊的朝向。 @P@P召集部隊/解散部隊。 @P使用防御戰術。敵人接近後才開始進攻。 @P使用進攻戰術。自動攻擊附近的敵人。 @P使用特殊戰術。騎兵的特殊戰術是騷擾。打一陣就退回來休整，然後再追擊，如此循環。 @P顯示所有部隊。讓你查看所有 @84軍事單位 ，直接發布命令。 @P遊戲 @3暫停 時無法指揮騎兵戰鬥。

original: Bellerophon, the famed horseman, will come to your city if you build his Hero's Hall and outfit it with the required items.  To find out what Bellerophon wants, right-click on the Hall.  His demands will be listed there, and each one will be checked off as you meet it. @POnce you have met all of Bellerophon's requirements, you can bring the hero to your city by right-clicking his Hall and clicking the 'Summon Bellerophon' button. The hero will begin his journey to your city. @PYou may need Bellerophon's services to fulfill a @130quest.  He is also the only hero who can defeat @92Echidna and @92Chimera. If you don't have any heroic duties for Bellerophon, you can also send him to battles abroad.

original: Build a Corral to raise cows for meat. Corrals must be built along a road. @POnce you build a Corral, you can place some cattle in a meadow.  As you place the cattle, you'll notice that some of the cattle are bulls.  Bulls watch over the herd, safeguarding the cows, and are not used for food.  All cattle can be sacrificed to the gods. @PWhen a cow is old enough, a rancher herds it back to the Corral, where it is killed and carved into meat. As soon as enough meat is stored at the Corral, a deliveryman brings the food to a Granary, or to a trading facility if you are exporting the good.  @PCorrals aren't just places of death. Calves are born at the Corral and, after they have been weaned, are put out to pasture with the other cattle. Because calves are born frequently, you don't need to worry about replacing slaughtered cattle yourself. You do, however, need to replace any cattle that priests take for sacrifice.

original: To harvest the succulent oranges that grow on @149Orange&Trees, build an Orange Tenders' Lodge. Orange Tenders' Lodges must be built along a road. @POnce an Orange Tenders' Lodge has employees, it sends out tenders to take care of the trees. Tenders prune and maintain the trees to ensure that the oranges growing upon them are healthy. Harvest time arrives in November. The tenders will pick fruit for two months. After two months, any oranges that have not been picked will go to waste. @PAfter the oranges are harvested, the tenders bring the food back to the Orange Tenders' Lodge, where it is cleaned and prepared for storage. When enough oranges are ready, a deliveryman will bring them to a Granary or to a trading facility if you are exporting the food. Make sure that the Orange Tenders' Lodge is connected by a road to the oranges' destination. Otherwise, the deliveryman will get stuck.

original: To build a Sanctuary, you must first have marble stored in the city. Each Sanctuary requires a different amount of marble in order to place its base and steps. @PTo build a Sanctuary, choose the Mythology Tab and click on the Sanctuaries button. Choose the Sanctuary you want to build from the list, and a red footprint will appear. Move the red footprint to the spot where you want to build the Sanctuary. If you want to rotate the footprint, press the 'r' key. When you've positioned the Sanctuary where you want it, and when the footprint turns green, click to place it. @PPressing the 'm' key when placing a Sanctuary can also be helpful, because it will freeze the Sanctuary's footprint, and allow you to move the mouse to scroll your view, and make sure the Sanctuary is placed where you want it. Provided the footprint is green, click to place the Sanctuary. Or, press 'm' again to unfreeze the footprint and look for a better location.  There can be no more than four Sanctuaries in any city.  Some cities can support even fewer Sanctuaries, so choose which you want to build carefully. If you find yourself in need of a different Sanctuary, but the city cannot support any additional Sanctuaries, you'll have to demolish an existing Sanctuary to build a new one. @PIn order for Sanctuary construction to begin, you need artisans from an @45Artisans'&Guild. You also must make sure that the Sanctuary is connected by road to the Artisans' Guild, and to the storage facility from which it will draw materials for its construction.  Artisans will wait at the construction site for a delivery of supplies, either marble, wood or sculpture. If the requisite construction materials are available in a Storehouse, @12Pier or @11Trading&Post, the Storage building's oxcart will bring the material to the construction site. When the material arrives, the artisans will use it to construct the Sanctuary. @PIf you would like to halt construction on a Sanctuary, right-click the Sanctuary and click the 'Halt Sanctuary Construction' button. The artisans will finish up their current tasks and then go home or look for another construction project that needs their services. To resume construction, right-click the Sanctuary and click the 'Resume Sanctuary Construction' button. @PTo find out about the benefits a particular Sanctuary will bring, click on the desired god: @62Zeus, @61Poseidon, @58Hades, @71Hera, @56Demeter, @55Athena, @52Apollo, @54Artemis, @70Atlas, @53Ares, @59Hephaestus, @51Aphrodite, @60Hermes or @57Dionysus
text: @P要建造聖所，首先要足夠的大理石。 @P選擇神話標簽裡的'聖所'按鈕，點擊你想建造的聖所，然後放到畫面上，按R鍵可以旋轉。 @P建造聖所時按'M'鍵可以把聖所暫時固定住，此時你可以移動屏幕看看周圍的情況，然後再按'M'鍵可以解除固定，然後決定一個最佳的建造場所。一座城市最多可以建造4個聖所，如果上限已滿，而你還想建造其它聖所，就必須拆毀原來的聖所。 @P要建造聖所，你還要有 @45工匠行 ，並且聖所還要以道路和工匠行以及貨棧、 @12貿易港 和 @11貿易站 相連。 @P關於各個聖所的用途，參見： @62宙斯 、 @61波賽東 、 @58黑帝斯 、 @56狄蜜特 、 @55雅典娜 、 @52阿波羅 、 @54阿緹蜜絲 、 @53阿瑞斯 、 @59赫菲斯托斯 、 @51愛芙羅黛蒂 、 @60荷米斯 、 @57狄俄尼索斯 。

original: Greece and Atlantis are very active places, and leaders of its city-states are always interacting with each other. The quality of the relationships you have with other cities and leaders can have direct consequences for your own city. Most of the rules of world etiquette apply to both Greece and Atlantis. Atlantis, however, has some special rules that apply only to Atlantean rulers. Click @148here for more details. @L@LCITY TYPES @PSeveral different types of relationships can form between you and other leaders. They are: @L@PALLIES. Allies are your peers and equals. They expect to be treated with respect and are more than willing to help you out if you treat them well. Of course, they won't hesitate to turn their backs on you if you betray their trust in you, or fail to help them when they need it.  Allies are normally very interested in conducting trade with you. @L@PRIVALS. Rivals, though not necessarily openly hostile, view you as a competitor, and are rarely interested in helping you at all.  If a rival has something you need or want, asking him nicely isn't going to do you any good.  In such cases, your only options are to demand what you need, raid his city, or even attempt to conquer it.  Rarely, a rival will respond to a normal request if you have done so much for him that he thinks extremely highly of you. Don't be surprised if rival leader try to make excessive demands of you. Whether you meet these demands or not is entirely up to you. Of course, if you fail to meet a rival leader's demands, he is likely to become upset. @PIf a rival leader attacks and conquers your city, he has a right to demand annual @129tribute from then on.  If you refuse to pay tribute, the rival leader is likely to attack you for this.  Conquering the rival leader's city in return, or defeating his army on your own soil are the only ways you can break free of this obligation. If the same rival defeats you twice on your own soil, the episode is over. @L@PVASSALS. When you attack and successfully conquer another city, it becomes your vassal, and must pay you annual @129tribute from then on.  Your vassals will happily conduct trade with you, and try their best to do everything you ask of them. If you push a vassal too hard, though, he may become fed up, and lead his city to rebel against your lordship.   @L@PCOLONIES. Colonies you establish remain extremely loyal to you. Your colony leaders regard themselves as your governors, and will do everything in their power to satisfy your needs. Like vassals, colonies are your subjects, and have an obligation to pay @129tribute annually.  Colony leaders are happy to conduct trade with your city, and in many cases rely on your support.  Of course, even leaders of loyal colonies have their limits. If you push them too far, they just might rebel against you. @L@PDISTANT CITIES. Distant cities do not involve themselves in political activity, but do conduct trade with you when it is beneficial to them.  @L@PTHE PARENT CITY. When you're personally establishing a colony, one of your trusted governors will administer the parent city on your behalf. @L@PINACTIVE CITIES. Some cities will become inactive from time to time, for various reasons.  Inactive cities are marked with a small bronze disc on the World Map, but you cannot interact with them in any way. @L@LHOW OTHER LEADERS FEEL TOWARD YOU @PThe leaders of other cities form opinions of you based on their interactions with you in the past. When you first begin interacting with the leader of another city, he or she doesn't really have an opinion of you. As other leaders learn more about you, they will begin to form ideas about you and will adjust their actions accordingly. So, if you do things to please another leader, like giving a gift of a much needed item, or fulfilling his or her request, the leader will be predisposed to do nice things for you. Of course, if you greet another city with an attack, its leader won't think too highly of you. @PTo learn how a given leader feels toward you, go to the World Map by clicking the @88View&World&button on the Control Panel. Select a city by clicking on it on the World Map, and its name will appear in the panel on the right. You'll also see a button that describes how its leader currently feels about you. Below the leader's name is an open scroll. Click on it, and you'll see a list of all your interactions with this leader, and even some interactions you've had with other leaders, that have contributed to the selected leader's current opinion of you. @PTo find out how a leader might react to you given his current opinion of you, click on the Attitude button, located just below the Scroll button.  You'll see a panel giving pointers on how to improve or maintain your standing with the given leader. @L@LACTIONS @PTo initiate activity with another city, use the buttons that appear at the bottom of the panel.  If a particular option isn't available to you, the button will be grayed out.  The buttons you will see are: @L@PMAKE REQUEST/DEMAND. The types of requests or demands you can make of another leader depends upon what type of relationship you have with his or her city, and the leader's current attitude toward you. Clicking on the request/demand button will display your choices. @PIf you have an average to good relationship with an ally, you can request goods and food from him or her. If an ally thinks highly of you, his or her own citizens' will be willing to risk their lives on your behalf.  You'll be able to request that the leader send military forces to defend your city.  If an ally thinks very highly of you, he or she will even send soldiers to attack and conquer another city on your behalf. @PRival leaders are unwilling to fulfill simple requests for food and goods, unless your relationship with them is excellent. Normally it won't be, so if you need food or goods from a rival you'll have to demand it. If the rival leader feels you have the military might to back up your threat, he or she will probably fulfill your demands. @PAs loyal, obedient subjects, your vassals and colonies will respond to your requests for goods and food even if they aren't particularly fond of you. If your relationship with them is good, they'll even send soldiers to attack another city on your behalf. They'll also send soldiers to help you defend your city, as long as your relationship with them is good. Be aware, though, that if their opinion of you sinks too low, they won't entertain any requests from you at all.  @L@PFULFILL REQUEST. Click on this button to fulfill the selected city's outstanding request. A panel listing the outstanding requests from the city's leader will appear when you click this button. Choose the request you would like to fulfill, and click the Dispatch button to send the requested items. If the outstanding request is for military forces, a panel listing the forces you can enlist will appear. You'll also see the action that the requesting leader wants your forces to take. If you want to send forces, select the companies, ships, or even heroes you want to send by clicking on them, then click the Dispatch button.  You cannot send rabble on military campaigns abroad, and you cannot use forced loaned to you from another city to fulfill requests. @L@PGIVE GIFT. Giving gifts can be a good way to mend poor relationships. Some gifts, however, are more appreciated than others. Cash is always appreciated, though a leader whose city has a very weak economy will appreciate a gift of cash more than a leader whose city is economically powerful.  All leaders appreciate gifts of items their city needs. Gifts of items a city doesn't need aren't appreciated much. You can tell what a city needs by clicking on it. If the city trades with you, the items it needs, if any, are the items it imports. If the city isn't trading with you, the items it needs will appear in the panel below the Attitude button. @PGifts are most appreciated if they are not given too often. If you give a city too many gifts in a short amount of time, its leader will appreciate them less and less, and may even refuse to accept the gift. @L@PRAID. Raiding cities, especially rivals, is a very good way to get things you need without having to pay for them.  To do this, click the Raid button, then use the panel presented to enlist forces to conduct the raid.  Click on the Select Plunder button to choose which item you want the raiding party to steal from the targeted city. When you're done setting up the raid, click the Dispatch button to send the raiders on their way. @PCONQUER CITY/QUELL REBELLION. Click on this button to attempt to conquer the selected city or, in the case of a vassal or colony, to quell a rebellion. When you click this button, a panel will appear allowing you to select which of your forces you would like to enlist for the assault. Rabble can never be sent on military campaigns abroad.  When attacking a rival, some of your allies may even be willing to provide support, joining in the assault with you.  Only one ally will join you at a time, though.  Select the forces you wish to enlist, then click the Dispatch button. When the fighting is over, a message will notify you of the results. If you successfully conquer an ally or rival, it will become your vassal, and start paying you tribute.  If you quell a rebellion, the vassal or colony will resume any tribute payments its leader was making.  @PClick here for information on @117Trade with other cities.
text: @P和其它城市的外交關系有時可以決定你的城市的發展速度。 @L@L城市類型 @P城市類型包括： @L@P同盟。盟友會樂於和你展開貿易，如果你和他們的關系不錯，他們會在關鍵時刻助你一臂之力。當然，如果你背叛了盟友，他們也會成為你的敵人。 @L@P敵城。敵城就是你的對手，他們一般不會主動幫助你，如果你需要敵城的物資，可以提出要求，或者搶劫甚至占領這座城市。敵城也經常會向你提出要求，如果你無法滿足這些要求，他們的領袖就會對你非常不滿。 @P如果敵城占領了你的城市，就可以要求你每年 @129進貢 。如果你拒絕進貢，敵方就會來犯。唯一的解決方法是占領對方的城市或者在自己的領土上打敗對方的軍隊。如果某個敵人在你的領土上打敗你兩次，本關的任務就算失敗。 @L@P附庸城。如果你占領了其它城市，它就會變成你的附庸城，每年向你 @129進貢 。附庸城會盡量滿足你的各種要求，但如果你貪得無厭，附庸城的人民會揭竿而起和你開戰。   @L@P殖民地。你建立的殖民地會對你非常忠心，和附庸城一樣，它們會每年 @129進貢 。殖民地會和你展開貿易，並且盡量滿足你的各種要求，但如果你橫征暴斂，殖民地也會反抗你。 @L@P遙遠的城市。這些城市和希臘的政治形勢無關，但可能會和你展開貿易。  @L@P母城。如果你親自出外建立殖民地，你手下的官員會自動代替你成為母城的總督。 @L@P處於停滯狀況的城市。你無法和處於停滯狀況的城市進行任何外交和貿易。 @L@L其他領袖對你的態度 @P其他城市的領袖在遊戲開始時對你一無所知，如果你善意對待他們，他們對你會慢慢產生好印象，反之則會討厭你。 @P要得知其他領袖對你的態度，可以點擊控制面板中的 @88查看希臘及周邊地區 ，在大地圖上選擇城市後右邊會出現一個控制區，在該城領袖的名字下面有一個按鈕，點擊後可以看到你和這個領袖之間所有的相關事件，如果你和其它城市的外交事件影響到這個城市的領袖對你的看法，那麼這些事件也會被列出來。 @P點擊'態度'按鈕後你可以得到關於增加其他領袖對你的好感的建議。 @L@L外交事件 @P控制區的下方有一些功能按鈕，如果某些功能不可用，會顯示為灰色。這些按鈕包括： @L@P發出請求。你可以提出的請求由你和這個城市的關系及它的領袖對你的態度決定。 @P如果該城市的領袖和你的關系不錯，你可以要求他給你食物和貨物；如果他和你的關系很不錯，會派出軍隊幫助你作戰；如果他和你的關系非常好，甚至可能會派出軍隊為你攻占其它城市。 @P敵城一般不會滿足你的請求，但是如果你的軍事實力足夠強大，它們也可能會屈服。 @P你的附庸城和殖民地會滿足你對食物和貨物的請求，如果他們和你關系特別好，也會派出軍隊幫助你作戰。不過如果你對他們橫征暴斂，他們和你之間的關系會惡化，最終不理睬你的請求。  @L@P滿足請求。點擊這個按鈕後，你可以看到所有其它城市對你的請求，選擇好之後點擊'派遣'就可以送出物品了。如果是軍事請求，你還可以在一個面板中選擇要派遣的部隊，你不能派遣民兵或其它城市借給你的軍隊。 @L@P送出禮物。禮物可以改善你和其它城市之間的關系，送禮要注意針對性，最好是對方城市需要什麼你就送什麼，這樣會有最佳效果。一般該城市進口的貨物就是它需要的貨物，你也可以按'態度'按鈕查看它需要的貨物。 @P最好不要在一段時間內反復給一個城市大量禮物，這樣每次送禮的效果會越來越差。 @L@P搶劫。搶劫敵城可以讓你一下子獲得大量物資。點擊'搶劫'按鈕後你可以選擇要派出的部隊然後按'派遣'按鈕讓他們出發。 @P占領城市/平息叛亂。點擊這個按鈕可以讓你派出軍隊占領其它城市，對於你的附庸城和殖民地來說，則可以平息叛亂。你可以選擇要派出的部隊然後按'派遣'按鈕讓他們出發，民兵無法出國作戰。攻占敵城時你的盟友可能會來幫助你，不過一次只能有一個盟友能和你協同作戰。戰鬥結束後你會看到戰果報告，如果成功占領了敵城，它就會開始向你進貢，如果平息了叛亂，附庸城或殖民地就會恢復向你的進貢。 @P點擊此處可以得到關於 @117貿易 的更多信息。

original: Every year, Pan-Hellenic Games are held in Greece, and contestants from all over the land gather to see who is the best. There are four Games in all: the Isthmian, Nemean, Pythian and Olympian. The Isthmian Games test a philosopher's wit and intelligence. The more @14Podiums and @13Colleges you have, the better your philosophers' chances are of faring well in the Isthmian games. The Nemean Games are a showcase for Greece's athletes and competitors. Remember to build plenty of @15Gymnasiums and a @18Stadium to give your contestants the best chance of winning these Games.  Actors compete in the Pythian Games, and having plenty of @16Drama&Schools and @17Theaters in your city will help your actors to victory.  Finally, the Olympian Games are a test to see which city is the greatest center of overall culture. Actors, philosophers, athletes and competitors all compete in the Olympian Games. @PWinning any of the Pan-Hellenic Games is beneficial. Other city leaders can't help but be impressed by this, and their opinions of you will increase. You'll also be able to honor your contestants' achievements by building a @23Commemorative&Monument. And, if you win the Olympian Games, your city will have the honor of hosting its own Games in four years, as long as there is a functioning Stadium to host the event.  Other leaders will think more favorably of you when you host your own games, regardless of how your contestants do in them.
text: @P泛希臘競賽每年都會舉辦一次，參賽者來自希臘的各個城市。泛希臘競賽包括四個比賽項目：埃斯米亞競賽由學者參加，你的 @14講壇 和 @13大學 越多，獲勝機會越大。納米爾競賽由運動員和高級運動員參加，你的 @15體育館 和 @18露天運動場 越多，獲勝機會越大。普西恩競賽由演員參加，你的 @16戲劇學院 和 @17劇場 越多，獲勝機會越大。奧林匹克競賽則是各種比賽的總和，演員、學者、運動員和高級運動員都會參加奧林匹克競賽。 @P獲得競賽的勝利後，其他領袖對你的好感度會上升，你也可以建造 @23紀念碑 來慶祝一下。如果你贏得了奧林匹克競賽，就可以在自己的城市舉辦運動會，這會大大提高你的聲譽。當然，你的城市首先要有露天運動場。

original: There are several different types of terrain in the Greek world, and some of them have special qualities. @L@PGRASSLAND. You can build most buildings on grassland, but it is not fertile enough to support farms or livestock. People can walk over grassland. @PMEADOW. Meadowland is marked by purple tufts. It is the only land fertile enough to support all types of farm and orchard crops, and is the only land with enough natural vegetation to support livestock. People can walk over the meadow without any problem. @PFOREST. Forests can be harvested by lumberjacks from a @41Timber&Mill. You can also clear a forest by clicking the @86Clear&button and clicking on the forest, or on individual trees.  Once trees are cleared, however, they will never regrow.  @PMARSH. Nothing can be built upon the murky marsh.  People can pass through it, but the ground is too soft to support buildings, but people can walk on it. @PBEACH. Sandy beaches abut some areas of water.  The sands shift far too much to support buildings. @PROCK. Ordinary rock cannot be built upon, and people have difficulty walking across it. They can only pass through where there are small passes or stairways.   @PORE-BEARING ROCK.  You'll see metallic nuggets embedded in some rocks.  Rocks with the copper nuggets contain copper ore, which can be smelted to create bronze at a @43Foundry.  Rocks with silver nuggets contain silver ore, which could be smelted and struck into coins called drachmas, at a @44Mint. Rocks with red nuggets contain orichalc ore, which is converted to orichalc at a @127Refinery. @PQUARRY.  There are two types of quarry: black marble quarry and white marble quarry. If you see a flat, grayish-white surface, stonecutters from a @42Masonry&Shop will be able to hew white marble. Flat, dark gray rocks indicate the presence of black marble, which can be quarried by stonecutters from a @131Black&Marble&Workshop. @PWATER.  Sea urchins and edible fish dwell in some bodies of water.  Some structures must be built along the water's edge. Specifically, these structures are the @12Pier, @28Water&Crossing, @38Urchin&Quay, @38Fishery, @32Trireme&Wharf and @143Frigate&Wharf.
text: @P遊戲裡有以下幾種地形： @L@P平地。平地上可以建造大多數建築物，不過無法建造農場。行人可以在平地上行走。 @P草地。草地上有紫色植物的標記，可以建造農場，放牧牲畜。行人可以在草地上行走。 @P森林。 @41伐木場 的伐木工人可以在森林裡伐木。你可以用'清除'按鈕把樹木清除，被清除的樹木不會再長出來。  @P沼澤地。沼澤地上不能造建築物，但行人可以在沼澤地上行走。 @P海灘。海灘上不能造建築物。 @P巖石。巖石上不能造建築物，人無法越過巖石，但如果巖石之間有空隙，他們可以穿過這些空隙。   @P礦石。礦石的圖案是巖石上加一些礦物顆粒。銅礦石在 @43鑄造場 加工成青銅，銀礦石在 @44鑄幣場 製造成銀幣。 @P採石場。 @42石料加工廠 的採石工人可以到採石場采集石料。 @P水。海膽和魚都生活在水中。 @12貿易港 、 @28浮橋 、 @38海膽加工場 、 @38漁場 和 @32三層船碼頭 都要造在水邊。

original: The city's industries produce goods for the city's residents, and materials needed for the @110construction&of&Sanctuaries. @PThere are two main types of industry: raw materials producers and workshops. The raw materials producers are the @43Foundry, @44Mint, @127Refinery, @42Masonry&Shop, @131Black&Marble&Workshop and @41Timber&Mill. Grapes grown on a @36Grapevine and olives grown on an @35Olive&Tree are raw materials of sorts, because they are used by workshops to make wine and olive oil respectively.  The industrial workshops are the @47Winery, @46Olive&Press and @48Sculpture&Studio. Click on any of the above links to read about a particular industry. @PAll industries share a few things in common. All must have access to a road so that they can access the city's labor pool.  All of them also operate much more efficiently when they fully staffed with workers. An understaffed industry will still function, but it will turn out its product at a much slower rate. @PYour city's road system is important if industries are to run smoothly. All your industries must be connected by a road to a building that can receive their final products. This building can be a @10Storehouse or, if you are exporting the product, a @12Pier or @11Trading&Post. Raw materials producers can also take their supplies directly to a workshop that needs them.  @PA workshop must not only have access to a storage facility that can receive its final product, but it must also be connected to a source of the raw material it requires.  A workshop can connected to the raw materials producer on which it depends directly, by a road, or it can be connected to a Storehouse that is storing the raw material it needs. The closer the workshop is to its source of raw materials, the more efficient production will be. @PClick on the @78Industry&Tab for more information on the city's industries.
text: @P工業設施生產各種生活用品，還為建造 @110聖所 提供物資。 @P工業設施分成兩類，一類是原料提供，一類是加工場。原料提供設施包括 @43鑄造場 、 @44鑄幣場 、 @42石料加工廠 、 @41伐木場 。 @36葡萄藤 和 @35橄欖樹 是生產葡萄酒和橄欖油的材料來源。加工場包括： @47酒坊 、 @46油坊 和 @48鑄像場 。 @P所有的工業設施都必須建在道路邊上，只有在工人滿員的情況下工業設施才能達到最快的生產速度。 @P要讓工業設施得到最佳的效率，你應該讓它們靠近產品存放地，例如 @10貨棧 ，如果你準備出口， @12貿易港 或 @11貿易站 也行。原料提供設施也可以把原料直接送往需要它們的加工場。  @P加工場不但要靠近產品存放地，而且要接近原料生產地，或者是存放所需原料的貨棧。 @P詳細介紹參見 @78工業標簽 。

original: Your city won't be able to operate at all without people. You need commoners to fill jobs that keep the city's services running, to man the oars of your ships, and to defend the city as mobs of @104rabble if necessary. You need the elite warrior class to fight for you as @105hoplites and @106horsemen. @PWhen a city is new, immigrants generally come willingly, looking for a better life. As your city becomes established, would-be immigrants will expect certain things from your city, or else they won't come. If your city fails to meet the needs of its current residents, these people will move out to look for a better situation. @PTo keep residents in your city and to keep new immigrants coming, make sure you provide basic services. If there isn't enough food in the city to feed its current population, new immigrants will be discouraged from coming, and some of the city's current residents might leave. High unemployment, low wages and high taxes are all deterrents to immigration. When you go into debt, you cannot pay your workers. If you are in debt for too long, immigrants will not want to come to your city. Excessive military service, especially when unnecessary, will lower your popularity and hinder immigration.  If you have a history of charging high taxes, paying low wages or requiring a lot of unnecessary military service, or if you have a history of prolonged debt, immigrants will be reluctant to come to your city. Their memories are long, and they will fear that you might return to your old, stingy ways. Finally, even if people wish to come to your city, they won't be able to if the city lacks vacant housing, because they will have nowhere to live.  The same problems that limit immigration can also cause emigration. @PIn addition to immigration and emigration, your city's population grows and shrinks due to births and deaths. In cities with good @118hygiene practices, more babies will be born, and fewer deaths will occur, and your population will grow as a result. If, however, hygiene is poor in your city, deaths could outnumber births, and your population will likely shrink. @PClick on the @76Population&Tab for more information on the city's residents.
text: @P人口對城市發展的重要性是不言而喻的，他們可以作為工人、作為 @103三層船 的水手，作為民兵、 @105步兵 和 @106騎兵 等等。 @P當你的城市建立時，會有一批移民來到。此後隨著城市的發展，會吸引更多的移民。但是如果你的城市建設達不到居民的要求，他們也會遷離這個城市。 @P要吸引移民來到你的城市，你首先要保證食物的供應。此外，過高的失業率和稅率以及過低的工資都會讓人們對你的城市望而卻步。如果你負了債就無法付給工人工資，這樣時間一長人們就會離開你的城市。如果你過去的稅率和工資水平一向比較苛刻，而且又窮兵黷武，也會導致人們不願來到你的城市。最後，你要建造足夠的房屋才能讓移民在你的城市居住。如果房屋減少，有一部分人就不得不離開。 @P如果城市的 @118衛生 條件好，嬰兒的出生率就高，人口會增加。如果衛生條件很差，死亡率就會很高，導致人口下降。 @P詳細介紹參見 @76人口標簽 。

original: Keeping your population fed is extremely important, so planning efficient farms and other food-producing structures, or acquiring food from other cities, is vital. @PAll your @29Farms, @38Urchin&Quays, @38Fisheries, @40Dairies, @109Orange&Tenders'&Lodges, @108Corrals and @69Hunting&Lodges must have access to a road so that they can access the city's pool of workers. In addition, they are at their most efficient when they are fully staffed. If understaffed, they will still produce food, but at a slower rate than usual. In addition, all of these buildings need to be connected by road to a @9Granary or, if you are exporting food, to the appropriate @11Trading&Post or @12Pier. @PTo increase the efficiency of Hunting Lodges, Urchin Quays and Fisheries, place them as close as possible to their prey. The shorter the distance the hunter, urchin gatherer or fishing boat has to travel, the quicker it will return with food. The closer a corral is to the herd of cattle, the more efficient it will be, too. @PGood land management is key to planning your Farming system. Your Farms have to share the city's usable meadowland with @36Grapevines, @35Olive&Trees, @95Sheep, @95Goats and @152Cattle, and finding room for everything can be tricky if you have limited meadowland. Remember that only one portion of a Farm needs to be on meadowland for the farm to be productive. @PMaking sure that your people get the food produced or imported by your city is the job of your @128distribution&system. @More information on food production can be found by clicking on the @77Husbandry&Tab.
text: @P你的 @29農場 、 @38海膽加工場 、 @38漁場 、 @40奶品場 和 @69獵人小屋 都必須建在路邊，要保持足夠的工人數量。你應該讓它們靠近產品存放地，例如 @9糧倉 ，如果你準備出口， @11貿易站 或 @12貿易港 也行。 @P要提高獵人小屋、海膽加工場和漁場的效率，應該讓他們盡量靠近獵物的活動區域。 @P你要合理利用草地資源，因為 @36葡萄藤 、 @35橄欖樹 、 @95綿羊 和 @95山羊 都需要草地。記住，農場只要有一部分建在草地上就行。 @P要通過 @128銷售 渠道讓所有居民都得到食物。 詳細介紹參見 @77農業標簽 。

original: Trade with other cities can be extremely profitable. It can also help you provide the goods that your people can't produce for themselves. @PEach @11Trading&Post and @12Pier is dedicated to a particular city. To open trade with another city, simply build the Trading Post or Pier associated with it. Then, right-click on the building to tell it how much you want to import or export.  @PTo import an item, click the button next to the good you want to import until it reads 'Buying'. Then, tell the trading facility how much of the good you want to import by setting a stock limit. Each time a trader visits, the trading facility will buy the good until the stock limit is reached, as long as it has sufficient storage space, and as long as the trader has enough goods to sell. @PTo export an item, click the button next to the item you want to export until it reads 'Selling'. Then, set the stock limit. The trading facility uses the stock limit as a guide to how much of the exported item it should keep on hand at all times, should a trader visit to make a purchase. The trading facility will send out a deliveryman to get the item for export, until it is storing the limit you've specified.  @PTo see what a city trades before building its trading facility, click the @88View&World&button. When the World Map appears, click on the city with which you'd like to trade. The goods that it can import and export will be displayed on the panel on the right. In addition, you'll see how much of each good the city can trade in a year. If you have already built the city's trade facility, you can give trade instructions by clicking on the Orders button. @PWhen giving trade instructions, keep the needs of your citizens in mind. Deliverymen place a high priority on bringing exportable goods to trading facilities. They will always bring exportable goods to a trading facility before delivering them to the city's Storehouses or Granaries. If you export too much, your people might end up having to go without. If you notice that your citizens are running out of a good you are exporting, consider decreasing the trade facility's stock limit for the exported good. Remember that vendors from an @8Agora cannot procure goods intended for export, currently stored in a trade facility set to 'Selling'.   @PKeep an eye on your treasury when you are importing goods. The cost of importing items can add up quickly, so make sure you are importing only as much as your city needs.  @PPiers and Trading Posts employ deliverymen to help facilitate trade. With imports, deliverymen seek to distribute the goods as soon as they are dropped off. Normally he'll deliver imported goods to the nearest Storehouse that is accepting the item, but if it's a raw material, the deliveryman will look for a workshop that needs it. If he can't find one, he'll take the goods to a Storehouse. If the import is a food, the deliveryman will transport it to a @9Granary. Make sure the trading facility is connected by a road to the imported goods' final destinations. The quicker a deliveryman can move goods out of the trading facility, the more you'll be able to import. @PClick on the @79Distribution&Tab for more information on trade.
text: @P通過貿易，你可以得到自己無法生產的物資。 @P每個 @11貿易站 和 @12貿易港 都對應一個城市。要和其它城市進行貿易，只要建立相應的貿易站或貿易港就行了。  @P如果要進口物資，你可以點擊'購入'，然後決定進口數量。 @P要出口物資，則點擊'售出'，然後決定出口數量。  @P你可以進入大地圖，然後點擊一個城市的圖標看看它會進口和出口什麼貨物，你可以在控制面板上點擊'訂購'直接購買。 @P在出口時，送貨工會優先把出口物資送到貿易站或貿易港，如果你出口太多，那麼自己的人民就可能無法得到足夠的物資供應。   @P進口的物資數量夠用就好，如果太多就會影響到你的財政狀況。  @P貨物進口後，送貨工會把它們送到最近貨棧，不過如果這些物資是原材料，他就會優先考慮送到需要它們的加工場去。如果進口的是食物，就送到 @9糧倉 。 @P詳細介紹參見 @79儲存與銷售標簽 。

original: Wise leaders encourage their citizens to adopt good hygiene practices. Poor hygiene practices can lead to plague, which can lead to the deaths of your hard-working and elite citizens alike. @PTo keep hygiene practices sound, make sure all your people are able to eat regularly, and are visited regularly by a healer from an @50Infirmary. If you fail to provide these things, hygiene will fall, and plague could break out.  @PWhen a home is infected with plague, some of its citizens unfortunately die. The remaining people of the household will concentrate on getting healthy for the next two months, so no new people can move into an infected house during this time. Once the two months have passed, though, the residents of the infected house will welcome new residents. @PFor more information on the city's hygiene practices, click the @80Hygiene&and&Safety&Tab
text: @P如果城市的衛生狀況太差，可能會發生瘟疫，導致大量人口死亡。 @P要提高衛生狀況，你首先要讓人們得到足夠的食物，其次還要讓 @50診所 的醫師經常訪問他們。  @P如果一間房屋出現瘟疫，就會有一部分人死去，在2個月之內其他人不能住進這間屋子。 @P詳細介紹參見 @80衛生與安全標簽 。

original: Appeal is a measure of the beauty of a particular location. People who live in areas of high appeal appreciate their surroundings and pay more in @120taxes. @PMost buildings have an effect on the appeal of the surrounding area. Buildings that people want to live near, such as Sanctuaries, the @24Palace and @17Theaters, tend to increase an area's appeal. @85Aesthetic&Structures are specifically designed to raise an area's appeal. Noisy or foul-smelling buildings, like Farms, industries, @16Drama&Schools and @13Colleges, are a detriment to an area's appeal.  Boulevards and Avenues increase the appeal of any area. @PLook at an area's @5roads for an indication of its appeal. The nicer an area, the nicer the roads will be. You can also click on the 'See Appeal' button on the @85Aesthetics&Tab to gauge an area's attractiveness.  How appealing an area is has no effect on your city's industries, but makes a big difference in your city's residential areas.
text: @P如果一個地區建設得非常漂亮，附近的居民會交納更多稅款。 @P聖所， @24宮殿 和 @17劇場 都可以改善環境。 @85美化 建築、大道和林蔭道也可以改善環境。而嘈雜的建築，如農場、工業設施、 @16戲劇學院 和 @13大學 則會影響環境。 @P @5道路 可以體現出一個地區的環境，如果道路整潔，環境就好。你可以點擊 @85美學標簽 裡的'查看環境'查看。環境不影響工業生產，但對住宅區的發展非常重要。

original: In order to be a successful leader, you must be able to make money. In fact, if you are in debt too long, causing your workers to go without pay, they will even forcibly remove you from your position. @PYou have several sources of income, the two main sources being taxation and money earned from @117exports. You also might be able to mint your own coins if there are any deposits of @44silver&ore in and around your city. In Atlantis, you can earn revenue from a thrilling @139Hippodrome.  Furthermore, other leaders may have an obligation to pay you annual tributes in cash, or sometimes give you gifts of money. You can also ask other leaders for money. There are, of course, several ways to spend money, too. The key to turning a profit is to keep expenses as low as possible while taking full advantage of all your sources of income. @L@LTAXES @PTo collect taxes, you need a functioning @24Palace as well as some @26Tax&Offices. Clerks from the Tax Office will circulate through the streets, collecting money from the houses they pass.  @PTo set a tax rate, select the @81Administration&Tab.  You'll see the city's current tax rate displayed. Use the scroll buttons to adjust the tax rate up or down. You have several choices of tax rate to levy, anywhere from no tax at all to an outrageous tax rate. The higher you set taxes, however, the less popular you will be among your citizens. Of course, if you set a low tax rate, your popularity will increase. As you adjust the tax rate, you'll see how much money the new rate will bring in for the year. You can also set the tax rate by right-clicking on a Tax Office. @PResidents of @7elite&housing pay more in taxes than those who live in @6common&housing. Also, those who live in areas of high @119appeal pay more taxes than those that live in areas of low appeal. Those who live in beautiful surroundings appreciate the work the city has put into the area and are willing to pay more. @PTo maximize your tax receipts, make sure as many of your citizens as possible are registered for the tax. To see which areas of the city might not be paying their fair share, select the Administration Tab and click on the 'See Taxes' button. You'll see the city's clerks going about their duties. You'll also see columns and stacks of coins in front of the city's housing. The higher the column, the more recently the house has been visited by a clerk. The stack of coins indicates how much money the household has paid in taxes for the year so far. You might want to build more Tax Offices in any areas containing houses that are not regularly visited by a clerk.  @L@LEXPORTS @PProfits from exports tend to be the most lucrative source of income for a city. Generally you'll earn more exporting manufactured goods than raw materials. Some raw materials can be quite valuable, however. To see which goods fetch the highest prices, select the @79Distribution&Tab and click on the Magnifying Glass button. You'll see the prices for goods in the screen that pops up. @L@LKEEPING COSTS DOWN @PWhen trying to control costs, keep the following in mind: @L@PBUILD ONLY WHAT YOU NEED, ONLY WHEN YOU NEED IT. When you're just beginning to build a city, it can be very tempting to place building after building to fill the empty terrain. Resist this temptation. Building lots of buildings quickly before you've established any sources of income can be a surefire way of going into debt. Not only do the buildings cost money to build, but you also have to pay the wages of any employees the building requires. Furthermore, if you don't have all the workers you need, you might find yourself building more houses to draw more workers to the city. Those houses will cost money, and you'll have to pay even more wages to the new workers that arrive. @L@PKEEP THE COST OF IMPORTS DOWN BY IMPORTING RAW MATERIALS. Generally, raw materials cost much less to import than manufactured goods. When you can, import the appropriate raw material and build a workshop that can manufacture the finished good from it. @L@PBE CAREFUL NOT TO IMPORT MORE THAN YOU NEED. Import costs can spiral out of control if you do not keep a close watch on them. Trading facilities only import up to the stock limit you set, but they only take into consideration the amount of the imported item currently stored in the trading facility. And, as soon as an imported item is dropped off at a trading facility, deliverymen try to take the good elsewhere. So, even though you might not have any of the imported good stored in the trading facility, you might have plenty stored in the city's Storehouses. If you do, you might want to stop buying goods for awhile. @L@LIF YOU STILL CAN'T KEEP YOUR CITY SOLVENT, by all means, ask other cities for money. For more on how to ask for money, click @111here.
text: @P你要有足夠的錢才能讓工人們得到報酬，努力工作。 @P你有兩大收入來源：稅收和 @117出口 。如果采到了 @44銀礦石 ，也可以鑄造一些錢幣。此外，其它城市可能會向你進貢或送禮，你也可以向其它城市提出相應的要求。 @L@L稅收 @P要收稅，你得建造 @24宮殿 和 @26稅務所 ，建成後稅務官會四處去收稅。  @P要設置稅率，進入 @81管理標簽 ，用滾動按鈕調節稅率的高低。稅率越高，人民對你的好感越低。你也可以在稅務所上點擊鼠標右鍵來調節稅率。 @P @7高級住宅 的居民交的稅比 @6民房 的居民多，而 @119環境 好的地方人們交的稅會更多。 @P點擊管理標簽裡的'查看稅收'後，你可以看到稅務官的工作情況。房屋前面的圓柱高，代表稅務官不久前剛去收過稅。此外，房屋邊上還有一堆錢幣的圖案，錢幣越多，代表交的稅也越多，你可以把鼠標放在錢堆上觀看詳細信息。如果一片區域都沒有交過稅，你應該在那附近建造稅務所。  @L@L出口 @P一般來說出口制成品要比出口原材料更賺錢，不過某些原材料也非常珍貴。你可以點擊 @79儲存與銷售標簽 裡的放大鏡觀看貨物的價格。 @L@L降低成本 @P要降低成本，你要： @L@P只建造自己需要的建築。 @L@P盡量只進口原材料，然後自行加工。 @L@P只進口自己需要的東西。 @L@L另外，你還可以要求其它城市送錢給你，詳細介紹參見 @111此處 。

original: Your city won't run very well at all if it doesn't have any workers. Workers live in the city's @6common&housing, but not all of the residents of a common house work. Some stay home because they are too young or too old to work, and others stay home simply because they can. @PThere are two employment problems you may experience: unemployment and worker shortage. @L@PUNEMPLOYMENT. A high unemployment rate can cause your citizens to become quite frustrated with you. If you have unemployment problems, you can try to solve them by creating new jobs. This could be your chance to give a boost to certain sectors of your city that might be lacking. For example, if you are deficient in one type of cultural pursuit, unemployment can give you the chance to solve the problem. Before you begin constructing new buildings to create more jobs, make sure you can afford the cost of the building plus the expense of employing the workers. You don't want to replace your unemployment problem with a debt problem. @PAnother way to solve an unemployment problem is to encourage emigration by demolishing common housing. Though this measure is a little Draconian, it is effective.  @L@PWORKER SHORTAGE.  A worker shortage can be a very serious problem. Buildings that do not have a full staff of workers do not run efficiently. The best ways to solve a worker shortage problem are to either get rid of some building that employ workers, or to draw more people to the city. @PThere are a few things you can do to ease the effects of a worker shortage. You can assign a high priority to certain labor sectors of the city, to ensure that your most important services continue uninterrupted. To assign priorities to the various labor sectors in the city, choose the @78Industry&Tab and click on the Magnifying Glass button. In the screen that appears, you'll see listed all of the different employment sectors in your city. Set a priority level for each by using the scroll buttons to the left. In the case of a labor shortage, the sectors that you designate as a high priority will be staffed first. Sectors with a low priority will be last in line to receive workers. If you don't currently have enough workers to staff all buildings that need them, as you change priorities you'll probably see the number of workers assigned to a sector change. @PYou can also completely shut down particular industries. Workers previously employed by an industry that has been shut down will find work elsewhere. This can be a good temporary fix to a worker shortage problem. @PAlso, remember that @32Trireme&Wharves and @143Frigate&Wharves require a significant number of people in order to function. If you are experiencing a worker shortage, consider sending the Wharf's crew home so that they can find jobs in other parts of the city. You can send the crews of all of your Wharves home by choosing the @84Military&Tab and clicking on the 'All Crewed' button so that it reads 'Crew Ships'. You can also send the crew of a particular ship home. Click on the Magnifying Glass button in the Military Tab. In the screen that appears, click on the Status button of the ship whose crew you want to send home. Or, click on the individual vessel itself then click the orders button for 'send crew home.'
text: @P要發展城市，工人自然是必須的。不過太老和太小的居民是不會參加工作的。 @P你最容易遇到的問題有兩個：失業和工人短缺。 @L@P失業。失業會讓居民對你失去信心，所以是比較重要的問題。一般通過建造新的設施就可以解決失業的問題，但是你首先要有足夠的經濟實力承擔建造和雇傭工人的費用。 @P另外一個解決方法是摧毀民房，讓一部分居民離開你的城市。這雖然有點過份，但十分有效。  @L@P工人短缺。如果生產設施缺少工人，就會影響效率。要解決這個問題，你可以關閉一些生產設施，或者吸引更多的人來到你的城市。 @P如果發生了工人短缺的現象，你應該優先保證主要的生產設施有足夠的工人。你可以點擊 @78工業標簽 中的放大鏡觀看城裡的工人分布狀況。 @P此外，如果關閉一些生產設施，就可以讓那裡的工人到其它地方工作。 @P另外， @32三層船 需要一定的人去操作才能投入使用，所以如果你缺少工人，可以進入 @84軍事標簽 ，點擊相應按鈕暫時讓船上的水手離開，參加別的工作。

original: Many of the things you'll have to do as leader of a city-state can make you unpopular among your people.  The people in your city watch your actions very closely and are quick to form opinions of you. If their opinion of you sinks to low levels, they might start causing trouble in your city. At the very least, they'll tell others how much of an ogre you are and discourage new immigrants from coming to your city. Of course, if you are very popular amongst your people, they'll be less inclined to cause trouble, and they'll tell all their friends in other lands how great it is to live in your city. @PSeveral factors affect your popularity. High taxes, low wages, and high unemployment are all certain to make you less popular. If you are in debt for a prolonged period of time - which means that workers haven't been paid - your popularity could plummet. Your citizen soldiers also do not like to be called to arms too much, especially when it is unnecessary.  Lack of food also angers people. Of course, you can make your people quite happy if you pay them well and charge a low tax rate. They will also like you if you make sure that they are always well-fed and that most of them have jobs to go to. @PIn Atlantis, @139Hippodromes also affect your popularity. Having a thriving Hippodrome in your city increases your popularity with your people - to a point. If your Hippodrome is extremely large, your people will begin to resent having to share their city with dirty, dusty horses and jockeys of questionable repute. Your popularity with them will decline. To find out how your citizens are feeling about the races, right-click on the Hippodrome.
text: @P如果你的聲望值非常高，你的人民就會服從你，新的移民也會不斷涌入你的城市。如果聲望值太低，他們會不服管教，新的移民也會越來越少。 @P高稅率、高失業率、低工資和長期不付工資都會降低你的聲望。此外，如果人們得不到足夠的食物，你的聲望也會降低。

original: Unrest in the city occurs when conditions aren't satisfactory to some of your residents.  Residents of lower-quality houses may turn to a life of crime if you fail to provide jobs or adequate food.  They also become unhappy if they aren't paid well, if they have to pay too much in taxes or if you call them to arms too much. They really don't like it when the city goes into debt, because this means they might not be paid.  @PWhen unrest is too high, disgruntled citizens and outlaws will hit the streets, potentially causing a lot of trouble. As an immediate solution, watchmen from a @27Watchpost can help to keep unrest in check. As they pass by housing, they reduce the chance that an angry outlaw or disgruntled citizen will emerge. To see which areas are most likely to produce an outlaw, choose the @80Hygiene&and&Safety&Tab and click on the 'See Unrest' button. The higher the column in front of the house, the more likely it is that one of its residents will turn to a life of crime. @PUnrest can result in four different types of unsavory citizen. The disgruntled citizen wanders the city's streets, complaining to whomever comes close enough to hear him. He won't cause any damage, but he is still a pest. The mugger is more violent than the disgruntled citizen. He wanders the city, attacking and killing people for whatever possessions they might have. The thief, dissatisfied with his lot in life, steals things from the city's @7elite&housing. Finally, the vandal, by far the most angry of the outlaws, will completely destroy an elite home.  @PRight-click on any of these unhappy people to find out just what is making them mad. If a nobleman or watchman happens upon an outlaw, he will see to it that the outlaw is removed from the streets.
text: @P如果你不能為城裡的居民提供足夠的食物和就業機會、工資太低、稅率太高、或者你過於頻繁地把他們招募進軍隊，他們就會開始不滿，甚至成為罪犯。 @P罪犯會在大街上製造混亂，而 @27了望臺 裡的督察官會負責懲戒罪犯。要查看治安情況，點擊 @80衛生與安全標簽 裡的'查看治安'按鈕。民房前的圓柱越高，出現罪犯的可能性越大。 @P罪犯分為許多種。一般人會對社會不滿，不過他們不會搞破壞；強盜會殺人搶劫；盜賊會偷 @7高級住宅 裡的東西；暴民會摧毀高級住宅。  @P在罪犯身上點擊右鍵可以看到他們不滿的原因。

original: Sooner or later, your city will be invaded by an enemy. Foreign enemies include the Persians, Centaurs, Amazons, Oceanids, Mayans and Egyptians. Some of these enemies come to your city by boat, others come over land, and some could even launch a two-pronged attack, coming to your city by land and sea. The Oceanids approach your city in a very clever way: they swim under water.  You can tell that they are approaching by the air bubbles that rise to the surface. Your own boats can do nothing to attack the Oceanids while they are swimming to your city. Only the Kraken can dive to the depths necessary to stop the Oceanids from coming to shore. @PYou have several ways of handling attacks, and not all of them involve combat. @L@PBRIBERY. When an enemy invades, you may be able to bribe the attacking army. The larger the invading army, the more expensive it will be to buy them off. It is a great victory for your city when your bribery attempt succeeds, because it means that your city has been saved without loss of life. @L@PSURRENDER. You can also, of course, surrender to the invader. If you do, your city will be conquered, and you will have to start paying tribute to the conqueror. On the bright side, however, your city won't suffer any casualties. @L@PFIGHT. Of course, you can choose to fight the enemy. If you would rather your generals run the battle, turn on Auto-Defend, by clicking the small helmet icon on the @84Military&Tab. With Auto-defend off, you must command your own soldiers and boats. Click on the following links to learn about the orders you can give to your @104rabble, @105hoplites, @106horsemen, and @103triremes. If Atlantis is your domain, click on the following links to learn about the orders you can give to your  @145archers, @146spearmen, @147charioteers and @144frigates. @POnce your companies are in the field, you can select one company at a time to give it orders. You can also select more than one company and issue them all the same order at one time. To select more than one company, first select one of them. Then, hold down the mouse button and drag a box around all the companies you wish to select.  You can remove individual companies from the selection by shift-clicking on them.  Then, issue an order, and all of the selected companies will carry it out. @L@PCombat can also take place outside your city. Your generals always handle combat abroad. For more information on military campaigns abroad, see the entry on @111Diplomacy&and&the&World.
text: @P如果你遭到敵人的侵略，可以用很多種方法來應付，不一定要通過戰鬥。 @L@P賄賂。入侵的敵軍越多，所需的金錢就越多。 @L@P投降。投降後你必須開始向對方進貢，但至少你的城市能保持完整。 @L@P戰鬥。如果你想讓手下的將軍指揮戰鬥，可以打開 @84軍事標簽 裡的'自動防御'。關於兵種的詳細介紹參見： @104民兵 、 @105步兵 、 @106騎兵 、 @103三層船 。 @P戰鬥時你可以指揮單個士兵，也可以用鼠標拉一個框選中一群士兵指揮。 @L@P在國外的戰鬥由你的將軍指揮，詳細內容參見 @111外交 。

original: Greece and Atlantis can be unforgiving lands, where disasters can strike your city, ruining portions of the terrain. Sometimes these disasters are initiated by gods, but they can also happen for no discernible reason. The disasters your cities may experience are landslides, earthquakes, tidal waves and lava. @PWhen the ground is unsettled, a landslide can occur. Massive boulders come cascading out of the mountains and spread across the landscape. These rocks demolish anything in their paths. Once they settle, they cannot be cleared away and you cannot build anything on them. @PEarthquakes shatter the land, leaving it cracked and broken. Any buildings that were standing on the land affected by the earthquake will be destroyed. The cracks left behind by an earthquake are permanent, so reusing the land becomes challenging. You can build roads across these cracks; road crews automatically erect a small bridge in such circumstances.  @PTidal waves assault the land and knock down anything in their path. When the wave ebbs, you can build on the land again. Sometimes, though, the tide doesn't recede, and the coastline is changed forever. @PLava erupts from the ground and burns down the structures it flows over. When the lava cools, it leaves the land burnt and useless. @PIf a city is truly unfortunate, parts of the land may break off and sink into the ocean. All that was on the land is lost, and the coastline will change shape.
text: @P災難包括自然災難和神降災難。自然災難包括： @P山崩。從山上滾下的巨石可以摧毀一切擋在它們面前的建築。巨石無法被消除，也不能在巨石上造建築物。 @P地震。地震會摧毀範圍內的所有建築，而且會留下永久的裂痕。要通過裂痕，你可以在它上面建造道路。  @P洪水。洪水會摧毀周圍的建築，洪水消退後你還可以在那些地方重新造建築物。 @P熔岩。熔岩會摧毀建築，而且會讓土地焦裂，再也無法利用。

original: A road connects every city in Atlantis and Greece to the rest of the world.  Sometimes, the road runs completely through the city, and other times it is marked by only a small road at the entrance and exit to your city. You can destroy and rebuild this road however you want. But, if you ever block the entry and exit point of the original road with buildings or other obstructions, you will be cut off from the rest of World, and land trade and immigration will cease. If you cut off the Road to the World, you'll be notified by a message. On the message is a button you can click to go directly to the site of the problem. Once you restore access to the world by removing the obstruction, land trade and immigration will resume.  If necessary, superintendents will clear the obstruction.
text: @P有一條主要道路連接各個城市，你可以毀掉或重建這條道路。如果你毀掉或封閉了這條道路，就無法和其它城市進行貿易。如果發生這種情況，你會看到一條提示信息，上面有個按鈕可以直接到達該地點。道路暢通後貿易會自動恢復。如果有必要，管理員會爲你消除障礙物。

original: Metallurgists at the Refinery convert orichalc ore into orichalc metal. Orichalc is used in the construction of Pyramids and is also used to make Atlantean Fire launchers at @31Towers and @143Frigate&Wharves. @PIn order for a Refinery to function, it must be built along a road. You also need to make sure that the metallurgists can reach the ore. If there is some impassable terrain in the way - an unbridged body of water, for example - the metallurgists won't be able to mine anything. @PAssuming nothing is blocking the way, the metallurgists make their way to the ore, mine some from the ground and return it to the Refinery. Once the Refinery has converted enough ore to make a cartload, a deliveryman will first look for a @31Tower or @143Frigate&Wharf that needs the metal. If he can't find any, he'll then take the metal to a trading facility if you are exporting the good. If you aren't exporting the metal, or if the trading facility cannot accept any more, than the deliveryman will bring the orichalc to a Storehouse. @PA deliveryman never brings orichalc directly from the Refinery to a construction site. If orichalc is needed for a Pyramid, it is procured from a Storehouse.
text: 冶煉廠的冶煉工將山銅礦石煉成山銅。山銅用於建造金字塔，也用來為 @31塔樓 和 @143護衛艦船塢 製造亞特蘭蒂斯之火發射器。 @P冶煉廠必須建在道路旁才能運作。也要確保冶煉工能到達礦藏。如果途中有無法通行的地形，例如沒有浮橋的水域，他們就無法採礦。 @P只要道路暢通，冶煉工就會前往礦藏，採出礦石並帶回冶煉廠。煉出足以裝滿一車的山銅後，送貨工會先尋找需要山銅的 @31塔樓 或 @143護衛艦船塢 。如果沒有，而你正在出口山銅，他就會把貨送到貿易設施。如果沒有出口，或貿易設施已經放不下，他就會將山銅送到貨棧。 @P送貨工不會把山銅直接從冶煉廠送到工地。金字塔所需的山銅必須從貨棧取得。

original: In order for citizens to benefit from all the food and goods you procure for them, you must have an efficient distribution system. The building blocks for the city's distribution system are the @9Granary, @10Storehouse and @8Agora. @12Piers and @11Trading&Posts also play a role in distribution.  @PThe Agora is the centerpiece of the distribution system. Vendors come from the Agora and seek out Granaries and Storehouses to procure goods needed by the households the Agora serves. When the Agora is stocked, peddlers emerge to bring the food and goods to the city's residents. The closer the Agora is to its supply sources, the more efficient it will be. If an vendor is too far away from its source of supply, he won't even bother to make the journey.  @PStorehouses and Granaries need to be connected to the Agoras that they supply. Storehouses and Granaries must also be connected to the farms and other industries that produce goods to be later distributed to the city's households. @PIf you are importing goods that your citizens need, deliverymen from your trading facilities will deliver the goods to your Storehouses and Granaries, provided they are connected to the Storehouses and Granaries by a road. @PFor more on Piers and Trading posts, read the entry on @117trade.
text: @P為了讓所有人及時得到食物和物資，你必須建立分配系統，相應的建築包括： @9糧倉 、 @10貨棧 、 @8市場 、 @12貿易港 和 @11貿易站 。 @P市場是整個系統的核心，送貨工把各種食物和物資從糧倉和貨棧運送到市場，然後送到居民的手中。  @P糧倉和貨棧要有道路和貨物來源建築以及市場連接。 @P貨物進口後也會被送往糧倉和貨棧。 @P關於貿易港和貿易站，參見 @117貿易 。

original: All of your subject city's have an obligation to pay you annual tribute.  Subject cities include vassals obtained primarily through conquest, and colonies that you have established.  Of course, if you yourself are conquered by another city, you will be expected to pay annual tribute to the conqueror.  It is quite possible to find yourself collecting tribute from some cities, while simultaneously paying tribute to others. Tribute is paid every year and can take the form of food, goods or money. If you fail to pay the tribute you owe, your overlord will likely become very angry with you. If your relationship with any of your subject cities deteriorates, its leader will stop paying you tribute.
text: @P你的殖民地和附庸城每年都會向你進貢。如果你的城市被佔領，你也要向對方進貢，所以有時候你在收取一個城市的進貢的同時，又要向另一個城市進貢。進貢的物品可以包括金錢、糧食和貨物。如果你沒有及時進貢，會讓自己陷入危險，而如果你和附庸城及殖民地關係太差，它們可能會拒絕進貢。

original: Sometimes, the gods will send you on special errands.  These special errands are called Quests. @PAll Quests must be completed by a @94hero.  When a god issues a Quest, the appropriate Hero's Hall will be made available to you. After you prepare the Hall, the hero will come to your city. @PTo send the hero on the Quest, click the @75Overview&Tab.  You'll see the Quest listed there.  If the correct hero is available, you'll see a green light next to the Quest.  Click this light, then select the proper hero from the Enlist Forces panel.  Click 'Dispatch' to send the hero on the quest. You can also send a hero on a Quest by right-clicking the Hero's Hall and clicking the 'Dispatch' button. Or, you can click the @86Goals&Button and click the 'Dispatch' button that appears on the Goals Panel.

original: Stonecutters chisel out huge blocks of stone from a @113black&marble&quarry and take it back to the Workshop. At the Workshop, the huge block of marble is broken down into usable slabs.  @PA Black Marble Workshop must be built along a road to function properly. And, the stonecutters must be able to get to the black marble quarry. If anything is blocking their way - like an unbridged body of water - the stonecutters will stay inside the Workshop. @PProvided that they can get to the quarry, the stonecutters will make their way there and bring back a huge block of marble. As soon as a slab of marble is cut from the block, a deliveryman will bring the marble to a Storehouse or, if you are exporting the good, to a trading facility. @PBlack marble is used in the construction of @73Pyramids&and&other&huge&buildings. Black marble is never brought directly from a Black Marble Workshop to the artisans at the construction site. Artisans receive shipments of marble from a Storehouse.

original: In Atlantis, science is king. Atlanteans attribute much of their success as a culture to science. @PBecause science is so important, citizens demand that scientists roam their neighborhoods before they will improve their houses. Citizens living in the best homes expect to be schooled by several different scientists. If scientists fail to pass their homes for a period of time, residents will stop taking care of their homes, which will devolve into more primitive states. @PThe types of scientists in Atlantis are the scholar, astronomer, inventor and curator. The scholar studies at the @133Bibliotheke and roams the city's streets when he has made a discovery in his books. Astronomers are trained at @135Universities and then dispatched to @134Observatories to track the paths of the stars. Inventors apprentice themselves to experts at the @136Inventors'&Workshop. When their practice inventions pass muster, they move on to a @137Laboratory where they continue to devise the most ingenious contraptions. Like astronomers, curators also receive training from a University. When their schooling is complete, they proceed to a @138Museum, where they oversee the collections and spread word of the latest exhibits to nearby neighborhoods. @PWhen in Atlantis, science is also important to the hero, @64Hercules. He requires that scientists pass by his Hall and deliver news of the latest advancements before he'll come to the city.

original: The Bibliotheke is lined with shelves of books from around the world. Scholars devour the information found in the books and spread news of what they've learned to neighboring residents. @PTo build a Bibliotheke, select the @150Science&Tab and click the Bibliotheke button. Guide the cursor to the spot in the city where you'd like to build the Bibliotheke. If you see a green ghost of the building, you've chosen a suitable location. Click the mouse button to place the building. If you see a red square, then something is preventing placement. Either clear the obstruction or find a new spot for the Bibliotheke. To function, the Bibliotheke must be built along a road. @POnce the Bibliotheke is functioning, scholars begin their studies. Periodically, a scholar will leave the Bibliotheke to teach neighboring residents what he has learned. Residents of the housing he passes benefit from the knowledge that the scholar brings and may improve their homes as a result.  @PA scholar is a roaming walker and will turn around if he encounters a @30Road&Block.

original: Astronomers keep watch over the skies at an Observatory. @PTo build an Observatory, select the @150Science&Tab and click the 'Astronomy' button. Choose 'Observatory' from the list provided, and guide your cursor to the spot in the city where you'd like the Observatory. If you see a green ghost of the building, click the mouse button to put the Observatory in place. If the cursor is red, either clear the land of obstructions or find a new spot for the Observatory. @PIn order to function properly, an Observatory must be built along a road. You also need a working @135University in your city to train the astronomers. Once the astronomers learn about the stars at a University, they make their way to an Observatory to begin work. @PWhen an astronomer discovers something new in the skies, he walks the city's streets to tell people the news. The residents of each house he passes benefit from the knowledge. @PWhen an astronomer is making his way from a University to the Observatory, he passes through @30Roadblocks. Astronomers that leave from an Observatory, however, will turn around when they encounter a Roadblock.

original: Professors at the University train students to become @138curators or @134astronomers.  @PTo build a University, select the @150Science&Tab and click the 'University' button. Move the cursor to the spot in your city where you'd like to place the building. If you see a green ghost of the building, click to place the University. If the cursor is still red, something is preventing you from building the University in the selected location. It may be possible to clear the obstruction. Otherwise, you'll need to find another spot for the University. @PMake sure to build the University along a road so that it can function properly. Once the University is operating, professors begin teaching students and sending them to Observatories or a Museum. @PCurators and astronomers who are walking from the University to the Museum or Observatory ignore @30Roadblocks.

original: An Inventors' Workshop is an incubator for new inventors. Once these new inventors have mastered some basic techniques and developed a good understanding of patent law, they proceed to a @137Laboratory. @PTo build an Inventors' Workshop, first select the @150Science&Tab. Then, click the 'Technology' button and select 'Inventors' Workshop' from the list provided. Move the cursor to the place in the city where you'd like to place the Inventors' Workshop. If the cursor turns into a green ghost of the building, you've chosen a suitable location. Click the mouse button to build the Inventors' Workshop. If the cursor is still red, then something is preventing you from placing the building in the selected location. See if you can clear away any obstructions. If you can't, then you'll need to select a different location for the Workshop. Make sure to build the Workshop along a road. @POnce the Workshop is functioning, it will begin to train new inventors and send them to Laboratories. Inventors that are going from an Inventors' Workshop to a Laboratory ignore @30Roadblocks.

original: Inventors work on their latest inventions at the Laboratory. When they have devised something truly extraordinary, they excitedly leave the Laboratory to tell neighboring residents about the invention. @PTo build a Laboratory, select the @150Science&Tab and click the 'Technology' button. Choose 'Laboratory' from the list and guide the cursor to the spot where you'd like to build the Laboratory. If you see a green ghost of the building, click the mouse button to set the Laboratory in place. If the cursor is red, something is in the way. If you cannot clear the obstruction, you'll have to find another spot for the building. @PTo function properly, the Laboratory must be built along a road. It also needs skilled inventors from an @136Inventors'&Workshop.

original: The Museum holds the mysteries of the Atlantean past. A city can have only one Museum. @PTo build a Museum, select the @150Science&Tab and click the 'Museum' button. Guide the cursor to the spot where you'd like to place the Museum. If you see a green ghost of the building, click to place the Museum. If the cursor is red, something is preventing you from placing the Museum in the chosen spot. If you can't clear the obstruction, you'll have to find a new location. @PThe Museum must be built along a road to function. Curators who have graduated from a @135University must also make their way to the Museum. As new exhibits are developed, curators leave the Museum to tell residents of the city about the latest show. @PCurators from a Museum will turn around when they encounter a @30Roadblock. If a curator is on his way from the University to the Museum, he'll ignore Roadblocks.

original: Atlanteans enjoy watching the speed and grace of horses at a Hippodrome. Each city can have only one Hippodrome. @PHippodromes are built one segment at a time. They can be as big or small as you want. They can be a simple oval or a more free-form design. To place a segment of Hippodrome, select the @81Administration&Tab and click the Hippodrome button. Select 'Hippodrome' from the list and guide your cursor to the spot in the city where you'd like to start the Hippodrome. If you've chosen a suitable spot, the cursor will turn green. As you hold the cursor in place, the different types of segments you can build will cycle through. When you see the type of segment you want to build, click the mouse button to build the segment. @PRepeat the process to build additional segments of Hippodrome, making sure to attach the new segment to the end of an existing segment. Or, you can build multiple straight sections of Hippodrome at one time by clicking the mouse button and dragging the mouse until the Hippodrome is the desired length.  A Hippodrome is considered complete when you have a closed loop. @PBefore races can begin, a handler from the Hippodrome must retrieve some horses from a Horse Ranch.  The longer the Hippodrome is, the more horses will be needed.  Right-click on the Hippodrome to find out how many horses the Hippodrome needs, and how many are already in the Hippodrome's paddock, ready to race. @PThe longer the Hippodrome is, the more benefits it brings to your city. The bigger your Hippodrome, the more money it will generate for you. You'll also become more respected by other leaders, and your own people will admire you more.  Your people do have their limits, though.  If your Hippodrome is exceptionally large, they'll begin to resent your dedication to the races, and your popularity with your citizens will plummet. @PHippodromes can pose some interesting city design questions. To help fit a Hippodrome into your city, use the Crosswalk.  @PTo build a Crosswalk, select the Administration Tab and click the 'Hippodrome' button. Then, choose Crosswalk from the list. Guide the cursor so that it is adjacent to the section of Hippodrome you want your citizens to cross. Make sure that there is either clear land or a road on both sides of the selected segment. If you have chosen a good spot, you'll see a green ghost of the Crosswalk. Click the mouse button to place the Crosswalk. If the cursor is red, then the spot you've chosen isn't suitable. If you can, clear obstructions on both sides of the Hippodrome. Otherwise, you'll have to find a different spot for the Crosswalk. @PThe city's residents treat a Crosswalk just like they do a road or bridge.
text: 關於這個主題的幫助信息沒有找到

original: People love to play in Water Parks. @PThere are several variations of Water Park.  To see your choices, select 'Water Park' from the list of Recreational Areas.  Hold the cursor over some clear land, and you'll see your choices cycle through.  When you see the type of Water Park you want, click the mouse button to place it.  You can also click your mouse button and drag the mouse to place more than one Water Park at a time.
text: 人們喜歡在水上樂園遊玩。@P水上樂園有多種樣式。若要查看選項，從「休閒設施」列表中選擇「水上樂園」，將游標懸停在空地上，即可循環切換樣式。看到想要的樣式後點擊滑鼠放置。也可以按住滑鼠拖曳來一次放置多座水上樂園。

original: With a supply of @41wood and @34horses, workers at a Chariot Factory build and outfit chariots. Chariots are used by the most elite of Atlantean soldiers. @PTo build a Chariot Factory, select the Military Tab and click the 'Military Workshops' button. Choose 'Chariot Factory' from the list provided and move the cursor to the area where you want to build the Factory. If you see a green ghost of the building, click the mouse button to put the Chariot Factory in place. If the cursor is red, there is something preventing you from placing the building in the chosen location. If you cannot clear the obstruction, you'll need to find another spot for the Chariot Factory. @PMake sure to build the Chariot Factory along a road, and make sure that this road is connected to a supply of wood and horses. Otherwise, the Chariot Factory will be unable to make chariots. @PWhen the Chariot Factory needs wood, deliverymen from a @41Timber&Mill, Storehouse or trading facility will deliver a supply.  When the Chariot Factory needs horses, a hostler from the Factory will personally go to a @34Horse&Ranch to retrieve some horses. @PCompleted chariots are stored at the Chariot Factory until a chariot vendor from an Agora picks them up. Chariots cannot be traded.
