text: 有了 @41木材 和 @34馬匹 ，戰車工場的工人就能製造並裝備戰車。戰車由亞特蘭蒂斯最精銳的士兵使用。 @P要建造戰車工場，選擇軍事標籤，點擊「軍事工場」，再從清單選擇「戰車工場」，將游標移到預定地點。建築預覽呈綠色時，點擊便能放置。若呈紅色，表示有障礙阻止建造；如果無法清除，就必須另找地點。 @P戰車工場必須建在路邊，而且道路要連接木材與馬匹的來源，否則無法製造戰車。 @P需要木材時， @41伐木場 、貨棧或貿易設施的送貨工會送來物資。需要馬匹時，工場的馬夫會親自前往 @34馬場 取馬。 @P完成的戰車存放在工場裡，等待市場的戰車商販來取。戰車不能用於貿易。

original: The Atlantean army is made up of three types of soldiers: archers, spearmen and charioteers. @PErstwhile archers are the most basic soldier in the Atlantean military. They come from @6common&housing and supply their own bows and arrows. Their strength is long-range combat. Archers may only be used for city defense and cannot be sent abroad. For information on the specific orders that you can issue archers, click @145here. @PSpearmen come from the city's @7elite&housing. Once a peddler from an @8Agora supplies a house with armor, some of its residents will gladly take up arms in the interest of their city, both at home and abroad.  Their strength is short-range combat. Click @146here to learn about the orders you can give spearmen. @PCharioteers are the most elite soldiers in the Atlantean military. Only residents from the city's best elite housing can become charioteers. For more information on charioteer orders, click @147here.
text: 亞特蘭蒂斯軍隊由三種士兵組成：弓箭手、長矛兵和戰車兵。 @P弓箭手是亞特蘭蒂斯最基本的士兵，來自 @6民房 ，並自行準備弓箭。他們擅長遠距離作戰，只能保衛城市，不能派往海外。點擊 @145這裡 了解弓箭手的具體指令。 @P長矛兵來自城市的 @7高級住宅 。當 @8市場 的商販為房屋提供盔甲後，部分居民便會樂意拿起武器，在本城或海外為城市作戰。他們擅長近距離戰鬥。點擊 @146這裡 了解長矛兵的指令。 @P戰車兵是亞特蘭蒂斯最精銳的士兵，只有最好的高級住宅居民才能成為戰車兵。點擊 @147這裡 了解戰車兵的指令。

original: Each Frigate Wharf serves an associated frigate. Frigates only sail the seas in Atlantis. @PTo build a Frigate Wharf, select the Military Tab and click on the Military Workshops button. From the list that appears, choose Frigate Wharf. A red footprint of the building will appear. @PFrigate Wharves must be placed along the water, on a straight section of coastline. Run the red footprint along the coastline until you see a green ghost of the Frigate Wharf. Click to put the building into place. Make sure to build the Wharf along a road. @PIn order for workers at the Frigate Wharf to build a frigate, there must be a @24Palace in the city. The Frigate Wharf must also have a supply of wood and armor to build a frigate and to outfit its marines. Once these conditions have been satisfied, the Frigate Wharf's workers will build and later man the frigate. @PAfter the frigate has been built, it can be equipped with a deadly Atlantean Fire launcher. To arm a frigate with this deadly weapon, a load of @127orichalc must be delivered to the Frigate Wharf. Frigates that launch Atlantean Fire are stronger than boats that can not fire this dangerous weapon.   @PIt requires a lot of people to build and man a frigate.  If you're not ready to build the frigate yet, because, for example, you lack the necessary wood or armor, you may release the Wharf's workers so that they may be employed by other industries. To do this, right click on the Wharf, then click the 'Send Wharf workers home' button at the bottom of the panel.  To recall the workers to build the frigate, click the same button, which now says, 'Staff this Frigate Wharf'.   @PClick @144here to find out which orders you can give to a frigate.
text: 每座護衛艦船塢都服務一艘護衛艦。護衛艦只在亞特蘭蒂斯的海域航行。 @P要建造護衛艦船塢，選擇軍事標籤，點擊「軍事工場」，再選擇「護衛艦船塢」。游標會顯示紅色的建築輪廓。 @P船塢必須建在平直的岸邊。沿著海岸移動游標，直到預覽變成綠色，再點擊放置。記得讓船塢連接道路。 @P船塢工人要建造護衛艦，城裡必須有 @24宮殿 。船塢也需要木材造船，以及盔甲裝備海軍士兵。條件滿足後，工人便會造船，並在完工後擔任船員。 @P護衛艦完工後，可以裝設致命的亞特蘭蒂斯之火發射器。只要將一單位 @127山銅 送到船塢，就能裝備這種武器。能發射亞特蘭蒂斯之火的護衛艦，比未裝備者更加強大。 @P造船與操作護衛艦需要許多人。如果尚未準備好，例如缺少木材或盔甲，可以暫時解散船塢工人，讓他們轉到其他行業工作。在船塢上點擊右鍵，再點擊面板下方的「讓船塢工人回家」。要召回工人時，再點擊同一個按鈕，此時它會顯示「為這座護衛艦船塢召集工人」。 @P點擊 @144這裡 了解護衛艦可接受的指令。

original: The agile frigate is adept at defending your Atlantean city's shores and can be sent abroad on some military campaigns. When equipped with Atlantean Fire, the frigate becomes even stronger. Read the entry on the @143Frigate&Wharf to learn more about the manufacture of frigates and how to arm them with Atlantean Fire.  @PTo move the frigate, click on it and then click on the location you would like it to move to. To issue the frigate orders, click on it, then use one of the orders buttons that will appear on the Control Panel. The orders are: @L@PCALL CREW TO SHIP/SEND CREW HOME. This order tells the ship's crew to come aboard, or to go home, depending on what they are currently doing. Keep in mind that while issuing the 'Send Crew Home' command returns the frigate to the Wharf and disbands its crew, it does not instruct the frigate's Wharf to repair the ship. If you want repairs performed on the ship, you'll have to issue the 'Carry Out Repairs' order. @L@PDEFEND LOCATION. When given this order, the ship's captain will hold his vessel in one location, and defend this location against any attackers that come near.  @L@PATTACK ALL ENEMIES. When given this order, the ship's captain will aggressively seek out any enemy and attack it. The captain chooses which enemies to attack following a fixed set of priorities. First he'll seek out enemy transports which are currently carrying soldiers, to try to destroy them before their soldiers can reach land. If there are no such vessels, he looks for enemy warships to attack. Failing that, he'll order his frigate close to shore to attack any enemy soldiers that might have landed. Finally, if there are no enemy soldiers within his reach, he'll attack empty enemy transports. @L@PPATROL AREA. When given this order, the frigate's captain will patrol your city's waters, attacking any enemy ships he encounters.  @L@PCARRY OUT REPAIRS. Clicking this button will send the frigate back to its Wharf to be repaired. If the ship is severely damaged, the frigate captain will take it upon himself to return to the Wharf for repairs. @L@PGO TO SHIP. Clicking this button centers your view on the frigate.   @PYou cannot issue military commands while the game is @3paused. @PYou can select more than one frigate at a time and issue all of them the same orders. First, select a single frigate. When the cursor changes, click and drag your mouse. You'll notice that a box appears. Adjust this box by clicking and dragging your mouse so that the box contains all the frigates you want to select. Then, let go of the mouse button and order away! @PAfter you've selected a group of frigates, you can assign a hotkey to them. With the group selected, hold down the CTRL and press 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5.  When you want to recall the group of ships, simply press the ALT key plus the number that you assigned it to. @PWhile the frigate is an extremely effective weapon, it can be eluded by the crafty Oceanids. When Oceanids attack, they swim toward your city under the cover of deep water. Not even Atlantean Fire can harm them while they are approaching your city.
text: 靈活的護衛艦擅長保衛亞特蘭蒂斯城市的海岸，也能派往海外參加部分軍事行動。裝備亞特蘭蒂斯之火後，它會更加強大。查看 @143護衛艦船塢 條目，可了解造船與裝備亞特蘭蒂斯之火的方法。 @P要移動護衛艦，先點擊船隻，再點擊目的地。要下達指令，先選中船隻，再使用控制面板上的指令按鈕： @L@P召集船員／讓船員回家：依目前狀態，命令船員登船或回家。讓船員回家會使船隻返回船塢並解散船員，但不會修理船隻。需要維修時，請使用「進行修理」。 @L@P守衛地點：船長會讓船隻停在指定位置，攻擊接近的敵人。 @L@P攻擊所有敵人：船長會主動尋找敵人。他會先攻擊載有士兵的敵方運輸船，試圖在敵軍登陸前將其擊沉；沒有這類船隻時，便攻擊敵方戰船；再沒有，便靠岸攻擊已登陸的敵軍；最後才攻擊空載的敵方運輸船。 @L@P巡邏區域：船長會巡邏城市水域，攻擊遇到的敵船。 @L@P進行修理：點擊後護衛艦會返回船塢維修。受損嚴重時，船長也會自行返航修理。 @L@P查看船隻：將畫面置中於這艘護衛艦。 @P遊戲 @3暫停 時無法下達軍事指令。 @P你可以同時選取多艘護衛艦並下達相同命令。先選取一艘船，游標改變後按住滑鼠拖曳，將出現的方框涵蓋所有要選取的船隻，再放開按鍵下令。 @P選取一組護衛艦後，可以為它們設定快捷鍵。按住 CTRL，再按一至五的數字鍵。以後按 ALT 加上該數字，就能重新選取這組船隻。 @P護衛艦雖然強大，狡猾的海洋族卻能避開它。海洋族進攻時會潛入深水游向城市，在接近城市的途中，連亞特蘭蒂斯之火也傷不了他們。

original: Atlantean archers come from the city's @6common&housing. Residents of common housing will begin fighting for the city as soon as they are living in houses that are at least at the Hovel level, and you have erected a Palace.  @PTo select a company of archers, click on its standard or click on any of the women in the company. When you do, the @86Control&Panel will change, displaying the company's status. You'll see the company's name, along with the current morale of its women. If a company's morale dips too low, its women will refuse to fight. You'll also see a brief description of what the company is currently doing.  @PAbove the status information is a series of buttons that you use to position the company and give it orders. The buttons you'll see are: @PGO TO COMPANY BUTTON. Clicking on the Go To Company button will center your view on the company's standard. @PROTATE COMPANY BUTTON. The Rotate Company button indicates which direction the company is currently facing. Clicking on the button will rotate the company. @PMUSTER COMPANY/SEND HOME BUTTON. The Muster Company/Send Home button lets you call your soldiers to arms (muster) or send them home, depending on which they are currently doing. @PUSE DEFENSIVE TACTICS. When archers have been told to defend an area, they hold their position and fire arrows at any enemy within range. @PUSE OFFENSIVE TACTICS. When told to employ an offensive tactic, archers will seek out and attack any nearby enemy. @PEMPLOY SPECIAL TACTICS. The special tactic employed by archers is the skirmish. Archers will shoot arrows at a distant enemy. As the enemy approaches, the archers will fall back and continue firing arrows. After the skirmish ends, archers will return to their standard if there are no other enemies nearby.  @PSHOW ALL FORCES. Clicking on the Magnifying Glass brings up a list of @84all&your&military&forces. From there, you can issue general instructions to all of your military forces. @PYou cannot issue military commands while the game is @3paused.
text: 亞特蘭蒂斯弓箭手來自城市的 @6民房 。只要住宅至少達到簡陋小屋等級，而且城裡建有宮殿，居民就會開始為城市作戰。 @P點擊部隊旗幟或隊內任一女戰士，便能選取弓箭手部隊。 @86控制面板 會顯示部隊名稱、士氣和目前行動。如果士氣過低，她們會拒絕作戰。 @P狀態資訊上方的按鈕可用來調整位置及下令： @P查看部隊：將畫面置中於部隊旗幟。 @P改變方位：按鈕顯示部隊目前面向，點擊即可旋轉隊形。 @P召集部隊／解散部隊：依目前狀態，召集士兵武裝或讓她們回家。 @P使用防禦戰術：弓箭手會堅守指定位置，向射程內的敵人放箭。 @P使用進攻戰術：弓箭手會主動尋找並攻擊附近敵人。 @P使用特殊戰術：弓箭手使用游擊戰術，先向遠方敵人放箭；敵人靠近時，一面後退一面射擊。戰鬥結束且附近沒有其他敵人時，她們會返回旗幟旁。 @P顯示所有部隊：點擊放大鏡即可查看 @84全部軍隊 的清單，並向所有部隊下達一般指令。 @P遊戲 @3暫停 時無法下達軍事指令。

original: @PSpearmen come from the Atlantean city's @7Mansions and @7Manors. @PTo select a phalanx of spearmen, click on its standard or click on any of the soldiers in the company. When you do, the Control Panel will change, displaying the company's status. You'll see the company's name, along with the current morale of its men. If a company's morale dips too low, its spearmen will refuse to fight. You'll also see a brief description of what the company is currently doing.  @PAbove the status information is a series of buttons that you use to position the company and give it orders. The buttons you'll see are: @PGO TO COMPANY BUTTON. Clicking on the Go To Company button will center your view on the company's standard. @PROTATE COMPANY BUTTON. The Rotate Company button indicates which direction the company is currently facing. Clicking on the button will rotate the company. @PMUSTER COMPANY/SEND HOME BUTTON. The Muster Company/Send Home button lets you call your soldiers to arms and send them home. What the company is currently doing governs which command clicking this button will issue. If the company is already mustered, then clicking the button will send the men home. If the company is at home, then clicking the button will call the soldiers to arms. @PUSE DEFENSIVE TACTICS. When employing defensive tactics, spearmen will stand their ground, and attack anything that comes close to them with their spears. @PUSE OFFENSIVE TACTICS. When told to use offensive tactics, spearmen move together as a unit, attacking with their spears. @PEMPLOY SPECIAL TACTICS. The spearmen's special tactic is the wedge, which is good for breaking defensive formations. The soldiers organize themselves into a wedge shape to attack enemies. @PSHOW ALL FORCES. Clicking on the Magnifying Glass brings up a list of @84all&your&military&forces. From there, you can issue general instructions to your entire military. @PYou cannot issue military commands while the game is @3paused.
text: @P長矛兵來自亞特蘭蒂斯城市的 @7宅邸 和 @7莊園 。 @P點擊部隊旗幟或任一士兵，便能選取長矛兵方陣。控制面板會顯示部隊名稱、士氣和目前行動。如果士氣過低，長矛兵會拒絕作戰。 @P狀態資訊上方的按鈕可用來調整位置及下令： @P查看部隊：將畫面置中於部隊旗幟。 @P改變方位：按鈕顯示部隊目前面向，點擊即可旋轉隊形。 @P召集部隊／解散部隊：依目前狀態，召集士兵武裝或讓他們回家。部隊已被召集時，點擊會讓士兵回家；士兵在家時，點擊便會召集部隊。 @P使用防禦戰術：長矛兵會堅守陣地，用長矛攻擊接近的敵人。 @P使用進攻戰術：長矛兵會整隊前進，以長矛攻擊敵人。 @P使用特殊戰術：長矛兵排成楔形進攻，適合突破防禦陣形。 @P顯示所有部隊：點擊放大鏡即可查看 @84全部軍隊 的清單，並向所有部隊下達一般指令。 @P遊戲 @3暫停 時無法下達軍事指令。

original: @PCharioteers come from the Atlantean city's @7Estates. @PTo select a company of charioteers, click on its standard or click on any of the soldiers in the company. When you do, the Control Panel will change, displaying the company's status. You'll see the company's name, along with the current morale of its men. If a company's morale dips too low, its men will refuse to fight. You'll also see a brief description of what the company is currently doing.  @PAbove the status information is a series of buttons that you use to position the company and give it orders. The buttons you'll see are: @PGO TO COMPANY BUTTON. Clicking on the Go To Company button will center your view on the company's standard. @PROTATE COMPANY BUTTON. The Rotate Company button indicates which direction the company is currently facing. Clicking on the button will rotate the company. @PMUSTER COMPANY/SEND HOME BUTTON. The Muster Company/Send Home button lets you call your soldiers to arms or send them home, depending on which they are currently doing. @PUSE DEFENSIVE TACTICS. When charioteers have been told to defend an area, they remain in their chariots and attack any enemy that comes within range. @PUSE OFFENSIVE TACTICS. When told to use offensive tactics, charioteers will charge the enemy in an attempt to break their formations, after which they'll stay and fight. The charioteers will charge as often as they can, but the horses do need to rest between attacks. If engaged directly, the charioteers will respond in kind. @PEMPLOY SPECIAL TACTICS. The charioteers special tactic is to harass. When told to harass, charioteers charge the enemy, fight for a little bit, and then retreat. When the horses are rested, they repeat the maneuver. @PSHOW ALL FORCES. Clicking on the Magnifying Glass brings up a list of @84all&your&military&forces. From there, you can issue general instructions to your entire military. @PYou cannot issue military commands while the game is @3paused.
text: @P戰車兵來自亞特蘭蒂斯城市的 @7豪宅 。 @P點擊部隊旗幟或任一士兵，便能選取戰車部隊。控制面板會顯示部隊名稱、士氣和目前行動。如果士氣過低，他們會拒絕作戰。 @P狀態資訊上方的按鈕可用來調整位置及下令： @P查看部隊：將畫面置中於部隊旗幟。 @P改變方位：按鈕顯示部隊目前面向，點擊即可旋轉隊形。 @P召集部隊／解散部隊：依目前狀態，召集士兵武裝或讓他們回家。 @P使用防禦戰術：戰車兵會留在戰車上，攻擊進入範圍的敵人。 @P使用進攻戰術：戰車兵會衝鋒，試圖突破敵人的陣形，然後留在原地戰鬥。他們會盡可能再次衝鋒，但馬匹在攻擊之間需要休息。受到直接攻擊時，他們也會還擊。 @P使用特殊戰術：戰車兵採取騷擾戰術，衝向敵人，短暫交戰後撤退。待馬匹休息完畢，再重複行動。 @P顯示所有部隊：點擊放大鏡即可查看 @84全部軍隊 的清單，並向所有部隊下達一般指令。 @P遊戲 @3暫停 時無法下達軍事指令。

original: Atlanteans are bound by the Symphonia Ithikos, which prohibits internecine warfare. Any Atlantean leader that attack or raids another Atlantean ally will be swiftly punished. All Atlantean allies will instantly become the attacker's rival. If you, as an Atlantean leader, decide to attack or raid one of your compatriots, don't count on any help from other Atlantean leaders. All other Atlantean leaders will refuse to take part in such a murderous folly.
text: 亞特蘭蒂斯人受伊索斯和諧條約約束，禁止內戰。任何亞特蘭蒂斯領袖若攻擊或劫掠另一個亞特蘭蒂斯盟友，將立刻受到懲罰。所有亞特蘭蒂斯盟友都會立即成為攻击者的敵人。如果你作為亞特蘭蒂斯領袖決定攻擊或劫掠同胞，不要指望其他亞特蘭蒂斯領袖會幫忙。他們都會拒絕參與這種屠殺性的愚蠢行為。

original: Oranges grown on Orange Trees are enjoyed as food. To harvest oranges, you must have an @109Orange&Tenders'&Lodge. @POrange trees must be placed in a @113meadow. They do not need to be planted along a road. @PThe orange harvest starts in November and lasts for two months. Any oranges left on the trees after the harvest go to waste.
text: 橘子樹結出的橘子可供食用。要採收橘子，必須建造 @109橘農小屋 。 @P橘子樹必須種在 @113草地 上，不需要緊鄰道路。 @P橘子的採收季節從十一月開始，持續兩個月。收成季節結束後仍留在樹上的橘子都會白白浪費。

original: Select the Science Tab to keep your Atlanteans well-informed about the latest scientific discoveries. @PWhen you select the Science Tab, the buttons for the types of science building that you can construct in a city will appear. The possible buttons are @133Bibliotheke, Astronomy, Technology and @138Museum. Clicking Astronomy will bring up a list of two buildings: @134Observatory and @135University. Clicking Technology will also bring up a list of two buildings: @136Inventors'&Workshop and @137Laboratory.  @PThe Science Tab also helps you to keep track of the scientific activity in your city. The types of scientific pursuits are listed on the tab, along with an assessment of how adequately served the science needs of your citizens are. For more information on science in the city, click the small magnifying glass. More detailed information will appear, including the specific number of science buildings the city has. @PTo keep track of a specific type of scientific pursuit, use the small buttons at the top of the Science Tab. Click 'Show Scholars' to see all the Bibliothekes and scholars in the city, along with how recently each house in the city has been passed by a scholar. Clicking 'Show Astronomers' will allow you to see the astronomers in your city, along with all the Observatories and Universities. Columns in front of the houses reveal if an astronomer has recently passed. Click the 'Show Inventors' buttons to see the city's inventors, Inventors' Workshops and Laboratories. Clicking 'Show Curators' allows you to see the city's curators, Museums and Universities. Finally, click on 'Show All Science' to see all the scientists and science buildings in the city. You'll also be able to see how adequately educated the residents of each house are.
text: 選擇科學標籤，讓亞特蘭蒂斯居民掌握最新的科學發現。 @P選中科學標籤後，會出現城裡可以建造的科學設施按鈕，包括 @133圖書館 、天文、技術和 @138博物館 。點擊天文，會列出 @134天文臺 和 @135大學 ；點擊技術，會列出 @136發明工場 和 @137實驗室 。 @P科學標籤也能幫助你掌握城裡的科學活動。面板列出各種科學領域，以及市民需求獲得滿足的程度。點擊小放大鏡，可查看更詳細的資訊，包括各種科學建築的數量。 @P要查看特定科學領域，使用標籤上方的小按鈕。「查看學者」會顯示所有圖書館與學者，以及學者最近是否經過各間房屋。「查看天文學家」會顯示天文學家、天文臺和大學，房屋前的圓柱表示最近是否有天文學家來訪。「查看發明家」會顯示發明家、發明工場和實驗室。「查看館長」會顯示館長、博物館和大學。最後，「查看所有科學」會顯示全城科學家和科學建築，也能看出各間房屋居民接受科學教育的程度。

original: The docile and tasty deer is the favorite target of the deer hunter. To hunt deer, you must build a @69Hunting&Lodge. Once the Hunting Lodge has employees, the hunt will begin.
text: 溫馴而美味的鹿，是獵鹿人最喜愛的獵物。要獵鹿，必須建造 @69獵人小屋 。小屋有了雇工後，狩獵就會開始。

original: Cattle graze in a meadow until it is time for them to do their duty to the people of the city and become food. Cattle are slaughtered at the @108Corral. @PTo place some cattle in a meadow, first make sure that you have a Corral. Then, select the @77Husbandry&Tab and click the 'Herding' button. Select the 'Cattle' button, and place the livestock. Some of the cattle you place are bulls.  Bulls guard the herd of cows from hungry wolves and are never used for meat. @PCattle may be sacrificed to the gods at the city's Sanctuaries.
text: 牛群在草地上吃草，直到為市民提供食物的時刻到來。牛會在 @108牛欄 宰殺。 @P要在草地上放置牛群，先確保已建有牛欄，再選擇 @77農業標籤 ，點擊「放牧」，選擇「牛」並放置。有些放下的牛是公牛，牠們會保護牛群免受飢餓野狼侵襲，不會被宰殺取肉。 @P牛也可以在城市的聖所獻祭給眾神。

original: Atlanteans have developed advanced construction techniques, and these techniques are showcased in the construction of Pyramids.  The types of pyramids you can build are the Modest Pyramid, Pyramid, Great Pyramid and Majestic Pyramid. The main difference among these pyramids is size. @PTo lay the foundation for a Pyramid, select the @85Aesthetics&Tab and click the Pyramid button. Choose the Pyramid you would like to build from the list provided. Then, guide the Pyramid's footprint to the spot in your city where you would like to build the structure.  If the footprint turns into a green ghost of the building, then you have chosen a good spot. Click the mouse button to set the Pyramid in place.  If the footprint is red, then something is preventing you from placing the Pyramid in the selected location.  Either clear any obstructions, or find a new spot for the Pyramid. For more information on building a Pyramid, consult the entry on @73building&pyramids&and&other&large&buildings. @PTo build a pyramid, you need the services of artisans from an @45Artisans'&Guild. You also need supplies of marble (@131black, @42white or both), @127orichalc and @41wood. For more on building pyramids, click @73here. @PYou can have only one of each Pyramid type in your city.
text: 亞特蘭蒂斯人發展出先進的建築技術，金字塔就是這些技術的展示。可以建造的種類包括小金字塔、金字塔、大金字塔和雄偉金字塔，主要差異在於規模。 @P要放置金字塔地基，選擇 @85環境標籤 ，點擊金字塔按鈕，再從清單選擇所需種類。把建築輪廓移到預定位置，預覽變成綠色時便可點擊放置。如果呈紅色，表示有障礙阻止建造，請清除障礙或另選地點。更多資訊請參閱 @73建造金字塔與大型建築 。 @P建造金字塔需要 @45工匠行 的工匠，以及大理石（ @131黑色大理石 、 @42白大理石 或兩者）、 @127山銅 和 @41木材 。更多建造資訊請點擊 @73這裡 。 @P城裡每種金字塔只能建造一座。

original: A Shrine is dedicated to a specific god. There are three types of Shrine: the Minor Shrine, the Shrine and the Major Shrine. @PTo lay the foundation for a Shrine, select the @85Aesthetics&Tab and click the Pyramid button. Choose the Shrine that you would like to build from the list provided. @PTo build a Minor Shrine or a Major Shrine, you'll need supplies of marble (@42white, @131black or both), @127orichalc, @41wood and @48sculpture. You do not need sculpture to build a regular Shrine. For more on the construction of shrines, click @73here. @PYou can only have one shrine of each type dedicated to a god. So, for example, you can have a Major Shrine dedicated to Hera and another Major Shrine dedicated to Artemis, but you cannot have two Major Shrines dedicated to Hera.
text: 神殿供奉特定神明，分為小神殿、神殿和大神殿三種。 @P要放置神殿地基，選擇 @85環境標籤 ，點擊金字塔按鈕，再從清單選擇要建造的神殿。 @P小神殿和大神殿需要大理石（ @42白大理石 、 @131黑色大理石 或兩者）、 @127山銅 、 @41木材 和 @48雕像 。普通神殿不需要雕像。更多建造資訊請點擊 @73這裡 。 @P對同一位神明，每種神殿只能建一座。例如，可以同時擁有赫拉大神殿和阿緹蜜絲大神殿，卻不能建兩座赫拉大神殿。

original: Monuments to the Sky stretch towards the stars, which are a favorite topic of conversation among Atlanteans. There are three types of Monuments to the Sky: Small Monument to the Sky, Monument to the Sky and Grand Monument to the Sky. @PTo lay the foundation for a Monument to the Sky, select the @85Aesthetics&Tab and click the Pyramid button. Choose the Monument to the Sky that you would like to build from the list provided. @PTo build a Monument to the Sky, you'll need supplies of marble (@42white, @131black or both), @127orichalc and @41wood. For more information on the construction of Monuments to the Sky, click @73here. @PYou can have only one of each type of Monument to the Sky in your city.
text: 天空紀念碑伸向星辰，而星辰正是亞特蘭蒂斯人喜愛談論的話題。天空紀念碑分為小型、普通和大型三種。 @P要放置天空紀念碑地基，選擇 @85環境標籤 ，點擊金字塔按鈕，再從清單選擇要建造的種類。 @P建造天空紀念碑需要大理石（ @42白大理石 、 @131黑色大理石 或兩者）、 @127山銅 和 @41木材 。更多建造資訊請點擊 @73這裡 。 @P城裡每種天空紀念碑只能建造一座。

original: The Altar of Olympus is a favorite sight of Atlanteans. @PTo lay the foundation for the Altar of Olympus, select the @85Aesthetics&Tab and click the Pyramid button. Choose 'Altar of Olympus' from the list provided. @PTo build the Altar of Olympus, you'll need supplies of marble (@42white, @131black or both), @127orichalc and @41wood. For more information on the construction of the Altar of Olympus, click @73here. @PYou can have only one Altar of Olympus in your city.
text: 奧林匹斯祭壇是亞特蘭蒂斯人喜愛的景觀。 @P要放置奧林匹斯祭壇的地基，選擇 @85環境標籤 ，點擊金字塔按鈕，再從清單選擇「奧林匹斯祭壇」。 @P建造奧林匹斯祭壇需要大理石（ @42白大理石 、 @131黑色大理石 或兩者）、 @127山銅 和 @41木材 。更多建造資訊請點擊 @73這裡 。 @P城裡只能建造一座奧林匹斯祭壇。

original: The Temple of Olympus reminds your people of the gods' lofty home.  @PTo lay the foundation for the Temple of Olympus, select the @85Aesthetics&Tab and click the Pyramid button. Choose 'Temple of Olympus' from the list provided. @PTo build the Temple of Olympus, you'll need supplies of marble (@42white, @131black or both), @127orichalc and @41wood. For more information on the construction of the Temple of Olympus, click @73here. @PYou can have only one Temple of Olympus in your city.
text: 奧林匹斯神廟讓人民想起眾神崇高的居所。 @P要放置奧林匹斯神廟的地基，選擇 @85環境標籤 ，點擊金字塔按鈕，再從清單選擇「奧林匹斯神廟」。 @P建造奧林匹斯神廟需要大理石（ @42白大理石 、 @131黑色大理石 或兩者）、 @127山銅 和 @41木材 。更多建造資訊請點擊 @73這裡 。 @P城裡只能建造一座奧林匹斯神廟。

original: The Pyramid of the Pantheon celebrates all gods.  @PTo lay the foundation for the Pyramid of the Pantheon, select the @85Aesthetics&Tab and click the Pyramid button. Choose 'Pyramid of the Pantheon' from the list provided. @PTo build the Pyramid of the Pantheon, you'll need supplies of marble (@42white, @131black or both), @127orichalc, @48sculpture and @41wood. For more information on the construction of the Pyramid of the Pantheon, click @73here. @PYou can have only one Pyramid of the Pantheon in your city.
text: 眾神金字塔讚頌所有神明。 @P要放置眾神金字塔的地基，選擇 @85環境標籤 ，點擊金字塔按鈕，再從清單選擇「眾神金字塔」。 @P建造眾神金字塔需要大理石（ @42白大理石 、 @131黑色大理石 或兩者）、 @127山銅 、 @48雕像 和 @41木材 。更多建造資訊請點擊 @73這裡 。 @P城裡只能建造一座眾神金字塔。

original: The beautiful Observatory Kosmika keeps watch over the skies.  @PTo lay the foundation for the Observatory Kosmika, select the @85Aesthetics&Tab and click the Pyramid button. Choose 'Observatory Kosmika' from the list provided. @PTo build the Observatory Kosmika, you'll need supplies of marble (@42white, @131black or both), @127orichalc and @41wood. For more information on the construction of the Observatory Kosmika, click @73here. @PYou can have only one Observatory Kosmika in your city.
text: 美麗的宇宙天文臺守望著天空。 @P要放置宇宙天文臺的地基，選擇 @85環境標籤 ，點擊金字塔按鈕，再從清單選擇「宇宙天文臺」。 @P建造宇宙天文臺需要大理石（ @42白大理石 、 @131黑色大理石 或兩者）、 @127山銅 和 @41木材 。更多建造資訊請點擊 @73這裡 。 @P城裡只能建造一座宇宙天文臺。

original: The Museum Atlantika is a testament to the thirst for knowledge on Atlantis.  @PTo lay the foundation for the Museum Atlantika, select the @85Aesthetics&Tab and click the Pyramid button. Choose 'Museum Atlantika' from the list provided. @PTo build the Museum Atlantika, you'll need supplies of marble (@42white, @131black or both), @127orichalc and @41wood. For more information on the construction of the Museum Atlantika, click @73here. @PYou can have only one Museum Atlantika in your city.
text: 亞特蘭蒂斯博物館展現了亞特蘭蒂斯人對知識的渴望。 @P要放置亞特蘭蒂斯博物館的地基，選擇 @85環境標籤 ，點擊金字塔按鈕，再從清單選擇「亞特蘭蒂斯博物館」。 @P建造亞特蘭蒂斯博物館需要大理石（ @42白大理石 、 @131黑色大理石 或兩者）、 @127山銅 和 @41木材 。更多建造資訊請點擊 @73這裡 。 @P城裡只能建造一座亞特蘭蒂斯博物館。

original: Your great father, Atlas, is intent on building the continent of Atlantis into a mighty nation, unsurpassed by any the world has ever seen.  He has turned to you for help in achieving this goal.  This is a fairly easy adventure that consists of seven parent city episodes and two colony episodes.
text: 你偉大的父親阿特拉斯決心將亞特蘭蒂斯大陸建成一個前所未有的強盛國家。他向你尋求協助，希望實現這個目標。這場冒險的難度較低，包含七個主城章節及兩個殖民地章節。

original: @PMy dearest child, for a long time now you have enjoyed the benefits that come to the offspring of a king.  Now, it is time for you to assume the responsibility that your high birth demands.  Each of my nine brothers deserves a kingdom, and, as the eldest, I have pledged to personally assist them to found their kingdoms.  First, I am going to help Gadirus, my own twin, build his city.  While I am away, I am entrusting you to construct a fair and mighty city here near the hill where I was born and raised.  Poseidon himself dug the water-filled trenches that encircle the hill, protecting it from enemies.  The city that you build will become the capital of all of Atlantis, so be sure that the city befits its stature.  Good luck!
text: @P我親愛的孩子，長久以來你一直享受著國王之子的特權。現在，是時候承擔你高貴出身所要求的責任了。我的九個兄弟每人都該有一個王國，身為長子，我已承諾親自協助他們建立王國。首先，我要幫我的雙胞胎兄弟加迪魯斯建城。我不在的這段時間，委託你在我出生的山丘附近建造一座公正而強大的城市。波賽東親手挖掘了環繞山丘的壕溝，保護它免受敵人侵擾。你建造的城市將成為亞特蘭蒂斯的首都，所以務必讓這座城市配得上它的地位。祝你好運！

original: @PNews of your progress in the city of Atlantis has reached me here in Gades, and I applaud your efforts. Hopefully, your uncle, Gadirus, will prove as successful in Gades as you have been in Atlantis.  As you continue to work, keep in mind your familial obligations.  If Gadirus or any other of your uncles requires your aid, do not hesitate to give it to them.  If you help them, they will most certainly help you in your times of need.
text: @P你在亞特蘭蒂斯城的進展已傳到加迪爾，我為你的努力喝采。希望你的叔叔加迪魯斯在加迪爾也能像你在亞特蘭蒂斯一樣成功。繼續努力時，記住你對家族的責任。如果加迪魯斯或其他叔叔需要你的幫助，不要猶豫。如果你幫了他們，他們在你需要時也一定會幫你。

original: @PGreetings from the city of Euaemos!  Your uncle, Euaemon, has settled into his new city, but some of the things that I have spotted in the Atlantean countryside have given me cause for concern. In my travels, I've noticed monsters and beasts of enormous size and fearsome disposition roaming the countryside.  As we begin to establish ourselves here, we're all bound to have closer encounters with these creatures.  @PIt seems that our activities on Atlantis have caught the eyes of the Olympians.  Some are quite pleased with our activities, but, as usual, Hera is seething with jealousy.  Angrily, she barked, 'Finders-keepers does not apply on Olympus!  All of the gods should have an equal chance of being patron of Atlantis.  When the patronage of Athens was up for grabs, did some god just take it?  No!  There was a competition!  Besides, all I've got are some crummy cities.  Why does Poseidon get a whole continent to call his own?  I want a continent, too!'  With that, she spun on her heel and stormed out of the room, muttering and gesturing all the while.  Watch out for Hera.  When she's upset, she always takes out her frustrations on some unsuspecting innocent.  @PAphrodite, on the other hand, seems thrilled with Atlantis.  She's visited me several times already, always while I was helping one of your uncles build some large building.  As I toiled away under the hot sun, my chest, arms and other regions glistening with sweat, I heard Aphrodite coo, 'How magnificent!  How rugged!'  I'm not sure if she was referring to the beauty of the countryside, the imposing edifice under construction, or me!  Regardless, I think she could be very useful if you build her a Sanctuary to call her own. @PI have forwarded you the plans that our scholars drew up for a magnificent new structure called a Pyramid.  On paper, it looks to be quite impressive.  Why don't you build one and see how it turns out?
text: @P來自厄阿莫斯城的問候！你的叔叔厄阿蒙已在新城市定居，但我在亞特蘭蒂斯鄉間看到的一些東西令我擔憂。旅途中，我注意到巨大而凶猛的怪獸在鄉間出沒。隨著我們開始在此建立家園，遲早會與這些生物近距離接觸。@P看來我們在亞特蘭蒂斯的活動引起了奧林匹斯眾神的注意。有些神很高興，但一如既往，赫拉滿心嫉妒。她怒氣沖沖地說：「在奧林匹斯，先到先得不適用！所有神都應該有同等機會成為亞特蘭蒂斯的守護神。當雅典的守護權開放時，有哪個神直接拿走了嗎？沒有！那是有比賽的！再說，我只有一些破爛城市。為什麼波賽東能擁有一整個大陸？我也要一個大陸！」說完她轉身怒氣沖沖地走了，一邊走一邊嘀嘀咕咕。小心赫拉。她不高興時，總是把氣出在無辜者身上。@P另一方面，愛芙羅黛蒂似乎很喜歡亞特蘭蒂斯。她已經來拜訪我好幾次了，每次都是在我幫你叔叔蓋大建築的時候。當我在烈日下揮汗工作時，聽到愛芙羅黛蒂輕聲說：「多雄偉！多粗獷！」我不確定她是在說鄉間美景、宏偉建築，還是我！不管怎樣，如果你給她建一座聖所，她應該會很有用。@P我已把學者們繪製的宏偉新建築「金字塔」圖紙轉交給你。紙面上看來很壯觀。何不建一座看看效果如何？

original: @PI could not be more proud of you!  You have overcome some impressive challenges!  How did you ever manage to kill that Minotaur?  I heard that Hera paid you a little visit, too. @PFrom the descriptions I've received, the new Pyramid sounds absolutely awe-inspiring.  I bet that you could build them on an even grander scale. @PMeanwhile, our problem with gigantic animals is worsening.  While building the city of Ampher, a ten-foot tall iguana, sent by that runt Hermes, almost ate me for lunch.  If I, one of the strongest men in the world, can almost fall victim to these huge animals, then how will we ever convince ordinary mortals that our continent is a safe place to live?
text: @P我為你感到無比驕傲！你克服了令人矚目的挑戰！你到底是怎麼殺死米諾陶的？我聽說赫拉還來找過你。@P根據描述，新金字塔聽起來極為壯觀。我打賭你可以建得更宏偉。@P同時，我們的巨型動物問題越來越嚴重。在建阿姆費爾城時，一隻十英尺高的蜥蜴——那個小矮子荷米斯派來的——差點把我當午餐吃了。如果連我這世界上最強壯的人之一都差點成為這些巨獸的獵物，我們要怎麼讓普通人相信這片大陸適合居住？

original: @POur problem with oversized creatures has come to a head.  We have found the perfect place to build your uncle Mneuseus' city, but the area is ferociously guarded by a giant, malevolent gopher.  That fool Hermes was spotted in the area, so I suspect he is to blame for our gopher problem.  Luckily, Artemis became very excited when she heard of all the giant creatures here, so maybe she can help us with our trouble. @PUntil we find an effective way of handling our big animal problem, there is nothing for you to do but to continue building up Atlantis into the most glorious city ever.
text: @P我們的巨型生物問題到了緊要關頭。我們找到了為你叔叔姆紐修斯建城的完美地點，但該地區被一隻凶惡的巨型地鼠守衛著。那個傻瓜荷米斯被人看到在附近出沒，所以我懷疑地鼠問題是他搞的鬼。幸好阿緹蜜絲聽說這裡有這麼多巨型生物後很興奮，也許她能幫我們解決問題。@P在找到有效處理巨型動物的方法之前，你除了繼續把亞特蘭蒂斯建成有史以來最輝煌的城市之外別無他事可做。

original: @PThanks to Artemis and Atalanta, our extra-large animal problem is solved!  I am happy to say that we did our part in controlling these creatures, too.  Using orichalc, our scientists devised the most amazing weapon called Atlantean Fire.  There is nothing more majestic than watching blazing red Atlantean Fire fly through the air and hit its target.  When Atlantean Fire strikes its victim, it adheres to the unsuspecting subject, causing quite a lot of pain.  That gopher sure didn't like Atlantean Fire much.  Can you believe that orichalc, which decorates Pyramids so beautifully, can be transformed by our scientists into a deadly weapon?  You should really try it out for yourself!  Just build a Tower or Frigate Wharf.  Once these buildings have received some orichalc, the workers there will make Atlantean Fire.  You'll be thrilled with the result!   @PIt seems that several, smaller beasts have escaped Artemis and Atalanta's nets and snares.  Luckily, our own armies have had little trouble killing these hideous half-man, half-horse creatures.
text: @P多虧阿緹蜜絲和阿塔蘭忒，我們的巨型動物問題解決了！我很高興地說，我們也出了力。科學家用山銅製造了一種叫「亞特蘭蒂斯之火」的驚人武器。看著赤紅的亞特蘭蒂斯之火劃過天際擊中目標，無比壯觀。火焰一旦擊中目標就附著上去，造成巨大痛苦。那隻地鼠果然不喜歡亞特蘭蒂斯之火。你能相信那美麗裝飾金字塔的山銅，竟能被科學家變成致命武器嗎？你真該試試！只要建造一座塔樓或護衛艦碼頭。這些建築收到山銅後，工人就會製造亞特蘭蒂斯之火。你會對結果驚喜的！@P看來一些較小的野獸逃出了阿緹蜜絲和阿塔蘭忒的網。幸好我們自己的軍隊輕鬆殺死了這些半人半馬的怪物。

original: @PThe half-men, half-horse monsters have done the unthinkable.  They have attacked and completely destroyed Euaemos.  I credit the gods with your uncle Euaemon's successful escape, but we must prepare ourselves against further attack.  The gods have already done so much for us; I think that we can handle this particular monster problem ourselves.  Take care to fortify Atlantis lest these murderous brutes set their sights on you.
text: @P那些半人半馬的怪物做了不可原諒的事。它們攻擊並摧毀了厄阿莫斯。我感謝神讓你叔叔厄阿蒙成功逃脫，但我們必須防範進一步攻擊。神已經為我們做了這麼多，我想這個怪獸問題我們自己能處理。加固亞特蘭蒂斯，以免這些殺人魔獸把目標對準你。

original: @PWhat have we done?  How were we to know?  These half-men, half-horse beings that we took for horrible beasts were a race of intelligent beings called Centaurs, and we have utterly destroyed them.  These Centaurs had built a beautiful city at Cennia, with a gorgeous shrine to Dionysus, and even one to my own father, Poseidon!  How were we to know?   @PThe learned scholars say that we should take pains to discover everything we can about other creatures and peoples before we fight them.  They believe that this horrible tragedy could have been averted.  This seems reasonable, but isn't there something else we can do to prevent us from sinking into barbarism again?
text: @P我們做了什麼？我們怎麼會知道？這些我們以為是野獸的半人半馬生物，其實是一個叫肯陶洛斯的智慧種族，而我們已經把它們徹底消滅了。這些肯陶洛斯在森尼亞建了一座美麗的城市，有華麗的狄俄尼索斯神龕，甚至還有一座供奉我父親波賽東的！我們怎麼會知道？@P博學的學者說，在與其他生物作戰前應該盡力了解它們。他們認為這場悲劇本可避免。這話有道理，但難道沒有其他辦法防止我們再次陷入野蠻？

original: @PFor days and days I have been tortured by what we have done to the Centaurs.  I have beseeched my father to provide some solace and have sacrificed bull after bull to persuade him to speak.  Finally, he brought me to Olympus to discuss the matter.  To my surprise, the Olympians were fuming with anger.   They decried our arrogant act and demanded an explanation for our actions.  They said that only the gods could decide which species could live and which could die, that it wasn't the place of some upstart Atlantean.  I assured the gods that the Atlanteans weren't trying to usurp their power, and that we knew that we had made a horrible mistake when we killed the Centaurs, a mistake that we hope never to repeat.  But, we are destined to repeat our error if we continue to be subjected to attacks by vicious monsters and dangerous animals sent by jealous gods.  @PAfter I finished speaking, the gods withdrew to an inner room.  When they emerged, father Poseidon said, 'We gods have carefully considered your words, son, and find that they have merit.  So, we propose a pact.  If you foreswear war and bloodshed except in the defense of your lands, we gods will never launch an attack on the continent of Atlantis, nor will we loose our monsters on it.' I judged the pact to be fair and just, and quickly accepted the terms.  The agreement will certainly prevent us from repeating the mistake we made with the Centaurs.  'One word of warning, son,' Poseidon said.  'If the Atlanteans ever break this pact, I can personally assure you that no good will come of it.'   @PWith the sacred pact in hand, I returned to Atlantis to meet with the scholars.  The scholars proclaimed the agreement well-reasoned, but suggested that we put our own, personal stamp on the pact to truly make it Atlantean.  And so, to the sacred vow to make no more war, we added our own pledge to uphold our values of Science and Knowledge and named the whole the Symphonia Ithikos.  To underscore the permanence of this pact, I want to inscribe it on a magnificent tablet.  Perhaps one of the gods knows of a suitable material on which to carve this holiest of holy text. @PSurely, father Poseidon is largely responsible for this wonderful pact, and building a magnificent Sanctuary to my father in the center of the city of Atlantis would be an ideal way of honoring him.  But before you can build this amazing edifice, you must find a cornerstone.  Not just any stone will do; it must be the finest block of stone ever seen.
text: @P好幾天了，我們對肯陶洛斯的所作所為折磨著我。我懇求父親給我一些慰藉，獻了一頭又一頭牛來打動他。終於，他帶我去奧林匹斯討論此事。令我驚訝的是，奧林匹斯眾神怒氣沖沖。他們譴責我們傲慢的行為，要求解釋。他們說只有神才能決定哪些物種該活、哪些該死，不是某個新興亞特蘭蒂斯人可以決定的。我向神保證亞特蘭蒂斯人無意僭越他們的權力，我們知道殺死肯陶洛斯是個可怕的錯誤，希望永不再犯。但是，如果我們繼續遭受嫉妒之神派來的兇惡怪獸攻擊，我們註定會重蹈覆轍。@P我說完後，神退到內廳討論。出來後父親波賽東說：「孩子，我們仔細考慮了你的話，認為有道理。所以我們提議一個盟約。如果你們放棄戰爭和流血，只在保衛領土時動武，我們神也永不攻擊亞特蘭蒂斯大陸，也不放出怪獸。」我認為這個盟約公正合理，立刻接受了條款。這個協定必能防止我們重犯肯陶洛斯的錯誤。「孩子，警告你一句，」波賽東說，「如果亞特蘭蒂斯人違背這個盟約，我可以親自保證不會有好下場。」@P帶著神聖的盟約，我回到亞特蘭蒂斯會見學者。學者們說協定很有道理，但建議我們加上自己的印記，讓它真正成為亞特蘭蒂斯式的。於是，在不發動戰爭的神聖誓言之外，我們加上了捍衛科學與知識價值的承諾，將整個協定命名為「伊索斯和諧條約」。為了彰顯盟約的永恆性，我想把它刻在一塊宏偉的石碑上。也許某位神知道什麼材料適合刻這最神聖的文字。@P當然，這個美好的盟約主要歸功於父親波賽東，在亞特蘭蒂斯市中心為他建一座宏偉的聖所是致敬他的理想方式。但在你建造這座驚人建築之前，必須找到一塊基石。不是普通石頭就行，必須是有史以來最精美的一塊。

original: @PWhat a wondrous place the Crimson Isle is!  And dangerous, too!  With its constant earthquakes and fierce monsters, it's no surprise that only heroes are brave enough to go there.   The beautiful cornerstone quarried there will be perfect for Poseidon's Sanctuary.  And, the best artisans in our land have already begun to inscribe the Symphonia Ithikos on the gorgeous tablet of orichalc that was found on the Isle.  The orichalc tablet, strong and durable, will last forever, just as all Atlanteans' commitment to the Symphonia Ithikos will last for eternity. @PYour skills are needed in another part of our great continent.  The time has come to establish a colony and, since I am still busy helping your uncles build their kingdoms, I need you to found the city for me. As soon as you get it up and running, you'll be able to return to Atlantis and begin constructing the Sanctuary for Poseidon.
text: @P赤紅島真是個奇妙的地方！也很危險！不斷的地震和凶惡怪獸，難怪只有英雄才敢去那裡。那裡開採的美麗基石將完美用於波賽東聖所。我們最好的工匠已開始在島上找到的華麗山銅石板上刻伊索斯和諧條約。山銅石板堅固耐用，將永遠流傳，正如所有亞特蘭蒂斯人對和諧條約的承諾一樣永垂不朽。@P我們宏大大陸的另一處需要你的技藝。建立殖民地的時候到了，我還在忙於幫你叔叔們建王國，需要你替我建一座城。城市一旦運作，你就能回到亞特蘭蒂斯開始為波賽東建造聖所。

original: @PEveryone on Atlantis has happily embraced the tenets of the Symphonia Ithikos.  Certainly, the path we have chosen, that of peace and knowledge, will lead us all to greater glory. The gods have been upholding their side of the pact, too.  Except for a few rogue monsters, I haven't seen any more outrageously sized animals since we entered into this agreement.   As long as we Atlanteans honor this pact, no harm will come our way.  If we ever fail to live up to our promise - I don't want to imagine the horror that would befall us. @PNow, it is time for you to focus on celebrating the glory of your grandfather, Poseidon.  You have the sacred cornerstone that you need for his Sanctuary; now oversee the construction of what will surely be the most magnificent building any mortal or god has ever laid eyes upon.  Perhaps the central isle of your city would be the ideal location for the Sanctuary.  After all, it was on this isle that your grandfather first saw your grandmother.
text: @P亞特蘭蒂斯上每個人都欣然接受了和諧條約的宗旨。當然，我們選擇的和平與知識之路將帶來更大的榮耀。神也一直遵守盟約。除了幾隻流浪怪獸，自從簽訂協定後我沒再看到過異常巨大的動物。只要我們亞特蘭蒂斯人遵守盟約，就不會有災難。如果我們違背諾言——我不敢想像那會帶來什麼恐怖。@P現在，是時候專注於歌頌你祖父波賽東的榮耀了。你已有聖所需要的神聖基石；現在監督這座必將成為凡人和神所見過最宏偉建築的工程。也許城市中央小島是聖所的理想位置。畢竟，你祖父就是在那個小島上初遇你祖母的。

original: @PPoseidon is very proud of you today, and so am I.  The Citadel of Poseidon is even more beautiful than I had imagined that it could be.  All of your uncles have been patting me on the back and telling me that I've done a remarkable job raising you, and that you will certainly do a fine job when you climb to Atlantis' throne. @PThat time may come sooner than you think.  Don't fret, I am not at death's door.  In fact, it's quite the opposite.  Since I visited Olympus, I have not been able to get the splendid home of the gods out of my mind.  Jokingly, I asked my father what I needed to do to live on Olympus myself.  To my complete shock, my father said that he longed to have me, the most capable and intelligent of all his sons, by his side on Olympus.  He gave me a list of things I need to do to enter the Pantheon, and he promised to begin negotiating with the other gods to allow me into their number.   @PIn the meantime, your skills are again needed in another part of the kingdom.
text: @P波賽東今天為你感到驕傲，我也是。波賽東城堡比我想像的更美。你所有的叔叔都拍著我的背，說我把你教養得很好，你將來登上亞特蘭蒂斯王位一定能做得很好。@P那一天可能比你想像的更早到來。別擔心，我不是要死了。事實上正好相反。自從去過奧林匹斯後，我就忘不了那神的華麗住所。我開玩笑問父親，我要怎麼做才能自己也住在奧林匹斯。令我震驚的是，父親說他渴望讓我——他所有兒子中最能幹最聰明的一個——在奧林匹斯陪伴他。他給了我一份進入神族需要做的事項清單，並承諾開始與其他神談判讓我加入。@P與此同時，王國另一處又需要你的技藝了。

original: @PMy plan to become immortal is almost complete, but I need your help to realize this amazing dream.  To attain immortality, I must eat ambrosia, the food of the gods.  Be on the lookout for an opportunity to find some for me. @PTo cement my place among the gods, I want you to build a Pyramid, more spectacular than any other Pyramid that has ever been built.  Call this Pyramid the Pyramid of the Pantheon, and see to it that it is decorated with sculptures of the gods that have given us everything. @PI am about to cross the threshold into a new kind of life, and you are, too.  When I become immortal, the kingdom of Atlantis will be yours to rule.
text: @P我成神的計劃即將完成，但需要你的幫助來實現這個驚人夢想。要獲得永生，我必須吃下神的食物——仙饌。留意機會為我找一些。@P為了鞏固我在神中的地位，我要你建造一座比以往任何金字塔都壯觀的金字塔。就叫它萬神殿金字塔，務必用賜予我們一切的諸神雕像來裝飾。@P我即將跨入新生命的門檻，你也是。當我成神時，亞特蘭蒂斯王國將由你統治。

original: @PThe moment has arrived.  The delicious ambrosia has made me immortal - though I could have used some nectar to wash it down.  Now, I am to be welcomed as a god by all the Olympians, and you are to be crowned as supreme ruler of the kingdom of Atlantis.  As I leave this world behind, I have no doubt that you will continue to lead Atlantis well, perhaps even surpassing my excellence.  Remember all that I have taught you, and remember to uphold the Symphonia Ithikos.  I will always be watching over you and Atlantis. @PBy the way, I am quite pleased with the Pyramid of the Pantheon.  I especially like the sculpture of me that you commissioned and added to the mighty edifice.  Well done!
text: @P時刻到來了。美味的仙饌讓我獲得了永生——雖然我還想來點瓊漿玉液送送。現在，我將被所有奧林匹斯神接納為神，你將被加冕為亞特蘭蒂斯王國的最高統治者。我離開這個世界時，毫不懷疑你會繼續好好領導亞特蘭蒂斯，也許甚至超越我的成就。記住我教你的一切，記住遵守伊索斯和諧條約。我會永遠看顧你和亞特蘭蒂斯。@P對了，我對萬神殿金字塔很滿意。我特別喜歡你委託製作並加進那座宏偉建築的我的雕像。做得好！

original: This location is the perfect spot for a trade center, but no one knows what lurks just off Atlantis' shores.
text: 這裡是建立貿易中心的理想地點，但沒有人知道亞特蘭蒂斯岸外潛藏著什麼。

original: @PExpect the unexpected in the western wilds of our land.  No Atlantean has ever settled here, yet the location of the new city you will build is ideal.  It has been blessed with many resources, and it is well-suited to become an important trade center.  The only trouble is some mysterious ocean dwellers who have been punishing the coastline with raids.  If these people become a problem for you, please remember the Symphonia Ithikos and react to them with quiet restraint.  You may defend your city in any way you see fit, but remember that attacking these sea folk is taboo.  I have already sent some emissaries to find out more about these ocean dwellers and to try to establish peaceful relations.  Please be patient until our emissaries can do their work. @PI am helping your uncle, Elasippus, start his city not far to the north of where you are, so please honor him by sending any materials that he may request.
text: @P在我們土地西部荒野要預料意料之外的事。從沒有亞特蘭蒂斯人在那裡定居過，但你要建的新城位置理想。它有豐富資源，適合成為重要貿易中心。唯一的麻煩是一些神秘的海洋居民一直在海岸線劫掠。如果這些人成為你的問題，請記住伊索斯和諧條約，以克制態度應對。你可以用任何方式保衛城市，但記住攻擊這些海洋之民是禁忌。我已派使者去了解這些海洋居民，嘗試建立和平關係。在使者完成任務前請保持耐心。@P我正在不遠處幫你叔叔埃拉西波斯建城，所以他要求的物資請盡量供應。

original: @PThe Symphonia Ithikos has worked perfectly!  The Oceanids may never be our best friends, but they have agreed to trade with us, and each side has absolved the other of any past slights.  The Oceanids have generously offered to approach our cities in trade boats, rather then in their usual method, to make our transactions easier.  You have done very well with Evenestus, but it is time to leave Eggudico in charge there and return to Atlantis.
text: @P伊索斯和諧條約完美發揮了作用！俄刻阿尼德仙女們也許永遠不會成為我們最好的朋友，但她們同意與我們貿易，雙方都原諒了過去的過節。俄刻阿尼德慷慨地提出用貿易船靠近我們的城市，而不是她們平常的方式，以方便交易。你在厄文涅斯托斯做得很好，現在是時候讓埃古迪科留守，你回亞特蘭蒂斯了。

original: Blessed with ore and marble, Leucippium is an artisan's fantasy, with one slight twist.
text: 琉基皮翁擁有豐富的礦藏和大理石，是工匠夢寐以求的地方，只是還有一點小麻煩。

original: @POnce you have the city here at Leucippium up and running, Atlantis will never lack a good supply of construction materials.  But, there is a small quandary that we haven't yet solved. Our problem takes the form of a Sphinx who resides in the area.  Following the tenets of the Symphonia Ithikos, I sent scholars to find out more about her.  The Sphinx responded to our scholars' questions with a question of her own.  When our learned men failed to answer her correctly, she leapt upon them and swallowed them whole! Now, she's roaming the countryside, eating everyone and everything that doesn't answer her correctly.  If only someone could figure out the answer to her riddle, maybe she would leave us alone.
text: @P一旦你把勒基庇烏姆城建好運作，亞特蘭蒂斯就不會缺建材了。但是，有個小難題未解決。我們的問題是一隻住在該地區的斯芬克斯。依照伊索斯和諧條約的原則，我派學者去了解她。斯芬克斯用自己的問題回答我們學者的問題。當我們博學的人無法正確回答時，她撲上去把他們整個吞下！現在她在鄉間出沒，吃掉每個回答不出正確答案的人和東西。如果有人能猜出她謎語的答案，也許她就會放過我們。

original: @PIn accordance with the Symphonia Ithikos, we defended our fair city from the horrible Sphinx, who would simply not listen to reason.  We owe the safety of our city to the brave Atalanta, who was clever enough to devise the answer to the Sphinx's riddle.  The Sphinx was so shocked that Atalanta solved the riddle, she did not even see Atalanta's deadly arrows screaming towards her.   @PThe materials that Leucippium produces will supply lots of cities around the continent with the materials they need.  Leave Leucippium in the hands of Nauklarida and return to Atlantis.  You have more work to do.
text: @P依照伊索斯和諧條約，我們保衛了美麗的城市免受不肯講理的恐怖斯芬克斯侵害。城市安全要感謝勇敢的阿塔蘭忒，她聰明地想出了斯芬克斯謎語的答案。斯芬克斯太震驚阿塔蘭忒解出了謎語，甚至沒看到阿塔蘭忒致命的箭射向她。@P勒基庇烏姆生產的物資將供應整個大陸的城市。把勒基庇烏姆留給諾克拉里達管理，回亞特蘭蒂斯。你還有更多工作要做。

original: @PFondest greetings!  I am happy to say that immortality agrees with me, and I am doing quite well conducting godly acts.  I see that the crown of leadership fits you perfectly. You are masterfully leading the kingdom of Atlantis, and all of your uncles, dutifully leading kingdoms of their own, have told me that they are thrilled with your performance. @PBest of all, you are setting a fine example for your people by honoring the Symphonia Ithikos.  All in Atlantis are following suit, and we gods could not be more pleased with the result.  @PWith you at the helm, the future of Atlantis is bright!  I am proud to be your father.
text: @P問候！我很高興地說，永生很適合我，我行神職做得不錯。我看到領導的王冠完美適合你。你出色地領導著亞特蘭蒂斯王國，你所有的叔叔——各自盡責地統治著自己的王國——都告訴我對你的表現很滿意。@P最重要的是，你遵守伊索斯和諧條約，為你的人民樹立了好榜樣。整個亞特蘭蒂斯都在跟隨，我們神對結果非常滿意。@P有你掌舵，亞特蘭蒂斯的未來一片光明！我為你這個兒子驕傲。

original: With Atlantis safely settled, the thirst for knowledge draws the Atlanteans westward.  This adventure is above average in difficulty and consists of four parent city episodes and three colony episodes.
text: 亞特蘭蒂斯已安頓下來，對知識的渴求驅使亞特蘭蒂斯人向西探索。這場冒險難度中等，包含四個主城章節和三個殖民地章節。

original: @P'Order!  Order please!  Will the Council please come to order!  Azaes, Diaprepes, stop fighting over the last piece of steak!  The cooks will bring out more!' With that, Atlon, the High King of Atlantis, called to order the Council of Atlantis, a meeting of the rulers of the ten Kingdoms of Atlantis.  'And now, a report from Stevros, head of the Grand Westward Expedition.'  A burly, well-tanned fellow stood up and spoke: 'Crikey!  The things I saw west of here will amaze you!  I came across a new land, filled with astounding animals like ocelots, otters, manatees and geckos!  And the trees!  Big, leafy green trees like mangroves, beechnuts and mahoganies blanketed the land.  And how did I learn about all these animals and plants?  From the people!  They call themselves Mayans.  Ain't they beauties?' @PThe Council unanimously decided that more exploration of these western lands was needed, and that one of the rulers of Atlantis should personally oversee the voyages.  As the leader of the western-most kingdom, you were chosen to direct the expeditions. Unfortunately, the old capital of your Kingdom is not at all suited to support the far-reaching journeys.  A new city must be built that will facilitate long trips across the ocean. @PAfter all the matters facing the continent of Atlantis were addressed, the Council adjourned with a recitation of the Symphonia Ithikos.   By the sacred pact, forged between Atlanteans and the gods by Atlas himself, all Atlanteans pledge to hold high the values of science and knowledge and renounce warfare and bloodshed except in self-defense.
text: @P「安靜！請安靜！委員會請開會！阿薩斯、狄亞佩雷斯，別搶最後一塊牛排了！廚師會再端出來的！」說著，亞特蘭蒂斯高王阿特隆宣布亞特蘭蒂斯委員會開會，這是亞特蘭蒂斯十個王國統治者的聚會。「現在，聽大西征遠征隊首領斯特夫羅斯的報告。」一個結實、曬得黝黑的大漢站起來說：「乖乖！我在西邊看到的東西會讓你們大吃一驚！我發現了新大陸，滿是令人驚奇的動物，如虎貓、水獺、海牛和壁虎！還有樹！高大茂盛的綠樹，紅樹林、山毛櫸、桃花心木覆蓋大地。我怎麼知道這些動植物的？從人那裡！他們自稱瑪雅人。是不是很美妙？」@P委員會一致決定需要更多探索這些西方土地，並應由亞特蘭蒂斯的一位統治者親自監督航行。作為最西邊王國的領導者，你被選中指揮遠征。不幸的是，你王國的舊首都完全不適合支援遠航。必須建一座新城來方便跨洋長途旅行。@P亞特蘭蒂斯大陸的事務都處理完後，委員會背誦伊索斯和諧條約後散會。根據阿特拉斯親自在亞特蘭蒂斯人和神之間締結的神聖盟約，所有亞特蘭蒂斯人誓言捍衛科學與知識的價值，除自衛外放棄戰爭與流血。

original: @PWith Autoch thriving, it is time to strike out and establish a colony in a new land.  Who knows what amazing things will be discovered?  Plexaure, one of your trusted advisors, has agreed to watch over Autoch while you set off on a new adventure.    @L@PBefore you start your journey, remember that the Symphonia Ithikos only affords you protection from the gods as long as you remain on the continent of Atlantis.  Atlanteans in other parts of the world are not immune to attacks by gods and monsters.
text: @P奧托克蓬勃發展，是時候出發在新土地建立殖民地了。誰知道會發現什麼驚人的事物？你信任的顧問之一普萊克薩烏爾已同意在你出發新的冒險時看守奧托克。@L@P啟程前記住，伊索斯和諧條約只有在你留在亞特蘭蒂斯大陸上時才能保護你免受神的攻擊。亞特蘭蒂斯以外地區的亞特蘭蒂斯人無法免疫神和怪獸的攻擊。

original: @PIf Autoch is to become a center of exploration, it must grow larger and more prosperous.  Unfortunately, the land around the city isn't very fertile, and Autoch will never become a mighty city unless some alternate sources of food and other necessities can be found.  Thankfully, the gods provide for those who cannot provide for themselves.  Athena, Demeter and Dionysus all crave your worship and have promised to enrich the land if you build Sanctuaries for them.  Of course, immortal King Atlas has always enjoyed putting things together, and he will gladly help you build the Sanctuaries for the other gods if you first build one to honor him.
text: @P如果奧托克要成為探索中心，它必須更大更繁榮。不幸的是，城市周圍土地不太肥沃，除非找到食物和其他必需品的替代來源，否則奧托克永遠成不了大城。幸好神供應那些無法自給自足的人。雅典娜、狄蜜特和狄俄尼索斯都渴望你的崇拜，並承諾如果你為他們建聖所，就會讓土地豐饒。當然，不朽的阿特拉斯向來喜歡集東西，如果你先為他建一座，他會很樂意幫你為其他神建聖所。

original: @PWhat beautiful sights there are to see in Autoch.  Massive Sanctuaries grace the city, reminding all of the grandeur of the gods.  Of course, the gods themselves are frequent visitors and a joy to gaze upon.  Who could be sad when Athena, with her brisk, efficient march, blesses Olive Presses and Growers' Lodges?  And Demeter, with her overflowing basket, is truly a vision to behold.  Then there's Dionysus, majestically stumbling as only he can, toasting the health of all the people he passes. Truly, Autoch is a wonderful place.  But, your explorations are not yet done, and you must once again leave Autoch in the hands of Plexaure and build a new city in a far-off land.
text: @P奧托克有多美麗的景色啊！宏偉的聖所妝點著城市，提醒眾人神的威儀。當然，神自己也常光臨，令人賞心悅目。誰能難過呢？雅典娜邁著輕快高效的步伐，祝福榨油坊和葡萄園；狄蜜特拿著滿滿的籃子，真是美不勝收；還有狄俄尼索斯，只有他能搖搖晃晃地威風凜凜，為經過的每個人祝酒。真的，奧托克是個好地方。但你的探索還沒結束，你必須再次把奧托克交給普萊克薩烏爾，在遙遠的土地建新城。

original: @PThe Council of Atlantis is all abuzz over your latest discoveries.  The Mayan artifacts that you brought to Atlantis are wonders to behold, and the Council has decreed that all Atlanteans should see these fantastic pieces for themselves.  Unfortunately, Atlantis does not have a building suitable for displaying the entire collection.  Therefore, a great museum, which will draw people from all over the ten Kingdoms, must be built. @PThe glee over your latest finds was tempered by some slightly disconcerting news.  While you were away founding the colony, Diaprepes and Azaes both began to stockpile massive numbers of weapons in their respective cities.  It seems a little unusual, but these two cousins have always been competitive.  Maybe they are just having a contest to see who could make the most weapons the fastest.  @PMeanwhile, Demeter, in her never-ending quest to find new and interesting crops, has heard of a legendary field, filled with silver-colored stalks of corn called the Argent Maize.  In some ways, the Argent Maize reminds Demeter of her daughter, Persephone.  Silver calls to mind Hades who, through a cruel trick, forces Persephone to spend half the year with him.  The tall, ripe stalks, on the other hand, suggest the summer, when Persephone is once again at her mother's side.  So, with longing in her heart, Demeter yearns to have the Argent Maize to call her own, so that she may be reminded of her daughter during the times of the year when Persephone must live in the underworld.  Expect Demeter to call upon you to harvest the Argent Maize for her.
text: @P亞特蘭蒂斯委員會對你的最新發現興奮不已。你帶回亞特蘭蒂斯的瑪雅文物令人驚嘆，委員會下令所有亞特蘭蒂斯人都該親眼看看這些奇妙的東西。不幸的是，亞特蘭蒂斯沒有適合展示完整收藏的建築。因此必須建一座偉大的博物館，吸引十個王國的人前來。@P你最新發現帶來的喜悅被一些令人不安的消息冲淡了。你外出建立殖民地時，狄亞佩雷斯和阿薩斯都開始在各自城市囤積大量武器。這看起來有點不尋常，但這兩個表兄弟向來愛競爭。也許他們只是在比誰最快造出最多武器。@P同時，狄蜜特在不斷尋找新奇作物時，聽說了一片傳說中的田野，長滿銀色玉米穗，叫「銀色玉米」。在某些方面，銀色玉米讓狄蜜特想起她的女兒珀耳塞福涅。銀色讓人想起黑帝斯，他用殘酷的詭計強迫珀耳塞福涅每年有半年與他同住。而高大成熟的玉米穗則讓人想起夏天，珀耳塞福涅回到母親身邊的季節。所以，狄蜜特心中帶著渴望，希望擁有銀色玉米，這樣在珀耳塞福涅必須住在冥界的季節裡，她就能藉此思念女兒。預料狄蜜特會要求你為她收割銀色玉米。

original: @PThe Museum Atlantika towers above the city, and its splendid architecture is, in itself, worthy for inclusion in a museum.  The new artifacts retrieved from the Mayans are on display, and Atlanteans from all over the continent have flocked to your city to see the fine Mayan metalwork, the intricately patterned fabric and the remarkable yet simple tools used in everyday Mayan life. The latest exhibit in the Museum is an ear of the Argent Maize that Demeter kindly gave to you in thanks. @PWhile everyone in Atlantis is amazed by your latest discoveries, it won't be long until they yearn for more.  The time has come to see what else is in the world.
text: @P亞特蘭蒂斯博物館高聳於城市之上，其華麗建築本身就值得住進博物館。從瑪雅取回的新文物正在展出，整個大陸的亞特蘭蒂斯人湧入你的城市觀賞精美的瑪雅金屬製品、紋織品和簡單卻非凡的日常生活工具。博物館最新展品是狄蜜特好心送給你作為感謝的一穗銀色玉米。@P當亞特蘭蒂斯所有人對你的最新發現驚嘆不已時，他們很快又會渴望更多。是時候看看世界上還有什麼了。

original: @PHow could they?  How could Azaes and Diaprepes be so rash?  Have they forgotten the sacred words of the Symphonia Ithikos, words that they have vowed to uphold to the death?  Following some misguided notion, these cousins of yours have decided to declare war on each other, in direct violation of the commands of Poseidon and of the Symphonia Ithikos.  Neither will listen to reason, and the other rulers of Atlantis are growing nervous, fearing that the war may soon spread to other kingdoms in Atlantis.  So, in defense of the continent, which will surely be devastated if the cousins aren't stopped, an army must be sent to quiet Azaes and Diaprepes.
text: @P他們怎麼敢？阿薩斯和狄亞佩雷斯怎麼這麼魯莽？他們忘了伊索斯和諧條約的神聖字句——那些他們發誓至死捍衛的字句嗎？受了什麼誤導，你的這兩個表兄弟決定向對方宣戰，直接違背波賽東的命令和和諧條約。誰都不聽道理，亞特蘭蒂斯其他統治者越來越緊張，擔心戰爭很快蔓延到其他王國。所以，為了保衛這片一旦表兄弟們不停戰就必定遭殃的大陸，必須派軍隊去平息阿薩斯和狄亞佩雷斯。

original: @PThe war between Azaes and Diaprepes is over, and they have been whisked back to the city of Atlantis, where Atlon will make sure that their differences are resolved before he allows them to resume leading their kingdoms.  The soldiers of Autoch performed quite well in the battles, a remarkable feat considering their lack of experience in the ways of war. Hopefully, no other Atlanteans will ever have to know the cruelties of war.
text: @P阿薩斯和狄亞佩雷斯之間的戰爭結束了，他們被帶回亞特蘭蒂斯城，阿特隆會確保他們解決分歧後才准回去繼續領導王國。奧托克士兵在戰鬥中表現出色，考慮到他們缺乏戰爭經驗，這很了不起。希望其他亞特蘭蒂斯人永遠不必知道戰爭的殘酷。

original: A small archipelago, situated on prime trade routes.
text: 位於重要貿易航線上的小型群島。

original: @P'Well, hello there my cute little urchin,' Aphrodite purred, blowing you a kiss in greeting.  'Don't you think the land around Biminis is beautiful, just like me?  With all the pretty water and... ooh! the urchins!  How I love urchins, with their adorable little spines.  They're so tasty, too!  I simply must have a Sanctuary here, and you are just the one to build it for me!' @PWith that, the goddess disappeared.  No one can refuse Aphrodite, and as your assistants scouted around for a suitable place to build the Sanctuary, they noticed signs that the Oceanids had been here.  The Oceanids produce all manner of goods, so perhaps they can be convinced to trade with Atlantis.
text: @P「哎呀，你好啊，我可愛的小海膽，」愛芙羅黛蒂呢喃著，飛了個吻給你。「你不覺得比米尼附近的土地很美嗎？就像我一樣？有這麼漂亮的水……哦！海膽！我多愛海膽啊，牠們可愛的小刺。還很好吃！我一定要在這裡建一座聖所，你就是那個幫我蓋的人！」@P說完女神消失了。沒人能拒絕愛芙羅黛蒂，當你的助手們在找合適地點建聖所時，他們注意到俄刻阿尼德人來過的痕跡。俄刻阿尼德人生產各種貨物，也許能說服他們與亞特蘭蒂斯貿易。

original: @P'Thank you very much, my sweet mortal, for my fine Sanctuary,' Aphrodite exclaimed while jumping up and down.  'And, I just love visiting the Fountain of Youth!  I think I'm looking younger everyday, and I already looked very young!  Soon, I'll look like a baby!  Tee hee hee!  I'm going to go eat some urchins now.  Ta ta!' @PWhy an immortal goddess needs a fountain that grants immortality is beyond the ken of mortals.  But if Aphrodite is happy, then everybody is happy.  After meal upon meal of urchins, the time has mercifully come to return to Autoch.  New trade relationships with the Mayans have been established, and trade with the Oceanids is going swimmingly.  Autoch can be sure that it will always have a supply of... urchins.  Hooray.
text: @P「非常感謝你，我親愛的凡人，給我這麼漂亮的聖所，」愛芙羅黛蒂邊跳邊說。「而且我超愛青春之泉！我覺得自己一天比一年輕，而我本來就看起來很年輕！很快我看起來會像個嬰兒！嘻嘻嘻！我要去吃海膽了。再見！」@P為什麼不朽的女神需要賦予永生的泉水，凡人無法理解。但愛芙羅黛蒂高興，大家就高興。吃了一頓又一頓海膽後，終於回到奧托克了。與瑪雅人的新貿易關係已建立，與俄刻阿尼德的貿易也進展順利。奧托克可以放心永遠有海膽供應。萬歲。

original: This mysterious red land glistens in the sun.
text: 這片神秘的紅色土地在陽光下閃閃發亮。

original: @PCrimson Isle.  The very name strikes all Atlanteans with feelings of awe.  Back in the early years of Atlantis, only the bravest of heroes ventured onto the island.  These heroes told stories of the dangerous monsters, fearsome beasts, earthshaking disasters and amazing orichalc deposits found there.  It was on the Crimson Isle that the sacred cornerstone for the Citadel of Poseidon was found, and Achilles himself came here to mine the orichalc upon which the Symphonia Ithikos is inscribed. The time has come to bring civilization to the island and to tame all the wild things.
text: @P赤紅島。光是名字就讓所有亞特蘭蒂斯人充滿敬畏。在亞特蘭蒂斯早期，只有最勇敢的英雄才敢去那座島。這些英雄講述那裡的危險怪獸、凶猛野獸、大地震和驚人的山銅礦藏。波賽東城堡的神聖基石就是在赤紅島找到的，阿喀琉斯親自來此開採山銅，伊索斯和諧條約就刻在上面。是時候把文明帶到島上，馴服所有野生生物了。

original: @PThe Crimson Isle certainly lived up to its billing as a dangerous, wild place. Bellerophon was more than equal to the task of handling Echidna, and he is looking forward to taming some of the other wild beasts on the island.  With Bellerophon in residence, the hardy settlers will be able to focus all their time on mining orichalc.  The orichalc supply on the island seems never-ending, and no city in Atlantis will ever have to go without the metal again.
text: @P赤紅島果然名副其實，是個危險狂野的地方。貝勒羅豐對付厄喀德那綽綽有餘，他還期待馴服島上其他野獸。有貝勒羅豐坐鎮，堅強的殖民者可以把所有時間用來開採山銅。島上的山銅似乎取之不盡，亞特蘭蒂斯再也不會有城市缺金屬了。

original: An ideal spot for gorgeous Pyramids.
text: 建造華麗金字塔的理想地點。

original: @PThe Mayan lands are lacking just one thing: big, beautiful pyramids!  Cuello is the perfect place to build a few pyramids, and the Mayans are sure to be astounded by the grandeur of these impressive structures.  They'll probably want to learn how to build pyramids of their own, and maybe they'll even adopt our values of peace and science!  Regardless, when the Mayans see all the wonderful goods that come from Atlantis, they are bound to want some of their own. @PRumor has it that Ares has been spotted in these parts, and that he has been inciting some Mayans to resist us.  Hopefully, Ares and the Mayans won't cause too much trouble.
text: @P瑪雅土地只缺一樣東西：又大又美的金字塔！奎約是建幾座金字塔的完美地點，瑪雅人一定會對這些宏偉建築的雄偉感到驚嘆。他們可能會想學習建造自己的金字塔，甚至也許會接受我們的和平與科學價值觀！不管怎樣，當瑪雅人看到來自亞特蘭蒂斯的奇妙貨物時，他們一定會想要一些。@P傳聞阿瑞斯被人看到在這一帶出沒，他一直在煽動一些瑪雅人反抗我們。但願阿瑞斯和瑪雅人不會製造太多麻煩。

original: @PThe mighty Pyramids are amazing sights to behold, and the Mayans are thrilled with them.  Already, they are adapting the Atlantean design to build Pyramids of their own.  The Mayans are quite pleased with you, and are impressed that you were able to stand up to Ares and his nasty dragon.  Even the Mayans who were resistant at first have warmed to us, and have ceased to cause us any trouble.  Now, it's time to return to Autoch to tell the people of Atlantis all about our success here.
text: @P宏偉的金字塔令人歎為觀止，瑪雅人對它們很滿意。他們已經在改造亞特蘭蒂斯設計來建造自己的金字塔。瑪雅人對你很滿意，對你能對抗阿瑞斯和他那惡毒的龍印象深刻。即使最初抗拒的瑪雅人也對我們友善了，不再找麻煩。現在，是時候回到奧托克告訴亞特蘭蒂斯人民我們在這裡的成功了。

original: The perfect spot to build a research center to foster the free exchange of ideas between the Atlanteans and Mayans.
text: 這裡適合建立研究中心，讓亞特蘭蒂斯人與瑪雅人自由交流知識。

original: @PThe world of the Mayans is unlike any that has been seen before.  The rich jungles are full of the most amazing plants and animals - the monkeys are the best.  The Mayans share our love for astronomy, and Atlanteans have already learned much from their observations. @PThe ways of the Mayans are still shrouded in mystery.  They indulge in ritual human sacrifices that are quite barbaric.  They also become quite excited when a child is born with a limp, saying that it is the sign from the great god.  Their great god's name is Heff or Hanahpu or something, and they say that he is a master builder, and even built a man made completely of bronze.  Their god sounds familiar somehow... @PIf we are to learn all we can about the Mayans, a city must be built here at Copan.  Copan will serve as a research center, where Mayans and Atlanteans can come together and discuss ideas.  We hope to teach the Mayans much, and trust that we will learn from them in return.
text: @P瑪雅人的世界前所未見。茂密叢林充滿驚人的動植物——猴子最棒。瑪雅人和我們一樣熱愛天文學，亞特蘭蒂斯人已從他們的觀測中學到很多。@P瑪雅人的方式仍然神秘莫測。他們舉行相當野蠻的活人祭。他們看到出生時有跛腳的嬰兒也會很興奮，說這是大神的標誌。他們的大神叫赫夫或漢納普之類的，據說是個大建築師，甚至用青銅造了一個完全由青銅構成的人。他們的神聽起來有點耳熟……@P如果我們要盡可能了解瑪雅人，必須在科潘建一座城。科潘將作為研究中心，讓瑪雅人和亞特蘭蒂斯人聚在一起交流想法。我們希望教瑪雅人很多，也相信會從他們那裡學到東西。

original: The perfect spot to build a research center to foster the free exchange of ideas between the Atlanteans and Mayans.
text: 這裡適合建立研究中心，讓亞特蘭蒂斯人與瑪雅人自由交流知識。

original: @PHephaestus was incensed when you uncovered his little lie. Imagine, telling the Mayans that he was the supreme god when he knows darn well that Poseidon, Zeus and a host of other gods are above him.  The Mayans have been set straight, and Hephaestus has hobbled back to his forge. @PThe research center at Copan is thriving, and the Mayans are teaching us new things about their world every day.  In turn, we are sharing Atlantean life with them.  But, there are matters in Autoch that require your attention, so it is time to return.
text: @P你揭穿赫菲斯托斯的小謊言時，他勃然大怒。想想看，他明明知道波賽東、宙斯和一堆神都比他高，卻告訴瑪雅人他是最高神。瑪雅人已被導入正軌，赫菲斯托斯也一瘸一拐地回他的鍛造廠了。@P科潘的研究中心蓬勃發展，瑪雅人每天都在教我們關於他們世界的新事物。相對地，我們也與他們分享亞特蘭蒂斯的生活。但奧托克有事需要你處理，所以是時候回去了。

original: @PAll is well in Atlantis.  New specimens from the Mayan Colonies arrive every day and are prominently displayed in the Museum Atlantika, much to the delight of Atlanteans everywhere. Autoch is a booming center of commerce, and traders from near and far come to the city to ply their wares.  And, after years of being at odds, Azaes and Diaprepes have finally resolved their differences.  The Symphonia Ithikos is upheld, and the world is at peace.
text: @P亞特蘭蒂斯一切安好。來自瑪雅殖民地的新標本每天運到，在亞特蘭蒂斯博物館展出，令各地亞特蘭蒂斯人欣喜。奧托克是繁榮的商業中心，遠近商人都來此經商。歷年不和的阿薩斯和狄亞佩雷斯終於解決了分歧。伊索斯和諧條約得以維護，世界太平。

original: The Mediterranean Sea is the final frontier.  What people live along its shores, and what resources can be found to enrich life on Atlantis?  This adventure is average in difficulty, with 4 parent and 2 colony episodes.
text: 地中海是最後的疆界。沿岸住著什麼樣的人？又能找到什麼資源來豐富亞特蘭蒂斯的生活？這場冒險難度普通，包含四個主城章節和兩個殖民地章節。

original: @P'And so it is resolved,' said Atlon, the High King of Atlantis and head of the Council of Atlantis.  'We must settle the lands to our east to take better advantage of our trade relationship with the Phoenicians.  For the first time in hundreds of years, new Atlantean ground will be broken.'  As the members of the council cloaked themselves and gathered their belongings in preparation for the ritual bull hunt, they uttered the words of the Symphonia Ithikos by rote. @PThe Phoenicians changed everything in Atlantis.  Life here had remained the same since the Mayan colonies were established many, many years ago. No one minds the status quo too much, because everyone's needs are met.  That is, they were met until the Phoenicians somehow navigated their ships through the narrow strait that separates the Atlantic Ocean from the Mediterranean Sea and the lands to the east.  Everyone here loves the Phoenicians' goods, and the demand for more is high.  And so, the Council resolved that a new city be founded at Lixus, on the banks of the narrow strait, to facilitate trade with the Phoenicians.  And, they decided that you should be the one to establish the new city.  @PSo, to Lixus you go.  The strait there is, as advertised, extremely narrow.  It is also guarded by the ferocious Scylla.  Scylla was once a beautiful nymph pursued by our father, Poseidon.  When Amphitrite, Poseidon's wife, got wind of the affair, she turned Scylla into the monster that she is today.  No wonder she's mad at Poseidon's people!  Atlanteans will never be able to navigate the strait until Scylla is gone and some way is devised to widen the passage.
text: @P「就這樣決定了，」亞特蘭蒂斯高王兼委員會首領阿特隆說。「我們必須在東方土地定居，以便更好地利用與腓尼基人的貿易關係。數百年來第一次，新的亞特蘭蒂斯土地將被開墾。」委員們披上長袍，收拾東西準備儀式性的獵牛，一邊機械性地背誦伊索斯和諧條約。@P腓尼基人改變了亞特蘭蒂斯的一切。自從許多年前瑪雅殖民地建立以來，這裡的生活一成不變。沒人太介意現狀，因為大家的需求都被滿足。也就是說，直到腓尼基人設法駛船穿過將大西洋與地中海及東方土地分隔的狹窄海峽。這裡每個人都喜歡腓尼基人的貨物，需求很高。於是委員會決定在狹窄海峽岸邊的利克蘇斯建新城，以方便與腓尼基人貿易。他們決定由你來建立新城。@P所以，你去利克蘇斯。那裡的海峽正如傳聞般極窄。還有凶惡的斯庫拉把守。斯庫拉曾是美麗的寧芙，被我們的父親波賽東追求。當安菲特律特——波賽東的妻子——得知這段情事後，她把斯庫拉變成了今天這個怪物。難怪她恨波賽東的人！在斯庫拉被除掉、找到拓寬航道的方法之前，亞特蘭蒂斯人永遠無法通過海峽。

original: @PHercules isn't called the strongest man alive for nothing!  With his bare hands, he single-handedly widened the channel between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.  The strait, which will forever be known as the Pillars of Hercules in honor of the hero, is still narrow, but it is now navigable.  The crafty Odysseus also solved our Scylla problem, and the strait is safe. @PNow, all manner of ships can sail between Atlantis and the lands of the Mediterranean.  It won't be long now until Phoenician goods flood Atlantean Agoras.
text: @P海格力斯不愧是最強壯的人！他單憑雙手獨自拓寬了地中海與大西洋之間的航道。這道海峽將永遠被稱為海格力斯之柱以紀念這位英雄，它仍然窄，但已可航行。狡猾的奧德修斯也解決了我們的斯庫拉問題，海峽安全了。@P現在，各種船隻都能在亞特蘭蒂斯與地中海土地之間航行。腓尼基貨物湧入亞特蘭蒂斯市場的日子不遠了。

original: @PThe Phoenicians have already made good use of the newly widened Pillars of Hercules.  Now, it's time to follow suit.  The lands around the Mediterranean have been settled for a long time, and while the civilizations living there couldn't possibly be as advanced as Atlantean society, they probably still have plentiful goods to offer.  An eager band of adventurers has consented to explore the area and forge relationships with the peoples that they meet.  In the meantime, Lixus should be built into a bustling city, both to support trade and to impress the foreign cultures that visit the Atlantean city.
text: @P腓尼基人已經充分利用拓寬的海格力斯之柱。現在輪到我們跟進。地中海周圍的土地已定居很久，雖然那裡的文明不可能像亞特蘭蒂斯社會一樣先進，但它們可能仍有豐富貨物可提供。一群熱心的冒險者已同意探索該地區，與遇到的民族建立關係。同時，利克蘇斯應被建成繁華城市，既支援貿易，也給到訪的外國文化留下深刻印象。

original: @PThe Mediterranean explorations were quite fruitful indeed!  Goods flow easily between the Mediterranean nations and Atlantis, and profits in Lixus are way up!  As expected, the cultures encountered couldn't hold a candle to the Atlanteans.  The Egyptians are much like the Mayans were hundreds of years ago: primitive and in desperate need of Atlantean beneficence. The Greeks, on the other hand, are an entirely different ball of wax.  They are, by far, the most haughty civilization, if you can even use that term when referring to them, that we have ever met.  After displaying our superior knowledge and showing them our excellent Atlantean goods, the Greeks ordered us off their land while making threatening motions with their spears.  It's so sad when an entire culture is too insecure to realize that a superior people can only help them. @PMeanwhile, the Phoenicians have taken great advantage of the widening of the Pillars of Hercules.  They have criss-crossed the Atlantic, even trading with our Mayans directly.  We're certainly glad that Atlantis can be of such a great help to those money-centered Phoenicians. @PNow that we know what is out there in the Mediterranean, it is time to establish an Atlantean colony further to the east to increase profits from trade.
text: @P地中海的探索確實豐收！貨物在地中海各國與亞特蘭蒂斯之間輕鬆流動，利克蘇斯的利潤大幅上升！不出所料，遇到的文明與亞特蘭蒂斯人相去甚遠。埃及人像數百年前的瑪雅人：原始且急需亞特蘭蒂斯的幫助。希臘人則完全不同。他們是迄今為止我們遇到的最傲慢的文明。在展示我們優越的知識和出色的亞特蘭蒂斯貨物後，希臘人揮舞長矛威脅我們離開他們的土地。當一個文化過於自卑、無法理解優越民族只能幫助他們時，真是令人遺憾。@P同時，腓尼基人大幅利用海格力斯之柱的拓寬。他們橫跨大西洋，甚至直接與我們的瑪雅人貿易。我們很高興亞特蘭蒂斯能如此幫助那些金錢至上的腓尼基人。@P既然我們知道了地中海有什麼，是時候在更東方建立亞特蘭蒂斯殖民地來增加貿易利潤了。

original: @PEnough is enough!  The Phoenicians have taken complete advantage of us, usurping our trade relationships with the Mayans and even disrupting trade on Atlantis!  They have cut us almost completely out of the trade equation, which is unfathomable, given that we were the ones that opened up the Pillars of Hercules in the first place.  If the Phoenicians refuse to honor our centuries-long relationships with the Mayans, then we must do what we can to defend ourselves from this Phoenician threat to our continued prosperity.  We have already taken the step of charging a toll for passing through the Pillars of Hercules, and some Phoenicians have quite rationally agreed to pay us.  But, the city of Carthage flouts our authority and, in addition to refusing to pay the toll, has taken to piracy!  They have boarded our ships and stolen our goods!  If the pirates of Carthage continue to disrupt trade, it won't be long until Atlanteans everywhere are without the basic goods they need to survive.  We spoke to the more reasonable Phoenicians about their rebellious countrymen, but they have refused to intervene.  Though we Atlanteans are a peaceful people, we will not brook a threat to our homeland.  We will teach Carthaginians that we Atlanteans are to be respected and obeyed.  It is for their own good, and the good of Atlantis. @PAres has heard of our plight.  Knowing that we are not as skilled in the ways of war as some other, more barbaric cultures are, the god has agreed to help us put Carthage in its proper place, provided we show him the respect that he deserves.
text: @P夠了！腓尼基人完全利用了我們，篡奪了我們與瑪雅人的貿易關係，甚至擾亂了亞特蘭蒂斯的貿易！他們幾乎把我們完全擠出貿易圈，這難以置信，畢竟最初是我們打通了海格力斯之柱。如果腓尼基人拒絕遵守我們與瑪雅人數百年的關係，我們必須盡一切努力保衛自己免受腓尼基人對我們持續繁榮的威脅。我們已採取步驟對通過海格力斯之柱的船隻收過路費，一些腓尼基人很理性地同意付費。但迦太基城蔑視我們的權威，不僅拒付過路費，還開始海盜行為！他們登上我們的船搶走貨物！如果迦太基海盜繼續擾亂貿易，不久各地亞特蘭蒂斯人就會缺乏生存所需的基本物資。我們與較理性的腓尼基人談過他們叛亂的同胞，但他們拒絕介入。雖然我們亞特蘭蒂斯人是和平的民族，但我們不會容忍對家園的威脅。我們要讓迦太基人知道我們亞特蘭蒂斯人值得尊重和服從。這是為了他們好，也是為了亞特蘭蒂斯好。@P阿瑞斯聽說了我們的困境。知道我們不像一些野蠻文化那樣精通戰爭之道，這位神同意幫我們讓迦太基安分下來，條件是我們要給他應得的尊重。

original: @PCarthage has now fallen in line, like the rest of the Phoenicians.  Now, all Phoenician traders are respectfully paying the toll, understanding that what is good for Atlantis is good for everyone.  Just in case any Phoenician has any question about the toll, one of our many frigates out on the waters is sure to answer it for him.  The Oceanids, however, are refusing to pay the toll and have ceased trading with us.  The Oceanids have always been a little odd, and we won't miss their goods.   @PA second colony along the Mediterranean will cement our position with these new-found cultures.
text: @P迦太基已像其他腓尼基人一樣就範。現在所有腓尼基商人都恭敬地繳過路費，明白對亞特蘭蒂斯有利的事對大家都有利。為了以防有腓尼基人對過路費有疑問，我們在海上的眾多護衛艦一定會替他解答。然而俄刻阿尼德人拒付過路費，並停止與我們貿易。俄刻阿尼德人向來有點怪，我們不會想念他們的貨物。@P地中海的第二個殖民地將鞏固我們與這些新文明的地位。

original: @PThe Mediterranean is pleasant enough, but it's no Atlantis.  Our efforts to civilize Egypt have gone quite well, and the Egyptians are slowly adopting our ways.  The Phoenicians haven't caused any trouble since Carthage was taught a lesson, and trade is flourishing.  But the Greeks!  They have proven to be even more primitive than we had first thought.  They have continued to rebuff our efforts to introduce them to Atlantean life.  Don't they understand that adopting our ways will only make their lives easier?  It's too bad about the Greeks, really.  Not only are they primitive, they are dim-witted, too.  Then, there are those horrid Centaurs.  Thank Atlas that they have decided to leave us alone.  @PLixus is doing quite well, and goods are flowing freely into and out of Atlantis.  Still, there is a foreboding sense of danger ahead.  Many of the traders that have arrived here lately have looked a little peaked, and some of them report that a plague is spreading around the east.  The sickness has decimated the populations of many cities, and some cities are functioning only on their most basic levels, barely providing food to their residents.  It certainly wouldn't be surprising that illness would break out, especially given the squalid conditions that some of the people around there live in.  Well, that particular bridge will be crossed when we come to it.  In the meantime, the needs of Lixus must be addressed.  We must continue to be prosperous and productive to serve the needs of Atlantis.
text: @P地中海舒適是舒適，但不是亞特蘭蒂斯。我們教化埃及的努力進展順利，埃及人正慢慢接受我們的方式。自從迦太基被教訓後，腓尼基人沒再製造麻煩，貿易蓬勃發展。但那些希臘人！他們比我們想像的還要原始。他們繼續拒絕我們引介亞特蘭蒂斯生活的努力。他們難道不明白接受我們的方式只會讓他們生活更輕鬆嗎？希臘人真是可憐。不僅原始，還笨。還有那些可怕的肯陶洛斯。感謝阿特拉斯，他們決定不來煩我們。@P利克蘇斯發展得不錯，貨物自由進出亞特蘭蒂斯。不過，前方有一種不祥的危機感。最近來的一些商人看起來有點病懨懨，有些人報告說東方正在蔓延瘟疫。疫病已摧毀許多城市的人口，一些城市只能維持最基本的運作，勉強給居民提供食物。考慮到那裡一些人居住的骯髒環境，爆發疫病並不奇怪。到時候再過那座橋吧。與此同時，利克蘇斯的需求必須處理。我們必須保持繁榮和生產力來滿足亞特蘭蒂斯的需求。

original: @PThe plague was much worse than feared, and it decimated many Mediterranean cities.  Thank Poseidon, Lixus escaped any serious harm, as did our homeland on Atlantis.  Trade with the east is slowly being reestablished, but goods from the east are much harder to come by.  Our eastern trade partners claim that the plague wiped out a large portion of their population, and that they just can't produce as much as they used to.  If only these people were more quick to learn, they would be masters of Atlantean efficiency and wouldn't be having these problems. @PSuspiciously, the Greeks seem to have escaped this plague completely unharmed.  They threw themselves upon the mercy of Apollo, and that nursemaid of a god apparently took pity on them.  Or, perhaps the Greeks escaped the plague through pure, dumb luck.  That would be typical of them.  Still, it will only be a matter of time before we Atlanteans, with our superior culture, whip the Greeks into shape.  They cannot resist our beneficial ways forever.
text: @P瘟疫比擔心的更嚴重，摧毀了許多地中海城市。感謝波賽東，利克蘇斯和我們在亞特蘭蒂斯的家園都逃過一劫。與東方的貿易慢慢恢復，但東方貨物更難取得了。我們的東方貿易夥伴說瘟疫消滅了他們大部分人口，他們無法像以前那樣生產。如果這些人能學快一點，他們就會掌握亞特蘭蒂斯效率，不會有這些問題。@P可疑的是，希臘人似乎完全沒受瘟疫影響。他們向阿波羅祈求憐憫，那個奶媽一樣的神顯然憐憫了他們。也許希臘人是靠純粹的狗屎運逃過瘟疫。那才像他們的作風。不過，我們亞特蘭蒂斯人憑著優越文化，很快就會把希臘人教好的。他們永遠抵抗不了我們有益的方式。

original: A land of fertile river banks surrounded by desert, amongst a people that would benefit from our knowledge.
text: 沙漠環繞著肥沃的河岸，當地人民將受益於我們的知識。

original: @PThe Egyptians seem to be a fairly bright people, but they desperately need our help.  On Atlantis, we dedicate ourselves to the surety of science.  In Egypt, the people give themselves up to the vagaries of a river.  Their entire lives depend upon the flooding of the Nile, and if it doesn't flood exactly as anticipated, the Egyptians are lost.  Granted, the Egyptians have not had many problems producing massive amounts of wheat thus far, but it will only be a matter of time before the flood fails and the Egyptian people starve. @PTo lift the Egyptians out of their primitive state, we must show them the glory of Atlantean culture.  A city at Saqqara that showcases the best of Atlantean architecture will greatly impress the simple Egyptians.  Once we capture their attention, we will have no trouble instructing them on the proper way to live.
text: @P埃及人看來是個相當聰明的民族，但他們急需我們的幫助。在亞特蘭蒂斯，我們致力於科學的確定性。在埃及，人們聽命於一條河的變幻莫測。他們的整個生活取決於尼羅河氾濫，如果氾濫不如預期，埃及人就完了。當然，埃及人目前在生產大量小麥方面還沒遇到問題，但氾濫失敗、埃及人挨餓只是時間問題。@P為了把埃及人從原始狀態提升出來，我們必須向他們展示亞特蘭蒂斯文化的榮耀。在薩卡拉建一座展示亞特蘭頂級建築的城市，會給單純的埃及人留下深刻印象。一旦吸引他們注意，我們就能輕鬆教導他們正確的生活方式。

original: @PThe Egyptians have already learned a lot from us.  They are awed by our fantastic pyramids, and we have left a few Atlanteans behind to serve as advisors to them on their construction projects, as well as on other aspects of Atlantean life.  In return for showing them how to build wondrous pyramids, the Egyptians have agreed to supply Atlantis with wheat at a reasonable price.  Egypt is all we could have asked for.
text: @P埃及人已經從我們這裡學到很多。他們對我們奇妙的金字塔感到敬畏，我們留下一些亞特蘭蒂斯人作為顧問，指導他們的建築工程以及亞特蘭蒂斯生活的其他方面。作為我們教他們建造奇妙金字塔的回報，埃及人同意以合理價格供應亞特蘭蒂斯小麥。埃及正是我們所希望的。

original: Located on the borders of Greek territory, this site may give Atlanteans inroads to Greece.
text: 這裡位於希臘領土邊界，可能成為亞特蘭蒂斯人進入希臘的門戶。

original: @PIf a child refuses to take a spoonful of honey, then only the child suffers.  If a man refuses a generous gift of jewels from a loyal friend, then only the man suffers.  The Greeks have refused the sweetness and richness of Atlantean life, and only the Greeks suffer.  There is a limit to Atlantean patience.  We have extended our friendship and our help to the Greeks time and again, and time and again they have refused.  So be it.  It makes no difference to us. @PStill, the Atlantean desire to help is strong.  A city will be built here in Syracuse, on the outskirts of Greek territory.  Perhaps if the Greeks see for themselves the greatness of Atlantean culture, they will mend their ways and join us.  But, judging by what we know of the Greeks so far, that is unlikely.  Alas, it is not in the Atlantean nature to give up easily, so try we must.
text: @P如果孩子拒絕吃蜂蜜，苦的只有孩子。如果人拒絕忠誠朋友慷慨贈送的珠寶，苦的只有那個人。希臘人拒絕了亞特蘭蒂斯生活的甜美與豐富，苦的只有希臘人。亞特蘭蒂斯人的耐心有限。我們一再向希臘人伸出友誼和援手，他們一再拒絕。隨他們吧。對我們來說無所謂。@P不過，亞特蘭蒂斯人幫助的願望很強烈。要在敘拉古這裡、希臘領土邊緣建一座城。也許希臘人親眼看到亞特蘭蒂斯文化的偉大後，會改過自新加入我們。但從我們目前對希臘人的了解來看，這不太可能。唉，亞特蘭蒂斯人的本性不是輕易放棄，所以我們必須試一試。

original: @PHorrors!  Who would have thought that all the old stories about the ancient times in Atlantis were completely true?  We have seen Centaurs, and they are every bit as ugly as legend describes.  The barbarians attacked us, but we dispatched them easily enough.  In fact, at the sight of the Atlantean emblem on our armor, they began cowering in fear.  They didn't bother us too much again. @PSome of the softer Atlanteans among us felt sorry for the Centaurs, and declared that they would right a past wrong.  Envoy after envoy went to Centaur territory to propose peace, but none ever came back.  What else can we do? @PThe Greeks are still resisting us, and are none-too-happy that we are near their land.  As our immortal first king Atlas would have said, 'Like it or lump it.'
