text: @P天哪！誰能想到關於亞特蘭蒂斯遠古時代的古老傳說全是真的？我們見到了肯陶洛斯，牠們和傳說描述的一樣醜陋。野蠻人攻擊我們，但我們輕鬆擊退了。事實上，一看到我們盔甲上的亞特蘭蒂斯徽章，牠們就開始發抖。後來牠們也沒再來煩我們。@P我們中一些較軟弱的亞特蘭蒂斯人為肯陶洛斯感到難過，宣稱要糾正過去的錯誤。使者一批批前往肯陶洛斯領土提議和平，但沒有一個回來。我們還能做什麼？@P希臘人仍在抵抗，對我們靠近他們的土地很不高興。正如我們不朽的第一任國王阿特拉斯所說：「要嘛接受，要嘛忍受。」

original: @PAs we reestablish trade with cities in the Mediterranean, we have taken special care to teach the people better hygiene practice.  It is, after all, the Atlantean thing to do.  They are bound to be extremely grateful and increase the flow of goods as much as is practicable.  It is refreshing to see that so many of the people in the Mediterranean have so quickly adopted the spirit of Atlantean law. @PThen, there are the Greeks.  These stubborn people will just not listen to reason, or perhaps they just don't understand reason.  No one has ever resisted us before, and we are at a loss to understand why the Greeks are resisting us now.  Ah, well. @PThankfully, the Centaurs are leaving us alone.  They are far too unpleasant to gaze upon, and if the Greeks can't understand the Atlantean way, then the half-animal Centaurs will be completely confused by us.  They are not worth our effort. @PRegardless, the Mediterranean project is a smashing success, and the majority of the area is under our influence.  We are masters of the Mediterranean Sea.
text: @P在我們與地中海城市重建貿易時，我們特別注意教導人們更好的衛生習慣。畢竟這是亞特蘭蒂斯人的作風。他們一定會非常感激，並盡可能增加貨物流動。看到地中海這麼多人這麼快就接受了亞特蘭蒂斯法律精神，令人振奮。@P然後是希臘人。這些頑固的人就是不聽道理，或者他們根本不懂道理。從來沒有人抵抗過我們，我們不明白為什麼希臘人現在在抵抗。唉，算了。@P幸好肯陶洛斯不來煩我們了。牠們太難看了，如果希臘人不懂亞特蘭蒂斯方式，那半獸人肯陶洛斯更會完全被我們搞糊塗。牠們不值得我們費心。@P不管怎樣，地中海計劃大獲成功，大部分地區都在我們影響下。我們是地中海的主人。

original: Hard times have fallen on Atlantis.  Food and goods are hard to come by, and its people struggle to survive.  This adventure is difficult and consists of six parent city episodes and two colonies.
text: 嚴苛的時代降臨亞特蘭蒂斯。食物和物資匱乏，人民在生存邊緣掙扎。這場冒險難度困難，包含六個主城章節和兩個殖民地章節。

original: @PDateline - the Mediterranean.  The great plague that has laid waste to many of the lands around the Mediterranean is over, but its crippling effects remain.  The streets of Egypt and Phoenicia are littered with the remains of the unfortunate dead.  The many farms and workshops that were once filled with happy and industrious workers are silent, and very few goods and foods are being produced. @PThe effects of the plague are not limited to the Mediterranean.  In Atlantis, the lack of Egyptian and Phoenician products is taking a toll.  The shelves of Atlantean Agoras are nearly bare, and people from Gades to Autoch are waiting in long lines for the goods that they so desperately need.  Spirits are sinking fast, and many lament that Atlantis will never again see the glory of its golden years. @PTo salve his people's wounded spirits, Atlon, our glorious High King of Atlantis, has sent his eldest child to the eastern-most region of Atlantis. There, a great city will be built, which will embody the best of the Atlantean yesteryear.  The city will be called Cleitos, in honor of the mother of our immortal king Atlas, Cleito.  The people of Atlantis will be able to point to this city with pride and know that Atlantis still reigns supreme.
text: @P地中海消息：席捲地中海沿岸多個地區的大瘟疫已經結束，但它造成的重創依然存在。埃及與腓尼基的街道上，遍布不幸遇難者的遺體。曾經充滿快樂而勤奮工人的農場和工坊，如今一片寂靜，食物與貨物的產量所剩無幾。@P瘟疫的影響不僅限於地中海。埃及與腓尼基的產品短缺，也讓亞特蘭蒂斯深受其害。市場的貨架幾乎空無一物，從加德斯到奧托克，人們都為了急需的物資排起長隊。士氣迅速低落，許多人感嘆，亞特蘭蒂斯再也無法重現黃金年代的榮光。@P為了安慰人民受創的心靈，我們偉大的亞特蘭蒂斯至高王阿特隆，已派遣自己年紀最大的孩子前往亞特蘭蒂斯最東端的地區。在那裡，一座偉大的城市即將建立，重現亞特蘭蒂斯昔日最美好的一切。這座城市將命名為克雷托斯，以紀念永生之王阿特拉斯的母親克雷托。亞特蘭蒂斯人民將能自豪地指著這座城市，明白亞特蘭蒂斯依然至高無上。

original: @PDateline - Cleitos.  Atlanteans everywhere are dancing and singing in the streets, for Cleitos truly is a remarkable city.  It is a bastion of science, and people from all over the ten kingdoms clamor to see the mighty city for themselves. @PBut, what's this?  Trouble with our Egyptian friends?  It seems that the Egyptians, who owe much to the brave explorers who brought Atlantean knowledge to the Nile's shores, are withholding much-needed wheat from Atlantis, and have been raising the prices on goods important to Atlantean survival.  Great King Atlon himself has vowed to pay a visit to our Egyptian friends to remind them of all the wonderful things that Atlanteans have brought them.
text: @P克雷托斯消息：各地的亞特蘭蒂斯人都在街頭載歌載舞，因為克雷托斯確實是一座非凡的城市。這裡是科學的堡壘，十個王國的人民都爭相親眼看看這座偉大的城市。@P可是，這是怎麼回事？我們的埃及朋友出了問題？勇敢的探險家曾將亞特蘭蒂斯的知識帶到尼羅河岸，埃及人受益良多，如今卻扣住我們急需的小麥，還提高了亞特蘭蒂斯賴以生存的貨物價格。偉大的阿特隆王親自立誓，要拜訪埃及朋友，提醒他們亞特蘭蒂斯人帶來過多少美好的事物。

original: @PDateline - Saqqara.  Bushel upon bushel of tender stalks of Egyptian wheat sit on the docks, ready to be sent to Atlantis.  Atlanteans have the all-powerful King Atlon to thank for this bounty.  Escorted by a fleet of mighty frigates, our king journeyed down the Nile to meet with the Egyptians.  Together, they discussed all the benefits that the Egyptians have already reaped from their relationship with Atlantis.  Noting their error in judgement, the Egyptians quickly revised their exportation policies and agreed to turn over their surpluses of wheat at a most reasonable price.  In a gesture of goodwill, King Atlon promised the Egyptians that Atlantis would continue to sell its finest goods to them.   With the influx of Egyptian supplies, life in Atlantis is slowly beginning to return to normal.  Still, some goods are scarce, and the cities of the ten kingdoms are turning to Cleitos to provide for them. @PMeanwhile, in the dangerous waters of the Mediterranean Sea, vile Carthaginians have boarded yet another Atlantean trade ship.  Roughly tossing aside our brave merchants, the Carthaginians have seized cargo, stealing food from the mouths of Atlantean babes.  The plague has been hard on the people of Carthage, and they have reverted to their old, barbaric ways.  The other cities in Phoenicia refuse to call a halt to Carthage's insolent behavior and have mounted an insurrection of their own, increasing the selling prices of their goods to astronomical heights.  The king has asked his capable and daring eldest child, the ruler of Cleitos, to address the Phoenician issue. @PThe treacherous Mediterranean is offering even more trouble.  The peoples around the Aegean who have not seen the wisdom of Atlantean ways are stirring and seem to be contemplating aggression towards Atlantis as well.  Though mighty Atlantis has little to fear from the primitive Greeks, Centaurs and Amazons, King Atlon himself is casting a wary eye towards them and may personally step in to stop this latest threat to Atlantean well-being.
text: @P薩卡拉消息：一批又一批飽滿的埃及小麥堆在碼頭，準備運往亞特蘭蒂斯。亞特蘭蒂斯人應當感謝無所不能的阿特隆王，為我們帶來這些豐厚物資。在強大護衛艦隊的護送下，國王沿尼羅河航行，與埃及人會面。他們共同討論了埃及與亞特蘭蒂斯往來所得的種種好處。埃及人意識到自己判斷失誤，立即修改出口政策，同意以極為合理的價格交出剩餘小麥。為表示善意，阿特隆王也承諾，亞特蘭蒂斯會繼續向埃及出售最優良的貨物。隨著埃及物資湧入，亞特蘭蒂斯的生活正逐漸恢復正常。然而，有些貨物依然短缺，十個王國的城市都盼望克雷托斯供應所需。@P與此同時，在危險的地中海上，卑劣的迦太基人又登上了一艘亞特蘭蒂斯商船。他們粗暴地推開勇敢的商人，搶走貨物，奪去了亞特蘭蒂斯嬰孩口中的食物。瘟疫重創迦太基，使他們恢復舊習，再次採取野蠻行徑。腓尼基其他城市不肯制止迦太基的放肆行為，還自行掀起反抗，把貨物售價抬到天文數字。國王已命令自己最年長、能幹又勇敢的孩子，也就是克雷托斯的統治者，處理腓尼基問題。@P凶險的地中海還帶來更多麻煩。愛琴海周邊那些尚未明白亞特蘭蒂斯智慧的民族蠢蠢欲動，似乎也在考慮向亞特蘭蒂斯發動侵略。強大的亞特蘭蒂斯雖然無須畏懼原始的希臘人、半人馬和亞馬遜人，阿特隆王仍親自密切留意他們，必要時會出面阻止這股危及亞特蘭蒂斯福祉的新威脅。

original: @PDateline - Carthage.  The Carthaginians are again seeing reason, thanks to our astute military men. They have sworn to forego piracy, and all the cities of Phoenicia have been persuaded to sell their goods at more reasonable prices.  Order in the Atlantean world is restored. @PMeanwhile, the people of Atlantis have gathered to wish a bon voyage to King Atlon.  The King, impressively adorned in a peacock-feather raiment, is sailing to Greece. There, he will reason with king Pelops of Argos, to convince him that Greece will reap great rewards if it joins with Atlantis.
text: @P迦太基消息：多虧我們精明的軍人，迦太基人終於又肯講道理了。他們已立誓放棄海盜行徑，腓尼基各城也都被說服，同意以更合理的價格出售貨物。亞特蘭蒂斯世界的秩序恢復了。@P與此同時，亞特蘭蒂斯人民齊聚一堂，祝阿特隆王一路順風。國王身披華麗的孔雀羽衣，正航向希臘。他將與阿戈斯的珀洛普斯王講理，讓對方明白，與亞特蘭蒂斯聯合會為希臘帶來豐厚的回報。

original: @PDateline - Atlantis.  Sorrowful Atlanteans from throughout the ten kingdoms have journeyed to the city of Atlantis for the funeral of our great King Atlon, who died in pursuit of peace.  He once again tried to show the Greeks that uniting with us would make their lives much more fruitful and fulfilling.   The Greeks stubbornly refused to listen and, cursing loudly and taking up their spears, chased King Atlon from their lands.  On his way back from meeting with King Pelops, our most benevolent king was foully struck down by a hideous Centaur.  As he was taken into custody, the Centaur assassin snidely claimed that he thought that our most exalted king was a peacock! @PAlong the funeral procession route, Atlanteans' grief is mitigated only by their outrage over this most heinous crime.  Damophilos, a miner from Mestonia, echoed the thoughts of many Atlanteans, 'The Greeks must be behind the murder of our noble king!  They were the only ones who knew that the peace-loving King Atlon was in the Aegean!  It would be just like the Greeks to conspire with the misshapen Centaurs!' @PSo, as our glorious king is laid to rest, Atlanteans everywhere call for the destruction of Argos.  Only when Argos is gone will Atlantis be safe from the Greek menace.  Some Atlanteans are turning to our immortal king Atlas for guidance, and others are turning to the king's eldest child, the magnificent ruler of Cleitos, to thwart Greek aggression.  Our soldiers at the outpost of Knossos are preparing themselves, in case they are called upon to address the Greek problem.
text: @P亞特蘭蒂斯消息：悲傷的人民從十個王國趕往亞特蘭蒂斯城，參加偉大的阿特隆王的葬禮。他為追求和平而死。他曾再次向希臘人說明，與我們聯合能使他們的生活更加富足充實。然而，希臘人頑固地拒絕聽取，還大聲咒罵、拿起長矛，將阿特隆王趕出國土。在會見珀洛普斯王後的返程中，我們最仁慈的國王遭一名可怕的半人馬卑鄙地殺害。凶手被捕時，竟嘲弄地聲稱，他以為我們尊貴的國王是一隻孔雀！@P送葬隊伍沿途，唯有對這起滔天罪行的憤怒，稍稍沖淡了人民的悲痛。來自梅斯托尼亞的礦工達莫菲洛斯說出了許多人的心聲：「一定是希臘人在幕後策劃，謀殺了我們高貴的國王！只有他們知道熱愛和平的阿特隆王來到了愛琴海！與形體扭曲的半人馬勾結，正是希臘人會做的事！」@P因此，當光榮的國王入土為安時，各地人民都呼籲摧毀阿戈斯。唯有阿戈斯消失，亞特蘭蒂斯才能免於希臘的威脅。有些人向永生之王阿特拉斯尋求指引，也有人盼望國王最年長的孩子、克雷托斯的傑出統治者，能挫敗希臘的侵略。駐守科諾索前哨基地的士兵正整裝待命，隨時準備奉命處理希臘問題。

original: @PDateline - Hyperborea.  Grunting and grimacing under the weight, the hero Hercules holds up the world, freeing our immortal king Atlas.  Having been tricked by Atlas into taking up the burden, the hero could be heard saying, 'Why couldn't I have a little less brawn and a little more brain?' @PWith the weight of the world off his shoulders, Atlas marched to Greece to help the Atlantean cause.  After Argos was defeated by the Atlantean army, Atlas destroyed the city completely.  The Greeks are running scared and have scattered to the more mountainous regions of their land.  Even our ancient enemies, the Centaurs, are in hiding.   @PNews of our smashing victory in Greece quickly spread throughout Atlantis, and people are again in the streets, celebrating the glory of our well-trained army and of our immortal king.  All say that this momentous victory marks the rebirth of the Atlantean golden age! @PAnd so, on the piers of Cleitos, ships are being prepared to sail forth into the Mediterranean.  A colony will be established to help ensure Atlantis' continued peace and prosperity.
text: @P極北之地消息：英雄赫爾克利斯在重壓下苦苦支撐，扛起了整個世界，讓永生之王阿特拉斯得以脫身。這位受騙接下重擔的英雄嘆道：「為什麼我不能少一點蠻力，多一點腦筋？」@P卸下世界的重量後，阿特拉斯便進軍希臘，協助亞特蘭蒂斯的事業。亞特蘭蒂斯軍隊擊敗阿戈斯後，阿特拉斯將整座城市徹底摧毀。希臘人驚恐逃跑，散入更加險惡的山區。就連我們的宿敵半人馬也躲了起來。@P我們在希臘大獲全勝的消息迅速傳遍亞特蘭蒂斯。人民再次湧上街頭，歌頌訓練有素的軍隊與永生之王的榮光！大家都說，這場重大勝利標誌著亞特蘭蒂斯黃金年代的重生！@P於是，克雷托斯的碼頭正準備船隻，將要航向地中海。我們將建立一座殖民地，確保亞特蘭蒂斯持續和平繁榮。

original: @PDateline - Cleitos.  Storm clouds once again threaten the fine people of Atlantis.  Goods are again scarce, and people are beginning to go hungry.  People fear that our weakened state will prove irresistible to our foes, and they will once again threaten Atlantean peace.   @PIn Atlantis' darkest hour, the god Ares, like a beam of radiant sunshine, has come to our rescue.  In a secret location near Cleitos, he is working with our scientists, developing a super weapon that will defend Atlantis' shores from all comers.  All Ares asks in return is that a Sanctuary be built in his honor.   @PThe weapon is already almost complete, but it is missing one key component.  Ares says that only a brave and agile hero will be able to retrieve the final piece of the weapon from deep in the heart of Africa.
text: @P克雷托斯消息：陰雲再次覆蓋亞特蘭蒂斯善良的人民。貨物又開始短缺，人們逐漸挨餓。大家擔心，我們的衰弱會讓敵人忍不住趁虛而入，再次威脅亞特蘭蒂斯的和平。@P在亞特蘭蒂斯最黑暗的時刻，阿瑞斯如同一道耀眼的陽光，前來拯救我們。他正在克雷托斯附近的一處秘密地點，與科學家共同研製超級武器，保衛亞特蘭蒂斯海岸，抵抗一切來犯之敵。阿瑞斯要求的回報，只是一座獻給他的聖所。@P武器已接近完成，但仍缺少一個關鍵部件。阿瑞斯說，唯有勇敢而敏捷的英雄，才能從非洲腹地取回最後這塊部件。

original: @PDateline - Cleitos.  Oh, the humanity!  Chaos!  Chaos in the streets of Cleitos, and in the city of Atlantis. @PSomehow, a single, rogue Greek infiltrated Cleitos defenses and - oh, unspeakable horror - happened upon our best scientists, who were just about to complete Ares' secret weapon.  Cruelly, this Greek infidel slaughtered our scientists, all of whom died heroes' deaths in defense of Atlantis.  Then - gods help us - the brigand aimed the weapon at our heart, the city of Atlantis, and fired!  In the aftermath, the Greek scoundrel managed to escape.  @PIn Cleitos, clean-up of the carnage is just beginning.  The bodies of the dead, which are scattered about on the floor like a child's rag dolls, are being prepared for proper burial.  And, in the center of the room where the secret weapon stands, workers are dismayed to discover that the Greek dog has damaged the weapon!  Some mysterious, sticky substance has clogged the gears!  As the science world prepares to mourn its dead, scientists are already hard at work trying to decipher their fallen comrades' notes.  @PIn the city of Atlantis, the unhappy target of the secret weapon, people are shell-shocked and outraged.  The Citadel of Poseidon, the magnificent Sanctuary honoring the father of all Atlanteans, is no more.  What was once a beautiful building is now a heap of rubble, and the sacred tablet inscribed with the Symphonia Ithikos has cracked down the middle.  Atlanteans everywhere shudder to think of the damage that would have resulted had the weapon been finished.    @PAmidst this great tragedy, Atlanteans are once again rising up to move forward.  The docks of Cleitos are busy, preparing ships to set sail to a new colony site.
text: @P克雷托斯消息：天啊，太慘了！混亂！克雷托斯與亞特蘭蒂斯城的街頭一片混亂！@P不知怎麼，一名希臘惡徒竟突破了克雷托斯的防線，撞見正要完成阿瑞斯秘密武器的頂尖科學家。接下來的恐怖簡直難以言喻：這名希臘異教徒殘忍地殺害了科學家。他們都為保衛亞特蘭蒂斯英勇戰死。然後，願諸神救救我們，那個強盜將武器瞄準我們的中心亞特蘭蒂斯城，開火了！事後，這名希臘惡棍居然成功逃走。@P克雷托斯才剛開始清理屠殺現場。死者像孩子丟棄的布偶般散落一地，人們正準備好好安葬他們。在放置秘密武器的房間中央，工人震驚地發現，那個希臘混蛋還破壞了武器！某種神秘而黏著的物質堵住了齒輪！科學界準備追念死者之際，其他科學家已努力研究亡故同伴的筆記。@P不幸成為目標的亞特蘭蒂斯城中，人民既震驚又憤怒。紀念所有亞特蘭蒂斯人之父的宏偉波賽東堡壘，已經不復存在。昔日美麗的建築化為碎石，刻有神聖道德協約的石碑也從中間裂開。想到如果武器已經完工，破壞會有多麼嚴重，各地人民都深感恐懼。@P儘管遭遇如此巨大的悲劇，亞特蘭蒂斯人仍再次站起來，繼續前進。克雷托斯的碼頭忙著準備船隻，將航向新的殖民地。

original: @PDateline - Cleitos.  Atlanteans prepare for war.  Soldiers are sharpening their spears and polishing their armor as they pack their belongings for their journey into the Mediterranean.  On the home front, men, women and children are doing their parts to ensure Atlantis' success against the Greek horde.  Families are doing their best to make their supplies stretch, but food and goods will only stretch so far.  Demand for more remains high. @PAlong our coasts, the waters of the Mediterranean are surging through the Pillars of Hercules, lapping at our shores.  There are gods at work here.  The Greeks are Zeus' people, and he is pushing the waters back towards Atlantis, in what is sure to be a futile attempt to prevent our ships from sailing to Greece.  Certainly, our father Poseidon will not stand for Zeus' usurpation of his watery realm.  Poseidon will be avenged.  @PYet, our mission remains clear.  Shoulder to shoulder, Atlanteans march in defense of Atlantis.  They march to free our brethren in Carthage and Memphis who are cruelly subjugated by the Greek menace.  They march to safeguard our people from the hated Centaurs who, throughout our history, have always sought to oppress us.  They march knowing that one day soon, the people of Greece will no longer stand in Atlantis' way.  When their march is complete, future Atlanteans will never know hardship and will be able to live in freedom and peace.
text: @P克雷托斯消息：亞特蘭蒂斯正準備開戰。士兵一邊磨利長矛、擦亮盔甲，一邊收拾行裝，準備遠征地中海。在後方，男女老少也各盡其力，確保我們戰勝希臘大軍。每個家庭都盡量節省物資，但食物與貨物終究有限，對更多供應的需求依然迫切。@P沿著海岸，地中海的海水正湧過赫爾克利斯之柱，拍打我們的海岸。這是神明在作怪。希臘人是宙斯的子民，他正將海水推向亞特蘭蒂斯，企圖阻止我們的船隻航向希臘，但這必將徒勞無功。我們的父神波賽東絕不會容忍宙斯侵占他的海域。波賽東必將報復。@P然而，我們的使命仍然明確。亞特蘭蒂斯人並肩前進，保衛家園。他們要解放迦太基與孟菲斯的同胞，讓他們擺脫希臘威脅的殘酷壓迫。他們要保護人民，抵抗那些自古以來便想壓迫我們的可恨半人馬。他們深信，不久之後，希臘人便無法再阻擋亞特蘭蒂斯。當這場遠征結束，後代將不再知道苦難，得以自由而和平地生活。

original: @PDateline - the Mediterranean Sea.  After long and hard-fought battles around the Mediterranean, weary Atlantean soldiers are making their way home.  Their noble efforts have not gone unrewarded.  Thanks to their bravery, Greece's grip on our friends in Egypt and Phoenicia is loosened, and the Greeks have retreated all the way back to their homeland.  Even the ill-formed Centaurs have been forced from their city in Mount Aulip and are hiding deep within the mountains.   @PScientists on the home front have nearly finished repairs on the secret weapon.  Soon, it will be time to fire it at Mycenae and thwart the Greek threat forever.
text: @P地中海消息：在地中海周邊經歷漫長艱苦的戰鬥後，疲憊的亞特蘭蒂斯士兵正踏上歸途。他們高尚的努力沒有白費。多虧他們的勇氣，希臘對埃及與腓尼基朋友的控制已被削弱，希臘人一路退回本土。就連形體扭曲的半人馬也被逐出奧利普山的城市，躲進深山。@P後方的科學家即將修復秘密武器。很快，我們就能朝密刻奈開火，永遠粉碎希臘的威脅。

original: @PDateline - an orange grove on Olympus.  'People of Atlantis, hear my voice.  I have watched as my husband has left my side for Greece, to cavort with the maidens there.  Day after day, year after year, he has forgotten his duty to me, his wife.  I will stand for this no longer.  To rid myself of the pesky and attractive Greeks, I will help you in your war.  I will divert Zeus' attention so that you can use your secret weapon against the hated Greeks.  But, to keep Zeus completely distracted, I will need the services of the hero Jason.  When I am ready to set my plan in motion, I will visit you.' @PWith Hera's words in their hearts, Atlantean soldiers are again ready to strike out into the Mediterranean to remove the Greek threat once and for all.  Sailing the seas, their chests puffed out with Atlantean pride, they know that the end is near and that they will soon be able to return to their homes for good.  The secret weapon is aimed and at the ready.  The scientists are only waiting for the command to fire it upon Mycenae.  After the weapon is fired, brave Atlantean soldiers will march into Greece to extinguish the Greek threat once and for all.
text: @P奧林匹斯的橘子林消息：「亞特蘭蒂斯的人民，聽我說。我親眼看著丈夫離開我，前往希臘，與那裡的少女玩樂。日復一日，年復一年，他忘記了自己對妻子的責任。我再也不能容忍。為了除掉那些惱人又迷人的希臘人，我會協助你們作戰。我將分散宙斯的注意力，讓你們用秘密武器對付可恨的希臘人。不過，要讓宙斯完全無暇他顧，我需要英雄伊阿宋幫忙。等我準備展開計畫時，就會來拜訪你們。」@P帶著赫拉的話，亞特蘭蒂斯士兵再次準備出征地中海，徹底消除希臘的威脅。他們在海上航行，心中充滿亞特蘭蒂斯的驕傲，知道終局將近，很快便能永遠回到家園。秘密武器已瞄準並準備就緒，科學家只等命令，便會向密刻奈開火。武器發射後，勇敢的亞特蘭蒂斯士兵將進軍希臘，一勞永逸地消滅希臘的威脅。

original: @PDateline - Cleitos.  'Huzzah!  Huzzah!  All hail the mighty Atlantean army!  All hail the brilliant Atlantean scientists!  All hail the powerful gods!'  Happy shouting fills the streets of all Atlantean cities today!  The Greeks are defeated once and for all, and Atlantis is again safe!   @PAlready, plentiful supplies have been distributed through Atlantis, and Atlantean homemakers no longer need to make goods stretch.  Andromache, the wife of an Atlantean charioteer, had this to say: 'Thank the gods that there is finally enough meat to go around. I was running out of things to do with oranges.  Orange a la king, orange casserole, orange surprise, orange tetrazzini... if I never have another orange, it'll be too soon.' @POur men returning from the front report that the weapon caused significant destruction throughout Greece.  Said one soldier: 'The weapon did an astounding amount of damage.  On our way to Mycenae, we passed streams of bedraggled men and women whose homes had been destroyed.  The cities that we passed through were in ruins, obliterated by the chain of earthquakes and tidal waves that the weapon set off.  Mycenae itself was in shambles.  The city was ablaze, and there were gaping holes in its Walls.  Thanks to the weapon - and to science - defeating the Greeks was much easier than it could have been, sir!'   @PAnd so, the world begins to clean up the mess that the war made and start anew.  Atlantis is on the verge of a new golden age!
text: @P克雷托斯消息：「萬歲！萬歲！強大的亞特蘭蒂斯軍隊萬歲！傑出的亞特蘭蒂斯科學家萬歲！威力無窮的諸神萬歲！」今天，各城街頭充滿歡呼！希臘人終於徹底敗北，亞特蘭蒂斯再次安全了！@P豐富的物資已分送各地，家庭主事者再也不用精打細算地節省每樣東西。一位戰車兵的妻子安德洛瑪刻說：「感謝諸神，終於有足夠的肉了。我實在想不出橘子還能怎麼料理。奶油橘子、烤橘子、驚喜橘子、橘子義大利料理……我這輩子再也不想吃橘子了。」@P前線歸來的士兵報告，武器在希臘各地造成了巨大破壞。一名士兵說：「武器的破壞力驚人。我們前往密刻奈時，沿途遇到成群衣服破爛、失去家園的男女。武器引起連串地震與海嘯，所經城市全成了廢墟。密刻奈也一片狼藉，城內大火四起，城牆上破了幾個大洞。長官，多虧這件武器，多虧科學，擊敗希臘人比原本容易多了！」@P於是，世界開始清理戰爭留下的殘局，重新出發。亞特蘭蒂斯即將迎來新的黃金年代！

original: Just When You Thought It Was Safe...
Located near Greece, this site is the perfect spot for a fortified city.
text: 這裡靠近希臘，是建立要塞城市的理想地點。

original: @PDateline - Thera.  The news from the Mediterranean is bleak, but Atlanteans are doing their best to keep their spirits up.  The pestilent Greeks have regrouped and, with the help of the ignoble Centaurs and Amazons, have swarmed through the Mediterranean, conquering city after city.  Those dastardly Greeks completely destroyed the beautiful Atlantean city of Knossos.  Refugees from the city tell of the harrowing experience: 'There I was, asleep in my bed, when some brute knocked down the door to my house.  He said his name was Achilles, and that he was here to send the Atlantean cur home.  I assured him that I was home, but he didn't listen.  I just barely escaped with my life!' @PHere on Thera, preparations are underway to build a fortified city. Our fine Atlantean soldiers will be able to sail from Thera to the Greek mainland when the time comes to end the Greek threat and free our Phoenician and Egyptian friends from Greek tyranny.   @PThe journey to Thera was difficult, and it was only due to the superior firepower of Atlantean frigates that we arrived on the island safely.  Ordinary merchant ships are not as successful sailing through the treacherous Mediterranean, so goods from home may be hard to come by.  Thera will need to fend for itself.
text: @P特拉消息：地中海傳來的消息十分黯淡，但亞特蘭蒂斯人正努力振作。討厭的希臘人重新集結，在卑鄙的半人馬與亞馬遜人協助下，席捲地中海，接連征服城市。那些可惡的希臘人徹底摧毀了美麗的亞特蘭蒂斯城市科諾索。難民講述可怕的經歷：「我當時正在床上睡覺，一個野蠻人撞開家門。他說自己叫阿基裡斯，要把亞特蘭蒂斯走狗趕回家。我再三告訴他，這裡就是我的家，可他根本不聽。我差點沒命！」@P特拉正在準備興建要塞城市。當終結希臘威脅、解放腓尼基與埃及朋友的時機來臨，我們優秀的士兵便能從特拉航向希臘本土，讓朋友擺脫希臘暴政。@P前往特拉的旅程十分艱難，幸虧亞特蘭蒂斯護衛艦火力強大，我們才安全抵達。普通商船在凶險的地中海上可沒這麼順利，因此家鄉物資恐怕難以送達。特拉必須自力更生。

original: @PDateline - Thera.  The intimidating fortress here is a testament to Atlantean military might.  Not even the most foolhardy Greek would dare attack it.  @PBack on the home front, things have taken a turn for the worse.  Even the richest Atlantean, forced to wear old and tattered clothes due to a fleece shortage, is beginning to look like a beggar.  Hungry children roam the streets, looking for the smallest crumb of food.  As long as Greece has Phoenicia and Egypt under its boot, Atlanteans will continue to suffer.
text: @P特拉消息：這座令人生畏的要塞，證明了亞特蘭蒂斯的軍事力量。即使最魯莽的希臘人，也不敢攻擊它。@P然而，後方的情況更加惡化。由於羊毛短缺，就連最富有的人也被迫穿著破舊衣服，看起來像乞討者。飢餓的孩子在街頭遊走，尋找最微小的食物碎片。只要腓尼基與埃及仍被希臘踩在腳下，亞特蘭蒂斯人的苦難就不會結束。

original: A rich and fertile land that can serve as Atlantis' bread basket.
text: 這片富饒肥沃的土地，可以成為亞特蘭蒂斯的糧倉。

original: @PDateline - on the waters that were once Autoch.  There is nothing left.  The entire kingdom of Autoch and all the Atlanteans living there have sunk beneath the sea, never to be seen again.  Atlantis is again in mourning, grieving over the loss of the fine people of Autoch. @PWho's to blame for this tragedy?  Hephaestus, the lackey of the Greeks.  The bandy-legged god of volcanoes caused a massive eruption at the center of Crimson Isle, an eruption more furious than any recorded by Atlantean scholars. A flood of molten lava swept over Crimson Isle, and nothing but charred ashes remains.  After the eruption, tidal wave after tidal wave pounded the coast of Autoch until the whole region finally succumbed to the sea.  @PNow, Atlantis is completely cut off from our Mayan friends to the west, and Atlantis is deprived of the Mayan goods that we have come to rely on over the years.  Without these valuable goods, Atlantean cities are suffering.  Workshops have shut down due to the loss of raw materials, and hunger has become a constant companion in some cities.   @PYet, take solace, Atlanteans!  The new city at Malaca will provide!  Certainly, it won't be long until the wise ruler of Cleitos has the city up and running, and the overflow of goods will be quickly sent back to Atlantis!  Hold on a little longer, Atlanteans!
text: @P昔日奧托克所在海域消息：什麼都沒有了。整個奧托克王國與所有居民都沉入海底，再也看不到了。亞特蘭蒂斯再次陷入哀傷，痛惜奧托克善良人民的離去。@P誰該為這場悲劇負責？是希臘人的走狗赫菲斯托斯。這位雙腿彎曲的火山之神，讓赤紅島中央爆發大規模火山噴發，比亞特蘭蒂斯學者記錄過的任何一次都更猛烈。熔岩洪流席捲全島，只留下焦黑灰燼。噴發過後，一波接一波的海嘯撞擊奧托克海岸，直到整個地區最終被大海吞沒。@P現在，亞特蘭蒂斯與西方的瑪雅朋友完全斷絕聯繫，失去了多年來賴以生活的瑪雅貨物。缺少這些珍貴物資，各城苦不堪言。工坊因原料耗盡而停工，有些城市更長期覆蓋在飢餓之中。@P但請安心，亞特蘭蒂斯人！馬拉卡的新城市會提供物資！相信克雷托斯英明的統治者很快就能讓城市運轉起來，把多餘的貨物迅速運回亞特蘭蒂斯！再堅持一下，亞特蘭蒂斯人！

original: @PDateline - Cleitos.  The city of Cleitos has always been a welcome sight to poor Atlantean eyes.  And now, with the bounty of goods sent from Malaca, Cleitos is truly a vision of hope. @PAtlanteans across the continent are praying to the gods that Atlantis has seen its darkest hours.  The kingdom of Mestonia was shaken to its very core by an intense earthquake, and the people living there have evacuated the kingdom, flooding into other Atlantean cities.  The leaders of the Atlanteans cities are keeping the immigrants fed, clothed and employed, but everyone will breathe easier when some other sources of much-needed food and goods are found.
text: @P克雷托斯消息：對受苦的亞特蘭蒂斯人而言，克雷托斯一直是令人欣慰的景象。如今，馬拉卡運來豐富物資，讓克雷托斯真正成為希望的象徵。@P大陸各地的人民正向諸神祈禱，希望最黑暗的時刻已經過去。一場猛烈地震震動梅斯托尼亞王國，居民撤離故土，湧入其他亞特蘭蒂斯城市。各城領袖正努力讓移民有食物吃、有衣穿、有工作，但唯有找到更多急需的食物與貨物來源，大家才能真正鬆一口氣。

original: @PDateline - Atlantis.  A new day has dawned, and the ten kingdoms of Atlantis are in full bloom.  Well-fed children play in the city's streets, and Atlantean men and women are able to devote their lives to scientific pursuits.  In the city of Atlantis, the great Citadel of Poseidon is being rebuilt and is more glorious than it had been before.  Throughout the Mediterranean, happy Egyptians and Phoenicians work hard for the greater glory of Atlantis, providing Atlantean industries with the raw materials that they need to produce exquisite goods.  With the Greeks and Centaurs gone, there is nothing left to fear.  Atlantis is at peace, and the new Golden Age has begun!
text: @P亞特蘭蒂斯消息：全新的一天已經到來，十個王國繁榮興盛。吃飽的孩子在街頭玩樂，男女都能投身科學研究。亞特蘭蒂斯城正在重建偉大的波賽東堡壘，它將比以往更加輝煌。地中海各地，快樂的埃及人與腓尼基人辛勤工作，為亞特蘭蒂斯帶來更大的榮耀，提供產業所需的原料，製造精美貨物。希臘人與半人馬已經消失，再也沒有什麼值得恐懼。亞特蘭蒂斯迎來和平，新的黃金年代開始了！

original: A good leader keeps promises made to allies and old friends.  Unfortunately, keeping promises can have some unpleasant consequences.  This adventure is easy and consists of six parent city episodes and one colony episode.
text: 一位好領導者會信守對盟友和老朋友的承諾。不幸的是，信守承諾可能帶來一些不愉快的後果。這場冒險難度簡單，包含六個主城章節和一個殖民地章節。

original: @P'Proetus always gets the bigger piece.  It's not fair,' Acrisius whined when he heard his father's news.  After dozens of years of skilled leadership, King Abas, was stepping aside and dividing his kingdom between his twin sons.  Proetus indeed received the bigger piece, having been given the lands of Tiryns, Heraeum and Midea. Acrisius received the kingship of Argos, the prestigious capital city of the kingdom.  'Now listen, sons,' Abas said.  'In addition to ruling over the lands, you must also honor all the pacts that I have made with fellow leaders during my kingship.  This includes honoring the promise to protect Glaucus, king of Corinth.' @PYou, too, have a pact with King Abas.  Long ago, when both you and Abas were in your youths, you promised to always look after each other's lands and progeny.  Hopefully, Abas' sons will be as faithful to the vow as Abas was himself.  Acrisius and Proetus' help could be invaluable as you prepare to establish a new city at Lycia.  Lycia would be an ideal place to found a city, if it weren't for some undesirable neighbors.  Hostile tribes of Amazons live nearby, and the people of Solymi resent all foreign intrusions.  Then, there's the small matter of the fierce Chimera, who has been spotted in the area.  Having the King's sons on your side would make facing these challenges much easier.  Perhaps one of your daughters would be willing to enter into marriage with one of Abas' sons and solidify the union between the two families.  Certainly, it's a matter to be considered as you begin to construct Lycia.
text: @P「普羅托斯總是分到比較大的那份，太不公平了！」阿克里西奧斯聽到父親的決定後抱怨道。阿巴斯王英明統治數十年，如今決定退位，將王國分給雙胞胎兒子。普羅托斯的確得到較大一份，分得塔尼斯、赫拉聖地與米德亞。阿克里西奧斯則成為王國著名首都阿戈斯的國王。「孩子們，聽好，」阿巴斯說，「除了治理土地，你們還必須遵守我在位時與其他領袖訂立的一切盟約，包括保護科林斯國王格勞科斯的承諾。」@P你也與阿巴斯王訂過盟約。很久以前，你們都還年輕時，曾約定永遠照顧彼此的土地與子孫。希望阿巴斯的兒子也能像父親一樣忠於誓言。你正準備在利西亞建立新城，阿克里西奧斯與普羅托斯的援助可能極其重要。如果不是鄰居令人頭痛，利西亞原本是理想的建城地點。附近住著敵意強烈的亞馬遜部族，索呂米人也厭惡外來者入侵。此外，當地還有人見過凶猛的奇美拉，這也是個「小問題」。如果國王的兒子站在你這邊，面對挑戰就會容易得多。也許你的一位女兒願意嫁給其中一人，鞏固兩家的聯盟。開始建設利西亞時，這件事確實值得考慮。

original: @PThough the town of Lycia has begun to thrive, trouble abounds in the world.  Chimera is making life miserable in the nearby countryside, and some fear that she is heading straight for Lycia.  In Argos, King Abas has finally succumbed to death.  His sons, rather than embracing each other in grief, have deepened the rift between them.  Giving into his greed, Acrisius has ousted Proetus from the lands that his father bequeathed to him.  Proetus has come to Lycia and, calling upon the pledge that you made to his father so many years ago, has asked for your protection and help in reclaiming what is rightfully his.  In the wake of King Abas' passing, how can you refuse?
text: @P利西亞雖然開始繁榮，世間卻仍麻煩不斷。奇美拉正在附近鄉間肆虐，有人擔心她正直奔利西亞。阿戈斯的阿巴斯王終於去世，但兩個兒子沒有在悲痛中相互支持，反而更加決裂。阿克里西奧斯屈服於貪欲，將普羅托斯逐出父親留給他的領地。普羅托斯來到利西亞，提起你多年前對他父親的誓言，請求你保護他，協助奪回應得的一切。阿巴斯王才剛過世，你怎能拒絕？

original: @PThe celebration of the wedding between Proetus and your daughter, Stheneoboea, was dampened only by a sense of injustice.  Acrisius still has not relented and holds Proetus' lands in his jealous grip.  The time has come to restore Proetus to his kingdom, and for your daughter to live as a queen.  Since gentle entreaties to Acrisius have failed, perhaps less gentle arguments will have more sway with the petulant boy.  If Acrisius and Proetus cannot take it upon themselves to fulfill their father's wish that his kingdom be divided between them, then, in honor of the dead king, you will see to it that Abas' instructions are carried out.  When you have set things straight, Proetus will again lead Tiryns, Heraeum and Midea, and Acrisius will lead Argos.
text: @P普羅托斯與你女兒斯忒涅波亞的婚禮本該充滿喜悅，唯有未平的不公讓慶祝蒙上陰影。阿克里西奧斯仍不肯讓步，嫉妒地緊抓著普羅托斯的土地。是時候讓普羅托斯重掌王國，讓女兒過上王后的生活了。既然溫和勸說無效，也許不那麼溫和的道理，能說服這個任性的孩子。如果兄弟兩人無法自行遵從父親平分王國的遺願，那麼為了紀念故王，你將確保阿巴斯的吩咐得到執行。撥亂反正後，普羅托斯將重新統治塔尼斯、赫拉聖地與米德亞，阿克里西奧斯則統治阿戈斯。

original: @PAt last, order has been returned to the world.  Proetus is again in control of his kingdom, though the city of Heraeum was destroyed in the fighting.  Acrisius has retained control of Argos, as was his due, but he is not particularly pleased with your role in the proceedings, even calling you a 'meddling old dodger!'  Glaucus of Corinth, who has allied himself with Acrisius, is also determined to oppose you.  Perhaps, with time, ruffled feathers can be smoothed over. @PProetus and your daughter have settled comfortably into their new home at Tiryns.  Yet, Proetus has revealed to you that he is still uneasy.  Tiryns is still vulnerable to attack, and it is only a matter of time before Acrisius or his ally, Glaucus of Corinth, mounts another charge against the city.  Only walls built by the famed Cyclopes could possibly defend Tiryns, but the Cyclopes have been completely unresponsive to Proetus' requests.  Hera appeared to Proetus and offered to serve as an intermediary... provided that something is done for the goddess in return.  That's when Proetus remembered the old pact made between you and his father so many years ago.
text: @P世界終於恢復秩序。普羅托斯重新掌握王國，儘管赫拉聖地在戰火中被摧毀。阿克里西奧斯保住了應得的阿戈斯，卻對你的介入很不高興，甚至罵你是「多管閒事的老傢伙」！他的盟友、科林斯的格勞科斯也決心與你作對。也許時間能慢慢平息這些怨氣。@P普羅托斯與你的女兒已在塔尼斯的新家安頓下來。然而，普羅托斯向你坦言，他依然不安。塔尼斯仍易受攻擊，阿克里西奧斯或其盟友格勞科斯再次進攻只是時間問題。唯有著名獨眼巨人建造的城牆，才可能守住塔尼斯，但獨眼巨人始終不理會他的請求。赫拉向普羅托斯現身，願意居中協調，條件是必須先替女神做些事。這時，普羅托斯又想起你多年前與他父親訂下的盟約。

original: @P'More wine,' Bellerophon bellowed as he gnawed on the bones of some unfortunate beast.  'Hurry up now, chop chop!'  For nine long days and nine long nights, the peaceful quiet of Lycia has been interrupted at frequent intervals by shouted demands of 'More wine' and 'More beast.'  Just who is this confounded Bellerophon, anyway?  After helping him atone for his misdeeds, Proetus sent him packing here to Lycia in quite a hurry.  Ever since, the lout has been consuming food and wine at an alarming rate, flirting with your daughters and offending those with more delicate sensibilities.  It was while he was draining yet another amphora of wine that Bellerophon slapped his forehead and proclaimed, 'Oh, yeah!  I was supposed to give you this note from Proetus!'  Finally, some explanation for why Proetus sent you this dubious gift.  The contents of the note, however, did not make matters much clearer.  It read, 'Please do me a favor and kill the person who hands you this note.' @PProetus neglected to add, 'Remember the oath you made to my father,' but at this point, that goes without saying.  Rules of etiquette prohibit you from killing Bellerophon, a guest in your home, outright.  If only Bellerophon could accidentally fall off a roof, or perhaps someone's sword could slip and - completely by mistake - just happen to run him through.  Or, maybe he could be convinced to take on Chimera, who has been such a headache to everyone around Lycia. @PAfter describing Chimera to Bellerophon, and underscoring just how famous he would become if he managed to kill the beast, Bellerophon eagerly agreed to the challenge.  He claimed to have a plan and was ready to take the first step.  Of course, there was one caveat.  There's always a caveat.  A home must be built for him in Lycia, and it must be stocked with the best wine and other desirable sundries.  One does what one must do.
text: @P「再拿酒來！」貝勒羅豐吃著某隻可憐野獸的骨頭，大聲吼道。「快點，動作快！」整整九天九夜，利西亞的寧靜不斷被「再拿酒來」和「再拿肉來」的叫喊打破。這個討厭的貝勒羅豐究竟是誰？普羅托斯幫他贖罪後，便急忙把他打發到利西亞。此後，這個粗人以驚人的速度吃肉喝酒，調戲你的女兒，冒犯舉止文雅的人。又一罐酒見底時，貝勒羅豐拍了拍額頭說：「對了！普羅托斯叫我把這封信交給你！」終於能知道他為什麼送來這份可疑的禮物了。然而，信的內容並沒有讓事情更清楚，只寫著：「請幫我一個忙，殺掉把這封信交給你的人。」@P普羅托斯忘了補上「別忘了你對我父親的誓言」，但事到如今已不必多說。待客之道禁止你直接殺死家中的客人貝勒羅豐。要是他能不小心從屋頂摔下來，或有人失手讓劍完全意外地刺穿他就好了。也許能說服他對付奇美拉，這頭怪獸讓利西亞周邊的人傷透了腦筋。@P你向貝勒羅豐描述奇美拉，強調殺死怪獸後將如何名揚天下，他立刻熱切接受挑戰。他聲稱已有計畫，準備邁出第一步。當然，還有一個條件，永遠都有條件：你必須在利西亞替他建造府邸，備妥最好的酒與其他心愛物品。該做的事，終究得做。

original: @PUnbelievable.  Truly unbelievable.  Bellerophon has come flying into the city on the back of the mighty Pegasus!  Athena apparently likes this obnoxious young man and told him of a Golden Bridle that could break the winged steed.  Still, maybe Chimera will manage to kill him anyway. @PSeeing Bellerophon dead has become even more important now.  Proetus sent along another note, inquiring about the health of Bellerophon, and relaying that the rogue had the gall to make advances toward Stheneboea.  Being the virtuous woman that she is, she of course refused him.  Just thinking about that coarse, disgusting excuse for a man suggesting anything untoward to the gentle, refined Stheneboea....  It will be a welcome day indeed when Chimera mauls him to death!
text: @P難以置信，真的難以置信！貝勒羅豐竟騎著強大的飛馬珀伽索斯飛進城裡！雅典娜似乎很喜歡這個討人厭的年輕人，告訴他可以用黃金韁繩馴服飛馬。不過，也許奇美拉還是能殺死他。@P如今，讓貝勒羅豐死掉變得更加重要。普羅托斯又寄來一封信，打聽他的健康狀況，並說這個無賴竟敢勾引斯忒涅波亞。她如此忠於丈夫，當然拒絕了他。想到這個粗俗令人反感、不配當男人的傢伙，竟敢向溫柔高雅的斯忒涅波亞提出非分之想……奇美拉把他撕成碎片的那天，真值得期待！

original: If You Can't Beat Him, Join Him

@PBellerophon announced, 'I am nearly ready to defeat the ferocious Chimera and take my rightful place among the famous heroes of Greece!  But, before I undertake this most amazing of feats, I demand... nay, I insist... that you outfit another Hall for me!'  If building him a second home will quicken his departure from the earth, then a second home it is. @PMeanwhile, your daughter Philonoe has been spending quite a lot of time in Bellerophon's company, and she claims that Stheneboea is lying about Bellerophon.  Philonoe maintains that Stheneboea tried to seduce Bellerophon and Bellerophon gallantly resisted her.  Regardless of who is lying and who is telling the truth, the sooner that Bellerophon is removed from the city, the better.  There are other pressing matters facing you.  The Amazon and Solymi threats have escalated, and they must be dealt with forcefully.  Maybe, if by some miracle Bellerophon defeats Chimera, he can be sent to war against the Amazons and Solymis.  The Amazons are pretty good shots, after all.
text: @P貝勒羅豐宣布：「我已快準備好擊敗凶猛的奇美拉，在希臘著名英雄之中取得應有的地位！但在完成這項驚人壯舉之前，我要求……不，我堅持……你必須再替我準備一座府邸！」如果第二個家能讓他早點離開人世，那就再蓋一座吧。@P與此同時，你的女兒菲洛諾經常與貝勒羅豐相處。她說斯忒涅波亞在撒謊，堅稱是斯忒涅波亞企圖勾引貝勒羅豐，而他高尚地拒絕了。不論誰真誰假，讓貝勒羅豐越早離城越好。你還有其他急事：亞馬遜與索呂米的威脅日益加劇，必須以武力處理。也許，萬一貝勒羅豐奇蹟似地擊敗奇美拉，就能派他去打亞馬遜人和索呂米人。畢竟，亞馬遜人的箭法相當不錯。

original: @PBellerophon just won't die.  Against all odds, he defeated Chimera without even receiving so much as a scratch!  He didn't accidentally get in the way of an Amazon arrow or Solymi spear.  Even some of your own soldiers, sensing your disdain for Bellerophon, tried killing the cad, but even they were unsuccessful!  Bellerophon couldn't possibly be one of the immortals, but it certainly is beginning to seem that way. @PNow, Bellerophon has approached you to ask for your daughter Philonoe's hand in marriage.  How can you refuse a man that has killed the most ferocious monster seen in Greece for some time, successfully dodged the spears and arrows of two enemies, and outfoxed your own soldiers' plan to kill him?  If you did refuse, Bellerophon would probably find a way to marry Philonoe anyway.  Oh, well.  Maybe allying yourself with this seemingly indestructible man may bring you benefits after all.  Proetus will just have to be satisfied with the good effort made to kill Bellerophon.
text: @P貝勒羅豐就是死不了。他出乎所有人意料，擊敗奇美拉，連一道傷痕都沒有！他也沒意外撞上亞馬遜人的箭或索呂米人的矛。你的一些士兵察覺你對他的厭惡，試著殺死這個無賴，竟也全部失敗！貝勒羅豐不可能是不死之神，卻越來越像了。@P現在，貝勒羅豐向你請求迎娶菲洛諾。這個人殺死希臘近年最凶猛的怪獸，避開兩國敵人的矛與箭，還識破你士兵的殺人計畫，你怎能拒絕？就算拒絕，他恐怕也會設法娶到她。算了，與這個看似打不死的人結盟，也許終究有益。普羅托斯只好接受，你已很努力想殺死貝勒羅豐這個事實。

original: @PJust as things settle down, they stir up again.  Proetus has sent yet another note, and, as always, his note did not contain good news.  Of all the women in Greece, Dionysus offered Proetus' daughters - your granddaughters - the honor of entering into his cult.  Foolishly, your granddaughters refused, fearing the effects of drinking too much wine.  Now, Dionysus has driven your granddaughters mad, and they are roving the countryside, raving like lunatics.  Fortunately, a wise doctor named Melampus knows how to cure the women, but his price is quite high.  Proetus doesn't have the money and, citing that cursed oath, has asked you to raise the funds. @PHere in Lycia, preparations are under way for the marriage of Philonoe and Bellerophon.  Philonoe, in her sweetest, most pleasing voice, has asked that you build another home for Bellerophon in the city.  After all, she said, Bellerophon has been living a bachelor's life for some time and, well, you know how bachelors are about keeping up their houses!  She said that cleaning out Bellerophon's Hall would be harder than cleaning the Augean Stables!  How can you say no to your adorable daughter. @PNot everything at home is happy, however.  Echidna, incensed over the death of her daughter, Chimera, is slithering toward the city, intent on revenge.
text: @P事情才剛平靜，風波又起。普羅托斯再次來信，和往常一樣沒有好消息。狄俄尼索斯從所有希臘女子中，選中普羅托斯的女兒，也就是你的外孫女，給她們加入酒神教團的榮耀。她們卻愚蠢地拒絕，擔心喝太多酒的影響。如今，狄俄尼索斯使她們發瘋，在鄉間遊走，胡言亂語。幸好，一位叫墨蘭普斯的高明醫師知道療法，但收費十分昂貴。普羅托斯沒錢，又搬出那個該死的誓言，要你籌款。@P利西亞正籌備菲洛諾與貝勒羅豐的婚禮。菲洛諾用最甜美、最討人喜歡的聲音，請你在城裡再替他建一個家。她說，貝勒羅豐單身多年，你也知道單身漢怎麼打理屋子！清理他的府邸，比清理奧吉亞斯牛舍還困難！面對可愛的女兒，你怎麼說得出不？@P不過，家鄉並非事事愉快。厄喀德娜因女兒奇美拉之死憤怒不已，正爬向城市，決心復仇。

original: @PBellerophon may not be a bad person to have around after all!  He defeated Echidna without even breaking a sweat, and the city is safe from the monster's wrath!  Now, he has been overheard saying that for Philonoe's sake, he wants to resolve his problems with Sthenoboea.  Maybe those two will work out their troubles yet. @PDoctor Melampus, touched by your devotion to your granddaughters, has said that he will waive his usual fee if, in return, he is allowed to marry the fairest of the granddaughters.  Your granddaughter could do worse than to be a doctor's wife.
text: @P讓貝勒羅豐留在身邊，也許並不壞！他不費吹灰之力便擊敗厄喀德娜，城市終於免於怪獸的怒火。如今，有人聽見他說，為了菲洛諾，他想化解與斯忒涅波亞的問題。也許兩人終能化解往日恩怨。@P墨蘭普斯醫師被你對外孫女的關愛感動，表示只要准許他迎娶最美麗的那位，就免收平常的診金。能嫁給醫師，對外孫女而言也是個不錯的歸宿。

original: @PA tragedy has struck.  Hopes were very high when Bellerophon, in what seemed to be a friendly gesture, offered to take Stheneoboea for a ride on Pegasus.  As the pair soared upward, Pegasus suddenly bucked, and beautiful Stheneoboea plunged to her death.  Ever since Bellerophon slipped the Golden Bridle onto Pegasus, the winged horse has been as docile as a sheep.  Could Bellerophon have caused Pegasus to buck, or was it just an unfortunate accident as Bellerophon claims? @PPerhaps there will be some good news yet to emerge from all this grief and sorrow.  At long last, Melampus has revealed the cure for your insane granddaughters: build a Sanctuary to Apollo, the God of Healing.  Surely, Apollo will look upon your granddaughters with pity and cure them of their ailment. @PMeanwhile, Bellerophon, with sword rattling, has had the gall to accuse you of trying to kill him!  He says that it is all clear to him: Chimera, Echidna, your own soldiers' attempted ambush... he claims that the list goes on an on.  He has threatened that if you do not build another home for him, he will make your life most unpleasant once he assumes his seat on Olympus.  Assumes his seat on Olympus?   Maybe soaring to such great heights on the back of Pegasus has robbed Bellerophon's brain of some much-needed oxygen, because he sounds insane.  Refusing a dangerous, crazy man his wish would be futile and potentially deadly.  Maybe building him another hall would quiet him.
text: @P悲劇發生了。貝勒羅豐看似友善地邀請斯忒涅波亞共乘飛馬，大家原本滿懷希望。兩人升空後，飛馬突然猛然跳動，美麗的斯忒涅波亞墜地身亡。自從套上黃金韁繩，飛馬便溫馴如羊。是貝勒羅豐讓飛馬發狂，還是真如他所說，只是一場不幸的意外？@P也許悲痛之中仍會有好消息。墨蘭普斯終於說出治療外孫女瘋病的方法：替醫療之神阿波羅建造聖所。阿波羅必會憐憫她們，治好疾病。@P另一方面，貝勒羅豐竟揮劍威嚇，指控你企圖殺害他！他說全明白了：奇美拉、厄喀德娜、你士兵的伏擊……罪狀還多得很。他威脅，若你不再建一座府邸，等他登上奧林匹斯的神位，就要讓你不得安寧。登上神位？也許騎飛馬飛得太高，讓他的腦袋缺少空氣，因為他聽起來像瘋了。拒絕危險瘋子的要求既徒勞，又可能致命。或許再建一座府邸，就能讓他安靜。

original: @PThe Wheel of Fortune has finally spun, and those who were once on the bottom are now at the top, and those who were at the top are now at the bottom.  At long last, the news from Proetus is good!  Building a Sanctuary to Apollo, as Melampus had suggested, worked, and now your granddaughters have full possession of their senses.  As promised, your fairest granddaughter has wed Melampus and, as a wedding gift, Proetus has given Melampus one-third of his kingdom.  @PBellerophon, too, has experienced a reversal of fortune.  The brash man thought that he belonged with the gods on Mount Olympus, and he was led to believe that he had Hera's support.  Little did he know that Hera had had quite enough of his shenanigans, and that she knew Zeus would rapidly punish a mortal who dared approach the home of the gods.  As surely as Helios drives the sun across the sky each day, Zeus indeed quickly put Bellerophon back in his place.  The mighty god sent a gadfly, which bit Pegasus on the hind quarter.  Reeling from the sting of the bite, Pegasus reared back, throwing Bellerophon off.  Bellerophon plunged back to earth but, as usual, managed not to die.  Now, Bellerophon, bitter and broken, is wandering Greece alone.  Thanks to the gods, he has finally left Lycia for good.
text: @P命運之輪終於轉動。曾在低處的人登上高處，曾在高處的人跌落低處。普羅托斯終於傳來好消息！按照墨蘭普斯的建議修建阿波羅聖所，果然有效，外孫女都恢復了神智。依照承諾，最美麗的外孫女嫁給墨蘭普斯，普羅托斯也將王國的三分之一送給他作為賀禮。@P貝勒羅豐的命運也發生逆轉。這個狂妄之徒以為自己該與奧林匹斯諸神並列，還相信赫拉支持他。他不知道赫拉早已受夠他的胡作非為，也知道宙斯會迅速懲罰敢接近眾神居所的凡人。正如赫利奧斯每天帶著太陽劃過天空，宙斯果然立刻教訓了貝勒羅豐。大神派出一隻吸血牛蠅，刺刺飛馬後腿。飛馬吃痛，猛然揚起前身，將他拋落。貝勒羅豐墜回地面，但一如往常，又沒死。如今，他滿心怨恨、受傷落魄，獨自在希臘流浪。感謝諸神，他終於永遠離開利西亞了。

original: Almost everyone has deserted the ruins of Heraeum, everyone but one resident famous the world over for her unique hairstyle.
text: 幾乎所有人都離開了赫拉聖地的廢墟，唯獨一位以奇特髮型聞名天下的居民留下。

original: @PWhen Proetus mentioned that he needed a favor, and that it involved Hera, you might have guessed that you would find yourself here in Heraeum to rebuild the goddess' city and to dedicate a Sanctuary to her.  At least Heraeum has plentiful supplies of marble and some wood available to use for constructing the edifice.  But, as always in Greece, nothing can ever be entirely good.  The deadly Medusa has taken up residence here and threatens to cause problems.  Luckily, Perseus, the famous hero, has agreed to take care of the snake-haired monster, provided that you build him a fine lodge outfitted with his favorite things.
text: @P普羅托斯說需要你幫忙，而且與赫拉有關時，你大概就猜到，自己會來赫拉聖地重建女神的城市，並為她獻上聖所。至少這裡有大量大理石，也有一些木材可供建造。不過，在希臘，事情從來不會全然美好。致命的美杜莎已在此定居，隨時可能惹出麻煩。幸運的是，著名英雄珀耳修斯同意處理蛇髮女妖，條件是你要替他建造漂亮府邸，備齊他喜愛的物品。

original: @PThe goddess Hera is thrilled with her new Sanctuary and, as promised, has convinced the Cyclopes to build walls for Tiryns.  Proetus is thrilled and extremely thankful for your help, and has even done you the honor of comparing you to his own father.  With the restoration of Heraeum, old Abas' wishes have finally been carried out to the letter. @PAbas would have been proud of Proetus, who has been acting the part of a good king.  Your daughter reports that Proetus has taken in the most beautiful young man, a son of Glaucus of Corinth.  The man had accidentally killed his brother, and Proetus has agreed to help him atone for his sin. @PMeanwhile, all in Heraeum are talking of the fantastic sight that they have witnessed.  When Medusa was killed, a magnificent winged horse sprang forth from her body - no one even knew that she was pregnant!  This amazing horse, called Pegasus, quickly flew off towards Corinth.  People have reported that everywhere this horse alights, a spring bubbles forth from the ground.  Will wonders ever cease?
text: @P赫拉對新聖所十分滿意，依約說服獨眼巨人替塔尼斯建城牆。普羅托斯欣喜若狂，非常感謝你的幫助，甚至把你比作他的親生父親，以示尊敬。赫拉聖地恢復後，老阿巴斯的遺願終於全部實現。@P阿巴斯會為普羅托斯自豪，他正努力當一位好國王。女兒告訴你，他收留了一位極英容貌出眾的青年，是科林斯國王格勞科斯的兒子。青年意外殺死自己的兄弟，普羅托斯答應幫他贖罪。@P與此同時，赫拉聖地人人都在談論親眼見到的奇景。美杜莎被殺時，一匹宏偉的飛馬從她體內躍出，原來根本沒人知道她將要生孩子了！這匹名叫珀伽索斯的神奇飛馬，迅速飛往科林斯。據說，每當牠落地，地上就會湧出泉水。奇蹟真是無窮無盡！

original: @PSome time has passed since you received any bad news or strange requests from Proetus.  In fact, he has managed to forge an uneasy peace with Acrisius, and Melampus is leading his portion of the kingdom admirably.  Now that things in the world have settled down, you've been able to focus your full attention on Lycia, which has developed into a fine city.  For all the trouble that Bellerophon caused, his help in ridding the land of Chimera has certainly helped Lycia become the city that it is today. @PAnd what of Bellerophon?  At last report, he was still wandering Greece, and all who see him turn their backs upon him.  Some report that they have heard him planning to recapture Pegasus, but he certainly won't be able to find anyone - mortal or god - to help him reclaim the beast.  Finally, Lycia's Bellerophon troubles are over.
text: @P你已經有一陣子沒收到普羅托斯的壞消息或奇怪要求了。事實上，他與阿克里西奧斯達成了雖不穩固的和平，墨蘭普斯也把分得的領地治理得很好。天下逐漸恢復安定，你終能全心經營利西亞，使它發展成優秀的城市。貝勒羅豐雖帶來許多麻煩，但他除掉奇美拉，確實幫助利西亞成就今日的繁榮。@P至於貝勒羅豐呢？最新消息說，他仍在希臘流浪，見到他的人都轉身不理。有些人聽見他打算重新捕捉飛馬，但無論凡人或神明，都不會再協助他奪回牠。利西亞的貝勒羅豐之患，終於結束了。

original: In a world torn apart by oppression, a strong leader must arise to throw off the yoke of servitude.  This is a very challenging adventure that consists of six parent city episodes and two colony episodes.
text: 在一個被壓迫撕裂的世界裡，一位強大的領袖必須挺身而出，掙脫奴役的枷鎖。這是一場極具挑戰性的冒險，包含六個主城章節和兩個殖民地章節。

original: @POnly the Atlanteans could be so cruel.  Their brutal army swept into your city from Knossos, their base on Crete, and began their mission of destruction.  In the fray, families were torn apart, mother from father, brother from brother, sister from sister.  When the Atlantean army was done, there were only a few people left standing. @PWhen our Greek forefathers first met the Atlanteans, they were a weak little bunch always spouting off about peace and science.  Several decades ago, however, something changed.  They began to use science to develop new weaponry, which is respectable enough, and began using their new weapons to subjugate their neighbors.  Bit by bit, they took over most of the lands in and around the Mediterranean and built strongholds at Syracuse, Knossos and Carthage.  They even built a fort at Lixus that acts as a cork, preventing any unauthorized ships from entering or leaving the Mediterranean Sea.  But then, after making some ludicrous demands, they had the gall to invade Greece, an affront that cannot go unanswered.  They have already conquered many of our cities with their strong weapons and superior numbers, but we are Greek, and we are stronger. @PFirst, we must build a mighty city in Mycenae, a rocky area whose mountains offer us natural protection against our foes.  The mountains will not likely be enough, however.  We should also build extensive fortifications to protect our city from those Atlantean curs. From here, we will be able to resist the Atlantean onslaught until we are ready to strike.
text: @P只有亞特蘭蒂斯人能如此殘酷。他們的暴虐軍隊從克里特島上的科諾索基地出發，席捲你的城市，展開毀滅行動。戰亂中，家庭支離破碎，夫妻分離，兄弟姐妹失散。亞特蘭蒂斯軍隊收手時，僅剩少數人生還。@P希臘先祖初次遇見亞特蘭蒂斯人時，他們只是弱小的一群，總把和平與科學掛在嘴邊。然而，數十年前一切都變了。他們開始用科學研製新武器，這本身倒也值得尊敬，卻接著用它們征服鄰國。他們逐步占領地中海及周邊大部分土地，在敘拉古、科諾索與迦太基建立據點，甚至在利克蘇斯建造要塞，像木塞般封住地中海，不准未獲許可的船隻進出。後來，他們提出荒誕要求，竟還膽敢入侵希臘。這種侮辱絕不能不加回應。他們靠強大武器與人數優勢征服了許多城市，但我們是希臘人，我們更加堅強。@P首先，必須在密刻奈建立強大城市。這片多岩石的地區有山脈作天然屏障，保護我們抵抗敵人。但光靠山脈恐怕不夠，還應興建完善防禦工事，阻擋亞特蘭蒂斯走狗。我們將在此抵抗猛攻，直到準備好反擊。

original: @PMycenae is a powerhouse!  The Atlanteans could not tear our city down and have retreated for the time being.  Regrettably, our Greek compatriots have not fared so well.  Sparta and Athens are now firmly in the Atlanteans' grip, and we alone survive to stand up to those horrid Atlanteans.
text: @P密刻奈堅不可摧！亞特蘭蒂斯人無法摧毀城市，已暫時撤退。遺憾的是，其他希臘同胞沒有這麼幸運。斯巴達與雅典如今都被亞特蘭蒂斯牢牢掌握，只剩我們繼續挺身抵抗那些可怕的侵略者。

original: @PWithout an ally in the world, we stand proud against the Atlanteans.  The time has come to strike back at our foe.  The Atlantean base at Knossos is the key to their attacks on Greece.  Without this important military outpost, the Atlanteans will have a much more difficult time making war on the Aegean, at least for a little while.  Unfortunately, Knossos is heavily fortified by massive Towers that launch fire, which seems to stick to its target and is resistant to stopping, dropping and rolling. @POf course, the wiser Olympians are on our side.  Hermes has discovered a way to weaken the Atlantean defenses at Knossos, making reference to something called orichalc - whatever that is.  He says we'll have to find a brave and strong hero to carry out his plan.
text: @P即使舉世無盟友，我們仍昂然抵抗亞特蘭蒂斯。反擊的時候到了。科諾索基地是他們進攻希臘的關鍵。失去這個重要軍事前哨，他們要在愛琴海作戰便會困難許多，至少短期如此。不幸的是，科諾索防禦森嚴，巨大塔樓能噴射火焰。那火焰似乎會黏住目標，停下、伏下、翻滾也難以撲滅。@P當然，較明智的奧林匹斯諸神站在我們這邊。荷米斯已發現削弱科諾索防禦的方法，提到一種叫山銅的東西，天知道那是什麼。他說，我們得找一位勇敢強壯的英雄，執行他的計畫。

original: @PGods be praised!  Knossos has fallen!  After Achilles weakened Knossos' defenses, our brave soldiers marched in and destroyed the city.  The Atlanteans are stunned by our daring victory, and word of our remarkable achievement is spreading like wildfire throughout the Aegean.  The Amazons and Centaurs, realizing that we represent the best chance of throwing off the yoke of Atlantean domination, have sided with us.  They have vowed to help us in any way that they can to defeat the Atlantean menace.  Even the famous heroes of Greece have taken notice of our valor and are eager to come to our city provided, of course, there are suitable accommodations waiting for them when they arrive.
text: @P讚美諸神！科諾索陷落了！阿基裡斯削弱城防後，勇敢的士兵進軍並摧毀了城市。亞特蘭蒂斯人被這場大膽的勝利震驚，驚人成就的消息像野火般傳遍愛琴海。亞馬遜人與半人馬明白，我們最有希望打破亞特蘭蒂斯統治的枷鎖，因此加入我們。他們立誓盡一切力量，協助擊敗亞特蘭蒂斯的威脅。就連希臘著名英雄也注意到我們的英勇，熱切希望來訪。當然，前提是他們抵達時，城內已有合適的住處。

original: The Wrath of Poseidon and Sons

@PThe seas around Greece have been roiling and surging, threatening to overtake the land.  Poseidon is livid.  The Atlanteans are Poseidon's people, and he is well aware of what we have done to them at Knossos.  It's only a matter of time before the God of the Sea, father to monsters and master of earthquakes, makes his displeasure with us felt. @PThough Poseidon is vexed with us, we will push forward.  With Knossos destroyed, the time has come to release our Greek compatriots from Atlantis' iron grip.  Hoplites may not be enough to combat the Atlantean armies stationed on the Greek mainland.  Skilled and powerful horsemen have the best chance of defeating the Atlantean foe.  We can't have horses without wheat, however, and the crop is scarce in Greece.  Most of the farms have been abandoned or destroyed by the Atlanteans.  If all else fails, you may have to raid some other cities for supplies.  All's fair in love and war, after all.
text: @P希臘周邊海水翻騰激烈湧動，彷彿要吞沒陸地。波賽東勃然大怒。亞特蘭蒂斯人是他的子民，他清楚知道我們在科諾索所做的一切。這位海洋之神、怪獸之父、地震的主宰，遲早會讓我們感受到他的不滿。@P波賽東雖對我們惱怒，我們仍要前進。科諾索已毀，是時候讓希臘同胞擺脫亞特蘭蒂斯的強硬控制。單靠重裝步兵，可能不足以對抗駐紮希臘本土的敵軍；訓練有素、強大的騎兵最有希望取勝。然而，沒有小麥便無法養馬，而希臘小麥稀少，多數農場已遭廢棄或被亞特蘭蒂斯人摧毀。如果別無他法，可能必須突襲其他城市，取得補給。畢竟，愛情與戰爭中，手段不受限制。

original: @PThe last several years have been more difficult than any recorded in history.  Poseidon sent earthquakes and tidal waves to scourge the land, and Mycenae will never be the same again.  The angry god even sent his sons, Atlas and the Cyclops, to make life even more difficult.  Despite all of these hurdles, Sparta and Athens have been ripped away from the Atlanteans and are part of the Greek nation again. @PWith the Atlantean hold on Greece shaken, the time has come to expel the Atlanteans from another region of the world and push them out of the Mediterranean.
text: @P過去幾年比歷史記載中的任何時期都艱難。波賽東降下地震與海嘯，肆虐大地，密刻奈再也無法恢復原貌。憤怒的神明甚至派出兒子阿特拉斯與獨眼巨人，讓生活更加困苦。儘管如此，斯巴達與雅典仍成功脫離亞特蘭蒂斯，再次回歸希臘。@P亞特蘭蒂斯對希臘的控制已被動搖。現在，該把他們逐出另一個地區，進一步趕出地中海了。

original: @POur spies have returned from their harrowing reconnaissance mission to the Atlantean city, Cleitos, and they have some truly frightening news.  They report that those dastardly Atlanteans have built an enormous weapon.  This weapon is capable of causing widespread damage, and it doesn't even have to be anywhere near its intended target.  After our string of triumphant victories, they must be too frightened to meet us in honorable combat.  Other than its effects, our spies were unable to uncover anything else about the weapon or how it works.  Fortunately, the gods are with us, and they have provided us with the information our spies could not.  Hephaestus, the master craftsman, has devised a way to sabotage the weapon.  Only a crafty hero will be able to slip past the fortress at Lixus, penetrate the defenses of Cleitos, and get near the weapon without notice.  The quicker this weapon is neutralized, the easier it will be for us to defeat Atlantis once and for all. @PWhile we work on sabotaging this weapon of doom, our allies are valiantly battling Atlantean aggression.  Like any war effort, though, supplies are consumed at a rapid rate, and the demand for more is always high.  We need to rally to our allies' aid by providing them with the goods that they need to continue this glorious war against Atlantis.  Other cities still under Atlantean rule have been secretly sending us gifts in the hopes that we will free them, and many of our new allies have been sending us gifts in gratitude for our help.
text: @P間諜完成深入亞特蘭蒂斯城市克雷托斯的危險偵察任務，帶回駭人的消息：那些卑鄙的亞特蘭蒂斯人建造了巨型武器，能造成大範圍破壞，甚至無須靠近目標。我們接連獲勝後，他們想必已不敢堂堂正正交戰。除了效果，間諜未能查出武器的其他情報或運作方式。幸好諸神與我們同在，提供了缺少的情報。工藝大師赫菲斯托斯已想出破壞武器的方法。唯有機智的英雄，才能偷偷通過利克蘇斯要塞，突破克雷托斯防線，在不被發現的情況下接近武器。越快讓它失效，我們就越容易徹底擊敗亞特蘭蒂斯。@P我們設法破壞毀滅武器之際，盟友正英勇抵抗侵略。但任何戰爭都會迅速消耗物資，補給需求始終龐大。我們必須支援盟友，提供他們繼續這場光榮戰爭所需的貨物。仍受亞特蘭蒂斯統治的城市，也秘密送來禮物，希望我們解放它們；許多新盟友同樣送禮，感謝我們的幫助。

original: @P'Well, champ, let me tell you about this secret weapon thing,' Odysseus began.  'It was easy enough to penetrate the defenses that the Atlanteans had surrounding it.  Those Atlanteans always have their head in some book, and they were so intent on their scholarly studies that they didn't even notice me.  So, there it was, all shiny and red and with lots of buttons.  Since no one was paying any attention to me, I spun some dials and pressed a few of the buttons.  Next thing I know, the earth starts shaking!  Of course, this gets the attention of all the book-loving scientists, and they started coming after me.  Without wasting another minute, I poured about a dozen hives-worth of honey right into the weapon.  By this time, the scientists were on top of me. Of course, scientists don't fight nearly as well as heroes do, and I was able to single handedly vanquish them all.  There must have been a hundred of them.   @P'Anyway, slugo, you ought to get out there in the Mediterranean and attack while the attacking is good.  Though I wasn't able to destroy the thing completely, I at least gummed up the works for a little while. Since Atlantis is crawling with scientists, it won't be long until one of those little fellows figures out how to fix that big, red shiny thing.'
text: @P「好了，老兄，讓我告訴你那個秘密武器的事，」奧德修斯說。「突破亞特蘭蒂斯人在周圍設下的防線相當容易。他們總是埋首書本，專心研究，根本沒注意我。武器就在那裡，又紅又亮，上面全是按鈕。既然沒人理我，我就轉轉旋鈕，按了幾下。結果，大地突然開始震動！這下當然驚動了所有愛書的科學家，他們朝我衝來。我一刻也不停留，把大約十二個蜂巢的蜂蜜全倒進武器。這時科學家已撲到眼前。當然，他們打架遠不及英雄，我獨力打敗所有人，至少有一百個吧。」@P「總之，愛偷閒的傢伙，趁現在有利，趕快去地中海進攻。我雖沒能完全摧毀武器，至少讓它暫時卡住了。亞特蘭蒂斯到處都是科學家，不用多久，就會有小傢伙想出辦法，修好那個又紅又亮的大玩意。」

original: @PIt is the calm before the storm.  The wicked Atlanteans have regrouped in numbers beyond our imagining, and even now are preparing their massive war machine to reclaim all that we have wrested away from them.  They have repaired their fearsome weapon that Odysseus had damaged, and strengthened Lixus so that no one, not even a hero, can ever set foot uninvited on Atlantis again.  Some of our spies report that the Atlanteans have already recaptured Carthage and have fortified the city with their mysterious Atlantean Fire.  We can only hope that the reports are false.  Yet, one can't help but think that the Atlanteans' mastery of Carthage is like the first rivulet of water through a chink in an old dam.  The chink starts out small at first, but then grows and grows until the dam breaks and an ocean of water is flowing through, demolishing everything in its path.  The Atlantean horde is like that rivulet of water, bound to grow stronger and more deadly with each passing day. @PWe must stand firm against this rising tide.  Our enigmatic seers have spoken of the years ahead and foretell great hardship, when Greece is buffeted on all sides.  And yet, the seers say that those who are strong enough to withstand the Atlantean threat will be rewarded, that a great hero will emerge to lead Greece through the coming times that will be both cruel and fortuitous.  They also say that Zeus, in a rage over the Atlanteans' behavior, will, when he is ready, come to the aid of the Greeks. @PWhile we wait for this conquering hero, we must stiffen our sinews in the face of this latest Atlantean threat. The Centaurs of Mount Aulip have vowed that they will die before becoming Atlantean slaves again.  Let their vow be an example to us as we prepare for bloody battle.
text: @P暴風雨前的寧靜到來了。邪惡的亞特蘭蒂斯人重新集結，數量超乎想像，正準備龐大的戰爭機器，要奪回我們解放的一切。他們修復了奧德修斯破壞的恐怖武器，也加強利克蘇斯，使任何人，甚至英雄，都無法再未經許可踏上亞特蘭蒂斯。部分間諜報告，他們已奪回迦太基，並以神秘的亞特蘭蒂斯火焰加固城防。我們只能希望消息不實。然而，他們重掌迦太基，就像老堤防裂縫中流出的第一道細流。裂縫起初很小，接著越來越大，直到堤防崩潰，洪水摧毀沿途一切。亞特蘭蒂斯大軍就像那道細流，將日益強大、更加致命。@P面對上漲的洪流，我們必須站穩。神秘的先知預言，未來希臘將四面受敵，遭遇巨大苦難。但他們也說，堅強到足以挺過威脅的人將得到回報，一位偉大英雄會出現，帶領希臘度過殘酷卻也充滿機遇的時代。他們還說，宙斯對亞特蘭蒂斯的行為大為震怒，準備妥當後便會援助希臘。@P等待這位常勝英雄時，我們必須鼓起勇氣，面對新威脅。奧利普山的半人馬立誓，寧死也不再當亞特蘭蒂斯的奴僕。準備血戰之際，就以他們的誓言為榜樣吧。

original: @PBattered, but not beaten, we still stand.  The Atlanteans have defeated most of our allies, and our dutiful colonies, and all who lived in them, have fallen victim to Poseidon's rage.   @PYet, amidst all this carnage, there is a glimmer of hope. The massive fortress at Lixus has been destroyed, which is a considerable blow to Atlantean power.  We have Dionysus and Perseus to thank for the fall of Lixus.  When Dionysus heard of the fate of the Centaur city at Mount Aulip, he smote the people of Lixus the only way that Dionysus knows how: by drenching them in wine until they were all falling down drunk.  With the Atlanteans thusly indisposed, Perseus swept in with the head of Medusa, turning the besotted citizens of Lixus to stone. @PIf we are to take advantage of this most fortunate event, we must act quickly. It will only be a matter of time before the Atlanteans repopulate Lixus and restore the fort.
text: @P我們傷痕累累，卻未被擊倒。亞特蘭蒂斯擊敗了大多數盟友，忠誠的殖民地及其中所有居民，也都遭到波賽東怒火吞噬。@P然而，在這片慘況中仍有一線希望。利克蘇斯的巨大要塞已被摧毀，重創亞特蘭蒂斯的力量。我們應感謝狄俄尼索斯與珀耳修斯。狄俄尼索斯聽說奧利普山半人馬城市的命運後，用他獨有的方式懲罰利克蘇斯人：用酒淹沒他們，直到人人醉倒。趁敵人無力抵抗，珀耳修斯帶著美杜莎的頭衝入城中，把醉醺醺的居民都變成石頭。@P若要利用這份難得的好運，就必須迅速行動。亞特蘭蒂斯人遲早會重新移民利克蘇斯，修復要塞。

original: Zeus' Retribution: the Fall of Atlantis
text: 宙斯的懲罰：亞特蘭蒂斯的覆滅

original: @PWith a flash of light, Zeus appeared to our seers: 'My dear Greeks, I have been watching your war with the Atlanteans for some time, and I have grown tired of the Atlanteans' bullying antics.  My brother Poseidon has also grown too big for his britches - or whatever it is he wears.  It is high time that Poseidon and his promise-breaking people are put in their place. I am devising a plan that will let you defeat the Atlanteans once and for all, and give them a taste of their own, bitter medicine.  With the destruction of the fort at Lixus, a cunning hero will again be able to make his way to Atlantis, where he can carry out my plot.  I must spend a little more time ironing out the details, but I will come back to you soon.  Bide your time here in Mycenae a little longer, and victory will be yours.' @PZeus' words are a clarion call.  We must once again rise up, weapons in hand, and face the wretched Atlantean foe.  We will be ready.  When the Atlanteans attack, they will be greeted by the sound of our blood curdling battle cries, and escorted from our city at the ends of our spears.  If our allies fall, we will not quiver in fear, but redouble our efforts to defeat our enemy.  Angry gods and ferocious monsters will stand no chance against us.  We will outlast their assaults and turn them back with the aid of the gods and heroes of Greece.  All in the world will learn that the Greek people are not to be trifled with.
text: @P一道閃光後，宙斯出現在先知面前：「親愛的希臘人，我觀察你們與亞特蘭蒂斯的戰爭已有一段時間，受夠了那些仗勢欺人的行徑。我的兄弟波賽東也太自大了。是時候教訓他和背棄承諾的子民。我正制定計畫，讓你們徹底擊敗亞特蘭蒂斯，讓他們自食苦果。利克蘇斯要塞已毀，機智的英雄便能再次前往亞特蘭蒂斯，執行我的計策。我還需要一點時間完善細節，很快就會回來。你們再在密刻奈耐心等候一陣子，勝利就屬於你們。」@P宙斯的話如同響亮號角。我們必須再次起身，拿起武器，迎戰可恨的敵人。我們會準備好。亞特蘭蒂斯來襲時，將迎上令人恐懼的戰吼，再被長矛逐出城外。盟友即使陷落，我們也不會害怕顫抖，反而加倍努力打敗敵人。憤怒的神明與凶猛怪獸休想成功。我們將撐過猛攻，藉希臘諸神與英雄的幫助擊退他們。全世界都將知道，希臘人民絕不能輕侮。

original: @PThe world as we knew it is gone.  The daring Odysseus, following Zeus' instructions, dashed into the city of Cleitos, aimed the weapon at the heart of Atlantis and fired it.  As Odysseus raced from Atlantis, a huge fireball exploded on the continent, triggering massive earthquakes and tidal waves on the land.  From the safety of his ship, Odysseus looked back towards Atlantis.  He couldn't be sure, but it looked like it was sinking into the ocean.   @PThe cataclysmic effects of the weapon extended well beyond the continent of Atlantis.  Shock waves from the explosion emanated from Atlantis to the rest of the world.  When the shock waves reached Thera, it roused a giant volcano, which had long been slumbering.  The volcano erupted, and the sky filled with ash and fire. Thera was completely destroyed. @PGreece did not fair much better when the shock waves reached our shores.  Many cities were destroyed by floods, and a large portion of our army perished in the disasters.  Yet, we are still here, and soon it will be time for Greece to start anew.  Our greatest stories are yet to come.
text: @P熟悉的世界已不復存在。勇敢的奧德修斯遵照宙斯指示，衝入克雷托斯，將武器瞄準亞特蘭蒂斯的中心並開火。他逃離時，巨大火球在大陸上爆發，引發強烈地震與海嘯。從安全的船上回望，他雖不能確定，卻覺得亞特蘭蒂斯正在沉入海中。@P武器造成的浩劫遠遠超出亞特蘭蒂斯大陸。爆發衝擊波傳向世界各地，抵達特拉時，喚醒了一座沉睡已久的巨大火山。火山爆發，天空布滿灰燼與烈焰，特拉徹底毀滅。@P衝擊波抵達希臘海岸時，我們也好不到哪裡去。許多城市被洪水摧毀，大批軍隊在災難中喪生。然而，我們仍然存在，很快，希臘將重新開始。我們最偉大的故事，還在未來。

original: This site, the location of a former Atlantean base, would make an excellent outpost from which to liberate Egypt and its fierce warriors.
text: 這裡原是亞特蘭蒂斯基地，非常適合建立前哨，解放埃及與其勇猛戰士。

original: @PThe city that rises here on the ashes of the former Atlantean stronghold will serve as a symbol of what will soon happen the world over: What was once Atlantean will become Greek.   From here, we will have an easy time assaulting the Atlantean power base in Egypt.  This old and proud society, renowned for its military prowess, has long been under Atlantean rule, and some of them have been yearning for freedom.  Other Egyptians, however, are resistant to change.  Saqqara, one of the oldest Atlantean cities in Egypt, has long since become accustomed to the Atlanteans' domination.  The people of Saqqara fear that liberation from the Atlanteans will only mean exchanging one master for another, and would rather continue under Atlantean rule than to face the unknown.  But, if Saqqara is left to the Atlanteans, it will only be a matter of time before they bring to heel the Egyptian cities that we reclaim.  Therefore, it is resolved: Saqqara must be conquered. @POusting the Atlanteans from Egypt will not be easy.  In addition to opposition from Saqqara, we can expect Atlantean visitors from a new fortified city that the Atlanteans have established.   The city is called Thera, and it already possesses a strong and powerful military force.  With support from Lixus, it is well-equipped to withstand any attack, and more than capable of launching huge offensives.
text: @P在昔日亞特蘭蒂斯據點的灰燼上興起的城市，將象徵即將發生於全世界的變化：曾屬亞特蘭蒂斯的一切，都將屬於希臘。從這裡出發，我們能輕易攻擊他們在埃及的權力基地。這個古老而自豪、以武力聞名的民族，長期受其統治，部分人民渴望自由。然而，另一些埃及人抗拒改變。薩卡拉是埃及最古老的亞特蘭蒂斯城市之一，早已習慣這種統治。居民擔心，所謂解放只是換個主人，因此寧可維持現狀，也不願面對未知。但如果把薩卡拉留給亞特蘭蒂斯，他們遲早會重新制服我們解放的埃及城市。因此，決定已下：必須征服薩卡拉。@P將亞特蘭蒂斯逐出埃及並不容易。除了薩卡拉的反抗，我們還得迎接來自新建要塞城市的敵軍。那座城市名叫特拉，已擁有強大軍力。利克蘇斯提供支援，使它裝備充足，足以抵擋進攻，也完全有能力發動大規模攻勢。

original: @PRejoice!  We have freed the Egyptians from their oppressors.  Even Saqqara has begrudgingly joined the Greek fold.  With their powerful armies, they are sure to be valuable allies as we continue our quest to remove the Atlantean menace.  But, like a troublesome weed, the Atlanteans refuse to go away.  Their base at Thera is growing stronger by the day, and now it is much too powerful for our army to attack directly.  We can only hope to protect the cities that the Atlanteans at Thera decide to harass.
text: @P歡呼吧！我們讓埃及人擺脫壓迫者，就連薩卡拉也不情願地加入希臘陣營。他們擁有強大軍隊，必能成為寶貴盟友，協助我們繼續消除亞特蘭蒂斯的威脅。然而，敵人像惱人的野草，總也除不盡。特拉基地日益強盛，現在已強大到無法由我軍直接進攻。我們只能盡力保護那些遭特拉敵軍侵擾的城市。

original: This well-hidden spot provides easy access to the wealthy cities of Phoenicia.
text: 這個隱密地點便於前往腓尼基的富裕城市。

original: @PNo one could possibly find us here in this secret Cypriot harbor, not even the craftiest Atlantean.  From this obscure location, we'll be able to launch sneak attacks against the Atlanteans and expunge the Atlantean rogues from Phoenicia.  If we help the Phoenicians, they will surely repay us with some of their magnificent wealth, and we'll be able to continue to finance the war effort. @PMeanwhile, our Centaur allies from Mount Aulip have sent word that the Atlanteans, citing an ancient grudge, have declared war on all Centaurs.  The Atlanteans, calling the Centaurs misshapen brutes, have vowed to wipe them from the face of the earth.  Without our protection, our Centaur allies will surely fall. @POur mission is clear: rip the Phoenicians from the hands of the Atlanteans and ready ourselves to defend our Centaur allies. @L@PThe area would be perfect if it weren't for the lack of food in the area.  We will have to turn to others for the nourishment that we need.
text: @P沒有人能在這座塞浦路斯秘密港口找到我們，即使最狡猾的亞特蘭蒂斯人也不行。從這個隱密地點，我們能發動突襲，將亞特蘭蒂斯惡徒逐出腓尼基。如果幫助腓尼基人，他們必會以豐厚財富回報，讓我們繼續支付戰爭開銷。@P與此同時，奧利普山的半人馬盟友傳來消息：亞特蘭蒂斯以古老仇恨為由，向所有半人馬宣戰。他們稱半人馬是形體扭曲野獸，立誓將其從世上消滅。沒有我們保護，半人馬盟友必將覆亡。@P使命很明確：從亞特蘭蒂斯手中解放腓尼基人，並準備保衛半人馬盟友。@L@P要不是食物短缺，這裡本會十分理想。我們必須向他人求助，取得所需糧食。

original: @PThe grateful Phoenicians are celebrating our names today.  We have ushered the hated Atlanteans out of their cities, and the Phoenicians are again trading their wares freely and earning considerable amounts of cash.  As we prepare for battles ahead, the money that our Phoenician allies will supply will help us sharpen our swords and strengthen our shields.  With the Phoenician contribution to the war chest, our defeat of Atlantis is a certainty.
text: @P感激的腓尼基人今天正歌頌我們。我們將可恨的亞特蘭蒂斯人逐出城市，腓尼基人再次自由交易貨物，賺取可觀收入。我們準備迎接下一場戰鬥時，盟友提供的資金將幫助磨利刀劍、加固盾。有腓尼基資助軍費，擊敗亞特蘭蒂斯已是必然。

original: @PAnd thus, you begin again.  Many, many years ago, before you began the resistance against the Atlanteans, you were one of a handful of survivors of a brutal Atlantean attack.  Now, as then, you are one of few left, but the world has changed.  With the help of Zeus and the heroes of Greece, the Atlanteans have been crushed once and for all. Slowly, Greek land, scorched and scarred by war, will be restored to its former splendor.  Greek society will again thrive, and the few war-torn cities that dot the countryside will grow into powerful and noble city-states that will become the stuff of legend.  The Atlantean Age is over, and the Greek Age is born.
text: @P於是，你再次從頭開始。許多年前，在反抗亞特蘭蒂斯之前，你是殘酷襲擊中僅存的少數生還者。如今，你仍是少數倖存者之一，但世界已經改變。藉著宙斯與希臘英雄的幫助，亞特蘭蒂斯終被徹底擊潰。遭戰火摧殘、傷痕累累的希臘土地，將慢慢恢復昔日光彩。希臘社會會再次繁榮，散布鄉間、飽受戰亂的少數城市，將成長為強大而高貴的城邦，成為傳奇。亞特蘭蒂斯時代已告終，希臘時代誕生了。

original: @PThe seer emerged from the oracle at Delphi and uttered these words: 'I see two people walking together towards greatness.  One of these people is a hulking man, stronger than anyone else in the world.  The other person is incredibly good-looking and extremely smart.   Hercules is the muscle bound man, a son of Zeus who has incurred the wrath of Hera, Zeus' wife.  She drove Hercules to madness, and he killed his wife and children.  Since that fateful day, he has traveled around Greece, doing good deeds to atone for his sins.   @P'The incredibly good-looking and smart person is you.  You are destined to become the ruler of a great dominion, and some of the immortals will call you friend.  But that day is some time from now, and you have much to do before that beautiful day dawns.  Along the way, your fate and Hercules' fate will be intertwined. His enemies will become your enemies; his friends, your friends. Your path to glory begins with establishing the city of Tiryns in Argolis and introducing it to the world.' @L@PYou'll have plenty of time to build Tiryns into a thriving metropolis later. If you try to build a large city now, you will have difficulty feeding everybody.
text: @P先知從阿波羅聖所走出來：'我看見了兩個偉大的人走在一起，一個高大強壯，一個聰明博學。那個高大強壯的人是赫爾克利斯，他是宙斯的兒子之中最勇猛的，但是他遭到宙斯的妻子赫拉的嫉恨。她讓赫爾克利斯中了魔法，殺死了自己的妻子兒女。從那之後，赫爾克利斯開始在希臘各地做善事，希望能爲自己贖罪。  @P而那個聰明博學的人就是你，你將成爲希臘的偉人。不過你的前途並非一帆風順，赫爾克利斯的敵人也會成爲你的敵人。現在你首先要在阿爾格利斯建立塔尼斯城。 @L@P你將來可以把塔尼斯城建成大城市，不過目前你的食物和資源還不足以支持大量的人口。'

original: @PWhile you were busy establishing a colony, Hercules was headed for Troy where he whisked Hesione, princess of Troy, out of the jaws of Poseidon's gruesome Kraken.  How did Hesione manage to find herself in this scrape?  Her father, King Laomedon, refused to keep his promise to pay Apollo and Poseidon for building the walls of Troy. So, the gods punished Troy with plagues and floods, and the only way for Laomedon to save his city was to sacrifice his daughter. @PNow, Poseidon and Apollo are enraged that Hercules has meddled in their affairs. . . and they are well aware of your connection to this hero!  And the Kraken, whose taste buds were primed for a bite of human, is very hungry. Elsewhere in the world, the Centaurs, who are always on the look out for a new source of wine, have taken notice of you and your kingdom Trouble might not be far off!
text: @P在你忙於發展城市的時候，赫爾克利斯去了特洛伊冒險。海神波賽東和太陽神阿波羅爲特洛伊建造了城牆，但特洛伊的國王德莫頓拒絕支付報酬。憤怒的神明讓特洛伊發生了瘟疫，而且要求德莫頓用他的女兒祭祀。 @P由於赫爾克利斯救了這位公主，所以海神波賽東和太陽神阿波羅把怒氣發泄在你身上，海神派出海妖來對付你。另外，最近半人馬族在到處尋找葡萄酒，可能他們會來騷擾你。

original: @PDid you hear the one about Hercules and Pholus?  It seems that the hero had wandered deep into the Centaur territory of Erymanthus in pursuit of a boar when he grew quite thirsty.  The Centaur Pholus was willing to share his wine with Hercules, and they were soon raising flagon after flagon of the beverage.  It wasn't long before a horde of other centaurs decided to join the party.  One thing led to another, as things usually do when there's wine involved, and Hercules slew many of them in self-defense.  The Centaurs, of course, are none too pleased and are plotting their revenge against Hercules and anyone associated with him.
text: @P赫爾克利斯爲了追獵一頭野豬而進入了半人馬族的領地，半人馬族的人們邀請他參加宴會，當晚由於喝醉了酒，赫爾克利斯錯殺了許多半人馬族的戰士。半人馬族現在要向赫爾克利斯以及他所有的朋友宣戰。

original: @PIt seems ages now since you first heard how your fate would be intertwined with Hercules'.  Many of the friends you had then are now your enemies, and one of your oldest enemies has become your friend.  Nemea is now an ally, thanks to the exploits of the great Hercules, who killed a ferocious lion that was attacking the city.  Grateful Ronphus, Nemea's ruler, has begun rebuilding his decimated city.   @PThe Amazons and Centaurs, who were once your friends, continue to cause trouble, and the time has come to exert your dominance over them.  Capturing Mount Pelion, a prominent Centaur stronghold, will send them a loud and clear message that you are not to be trifled with.    @POf course, the more things change, the more they stay the same.  Apollo, Poseidon and Hephaestus still have nefarious plans to exact revenge on you.  It is time to call Zeus, Hercules' father, to ensure that these warring deities will never be able to harm the city again.
text: @P赫爾克利斯在納米爾殺死了一頭喫人無數的獅子，納米爾的領袖拉弗斯非常感激，和你結成了盟友。   @P而你以前的盟友亞馬遜女戰士和半人馬族都變成了敵人，現在你要攻佔半人馬族的要塞佩里歐，讓他們知道你的厲害。   @P不過，阿波羅、波賽東和赫菲斯托斯正準備報復你，你最好請出赫爾克利斯的父親宙斯確保城市的安全。

original: This far off land, located on the outskirts of the Amazon kingdom, is rumored to have rich deposits of copper ore.
text: 這裏已經是亞馬遜王國的邊境地區，據說蘊藏着大量的銅礦。

original: @PTraders from the Amazon city of Cyme have told you about this spot, and it is exactly as they described: rich in copper ore.  Certainly no one from Greece has ever ventured into this area, and it is rumored that the Amazon capital is nearby.  If the gods hear that you've discovered the city, one of them just might ask you to find something else...
text: @P據說亞馬遜王國的科萊姆地區盛產銅礦，不過這兒可能不太安全。如果神明知悉了你的行動，可能會要求你幫他們找些東西。

original: It's strange that no one has settled at Lerna. It's well-known for its fertile land and fish-filled lake. What could be keeping people away?
text: 勒爾納地區土地肥沃，風調雨順，但爲什麼沒有人願意來到這裏生活？

original: @PLerna is a place of great beauty, with fertile land perfect for the cultivation of olive trees and grapevines and a lake filled with plentiful fish - a perfect paradise except for one tiny little multi-headed problem. The hideous Hydra stalks the shores of the lake, destroying anything that comes in its path.  Only your friend Hercules is strong enough to dispatch this creature, and rumor has it Aphrodite is looking for a hero to help her find some vegetable or fruit or something.  The gods can be so hard to understand.
text: @P九頭蛇許德拉佔據了勒爾納地區的湖泊，害得當地人無家可歸。看來只有請你的朋友赫爾克利斯出馬剷除這隻怪獸了。另外，聽說愛芙羅黛蒂可能會要求你找些東西。

original: Rocky Lemnos looks like the world turned inside out. Silver and marble, which usually reside deep inside the earth, have risen to the surface.
text: 拉諾斯地區的礦產資源豐富，而且都在地表，非常容易開採。

original: @PPoor Lemnos was in the wrong place at the wrong time.  Once, Hephaestus enraged Zeus by disobeying him.  Zeus cast Hephaestus to the earth from high atop Mount Olympus.  Unfortunately for Lemnos, Hephaestus landed right on top of it, and the impact stirred up the land so that what once used to lie beneath it was now on top of it. @PWhen Hephaestus tried to stand up after his fall, he found that he had been lamed!  It was useless for Hephaestus to try to retaliate against Zeus - after all, tangling with Zeus was what got him into this mess in the first place.  So, Hephaestus decided to take his anger out on the island that broke his fall, and he has been pounding the land ever since. @L@PDue to the strange geography of Lemnos, getting food to your people can be very time consuming. If your population grows too large, you'll have trouble feeding everybody.
text: @P赫菲斯托斯因爲違抗宙斯的命令而被趕下奧林匹亞山，他正巧落在了拉諾斯地區，於是那些地下的礦產都被震到地面上來了。 @P爲了泄憤，赫菲斯托斯不斷敲打着這片土地。 @L@P鑑於這個地區嚴酷的地理環境，食物的生產會受到一定的限制。

original: @PYou have taken the first step on your journey to fame!  Now, it's time to leave Tiryns in the hands of your capable deputy, Eurystheus, and spread your influence to another area of the world.
text: @P你的第一個任務已經完成了，是時候離開塔尼斯，繼續開拓領土了。

original: @PThanks to Perseus, the Kraken has been slain, and Tiryns is once again safe!  Now that the city is peaceful again, it is time to set forth and found a new colony.
text: @P珀耳修斯殺死了海妖，塔尼斯終於安全了！現在你可以開闢一個新的殖民地了。

original: @PYou've managed to secure Tiryns from danger for now, but the Centaurs are bound to have more tricks up their sleeves...or wherever it is that Centaurs hide their tricks.  Now, the thrill of building a new city beckons.  Eurystheus will keep an eye on the city while you establish another colony to provide the supplies that Tiryns needs.
text: @P要保證塔尼斯的安全，你必須建造一座新的城市以保證塔尼斯的物資供應。你不在的時候，歐律斯會爲你管理塔尼斯城。

original: @PWith Mount Pelion serving you, your empire has again grown!  Zeus now guards the city, and Apollo, Hephaestus and Poseidon have gone away to see if they can cause trouble someplace else.  All is well in the kingdom of Tiryns!
text: @P佩里歐成爲了你的領土！有了宙斯的保護，別的神明不敢再來搗亂了！

original: @PEphesus thrives, and Artemis certainly got what she wanted, but now the entire Amazon nation is incensed at the theft of Hippolyte's Girdle!  These fierce women will follow you to the ends of the earth to make your life miserable!
text: @P普索斯城開始迅速發展，而阿緹蜜絲也得到了想要的東西。不過亞馬遜女戰士們看來是不會善罷甘休的！

original: @PHercules has removed the hideous blemish that defaced Lerna!  The Hydra has been dispatched, and the shores are now safe.  Aphrodite smiles this day, for she has the Golden Apples of the Hesperides in her clutches.
text: @P赫爾克利斯殺死了九頭蛇許德拉，人們歡呼雀躍。另外，愛芙羅黛蒂也非常高興，因爲她得到了金蘋果。

original: Lemnos is flourishing, providing valuable goods for Tiryns, and Aphrodite has calmed Hephaestus...for now.
text: 拉諾斯開始迅速發展，而愛芙羅黛蒂也設法使赫菲斯托斯安靜下來。

original: @PZeus has put a curse on your family, the house of Aeolus, decreeing that it shall never rule an empire.  There is only one way to lift the curse, and you will need the help of three of Greece's most famous heroes.  Theseus purportedly knows more about this curse, but Hades is holding the hero captive in the Underworld, and the great god will loose Cerberus upon anyone who dares to interfere with his plans for Theseus! @PMeanwhile, all of Greece is talking over the Centaurs' latest antics at Pirithous' wedding.  Intoxicated as usual, the Centaurs ruined the ceremony when they tried to carry off the bride!  Now, the Centaurs are on a drunken rampage through Greece, looking for more wine, and leaders of cities everywhere are jealously hoarding their supplies of the beverage.  You would be wise to do the same should you receive some.
text: @P宙斯對你的家族很不滿意，對你們下了詛咒。爲了解除這個詛咒，你必須找到希臘最偉大的3個英雄。目前忒修斯被黑帝斯關在地獄裏，而且讓地獄惡犬刻耳柏洛斯看守着他！ @P半人馬族正在四處收購葡萄酒，許多城主都在藉機大賺特賺，你也應該趕快撈一把。

original: @PThe immortals are quite busy these days!  Dionysus has become aware that you were instrumental in freeing Theseus from the Underworld!  The god is quite pleased by this news, because he needs Theseus' help.  Who knows?  Maybe if you can convince Theseus to help Dionysus, the god of the vine might reward you. @PUnlike Dionysus, Artemis is completely fed up with mortals.  It seems that a goddess cannot bathe anywhere any more without some mortal peeping at her.
