The goddess is so completely disgusted that she's decided to release her entire collection of oversized stags, boars, horses, lions and hares into the world to vent her fury on all mortals. @L@PIf you ever find yourself in need of Theseus' help, you should know that his Hall must be located close to the city's Palace.  After you build the Hall, right-click on it to see if you have built it close enough.
text: @P狄俄尼索斯知道你要救忒修斯之後非常高興，可能他是需要忒修斯爲他辦件什麼事吧。如果你能說服忒修斯幫助他，他可能會有所回報。 @P阿緹蜜絲的心情卻很差，她洗澡的時候老是被人偷看。她一怒之下放出各種野獸到處破壞。 @L@P要讓忒修斯幫助你，你必須首先爲他建造府邸。

original: @PBefore Theseus left your city, he told you a sad story: 'Once, two children, Phrixus and Helle, were in grave danger and tried to escape across the sea on the back of a golden, winged ram.  Helle lost her grip on the animal and plunged into the sea, but Phrixus managed to hold on.  When he arrived in Colchis, he sacrificed the ram to Zeus and gave King Aeetes, Colchis' ruler, the fleece. Retrieve the Golden Fleece, and Zeus' curse will be lifted, but returning the Fleece to Greece - hee hee, that rhymes! - won't be easy.  You'll require the services of a third, great hero.' @PIn other news, Hercules has been busy scaring birds away from Stymphalus.  These weren't your garden-variety sparrows!  These were huge, ravenous birds that weren't picky about what they put in their beaks: animals, crops, humans - everything tasted good to them.  Luckily, Hercules managed to drive the birds away with Hephaestus' castanets - though no one is sure if it was the noise of the castanets that scared the birds off, or the flamenco that Hercules performed as an accompaniment.  Regardless, Agapenor, the leader of Stymphalus, is very thankful for Hercules' help.  @L@PWhen you honor Athena with a Sanctuary, she will plant a sacred grove of olive trees for your citizens, and you can ask her for gifts of olives and olive oil.  You will certainly need her help to succeed here.
text: @P忒修斯告訴你，要解除宙斯的詛咒，你必須在另一位英雄的幫助下找到金羊毛。 @P此外，赫爾克利斯趕走了危害斯特夫城的巨鳥，城市的領袖阿格普納非常感激。  @L@P如果你爲雅典娜建造聖所，她會爲你建造一個橄欖園，增加橄欖油的產量。

original: @PIolcus is on the verge of becoming the pre-eminent power in all of Greece.  With a colony to call your own, you have begun to build a kingdom.  Now, you must spread your influence throughout Greece, making friends with those who treat you with respect and putting down those who oppose you.  As you near the end of your journey, Iolcus will shine forth, and its power will not be eclipsed.   @PIt is now time to thank Zeus for lifting the curse on your house and enabling you to become a great leader.  Building a Sanctuary in his honor is sure to please him, and he will smile upon you.
text: @P魯爾克城具有絕佳的發展潛力，你決定把它建成一個大都市。   @P宙斯已經取消了對你的家族的詛咒，你應該爲他建造一座聖所表達感激之情。

original: Located on Sickle Island, Corcyra is a beautiful and fertile land that is sacred to both Demeter and Dionysus.
text: 斯克爾島上的科爾拉城是狄蜜特和狄俄尼索斯的聖地。

original: @PThe island of Corcyra is Dionysus' gift to you for helping him retrieve the Horn of Amalthea. The island is the home of his nurse, Macris, who is also one of Demeter's favorite nymphs.  As a result, this land is doubly blessed - it is perfect for the cultivation of both grapes and wheat.  Dionysus is feeling generous and might reward you even further if you build a Sacred Grove in his honor.
text: @P狄俄尼索斯把科爾拉城送給你作爲禮物，這個城市非常適合種植葡萄和小麥。如果你能爲狄俄尼索斯建造一座聖所，他一定會有所表示的。

original: Corinth's central location within Greece makes it the perfect site for a strong military base.
text: 科林斯位於希臘的中心地帶，是兵家必爭之地。

original: @PBeing an adventurous hero is a double-edged sword.  On the one hand, there's the thrill of dangerous challenges in far off lands.  On the other hand, things become tiresome and dull quickly.   It wasn't long before Jason's eyes wandered away from his wife, the sorceress Medea, to a new, more exciting visage.  Jason, completely smitten with the new woman, left Medea. Now, Medea is in a rage.  She has already killed her sons by Jason and the father of Jason's new wife.  Still bloodthirsty, she has decided to exact revenge on you, too.  After all, if you had never sent Jason to retrieve the Golden Fleece, she would still be in Colchis.  The sorceress was last seen racing toward the Amazon city of Lemnos in a chariot pulled by two fiery dragons to find solace with the warrior women!
text: @P伊阿宋迷上了一個年輕漂亮的女人，這使得他的妻子美狄亞嫉妒得發狂。她殺死了和他所生的子女，甚至殺死了那個女人的父親。看來她還會對付你。據說她這些天在亞馬遜的拉諾斯城。

original: @PThanks to you and Hercules, Theseus has returned from the Underworld and is again roaming the Greek countryside looking for adventure.  He has sent word to you that the key to unlocking Iolcus' full potential lies in the far-off land of Colchis.
text: @P在你和赫爾克利斯的幫助下，忒修斯重回人間。他告訴你，要發展魯爾克城，就必須奪取科林斯城。

original: @PDionysus is indeed quite grateful that you have helped him retrieve the Horn of Amalthea, and there may be still more reward from Dionysus in the future.  The god has been spotted on Sickle Island, the home of his beloved nurse Macris, and he has been overheard saying that he is preparing a place for you, if you want it.
text: @P狄俄尼索斯非常欣賞你，他把科爾拉城送給你作爲禮物。

original: At last, Jason has brought the Golden Fleece safely back to Greece!  He has returned from Colchis with King Aeetes' powerful daughter, Medea, as his wife.   @PZeus has lifted the curse on your house, and it is now time to begin your own journey and build a kingdom.  The road before you forks. Will you choose the way of the sickle and build an economic powerhouse, or will you choose the way of the sword and build a military machine?  Corcyra, a fertile island, promises many resources that will help Iolcus thrive.  Corinth will provide you with a strong foothold from which you can exercise your might over all of Greece.
text: 伊阿宋不但帶回了金羊毛，而且娶到了美麗的公主美狄亞。   @P宙斯取消了對你的家族的詛咒，現在你可以大展拳腳了。你有兩條路可以走：發展斯克爾城，建立一個經濟中心；或者發展科林斯城，建立一個軍事中心。

original: Now, Iolcus is truly a powerful kingdom.  Nearly all of the cities in Greece call you either friend or master, and Zeus looks with pride upon the city of Iolcus and its capable leader.
text: 魯爾克已經成爲一個強大的王國，所有的領袖都主動要求和你結盟，而宙斯對你的表現也非常滿意。

original: @PDionysus has indeed blessed you, granting you his city of Eretria.  Corcyra is bustling, and it is time to return to Iolcus.  You have entrusted your new city to Alcinous and hope that he proves to be a capable and resourceful leader.
text: @P科爾拉的發展非常順利，你準備把這裏交給阿爾希諾斯打理，自己返回魯爾克。

original: @PCorinth's loyal fighting men are more than capable of defending their homes from harm.  Now it is time to return to mighty Iolcus and establish the city's dominance in Greece once and for all.  Your trusted general, Corinthus, will lead the city in your absence.
text: @P科林斯城爲你的王國奠定了穩固的軍事基礎，你把這座城市交給科林斯打理，自己返回魯爾克。

original: @PIn a time of darkness, Discord reigned in Greece and the people lived apart from each other.  Now, a new day is dawning, and the time has come for a leader to rise up and, for the first time, draw the people together, uniting them in a mighty city.  Zeus himself has selected you to achieve this remarkable feat and has pointed you to a site in the Argolid.  The city's name will be Argos.  People will flock to the city in the hopes of learning a trade and feeding their families, and they will expect you to provide for them.  @POther would-be leaders in Greece are also trying to start new cities.  Some of them will achieve a modicum of success, while others will fail completely.  You might encounter them in your journeys.
text: @P宙斯命令你在阿格里德建立一個繁榮的城市，把希臘各地的人民團結起來，讓他們過上幸福美滿的生活。  @P據說其他一些領袖也在向這個目標努力，他們都是你的競爭對手。

original: @PArgos is beginning to thrive, and you are learning more about the bounties that the land offers.  The time has come to build a Palace that will serve as the staff around which the scattered people of Greece will gather.  It is also time to begin collecting taxes from your people to help pay for the services that your city provides.  @PUp on Mount Olympus, the Tribunal of the River Gods has just come to order.  'We have come to a decision in this dispute,' the head of the Tribunal announced. 'And, though both parties presented convincing cases, we have no choice but to award Argos to Hera, wife of Zeus.  Sorry, Poseidon.'  As Hera jumped up and down in glee, Poseidon's brow furrowed, and his face became stormy.  Under his breath, he vowed that if he couldn't have Argos, no one could!  You might have to turn to Hera's husband for protection from the ruler of the sea!
text: @P要讓阿戈斯城快速發展，你要建造一座宮殿，它會提高你的聲望，而且可以讓你收稅。  @P奧林匹亞山的仲裁會把阿戈斯城判給了赫拉，這使得波賽東非常不滿，他準備毀掉阿戈斯城。看來你只能依靠赫拉的丈夫宙斯來幫助你了。

original: @PPoseidon continues his onslaught on Argos and is determined to destroy the city, and word around the Agora is that the god might also enlist the aid of one of his consorts to turn your city to stone! Only Perseus, who is off founding the city of Mycenae, will be able to help you slay this monster.  But even this worthy hero won't be able to defeat the creature by himself.  He will need some magical items to vanquish this unsightly foe. @L@PSome clever herders have discovered how to tame the wild goat.  At a Dairy, the goat's rich milk can be made into succulent cheese that your citizens find quite tasty.
text: @P波賽東爲了毀滅阿戈斯城，派出了自己手下的怪物。現在你唯一的希望就是讓英雄珀耳修斯幫助你，不過你首先要爲他找到一些魔法道具。 @L@P你的手下發現了飼養野生山羊的方法。山羊奶可以製成美味的奶酪。

original: The Gorgon, or The Bad Hair Day

@PJust as you are about to bring Argos into its full glory, some long-promised trouble has reared its ugly head.  That ugly head belongs to Medusa, a consort of Poseidon, who has taken up the god's cause and vows to crush Argos!  If you don't find a way to vanquish the Gorgon, she might soon turn your entire city to stone!  @PAs you find a way to slay the horrible beast, you must continue to guide Argos to its destiny.  Diverse people continue to come to your city from far and near, and they will want diverse gods to worship.  You should also take care of your colonies, making sure that they both enjoy all the resources available to Argos.  The city will be a shining example of what can be achieved when people band together.
text: @P波賽東不會善罷甘休，他派出了蛇髮女妖美杜莎來攻擊阿戈斯城。如果你不趕快想個辦法，所有人都會變成石頭！  @P隨着城市人口的增加，你的責任越來越重大。爲了保證物資供應，你要好好管理周圍的殖民地。

original: Calydon is a rich and fertile region, noted for its fine vineyards.  But, nothing is ever as good as it seems.

Life has been tough on Artemis lately.  First, her beloved Kernyeian Hind, a majestic stag, was wounded by Hercules who was trying to capture the animal.  Then, the people in and around the region of Calydon refused to worship her properly.  The depressed Artemis turned to her menagerie of animals for solace and, when she saw her mighty boar, snorting and snarling in his pen, her eyes lit up, and a small smile played across her face...
text: 阿緹蜜絲心愛的鹿最近被赫爾克利斯在打獵時誤傷，而卡利多的人又拒絕供奉她，她決定派野豬卡利多尼恩去報復。

original: No one knows much about the land of Miletos, located across the sea, far to the east. But, many great nations thrive in this land, so it must have much to offer. Hopefully, all the nations surrounding this site will be friendly...
text: 米蘭託在遙遠的東方，很少有人到過這片土地，但據說它非常富饒。

original: @PNo Greek has ventured this far east before, across the great sea, and you'll have to tread very softly to start a city in this land.  Great nations shoulder against each other here, and they'll be suspicious of you, a newcomer.  Cassiopeia, Queen of Ethiopia, will be particularly annoyed that you have come near her territory.  But she has much bigger things to worry about.  Ever the proud mother, Cassiopeia boasted that her own daughter, Andromeda, is more beautiful than Poseidon's daughters, the Nereids.  Now, Andromeda is to be fed to the Kraken, and Cassiopeia is devastated. If you can find a way to rescue Andromeda, the powerful Cassiopeia will certainly appreciate it, and you may gain a valuable friend. @PThe fleet-footed Hermes has also been spotted in the area, looking for Perseus.  The god says that he's seen an item in his travels that Perseus might find useful... @L@PWhile the Kraken roams free, life along the water might be difficult, and trade might be prone to disruption.  Look to other cities, even your rivals, for the things you need. Worshiping the gods also can be a boon to you, as many of their sanctuaries have valuable resources of their own.
text: @P這片土地對你這樣一個外人來說是非常危險的，據說埃塞俄比亞女王卡西佩雅對你非常警惕。不過她最近遇到了麻煩，她聲稱自己的女兒亞德米娜比波賽東的女兒還漂亮，結果遭到了波賽東的懲罰。如果你能救出亞德米娜，卡西佩雅會非常感激你。 @P據說荷米斯也在附近，他要尋找珀耳修斯，據說他最近看到過一樣對珀耳修斯非常有用的東西。 @L@P這個地區目前資源短缺，你要儘量和周邊城市展開貿易。你也可以考慮建造聖所，某些聖所可以增加資源的產量。

original: @PArgos is on its way to becoming a great city, and even the residents of Mount Olympus have begun to take notice!
text: @P阿戈斯開始穩步發展，神明們開始對你另眼相看了！

original: @PIn spite of Poseidon's animosity, Argos continues to grow.  But, to become a truly powerful kingdom, Argos must expand its borders.
text: @P雖然波賽東不斷阻撓，但阿戈斯仍然不斷發展。爲了保證城市的安全，你要在周邊地區拓展領土。

original: @PWith your help, Perseus has obtained a shiny shield and some fine headwear that will prove invaluable to him and to you.  Argos' stature is continuing to rise, but for the city to reach its apex, you must again expand its borders.  It would be wise to establish this colony in an area of the world distant from your first colony to avail yourself of the resources of different regions.  Your two colonies, however, will be so far from each other that their only contact with each other will be through Argos.
text: @P在你的幫助下，珀耳修斯得到了雅典娜神盾和黑帝斯的隱身帽。爲了謀求進一步的發展，你要到遙遠的地方再建立一座城市。

original: @PThrough deft use of Athena's Mirror Shield, Hades' Helmet of Invisibility, and Hermes' Winged Sandals, Perseus has slain Medusa, saving Argos from a cold fate! You have guided Argos to its zenith, inspiring other leaders around Greece to gather people together and start cities of their own.
text: @P珀耳修斯利用雅典娜神盾、黑帝斯隱身帽和荷米斯飛行靴殺死了美杜莎，拯救了阿戈斯！你的成功激勵了希臘各地的領袖，他們紛紛開始建造自己的城市。

original: @PIn spite of the many attacks by Artemis' Boar, you have built a thriving colony that will ensure that Argos never wants for luscious grapes.  The city will also provide sculpture from the Centaur outpost of Mount Pelion.  And, the boar that was a frequent and unwelcome guest will forever bear the name of the city and henceforth be known as the Calydonian Boar.
text: @P雖然阿緹蜜絲的野豬不斷搗亂，但是你仍然成功建立了一個殖民地，它能爲阿戈斯提供許多資源。

original: @PMiletos makes a fine addition to your empire.  The city is well respected by Cyprus, Egypt and Phoenicia, all of which eagerly trade with Miletos to obtain the finest Greek goods.  Through Miletos, Argos will have access to the valuable goods that these three nations provide. Queen Cassiopeia is eternally grateful for your role in saving her daughter from a horrible death, and she has cast her lot with yours. As you leave Miletos, she has graciously offered to look after the colony in your absence.  @PPerseus now has in his possession the Winged Sandals.  The footwear could come in very handy in the near future.
text: @P米蘭託成爲你的王國中又一個重要的城市，它大大加強了你和非洲各國的貿易往來。卡西佩雅非常感激你救了她的女兒，在你離開的時候她會替你掌管城市。  @P珀耳修斯得到了荷米斯飛行靴，它不久就會發揮重要的作用了。

original: @PThe conversation at the dinner table turned from the subject of the city you were on the verge of establishing to the fair Helen, beloved of everyone in Greece, who was about to choose a husband.  Odysseus said, 'Let us all swear an oath to protect Helen from harm and to support the man whom she chooses as a husband!  We owe her no less!  We shall name the oath after Helen's father and call it the Oath of Tyndareus!'  All shouted in assent, and Odysseus administered the oath to each person.  Everyone was too busy celebrating to notice that Odysseus did not take the oath himself, but the hero wouldn't have less than noble intentions. @PNow that the festivities are over, you must return to your land to begin building the kingdom of Aulis in earnest.  Soon, your city will match the cities that your friends Agammemnon, Odysseus and Ajax lead!  You can count on your friends sending you 'city-warming' presents to help you start your city!
text: @P在一次大型宴會上，著名的英雄奧德修斯建議在座的每個人都發誓永遠忠於希臘最美麗的女士海倫，也永遠忠於她的丈夫。他讓所有人都發了誓，但你注意到一點，不知是有意無意，奧德修斯本人並沒有發誓。 @P現在你要回到東方建設奧里斯王國，你的朋友奧德修斯、阿伽門農和阿賈克斯肯定會送些禮物給你的。

original: @PAt the wedding of Thetis and Peleus, Paris of Troy was asked to award a golden apple to the most beautiful goddess.  The contestants were Athena, Hera and Aphrodite.  'Very nice, ladies.  That concludes the talent portion of our competition.  Now, the interview: if you are crowned most beautiful goddess,' Paris asked the women, 'what will you do?'  Hera replied, 'If I win, I'll use my title to bring world peace and to help all the little animals.'  'If I win,' Athena said, 'I'll make sure that everyone has olive oil and bake everyone a batch of cookies!'  Finally, Aphrodite said, 'If you choose me, I'll arrange for you to take Helen, the most beautiful woman in Greece, as your wife.  I hope I win, because I just love golden apples!'  Paris carefully considered each goddess' answer, but, intrigued by the prospect of being married to the most beautiful woman in Greece, chose Aphrodite.  It wasn't long before Paris found Helen, tore her away from her husband, and brought her back to Troy. @PNow, Menelaus has declared war on Troy, and everyone bound by the Oath of Tyndareus is rallying to his side, and other leaders have taken up Troy's part. Calchas the seer had this to say about the impending war: 'Though rescuing fair Helen may seem simple, be forewarned that many obstacles will stand in your way.  Many will be old and gray by the time they return home.' @PAgammemnon and his soldiers have already left Greece to attack Troy, but Troy's walls, built by Apollo and Poseidon, are incredibly strong.  Only an intense, continual siege will be enough to break through the walls, and this type of onslaught will only be possible if the Greeks have a camp close to Troy.  But, maybe Agammemnon will be lucky... @POn the home front, you must prepare for further attacks on Troy by asking other cities to give what they can to you to support the war effort.
text: @P特洛伊的王子帕里斯要從三位女神中選出一個最漂亮的，'請問如果你成爲選美皇后，會做些什麼？'赫拉說：'我會維護世界和平，並且呼籲大家都來愛護小動物。'雅典娜說：'我會爲所有人送上我用橄欖油親手製成的餅乾。'愛芙羅黛蒂說：'我會讓你得到希臘最美麗的女人海倫。'帕里斯立刻選擇了愛芙羅黛蒂，並且在她的幫助下拐走了海倫。 @P希臘國王墨涅拉俄斯立即發動了對特洛伊的戰爭。先知告訴國王：'這場戰爭將艱苦卓絕，曠日持久。' @P特洛伊的城牆無比堅固，因爲那是阿波羅和波賽東爲他們建造的。希臘軍隊認識到短期內無法攻克特洛伊城，於是決定在附近建立一座城市作爲基地。 @P你要爲希臘提供後援，同時號召附近的其它城市多提供一些物資。

original: @PJust outside the walls of Troy, the Greek army captured an old man named Helenus.  Like most old men in Greece, Helenus was a great seer, and he weighed in with his two drachmas:  'Did anyone mention the Palladium yet?  There is an object held within Troy's walls, an object that Poseidon himself gave to the city when he was building its walls.  Troy will never fall as long as it has possession of this object. You'll need to retrieve this object if you want to win the war.' @POnly Odysseus, grandson of the master thief Autolycus, will be able to retrieve this magical object, and the great hero has been acting quite strangely lately.  He is the only great leader who has yet to participate in the war effort against Troy, pointing out that he never swore the Oath of Tyndareus.  Later, he was spotted laughing hysterically, sowing salt into earth around his Palace, rendering it infertile.  Crazy or not, Odysseus is the only one who can help.  Maybe if you offer him plenty of wine and olive oil and a lovely Hall to call home, he'll come to Aulis, though who knows what will happen to Ithaca if he leaves the city behind...
text: @P先知告訴你，特洛伊城裏有一座雅典娜神像，只要它還在特洛伊城裏，你就永遠無法攻破這座城池。 @P要偷雅典娜神像，只有一個合適的人選，那就是奧德修斯，不過他聲稱自己當初沒有發過誓言，所以不想參加特洛伊戰爭。不過如果你給他足夠的葡萄酒和橄欖油，再爲他建造一座漂亮的府邸，難說他不會改變主意。

original: @PIt's just crazy enough to work.  Odysseus' plan to break through the walls of Troy is ridiculous, but thus far, more traditional methods have failed.  Odysseus' plan is to build a huge wooden animal and fill it with the most skilled soldiers in the Greek army.  The Trojans will drag the wooden animal into the city themselves, and, under cover of night, the soldiers will attack the city from within.  Then, you can send more soldiers to attack Troy.  This two-pronged attack is sure to succeed.  Now, the only thing left is to decide which animal to build.  A badger? No, too small.  A rabbit? No, it's been done.  A puppy? No, too cute.  What about a horse?
text: @P特洛伊城久攻不下，奧德修斯提議建造一個巨型木馬送給特洛伊人，然後佯裝退兵。到了晚上，木馬裏藏着的士兵和城外的大軍裏應外合，肯定可以一舉成功。雖然大家認爲這個計劃非常冒險，但沒人有更好的主意了。

original: Tenedos is the perfect site for a military base, but is not well-suited for much else.
text: 你準備把忒尼德建造成一個強大的軍事基地。

original: @PCalchas the seer had this to say: 'To successfully conquer Troy, you'll need the help of the hero Achilles.  Achilles was once a willing participant in the war, but Agammemnon managed to offend him somehow...heroes can be so touchy.  You'll have to gently convince him to return to the fray, and maybe the gods will help you convince Achilles to fight.' @PWhile you try to convince Achilles to return to the fighting, you should build Tenedos into a strong military base that will help you conquer Troy.  Since it is devoid of natural resources, you'll have to rely on others to acquire the goods you need for the city.  You can always ask your friends for the supplies you need, and you can of course raid your rivals.  Naturally, Troy won't stand idly by and let you build a military stronghold in its backyard.  The Trojans just might turn to their favorite son, Hector, to cause you trouble.  Of course, the big, strong Hector is a favorite with Aphrodite... @L@PRemember that Calchas also prophesied that many men will be old and gray before they return home. Building a military base that can challenge Troy will take a long time.
text: @P先知說道：'要想攻克特洛伊城，必須靠阿基裡斯的幫助。'最近阿基裡斯在和阿伽門農鬧矛盾，你要想辦法說服他來幫忙。 @P現在你要開始建設忒尼德城了，這個城市附近缺少資源，所以你要和周邊城市加強交流。當然特洛伊人是不會對你的行動聽之任之的，他們派出了英雄赫克託耳來對付你。 @L@P要建造一個強大的軍事基地可能會需要很長的時間。

original: Anything built here, deep in Ionia, will certainly draw the attention of gods and mortals alike.
text: 看來連宙斯也要被牽涉進這場戰爭了。

original: @PThe seer from the oracle have yet another prophecy: 'Thus far, Zeus has been on the sidelines of this great war.  Build him a Sanctuary, and he will gladly join your side.  The Trojans won't stand a chance. Build a Sanctuary to the great goddess Athena, too, and she will protect the city from harm.' @POf course, building a Sanctuary to Zeus in the heart of Ionia is bound to rile up the gods that have taken Troy's side, and they won't be too thrilled about the Sanctuary to Athena, either.  They won't hesitate to make your life miserable and do what they can to prevent you from constructing the Sanctuary.  It would be wise to begin construction on the Sanctuaries as soon as you can.  The sooner you have both these gods firmly in your corner, the better off you'll be.  @L@PYou may need to rely on your allies or even your rivals for the things you need to make the city thrive.
text: @P先知建議你爲宙斯和雅典娜建造聖所，有了他們的幫助，你將戰無不勝。 @P當然，也有不少神明是站在特洛伊這邊的，如果你不盡快建造聖所讓宙斯和雅典娜來保護城市，後果不堪設想。  @L@P你需要大量資源，可以向盟軍索要，也可以考慮從敵方城市搶奪。

original: @PAulis is well on its way to becoming one of the greatest cities in all of Greece!  Yet, there is a hint of trouble in the air.  Helen has chosen to wed King Menelaus of Sparta, and the happy couple have settled into their home.  While everything seems to be exactly as it should be, word around Greece is that Helen might not be safe.
text: @P奧里斯很快就會成爲希臘最偉大的城市之一！不過現在好像出了點麻煩，海倫嫁給了斯巴達國王墨涅拉俄斯，有傳言說她可能會有危險。

original: @PThe walls of Troy have thus far withstood the Greek attack.  All of Greece's leaders have agreed that building a base of operations in Ionia will be the only way to carry the day at Troy and return Helen to her husband. @PMeanwhile, rumblings of discontent have been heard in the cities that great leaders have left behind to fight Troy.  In Mycenae, Agammemnon's wife Clytemnestra has been whispering seditious tales in the ears of anyone who will listen...
text: @P特洛伊的城牆太堅固了，希臘的將軍們準備在愛奧尼亞建立一個強大的軍事基地進行長期戰爭。 @P同時，希臘的大後方開始出現各種奇怪的謠言，而阿伽門農的妻子似乎和這一切有關。

original: @PThe crafty Odysseus has retrieved the Palladium, the first step in weakening Troy.  He has been heard talking about an ingenious plan to break through the walls of Troy, though one must remember that Odysseus doesn't always make a lot of sense.  @PWith Odysseus away from Ithaca, scores of suitors have descended upon the city, hoping to convince the fair Penelope, Odysseus' wife, to reject her sometimes batty husband and choose another.  Choked by the vast number of suitors in the city, Penelope has had no choice but to remove Ithaca from the world's stage until she finds a way to deal with all the suitors.
text: @P足智多謀的奧德修斯成功偷到了雅典娜神像，看來特洛伊的覆滅只是時間問題了。據說奧德修斯最近在計劃一次大膽的行動，要一舉攻佔特洛伊城。  @P奧德修斯不在家的時候，許多人都乘機追求他的妻子帕妮羅，她爲了尋求清靜，關閉了整座城市。

original: @PYou have sacked Troy, and Helen has been returned to her husband in Sparta.  Now, all the Greek leaders are headed back to their kingdoms, all of which have suffered in their absences.  Only your city of Aulis has managed to retain its previous glory.
text: @P特洛伊城終於被攻破了，希臘的將士們凱旋而歸，而奧里斯將蓬勃發展。

original: @PTenedos has grown into a powerful military base that is sure to help you conquer Troy.  Agammemnon will stay on here to direct some of the military efforts, even though his own city has fallen into disarray under the leadership of his wife, Clytemnestra.  Rumor has it that Clytemnestra has even taken a lover and no longer offers support to the war effort.   @PIn one of Tenedos' first triumphs, the city of Lyrnessus was taken.  The city incurred heavy losses in its fall, though, and its defenses are weak.  Now, it is time to return to Aulis.
text: @P忒尼德已經成爲一個強大的軍事基地，希臘軍隊統帥阿伽門農將在這兒坐鎮。但是目前後方出了大亂子，阿伽門的妻子背叛了他，她大權在握之後表示不會再爲前線提供物資。   @P攻克了勒尼索城之後，你決定返回奧里斯。

original: Many cities in Ionia have taken notice of the beautiful Sanctuary dedicated to Zeus in Pergamum.  Seeking to worship the greatest of all the gods, Ascania has declared its desire to be your loyal subject forever.  Many of their soldiers have even given up on the fighting life to worship Zeus.
text: 宙斯聖所建成後，卡尼亞的戰士們出於對宙斯的崇敬，決定加入你的陣營。

original: @PThe land here is desolate and bare, but then so is most land in mountainous Greece.  It's as good a place as any to establish a city, and you have your good friend Theseus to help you.  He's out and about in Attica, visiting other small cities in the region and convincing them that they should place themselves under your wing.  Though the city of Athens itself might not have the resources to prosper, perhaps it can grow into a mighty city once it is banded together with its neighbors. @PThere's only one problem with claiming land in Attica.  Minos, king of Knossos and master of the Minotaur, calls this land his own and won't take too kindly to someone trying to build a new city upon it.
text: @P你決定在阿堤卡地區建造一座城市，命名爲雅典。你的朋友忒修斯不斷遊說附近的城市，要求他們和你結成聯盟，只要有了他們的幫助，雅典一定會迅速發展起來。 @P目前只有一個問題，科諾索國王彌諾斯聲稱這片土地是他的，不允許你建造城市。

original: @PMinos and his Minotaur, son of Minos' queen Pasiphae and a bull, still plague Athens.  The time has come to cast off these burdens for good to prove that Athens can stand on its own two feet.  You must call Theseus, who is still traveling around Attica, back to the city, for only he can help you vanquish the Minotaur.  You'll also need a sleek and powerful trireme to sail to Crete to defeat Minos.
text: @P彌諾斯和他手下的牛頭怪彌諾陶洛斯還在不斷騷擾雅典，你準備拜託忒修斯來對付彌諾陶洛斯，不過你首先要爲他準備一艘三層船。

original: @PWhat wise sage advised to hold your friends close and your enemies even closer?  Hippias, a coward exiled from Athens long ago, has whispered his plans to usurp you in the ear of Darius, King of Persia.  Hippias has promised Darius eternal servitude if the king agrees to help him!  Now, the battle has started, and Delos has entered the fray, revolting against the Persian city of Sardis.  The clarion call has been sounded throughout Greece, and most city-states have agreed to set aside their differences and unite in one Greek front to help Delos and turn back the Persians!  Only Sparta and Corinth have turned a deaf ear on the cry of our Greek brother!
text: @P希臘的叛徒希匹亞斯勾結了波斯國王大流士，在愛奧尼亞策動叛亂。大敵當前，希臘各城邦決定聯合抗敵，只有斯巴達和科林斯袖手旁觀。

original: @PDarius has indeed remembered the Athenians, and now he, his son Xerxes, and the entire Persian war machine are on their way to Greece to avenge the humiliating defeat we handed the barbarians!  Darius and the Persian fleet have cut a swath of destruction through the Aegean, and Xerxes and the Persian army, having already put down rebellions in Egypt and Babylonia, are marching towards us from the north.  Already, Mount Pelion and Ithome have submitted to the Persians. @PAfter a conference on the Isthmus of Corinth, all city-states in Greece have agreed to unite to face the latest barbarian threat.  Even Corinth and Sparta agreed to join the alliance, albeit reluctantly.  Even with all of Greece united, putting down the Persian military is a daunting task.
text: @P大流士沒有忘記失敗的恥辱，他調動了全波斯的軍隊，立誓要毀掉希臘。他們的軍隊非常強大，他們已經攻佔了佩里歐和依索姆城。 @P形勢萬分危急，現在斯巴達和科林斯也已經加入聯軍，但波斯軍隊仍然佔有絕對優勢。

original: @PYour old friend Theseus has one of the strangest habits.  He's never satisfied with his current wife and is always on the lookout for a new bride.  Antiope, sister of the Amazon queen, Hippolyte, is the latest woman to catch his eye, and he has abducted her.  The Amazon nation is not likely to stand idly by and just let their queen's sister go. @PMeanwhile, strange things are afoot in Sparta and Corinth.  Spies report that both cities are mobilizing their military forces for what can only be some troublesome purpose. The Oracle of Apollo will come in handy to help you keep a watchful eye on these cities, but ultimately, Sparta must be subdued if you are going to fulfill your destiny. @PIn the middle of all these troubles is Artemis.  The Amazons and Spartans are both her people, and she's bound to do something to help them both out.  Ares, too, loves these warlike people, so don't be surprised if he gets involved.
text: @P你的朋友忒修斯有個壞毛病，他喜歡沾花惹草，最近他拐走了亞馬遜女王希波呂忒的妹妹安蒂歐普，現在女王要大動干戈了。 @P同時，斯巴達和科林斯最近在不斷調動軍隊，你對他們非常警惕。也許阿波羅神喻能夠給你一些指示，不過你認爲和斯巴達的一戰已經不可避免。 @P更糟糕的是阿緹蜜絲和阿瑞斯站在他們這邊，他們會給你製造許多麻煩。

original: @PThe time has come to build Athens into the greatest city Greece - the world - has ever known.  Athens will be a center of culture and learning, and the greatest heroes will call the city home.  Only a few, monstrous obstacles remain between you and this glorious destiny.  Defeating these monsters could open up new possibilities for Athens. @PTheseus' womanizing habits continue to cause problems for those associated with him.  He and his best friend, Pirithous, have decided that they must marry daughters of Zeus.  Theseus has already made off with Helen from Sparta, and now Theseus and Pirithous are planning to raid the Underworld and steal Hades' wife, Persephone.  If Hades wouldn't let Persephone go back to her own mother, he surely won't give her up to Pirithous and Theseus! @PMeanwhile, Hercules has been off in the land of Elis, serving as King Augeas' stable boy.  He'll be looking for a new challenge soon, and Demeter might just have one for him.  Jealous of Artemis' menagerie of animals, she has been looking for some livestock to call her own.
text: @P你決心把雅典建設成世界上最偉大的城市。首先，你準備殺死那些爲害人間的怪物。 @P你那風流的朋友忒修斯膽子越來越大了，他竟然準備拐走黑帝斯的妻子珀爾塞福涅，黑帝斯可不是好惹的！ @P另外，據說狄蜜特最近準備委託赫爾克利斯尋找一種怪獸。

original: This harsh land has little to offer except rich deposits of silver ore.
text: 這片土地蘊藏着豐富的銀礦。

original: @PEstablishing a city here will be a boon to Athens.  There is plenty of silver ore to be had here, silver that can be minted into the drachmas that Athens will need to thrive.  Living here won't be easy, though, because the land is very unkind.
text: @P豐富的銀礦吸引你來到了這片土地，不過這兒的自然條件比較差。

original: This lonely, isolated land is blessed with plentiful wood, bronze and marble.
text: 這個孤島有大量的木材、銅礦和石料。

original: @PTheseus' dear friend Pirithous, leader of the Lapiths, happily wed Hippodamia in a sumptuous ceremony that featured the best food and wine that Greece has to offer.  When the thirsty Centaurs heard about the ceremony, they couldn't resist the prospect of drinking the delicious wine, and attended the ceremony uninvited.  Pirithous and Hippodamia graciously greeted the Centaurs at first, but Centaurs aren't known for their self-control, and they were soon completely drunk.  The besotted Centaurs then did the unthinkable: they attempted to kidnap the bride!  Pirithous was so outraged he has declared war on the Centaurs, and Theseus has beseeched us to provide Pirithous with the raw materials he needs to make armor to help them in their war.   @PAn outpost here in Amphipolis will be perfectly suited to provide the raw materials that Pirithous needs.  The Centaurs, however, are well aware of the bounty of the land around Amphipolis and may prove to be unwelcome visitors again.
text: @P忒修斯的朋友普里修斯和荷絲米娜結婚了，想不到半人馬族不請自來，而且喝醉之後竟然想搶走新娘。普里修斯一怒之下向半人馬族宣戰，你自然也不會袖手旁觀。   @P你要在安菲斯建造一座城市，爲普里修斯提供物資。你要當心半人馬族的偷襲。

original: In spite of King Minos, Athens is on its way to becoming a great city.  Already, several small cities in and around Attica consider you their friend or have placed themselves under your leadership.  But, Athens' growth will always be stunted as long as you suffer under the yoke of Minos.
text: 你已經成功地讓周圍幾個城市和你結盟了，但是如果不除掉彌諾斯，你將睡不安枕。

original: The people of Athens stand tall and proud today.  The man they used to call master is now their humble servant, and his grotesque stepson has been sent away from Greece's shores.  News of your achievements has spread through Greece like a wildfire, and Eretria and Odessos, in awe of your accomplishments, have willingly placed themselves under your leadership. Yet, the goods that these new subjects provide to Athens still aren't enough for the city to achieve greatness.  It is time to leave Athens behind and establish a new city.
text: 雅典城的威名如日中天，連拉西亞和奧得索斯都來要求和你結盟。爲了取得更大的成功，你準備暫時離開雅典，建立一座新的城市。

original: @PGreece's borders are secure from the Persian threat... for now.  Delos is once again a Greek city, and you had even brought Sardis under your control.  But Darius would not allow one of his most important cities to remain a subject to you and has snatched the city back.  Darius is so incensed at your actions that he has instructed his servant, under penalty of death, to repeat the words, 'Master, remember the Athenians,' three times, every time the King sits down for a meal.  You will certainly meet Darius again, and the oracle has enigmatically advised you to 'trust in a wall of wood.' @PTurning back the Persians brought most of Greece together, yet Sparta and Corinth remained aloof and have even declared themselves Athens' rivals!
text: @P波斯軍隊被打敗了，不過大流士並不甘心失敗，他正策劃着捲土重來。 @P希臘又將聯合起來對抗波斯，不過斯巴達和科林斯不但不幫忙，還要與你爲敵。

original: @PThe taste of this most unbelievable victory is truly sweet!  In spite of the overwhelming odds against us, we've defeated the Persians once and for all.  Cities that had been conquered by Persia have returned to the fold, and the Persian city of Hattusas calls you master. @PIn spite of the great victory that the city-states of Greece achieved together, Sparta and Corinth have again turned their backs on you.
text: @P希臘人民同心同德，戰勝了不可一世的波斯軍隊。被佔領的土地光復了，波斯城市哈特薩也投降了希臘。 @P雖然你取得了巨大的勝利，但斯巴達和科林斯仍然對你極不友好。

original: With Sparta defeated, Athens has become the most prominent city in Greece.
text: 斯巴達被打敗了，雅典成爲希臘最偉大的城市。

original: Athens, the golden city, is a jewel in the Greek countryside.  People from around the world flock to it to drink in its beauty and partake of its diverse cultural offerings.
text: 雅典迅速成爲整個希臘的經濟、文化和政治中心。

original: The Laurion mines give Athens the economic stability it so desperately needs.
text: 勞倫地區的豐富礦產加快了雅典的發展。

original: With the Centaurs firmly under control, Amphipolis will be a reliable source of the goods Athens needs to build a powerful military.
text: 半人馬族被打敗了，安菲斯成爲保護雅典的軍事基地。

original: @PFollow a cow?  The priestess from the Oracle said to follow a cow?  A peculiar command, to be sure, but then the priestess is never wrong.  She promised that great things would come to the person who follows her cow until it lays down to sleep, and then builds a city on the spot.  This person will be able to achieve something that four powerful men failed to achieve and finally bring Europa back to Greece.  The beautiful Europa was abducted years ago by a white bull and has not been seen since.  And thus, the priestess' bovine-centric prophecy came to an end.   @PThe cow did not choose a very good spot.  She fell asleep a short distance from a hideous multi-headed serpent that purportedly belongs to Ares.  The monster is always ravenously hungry and eats everything that comes near him!  Building a city here won't be easy, but the promised reward is irresistible!
text: @P你的公主是個預言家，她讓你緊緊跟隨牛羣探險。如果你能在牛羣停下休息的地方建造一座城市，將來就能建立不朽的功勳。   @P牛羣停下的地方實在不太安全，那裏附近盤踞着阿瑞斯手下的兇殘的巨龍。但是爲了實現公主的預言，你將克服一切艱難險阻！

original: @PThe time has come.  Ares' multi-headed serpent will not leave Thebes alone, and as the city grows, the monster is bound to cause more trouble, plus you could really use some of that marble it seems to be guarding.   For the good of the city, the serpent must be slain.  No ordinary human can perform this extraordinary task, however.  You will need the help of a hero!
text: @P看來巨龍是不會讓你在它的巢穴附近建造城市的。你準備尋找一名英雄來消滅巨龍，如果能夠成功，你還可以得到巨龍守護着的大理石。

original: @PThe wise goddess Athena offered this advice: 'Ares is indeed going to be upset by the loss of that serpent. He has this thing for serpents - single headed, double-headed, dunder-headed - it doesn't matter, he loves them all.  And, he really liked how the sun glistened off all those heads.  But, do you know what Ares likes almost as much as serpents?  Big, big Sanctuaries built just for him!  He likes to conduct what he calls 'ambush practice' in a Sanctuary's twisting halls, but to most it seems like he's playing hide and seek.  If you build a Sanctuary for Ares, the god will be thrilled to have a new place to practice the art of war, and he'll forget all about the serpent. He'll even take some of the slain serpent's teeth, sow them in the earth, transforming them into fiercely powerful soldiers called Sparti.  These soldiers will do your bidding and help to protect Thebes.  Heed my advice, mortal, and good luck.'
text: @P女神雅典娜告訴你：'你的行爲已經激怒了阿瑞斯。但是如果你能爲他建造一座聖所，他將對你另眼相看，而且會讓手下的巨龍幫助你保衛底比斯城。'

original: @PThe wedding of Harmonia and Cadmus was a splendid affair.  Hephaestus, Aphrodite and Ares were in attendance, along with notable leaders from all over the world.  Ares and Aphrodite beamed with pride as they each presented Harmonia with a gift.  Aphrodite gave the bride a gorgeous necklace that Hephaestus had made, and Ares presented the bride with a beautiful and ornate robe.  But, the gift that you brought to the wedding was the best of all.  You brought Europa, and she was finally reunited with her brothers Cadmus, Thasus, Phoenix and Cilix.  Ecstatic over the return of their sister, Cadmus and Thasus have become your staunch allies, while Phoenix and Cilix opened their distant cities, Phoenicia and Cilicia, to trade.  Harmonia and Cadmus even agreed to present you with the Robe and Necklace, though they thought it best to send you the gifts later, after the gods had left, so as not to offend them.   @POnly two things marred the ceremony.  The first was the fear that Talos would arrive on the scene at any moment.  The second was the shocking lack of wine!  Wine has been difficult to come by in Greece lately, except in Mount Cithaeron, which has an abundance of the beverage.  The people of Mount Cithaeron are refusing to share their supplies, though, keeping all of the wine for themselves.
text: @P哈莫尼亞和卡德米亞的婚禮引來了許多貴賓，包括赫菲斯托斯和愛芙羅黛蒂，不過在所有的結婚禮物中，你的禮物最讓人喫驚：你帶來了歐羅巴，讓她和卡德米亞、賽索斯、腓尼基和克利希團聚了。卡德米亞和賽索斯非常感激你，表示願意和你結盟，而腓尼基和克利希同意開放腓尼基城和克利希城和你進行貿易。此外，他們還同意把神明送給他們的絲袍和項鍊送給你。   @P有兩件事情破壞了婚禮的氣氛：首先有傳言塔洛斯會來攪局，其次葡萄酒非常短缺。聽說薩倫地區盛產葡萄酒，不過那兒的人拒絕出售。

original: @PThe situation at Mount Cithaeron has gotten out of control.  Nearly all of Greece's supply of wine is hoarded there, and now strange things are happening around the city.  There have been reports that the bodies of sheep, goats, and even people, gruesomely torn apart, have turned up nearby.  The attacks seem much too vicious to be the work of a wandering pack of wolves or an angry wild boar.  The frightening deaths have scared the people of Mount Pelion into hiding, and they have not had contact with anyone for some time.  Adrastrus of Argos has stopped trading, choosing not to risk the lives of his merchants for a few measly drachmas and supplies.  The only solution to these problems is to invade Mount Cithaeron and see what is going on there for yourself.
text: @P盛產葡萄酒的薩倫地區最近發生了恐怖的兇殺事件，許多人，包括許多牲畜被殘酷殺害，從傷口來判斷，肯定是被某種巨大的生物所傷。現在薩倫地區已經中斷了和外界的葡萄酒貿易，要想獲得葡萄酒，只有派兵到薩倫地區調查那裏的神祕事件的真相了。

original: @PFear is crippling nearly all of Greece.  The Maenads are everywhere, leaving cities throughout Greece in shambles.  Now, Dionysus has rallied his Maenads to attack Thebes to punish you for destroying their home.  If things are ever going to return to normal, you will have to find a way to kill these horrible monsters and restore a feeling of safety to the people of Greece so that trade and diplomatic exchanges may be conducted once again.
text: @P由於你摧毀了酒神侍女的家園，酒神狄俄尼索斯準備帶領她們進攻底比斯，看來唯一的生存之道就是消滅她們了。

original: @PThe dastardly Polynices of Orchomenos, exiled from Thebes, has stolen the Robe and Necklace of Harmonia!  The double-crosser has claimed the throne of Thebes, and promised Adrastus of Argos and Tydeus of Calydon these and other spoils if they help him take your city.  You must defeat these villains to keep what's rightfully yours.  @PMeanwhile, Hephaestus, the lame god, has caught his wife, Aphrodite, in a forbidden embrace with Ares.  Slowly, Hephaestus has put two and two together and finally understood why Ares and Aphrodite had both been so proud of Harmonia at her wedding, and why the gorgeous goddess of the tender passions thought it necessary to spend nine months at a beauty spa some twenty years ago.  Hotter than the metals that he pounds in his forge, Hephaestus has decided to destroy all that Ares holds dear, whether it be a mortal, a monster or a city!
text: @P阿卡米的普利尼斯偷走了底比斯城裏的絲袍和項鍊，聲稱自己是底比斯之王，他還和阿戈斯城和卡利多城結成聯盟準備對你發動進攻。  @P同時，赫菲斯托斯發現自己的妻子愛芙羅黛蒂和阿瑞斯有私情。大怒之下，赫菲斯托斯準備摧毀所有和阿瑞斯有牽連的城市。

original: A rugged and forested land, Cydonia is located on Crete, the gateway to the rest of the world.
text: 賽尼亞是克里特的交通要道。

original: @PThe people of Crete are wary of you, and an old beggar man reveals the reason: 'Once, a woman was spotted far off our shores, approaching our island on the crest of a giant, foamy wave.  As the woman drew closer, it became clear that she wasn't riding on the sea, but on the back of a great white bull!  The bull deposited the woman on our shores, and Talos, a bronze man forged by Hephaestus, guards the woman night and day.  The bronze man guards our island, too, preventing invaders from doing us harm.   @P'It has been prophesied that a leader from Thebes will come to our island and take this woman from us.  We fear that if this leader succeeds, Talos will no longer guard our island.  And, since you are from Thebes, you might just be the one that will change our world completely.'
text: @P克里特島上有這麼個傳說：曾經有個女人騎着一頭巨大的白牛來到了附近的海灘，赫菲斯托斯派出銅人塔洛斯在周圍守護她，後來塔洛斯也稱爲克里特的守護者。   @P有預言說一個底比斯來的人會把那個女人帶走，而塔洛斯將不再守護這個小島。

original: @PUnder your leadership, Thebes is beginning to thrive.  Yet, the multi-headed menace still plagues the land, and the city will never be truly great as long as it counts the monster as one of its residents.
text: @P在你的努力下，底比斯城不斷發展，不過巨龍仍然在附近出沒，形勢還不容樂觀。

original: @PThe serpent is gone, yet worries remain.  Ares was fond of the serpent, and he cannot be happy that you have arranged for the serpent's death.  Athena, the goddess of warriors, crafts and wisdom, has arrived to collect some of the serpent's teeth for some strange and wonderful purpose.  Maybe she can shed some light on how to earn Ares' favor.
text: @P巨龍被殺死了，但你也得罪了阿瑞斯。據說雅典娜會到附近收集巨龍的牙齒，也許她能說服阿瑞斯不與你爲敵。

original: @PAres is shouting for joy over his latest Fortress, and his Sparti stand guard over your city.  With Thebes well protected and in the trustworthy hands of your prideful deputy, Oedipus, it is time to set forth and expand the kingdom. The Oracle at Delphi recommends establishing a city at Cydonia in Crete...though she's hinted that fertile fields and great forests are not the only things to be found there!
text: @P阿瑞斯成爲你的朋友，他派出近衛軍幫助你守衛城市。根據先知的神喻，你準備在克里特的賽尼亞建立城市，底比斯城暫時讓俄狄浦斯托管。

original: @PJason reduced Talos to a pile of scrap metal by removing the single nail that holds the bronze man's blood inside of him.  During the dark of night, however, someone made off with Talos' carcass.  Maybe it was a local sculptor, looking for an extra supply of bronze.  Then again, it could have been Hephaestus...  @PMeanwhile, your stature has grown throughout Greece.  Many cities call you friend, and even the great Minos of Knossos has declared himself your loyal subject.   All of Greece talks of the beautiful Robe and Necklace of Harmonia that Cadmus has promised you, which are even now on the way to Thebes.
text: @P伊阿宋殺死了銅人塔洛斯，當天晚上塔洛斯的軀體失蹤了，難道是赫菲斯托斯干的？  @P你的名聲已經傳遍了希臘，連科諾索的彌諾斯都來投靠你。卡德米亞答應送給你哈莫尼亞的絲袍和項鍊，目前它們正被送往底比斯城。

original: @PHorror.  Unspeakable horror is what you found at Mount Cithaeron.  Madwomen who called themselves the Maenads, drunk on wine, were gleefully tearing apart the bodies of their innocent victims.  Forced from Mount Cithaeron by your invasion, these servants of Dionysus have now scattered throughout Greece, continuing their reign of terror.
text: @P薩倫山區簡直成了人間地獄，瘋狂的酒神侍女到處殺害無辜的百姓。在你到達之後，她們逃跑了。

original: @PEverything has returned to normal.  People can leave their homes without fear, contact has been restored between you and other leaders, and goods are once again flowing throughout Greece.  Yet, a foreboding sense of doom permeates the air.  Perhaps it's because the Robe and Necklace of Harmonia, promised to you so long ago by the honorable Cadmus, have not yet arrived in Thebes. Worse still, you haven't heard from Cadmus for some time.  There could still be trouble brewing.
text: @P經過你的努力，希臘地區的物資貿易又恢復了正常。但是卡德米亞答應送給你的哈莫尼亞的絲袍和項鍊還沒有送到底比斯城，而且很久都沒有卡德米亞的消息了，看來有必要調查此事。

original: @PYou have thoroughly crushed Polynice's attempt to usurp your power, and the leaders that supported him are now firmly under your rule.  Not even Hephaestus will threaten Thebes now!
text: @P你徹底挫敗了普利尼斯的陰謀，現在連赫菲斯托斯都無法威脅底比斯城了。

original: The priestess' prophecy has come true!  You have wrested Europa from Talos' grip and delivered her back to her brothers in Greece.  Talos, however, is enraged that you have taken his charge from him and is following close on your heels!
text: 你成功地把歐羅巴從塔洛斯那兒救出來，讓她和希臘的親人團聚了。不過塔洛斯是不會對你善罷甘休的。

original: @PNot so long ago, Sparta was the greatest city in the Peloponnese.  Menelaus and his beautiful wife Helen ruled over all, and people were content.  But then, Paris of Troy abducted Helen, and a great war broke out.  Through cunning and strength, our soldiers won the war, but things weren't the same when Menelaus returned to Sparta.  The city soon crumbled, and only a few ruins remain of what was once a glorious city. @PThe time has come to establish a new Sparta on new land!  The new Sparta will rise in glory and power, and one day eclipse the prestige of the old Sparta!
text: @P斯巴達曾經是希臘最強大的城邦，但自從特洛伊戰爭後，它逐漸走下坡路，最終變成了一片廢墟。 @P現在你要建立一座新斯巴達城，讓它成爲希臘最強大的城邦。

original: @PIf we are to build a mighty army, our citizens must have some olive oil.  We don't seem to have any here in Sparta, but word is that puny city Olympia makes it.  We haven't had any fun in so long - let's go take over Olympia and get their olive oil!  We could probably get Corinth to join us, and maybe our beloved Ares will come along!  Maybe Olympia will get word of our plans and even try to attack us!  Wouldn't that be a gas? @PMeanwhile, the cult of Dionysus is on the rise in Greece.  Wine does have its purpose - a drop or two can go a long way to quenching one's thirst.  But, why anyone would drink to excess is a mystery.  Still, the drunken lout seems to hold a strange appeal to others around the country, and they swoon at the mere mention of his name. @PAnd, what is this rising in the east like the sun?  We hear rumblings of a new empire that is gaining some prominence.
text: @P我們需要大量的橄欖油，目前唯一可行的解決方法就是佔領盛產橄欖油的奧林匹亞城，科林斯城和我們的守護神阿瑞斯應該會幫助我們。 @P聽說現在整個希臘都在大量釀造葡萄酒，真不知道酒有什麼好處。 @P此外，聽說東方有一個帝國正在迅速崛起。

original: @PThe leader of that upstart empire causing so much trouble for those feeble cities has finally revealed himself.  He calls himself Darius, king of Persia, and he is quite the jokester.  He has sent word that he claims Sparta, along with the rest of Greece, as a subject! Maybe a mere declaration of superiority is enough for wine-soaked cities like Eretria to surrender, but that silly little ploy isn't going to work on us! @PI don't know why we've been dragged into this, because this is Athens' problem, anyway.  The Athenians started a revolt in Ionia, and now that Darius is attacking them in return, they realize that they've bitten off more than they can chew.  Gluttony just doesn't get you anywhere!   @PHipponax of Corinth has the right idea, though.  He's planning an all-out attack on Sardis, the capital of those barbarian Persians.
text: @P波斯國王大流士真是個白癡，他竟然妄想佔領希臘。 @P大流士在雅典人那裏已經栽了跟頭，真是個眼高手低的二流貨色。   @P另外，科林斯最近在和波斯人佔領的薩地斯開戰。

original: @PAthens has really gotten too big for its britches!  They have attacked Melos, killing all its men and enslaving its women and children, for refusing to participate in that silly Delian League!  It's up to us now to put an end to this foolishness!  As soon as we conquer Athens, Amphipolis, Delos and Eretria, we can return the world to normal.
text: @P雅典最近的所作所爲實在太囂張了，把希臘搞得烏煙瘴氣。我們要佔領雅典、安菲斯、德勒斯和拉西亞，讓這個世界清靜一下！

original: Some may say that Taras' fertile fields are lovely sights.  We see only grapes and herd animals that will ultimately allow Sparta to develop a stronger army!
text: 我們現在需要塔拉斯的葡萄和牲畜，最簡單的方式不是貿易，而是征服！

original: @PTaras looks to be the perfect place to station a Spartan army.  Plus, our spies have told us that somewhere in the vicinity is the city of Odessos, Athens' source of wheat.  If we can crush Odessos and cut off Athens' food supply, then Athens' downfall is certain.  And, our great god Ares has promised to help us find Odessos if we help him to retrieve something he wants!
text: @P我們要把塔拉斯建成軍事基地。附近的奧得索斯城是雅典的食物供給地，這可是塊肥肉。只要我們爲阿瑞斯找到他所要的東西，他就幫助我們尋找這座城市。

original: Ithaca is a tree-covered island, perfectly suited to be the base for the Spartan navy!
text: 伊塔克對斯巴達來說是最理想的海軍基地。

original: @PIthaca is the perfect spot to build a powerful naval base. If Athens has a strength, it is the Athenian fleet.  Our army is already vastly superior to the Athenians'; if our navy can overmatch the Athenian navy, Athens doesn't stand a chance!  When we have some triremes built, we should test them out by attacking someone! @PUnfortunately, Ithaca, home of the great Odysseus, has its problems.  Cyclops is coming to the city, looking for revenge.  He is enraged with Odysseus because the hero hurled a pointy stick into the Cyclops' only eye!  Luckily for the Cyclops, Athena managed to pluck it out, and he eagerly anticipates settling his score with Odysseus.  Scylla, too, is nonplussed with Ithaca's hero.  Imagine - sailing past the beast, and only offering six soldiers for her to eat.  That's just barely an appetizer! We'll need to find Odysseus to rid the land of these creatures.  @PScylla's master, Hermes, is also in the area, making life difficult for the city of Elis.  Hermes is extremely attached in an embarrassingly emotional way to Scylla.  If Odysseus can turn back Scylla, Hermes is likely to leave Elis alone, and the city will be extremely grateful.    @L@PWith so many monsters in the area, you might find that you need to ask for goods from your allies or take them from your rivals.
text: @P我們準備在伊塔克建造海軍基地，這樣一來就可以從海陸分兵包抄雅典。 @P伊塔克是英雄奧德修斯的家鄉，獨眼巨人和他有宿仇，所以很可能會攻擊這座城市。此外，六頭女妖斯庫拉也在附近作亂，也許你應該請奧德修斯來消滅這些怪物。

original: @PSparta is growing, and soon our power will be unrivaled in all of Greece!  Before we can attain that height, we must first acquire some resources that our city lacks.  Of course, there is a certain Athenian quaintness to trading for the items, but leaders we trade with tend to think we owe them other things as well. Really, why should trade relations have anything to do with helping them through a famine or plague!  There must be a better way...
text: @P斯巴達正在迅速崛起，我們目前要解決物資短缺的問題。

original: @PWith Olympia firmly under our thumb, obtaining olive oil is easy, and our star is on the rise.  While our city is gaining power, we've heard that some cities in the east are having trouble with some foreign empire.  If they raised their kids correctly instead of leaving them home with their mothers, they wouldn't be having these troubles!
text: @P奧林匹亞城已經是我們的了，形勢一片大好。據說東方有個帝國準備入侵希臘，不過這和我們無關。

original: @PWith their tails between their legs, the Persians were sent packing all the way back to Sardis.  But, can you believe how wimpy the Athenian military is?  They couldn't even defend their own city!  They were lucky that the Persian navy was so pathetically weak and inept, or else they would have never succeeded at Marathon.   @PStill, those Athenians are a squirrelly bunch, and we've heard that they are plotting, forming alliances throughout the Cyclades.  All of Greece is choosing sides, and smart ones will choose ours.
text: @P波斯軍隊夾着尾巴逃到了薩地斯，但如果不是因爲波斯的海軍太弱，雅典人是不可能戰勝他們的。  @P現在雅典在乘機擴張勢力，看來斯巴達和雅典的戰爭是一觸即發了。

original: The last of the Delian League has fallen to us, and Sparta reigns over all!
text: 現在斯巴達成爲了希臘的主人！

original: We have crushed Odessos under our heels, and Athens is beginning to starve.  Already, its ally Thermopylai has collapsed, and its citizens have scattered to the four winds.  The final battle cannot be too far off!
text: 我們佔領了奧得索斯，現在雅典人要捱餓了，想必他們很快就會狗急跳牆了。

original: When Odysseus killed Scylla, Hermes predictably went back to his mother, Maia, and bawled his eyes out.  What a sissy!  Anyway, he couldn't cry and bother Elis at the same time, so Elis is now free from Hermes.  In their gratitude, the city has become our subject!  Ithaca, once dominated by a pair of monsters, is now dominated by the Spartan fleet!  Our new fleet performed very well at Delos, and the city is now under our rule.  Soon, Athens and the rest of its allies will fall to us one by one, like olives falling off a tree!
text: 奧德修斯消滅了六頭女妖斯庫拉，而我們的艦隊所向披靡，很快就征服了德勒斯，看來雅典遲早是我們的囊中之物了。

original: All that was foretold has come to fruition.  In spite of many battles and obstacles, you and Hercules together have risen to prominence.  Through his deeds, Hercules has atoned for the murders of his wife and children and has earned immortality from the gods!  You, too, have earned a measure of immortality, for people will long tell tales of your many triumphs as leader of Tiryns.  They will speak of how you defeated Amazons and Centaurs, faced a monster and even managed to thwart the bad intentions of Apollo, Poseidon and Hephaestus!  Your fame is secured!
text: 你和赫爾克利斯聯合在一起可謂所向無敵，甚至贏得了許多神明的尊敬。你打敗了亞馬遜人和半人馬族，打敗了怪獸，甚至挫敗了阿波羅、波賽東和赫菲斯托斯的陰謀，一時名震天下。

original: You have taken Iolcus from its humble beginnings and built it into the most powerful kingdom in all of Greece, risking the wrath of gods and mortals alike to achieve your destiny.  Along the way, you have liberated a hero from the Underworld, slain the fearsome Calydonian Boar, and restored one of Greece's most treasured possessions, the Golden Fleece, to its proper place.  Zeus, who had once cursed your family, now blesses you and celebrates your name throughout Mount Olympus!
text: 你把默默無聞的魯爾克建成了繁榮的都市。此外，你從地獄救出了一位英雄，殺死了野豬卡利多尼恩，使金羊毛重返希臘，這些壯舉讓宙斯對你讚賞有加！

original: @PThrough your leadership, you have forever changed the face of Greece.  With Argos, you have shown the people of Greece that they should no longer live isolated from one other, but should put themselves under the protection of a great leader like you, who will provide them with the things they need to enrich their lives.
text: @P阿戈斯城的繁榮顯示了你的精明強幹，從此希臘各城邦都把你當作他們的領袖。

original: Not all the leaders who fought alongside you in the Trojan War have fared so well as you.  Sparta has collapsed, and Menelaus and Helen have gone to Egypt to start their lives anew there.  Odysseus is nowhere to be found, and the suitors at Ithaca are imposing themselves more and more everyday.  Mycenae, too, has collapsed under the treachery of Clytemnestra.  Yet, Aulis, through your sage leadership, stands tall and proud.
text: 經過連年的征戰，希臘一片蕭條，物是人非，只有你的奧里斯城屹立不倒。

original: In the harshest and most barren of environments, you have managed to build a city that has all the amenities of the richest, most fertile lands.  You have led Athens through times of great turmoil from which it has emerged unblemished and strong.  Greece's most noble heroes are frequently spotted on the city's streets, and monsters and other unsavory types steer clear of the most notable city in the world.
text: 在你的不懈努力下，雅典城雖然歷經滄桑，卻屹立不倒，最終成爲希臘文明的象徵！

original: Any one of your many achievements would have been enough to rank you among Greece's best leaders.  Not only did you defeat Ares' serpent and rescue Europa from Crete, you rid Greece of the horrible Maenad threat and rebuffed Polynice's attempt to depose you!  Never has a single ruler done as much for Greece as you have.
text: 你打敗了阿瑞斯的巨龍、救出了歐羅巴，趕走了窮兇極惡的酒神侍女，又挫敗了普利尼斯的陰謀。你爲希臘所做的一切將造福子孫萬代。

original: Could there ever have been any doubt that Sparta would once again rise and far surpass its previous glory?  From our humble rebirth, we have slowly gained power, and now Greeks everywhere follow our rules.  And the first rule of Sparta?  Under penalty of death, no one is to worship that foul-smelling, drunken, messy excuse for a god, Dionysus!
text: 斯巴達終於成爲了希臘最強大的城邦，我們遲早要統一整個希臘。此外，我們要把斯巴達人堅韌不拔的精神推廣到整個希臘。

original: Together, you and Hercules will begin the journey to immortality.  As he performs his legendary labors, you will build a legendary Kingdom that will provide fodder to storytellers for years to come. This challenging adventure consists of seven episodes.
text: 你和赫爾克利斯要開創一片豐功偉績，建造一個強大的王國。整個冒險歷程由七個小故事組成。

original: Overcome Zeus' curse to become one of the most celebrated rulers in all of Greece! This challenging adventure consists of five episodes.
text: 你要消除宙斯的詛咒，成爲希臘最偉大的領袖！整個冒險歷程由五個小故事組成。

original: The people of Greece are scattered around the country.  You will gather them together, like a shepherd gathers his flock, and lead them to a brighter day. This adventure is not too challenging and consists of six episodes.
text: 你要把希臘各地的人民團結起來，建設一個偉大的國家。整個冒險歷程由六個小故事組成。

original: Lead Greek forces to Troy to rescue the most beautiful woman in the world! This adventure is extremely challenging and consists of six episodes.
text: 率領希臘的軍隊從特洛伊救出世界上最美麗的女子海倫。整個冒險歷程由六個小故事組成。

original: Lead Athens from its earliest days, through times of war, to the Golden Age! This adventure is somewhat challenging and very long. It consists of eight episodes.
text: 將雅典城建成希臘最偉大的城市。整個冒險歷程由八個小故事組成。

original: Gods, mortals and monsters will all try to prevent you from leading Thebes to glory. This adventure is fairly easy and consists of eight episodes.
text: 將底比斯建成一座繁榮強盛的城市。整個冒險歷程由八個小故事組成。

original: Build Sparta's might and lead its military against all comers, whether they be Greek or barbarian! This adventure is quite challenging and consists of five episodes.
text: 把斯巴達建成希臘最偉大的城市。整個冒險歷程由五個小故事組成。

original: Welcome to the first Zeus tutorial!  This is the Goals screen, where you'll receive basic instructions about how to build and manage cities in the Greek world.  This lesson has no specific goals, as indicated by the phrase 'Open play, no episode goals', above.   @L@LTo exit this screen, click your right mouse button. To return for further instructions, click the Episode Goals button, which you can see at the bottom of the Control Panel, to the right: @G13 @LSoon you're going to exit this screen, and study a sample neighborhood we've provided.  The first things you'll learn about are roads and walkers. @L@L@LRoads and walkers @LWalkers emerge from buildings you place, and are guided by the roads you lay out for them.  Click with your right mouse button on any building, walker or location to see what it is, and to get more information about it.  Pause the game with the 'p' key.   @L@LNow click your right mouse button to exit this screen, and study the sample neighborhood.  If you find the play area moves around too fast, use the 'Options' menu to slow the scroll speed. When you're ready to build a neighborhood of your own, return to this screen for instructions. @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Laying out roads @LTo the right of the sample neighborhood, lay out a looping road (like the one you see in the sample neighborhood) by clicking the Roads button: @G14 You can place long sections of road by holding the mouse button down and dragging.  For this tutorial, make sure the road loop for your new neighborhood is not connected to the sample neighborhood. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Housing and Immigration @LThe Population tab gives information about your city's people and housing.  From here, place some vacant housing lots inside the block, alongside the road, by clicking the Common Housing button: @G01 Eventually, new workers will move into the vacant lots, turning them into huts.  You can place large sections of housing by holding the left mouse button down and dragging.   @L@LWhen you have a few occupied huts in your new neighborhood, return here to continue. @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Hazards @LMost buildings need regular maintenance so they don't catch fire or collapse.  In the sample neighborhood, a 'superintendent' periodically emerges from the Maintenance Office, tending to the buildings he happens to pass.  At the top of the Hygiene and Safety tab, click 'see hazards', and look for a rising hazard column on any building not recently passed by a superintendent: @G02 Click the 'see hazards' button again to return to normal view.  You can also tap the spacebar to switch back and forth between normal and special views.  When you're done, return to learn how to add a Maintenance Office to your new city. @L@L@LSTEP FOUR - Maintenance @LTo add a Maintenance Office to your new neighborhood, select the Hygiene and Safety tab, then click the Maintenance Office button: @G03	 Use the 'see hazards' button again to make sure all your new huts have access to the superintendent.   @L@LWhen you've provided maintenance services to your new neighborhood, return here to continue. @L@L@LSTEP FIVE - Water for houses @LIn the example neighborhood a water bearer periodically emerges from the Fountain, carrying water to the houses he passes.  To see which houses have water, select the Hygiene and Safety tab, then click 'see water'.  Each house passed by the water bearer has a tall column.  As water is consumed, this become shorter, until the water bearer visits again.  To provide water to your new neighborhood, select the Hygiene and Safety tab, then the Fountain button:  @G04 @L@LExperiment with other configurations of roads, housing and working buildings.  Use the Clear Land button to demolish buildings or trees when necessary:  @G16 @L@LUse the 'undo' button when you make a mistake: @G17 When you're ready to move on, return to this screen and click Next Tutorial. @L @L
text: 歡迎進入遊戲教程。   @L@L要退出這個屏幕可以按鼠標右鍵，要回到這個屏幕可以點擊控制面板底下的這個圖標： @G13 @L你首先要知道的是道路和行人。 @L@L@L道路和行人 @L行人從建築裏走出來，沿着道路行走。右鍵點擊建築、行人等可以詳細查看。你可以按P鍵暫停遊戲。   @L@L現在你可以點擊右鍵離開這個屏幕。如果你覺得瀏覽時畫面滾動太快，可以在選項菜單中降低捲動速度。準備建造時請回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第一步 - 建設道路 @L你可以點擊這個按鈕建造道路： @G14 你可以拖動鼠標同時建造一批道路。在教程裏請不要讓你造的道路和原有的建築連接。 @L@L@L第二步 - 房屋和移民 @L點擊民房按鈕在道路邊建造民房。 @G01 民房造成後自然會有移民來到城市。你可以拖動鼠標同時建造一批民房。   @L@L建成一些民房後請回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第三步 - 險情 @L要防止民房着火或倒塌，你需要管理員去維護和修理。在衛生與安全標籤中點擊'查看險情'，你還可以根據房屋邊的圓柱查看發生險情的可能，圓柱越高，發生險情的可能性越大，而被管理員查看後圓柱會降低。 @G02 你可以按空格鍵改變查看方式。現在請建造一個維修所。 @L@L@L第四步 - 維護 @L在衛生與安全標籤中點擊'維修所'。 @G03	 利用'查看險情'查看是否所有房屋都有管理員。   @L@L當所有房屋都有管理員後，回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第五步 - 飲水 @L挑水工會從噴泉挑水送到各個民房。你可以點擊'查看飲水'調查居民的飲水情況，房屋前的藍色圓柱越高，居民的飲用水就越多。如果房屋缺少飲用水，就會降級。你可以在衛生與安全標籤中建造噴泉。  @G04 @L@L你可以用'清除'按鈕清除建築和樹木。  @G16 @L@L使用'撤銷'按鈕可以消除剛纔的錯誤命令。 @G17 你現在可以選擇下一課教程了。 @L @L

original: @PFor centuries, people have flocked to Greece's large and beautiful cities, hoping to lead prosperous lives.  In their attempts to provide for their people, leaders have stripped the Greek countryside of its resources, and now these leaders are scrambling to make sure that their citizens are clothed and fed and that their militaries have all the supplies they need.  Quickly, they are finding that Greece itself can no longer support its large population. @PYour city at Larisa in Ionia will provide for the city-states of the mainland, and you'll be able to turn a tidy profit.  Though Larisa has vast supplies of marble and wood, it is lacking the resources that people need to lead satisfying lives.  You'll be able to acquire these items from other leaders, but it would be better if your kingdom could produce them itself.  The gods can provide you with some of the goods you need, and you can also establish colonies whose resources will complement Larisa's.  When you are ready to establish the first colony, click on the Goals Button and set aside the goods that the colony needs to get started.
text: @P隨着希臘的不斷發展，你很快發現希臘本身的資源已經不足以應付快速的發展了。 @P拉里薩缺少資源，你可以從其他領袖那裏爭取所缺的資源，但如果自己能生產則更好。你可以向神明祭祀，要求一些資源，也可以通過建立殖民地獲得資源。當你做好建立殖民地的準備工作後，就點擊任務目標按鈕，撥出建立殖民地所需的物資。

original: With a new colony providing you with valuable goods, Larisa is poised to become the wealthiest city in all the world.  Already, cities around Greece are wondering how they ever lived without the goods that you provide.  If you could provide even more items, then Larisa would be even more profitable.  Establishing a second colony that has access to resources that your kingdom currently lacks will only add to Larisa's prosperity.  Remember, when you are ready to establish the second colony, click on the Goals button and set aside the goods that the colony will need to get started.
text: 拉里薩得到了所需的物質，很快就迅速發展起來。爲了讓拉里薩進一步繁榮，你要建立第二個殖民地。點擊任務目標按鈕，撥出建立殖民地所需的物資。

original: With two colonies supplementing Larisa's wealth, nothing can stop you from amassing enormous amounts of money.  Other leaders in the world stand in awe of your growing prosperity.
text: 拉里薩現在擁有兩個殖民地，已經成爲非常強大的城邦。

original: Smyrna is a land of metal, rich in both copper and silver ore.
text: 士麥那富含銅礦和銀礦。

original: The ores at Smyrna will significantly bolster Larisa's wealth.  Foundries produce bronze which, in and of itself, is valuable, but is even more valuable when it is manufactured into sculpture and armor.  Silver is money, pure and simple.  Bustling Mints will convert the silver into drachmas, and your treasury will grow.  When you have established the industries to your satisfaction, click on the Goals button and set aside the required goods to return to Larisa.
text: 士麥那的礦產無疑會增加拉里薩的財富。銅礦可以用來打造盔甲和鑄造雕像，銀礦用來打造銀幣。建造了採礦設施之後，點擊任務目標按鈕，撥出所需的物資，回到拉里薩。

original: The fertile fields here are the perfect hosts for livestock and Wheat Farms.
text: 這裏的肥沃土地正適合建造農場，蓄養牲畜。

original: The island of Naxos is well-known for its meadows, which sheep in particular find tasty.  The fleece these sheep provide will help you to ensure that Larisa always has a plentiful supply of this basic necessity.  Wheat, too, can be grown here, and it can be used to feed horses and people alike.  When you are ready to return to Larisa, click on the Goals button and set aside the specified goods.
text: 納索斯島是個建造農場，蓄養牲畜的好地方。當你準備回到拉里薩的時候，點擊任務目標按鈕，撥出所需的物資，回到拉里薩。

original: You have decided to leave Larisa for now and establish a colony to supplement the city's resources.  After you click 'Proceed,' you will see the World Map, where you can choose a site to establish a colony.  To read a description of a colony site, click on it.  Choose the one you want to establish first, and click the button next to 'Choose this location?' to proceed.  You'll get a chance to establish the other colony later.
text: 你準備離開拉里薩，建立一個殖民地。點擊“繼續”，進入大地圖，然後選擇殖民地的方位。你以後還可以建造另一個殖民地。

original: You have again decided to leave Larisa temporarily and establish a second colony.  When the second colony is securely in your fold, Larisa will be nearly self-sufficient and dripping in wealth.
text: 你準備再建造第二個殖民地，這將使拉里薩得到足夠的物資投入建設。

original: Now that Smyrna's Foundries and Mints are thriving, you have decided to return to Larisa, where the ores and the goods that are manufactured from them will only serve to increase your wealth.
text: 士麥那的鑄造場和鑄幣場都已經建成了，你準備返回拉里薩。

original: You have decided that its time to turn your attention back to Larisa and leave Naxos in the hands of your deputy, Elephenor, who will make tribute payments to you in precious fleece.
text: 你決定返回拉里薩，把納索斯留給總督管理。

original: Under your leadership, Larisa, supported by its two colonies, will become the richest kingdom in the world!  This is an open play adventure, so you won't have to worry about meeting specific goals.
text: 由於你的努力，拉里薩已經成爲最富裕的城市了。由於這是自由建設模式，所以你可以隨心所欲地繼續進行遊戲。

original: @PLike one of the Titans of old, Athens is running roughshod over everyone in Greece, forcing city-states to bend to its will.  The Athenians have taken complete control over Greece's trade routes and have fixed the prices of goods to fit their needs, making free trade very difficult.  Those who dare to challenge them find themselves crushed, nearly consumed by the Athenians just as Cronus ate his own children.  But, just as the fearsome Cronus was toppled, so too shall Athens be. @PThe best way to break Athens' rule is to chisel away at its empire, conquering its weaker allies one by one. Mount Malea is an ideal spot to build a city that will rival Athens' dominance, and the area around the city has many of the resources you'll need for the city - and its citizen-soldiers - to thrive.  Athens, its patron goddess Athena, and its stronger allies will certainly make their displeasure with your upstart city felt. @PTo bring Athens to its knees, you'll need a strong navy.  Regrettably, the one thing that Mount Malea lacks is a steady supply of wood.  You'll need to establish a colony to provide you with this valuable resource.  When you are ready, click on the Goals Button on the Control Panel.  In the screen that pops up, click to dispatch the goods to the colony and return to the city.  In a moment, you will be able to leave your city to establish the colony.
text: @P雅典城已經非常強大了，雅典人飛揚跋扈，壟斷了貿易，把持各地的物價。那些膽敢反抗雅典的城市都遭到了滅頂之災。 @P要打敗雅典，你準備一步步蟬食它的殖民地。馬里亞山脈是建造你第一個城市的最佳地點，它附近有豐富的礦藏。不過，雅典和它的盟友們是不會坐看你的壯大的。 @P要打敗雅典，你需要強大的海軍，但是馬里亞山脈附近缺少木材。你準備建立一個殖民地以保證木材的供應。準備好之後，點擊控制面板上的任務目標按鈕，撥出建立殖民地所需的物資，然後離開城市出去建設殖民地。

original: @PNow that you can readily acquire wood from Orchomenos, you can build the triremes you need to become a true world power.  The Athenians have grown extremely anxious and have called on their patron, Athena, to help them crush you.  And Athena, the dutiful daughter, has asked her father, Zeus, to help her favorite city.  Call on all your resources - your allies, vassals and patron gods - to continue to lead Mount Malea on its march towards domination.
text: @P現在你已經能從阿卡米獲得足夠的木材，所以應該開始建造戰艦了。雅典人非常害怕，他們召喚了保護神雅典娜來對付你，而雅典娜又得到了宙斯的支持。你要聯合所有的盟友、附庸城和殖民地，抵擋住他們的攻勢，讓城市不斷發展。

original: Orchomenos is blanketed with thick, green forests, perfect for the construction of triremes.
text: 阿卡米的豐富木材資源讓你能迅速發展海軍。

original: @PThe heavily forested valleys around Orchomenos are a sight for sore eyes, for soon these tall trees will become the mighty triremes that will hopefully lead one day to Athens' destruction.  The Athenians, of course, are well aware of your intentions and will do what they can to interfere with your plans.  Once you have built up the wood industry at Orchomenos to your satisfaction, click on the Goals Button and dispatch goods to Mount Malea to return to the city.  In a short time, you'll be able to go back Mount Malea.
text: @P只要你獲得了這裏的木材資源，就能在海上壓倒雅典人。雅典人已經察覺了你的目的，可能會千方百計進行阻撓。當阿卡米的伐木設施開始正常運作後，點擊任務目標按鈕，把木材送到馬里亞山脈。很快你就可以返回那兒了。

original: @PYou have decided to leave your city behind for now and establish a colony to supply you with the wood you need. In a moment, you will visit the World Map to select a colony site.  Often, you'll have your choice of colony sites.  This time, though, your scouts have determined that only one location, Orchomenos, has the resources that you need. Click on it to see a description of the site.
text: @P你要建立殖民地，確保木材的供應。這次你無法自己選擇殖民地的位置，因爲參謀已經選中了阿卡米地區。點擊那兒之後可以看到相關介紹。

original: @PYou have decided to leave Orchomenos and return to Mount Malea where you can continue to chip away at Athens' power, leaving Polynices in charge of the colony.  As long as Orchomenos remains your colony in good standing, Polynices will give you wood every year as his tribute payment.  You can also ask him for wood, or purchase some from him.
text: @P你準備返回馬里亞山脈，殖民地自有它的總督來管理。

original: In this adventure, you will lead a fledgling city from its meager beginnings into a military powerhouse, establishing a colony along the way. This is an open play adventure, so you won't need to worry about specific goals.
text: 在軍事自由建設中，你要把一座小城市建成軍事重鎮，在這個過程中還要建立一個殖民地。你可以在本關裏隨意做任何事。

original: Nearly all of the gods collaborated to make the land at Olympia perfect.  Demeter made the land fertile so that livestock and farms could thrive.  Athena and Dionysus made sure that Olive Trees and Grapevines would be nourished by the soil.  Artemis set loose some of her boar, and Poseidon stocked the waterways with fish.  Even Hades touched the land, making sure that valuable ores rose to the surface.  You are the luckiest of all mortals to be able to build a city on this land!
text: 幾乎所有的神明都爲奧林匹亞的建設盡了力。狄蜜特讓土地肥沃；雅典娜和狄俄尼索斯讓橄欖樹和葡萄藤茁壯生長；阿緹蜜絲帶來了野獸；波賽東引來了魚羣；黑帝斯讓大地富含礦產。而你要在這兒建立一座不朽的城市！

original: This land has everything you need to build to your heart's content.  There are no goals to be met; everything is up to you!
text: 這兒有你所需要的任何資源，請隨心所欲地建設吧！

original: Your people need to eat, and the sea can be a bountiful source of food. In this tutorial we've provided a sample neighborhood which has a working fishing industry, and another neighborhood, to its right, which does not.  You're going to add a fishing industry to the neighborhood that needs one, but first study how this works in the sample neighborhood.   @L@LFishing @LFishing boats set out to sea from a Fishery, and return with fish, then deliverymen transport the fish to the nearest Granary.  Right click to exit this screen and observe this process in the sample neighborhood, then return to learn how to set up your own fishing industry. @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Catching fish @LPlace a Fishery near your neighborhood, (the one to the right of the sample neighborhood), by selecting the Husbandry tab, then the Land and Sea button: @G05 The Fishery must be placed on a straight section of coast.  Place it near a fishing spot, so the boats won't have too far to travel: @G18 When you see a boat from your Fishery fishing at the fishing spot, return here to continue. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Storing food @LFish, like all food, is stored in a Granary.  To build a Granary for your neighborhood, select the Distribution Tab, then the Granary button: @G11 Make sure the Granary is connected by road to the Fishery, then watch the Fishery carts deliver fish to it. @L@L@LRoadblocks @LAs more roads are added to your neighborhoods, you may find that walkers such as superintendents and water bearers occasionally wander outside your residential road loop.  These roaming walkers don't inherently know where you want them to patrol, but they can be guided with roadblocks, such as those in the sample neighborhood.  You probably don't need to add any roadblocks to your neighborhood now, but you can use the Place Roadblocks button to experiment:   @G15 Notice that walkers with specific destinations, such as fish deliverymen headed to the Granary, ignore roadblocks.   @L@LRemember to click with your right mouse button on any location, building or walker to learn what it is.   @LWhen you see some fish in your new Granary, return here and click Next Tutorial to learn how to distribute it to the houses in your neighborhood.
text: 我們爲你準備了兩個村莊，一個有漁場，一個沒有。   @L@L打漁 @L漁船從漁場出發，打到魚後工人會把魚送到糧倉。你可以離開本屏幕到村莊觀看一下，然後再回到本屏幕。 @L@L@L第一步 - 打漁 @L在右邊的村莊建造一個漁場。點擊農業標籤，再點擊'陸地和海洋'： @G05 漁場要建在平直的岸邊，儘量靠近魚羣。 @G18 漁船開始打魚後，回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第二步 - 儲存食物 @L所有食物都儲存在糧倉。要建造糧倉，點擊儲存與銷售標籤中的'糧倉'按鈕。 @G11 糧倉要有道路和漁場相連。 @L@L@L路障 @L你可以用路障控制行人的行動路線。雖然目前還沒有必要，但是你可以試試看。   @G15 有固定目的地的行人，例如送貨工不受路障的限制。   @L@L你可以用鼠標右鍵觀看行人或建築的介紹。   @L在你的糧倉裏有魚之後，可以進入下一個教程。

original: The Agora @LThe Agora is the central marketplace of a neighborhood, supplying food and other goods to its residents.  In the sample neighborhood, a food vendor periodically sets out from the Agora and heads for the nearest Granary, to procure food (ignoring roadblocks).  A peddler then emerges from the Agora to roam the streets, delivering food to any houses he happens to pass.  Observe this process in the sample neighborhood, then return here. @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Building a Granary @LAdd a Granary to your neighborhood (to the right of the sample neighborhood), by selecting the Distribution Tab, then clicking the Granary button: @G11 After placing the Granary, wait until it has a supply of fish, then return here. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Building an Agora @LTo distribute fish from your Granary to the Huts in your neighborhood, select the Distribution Tab, then click the Agora button, and select Common Agora:   @G10 Place the Agora directly ON TOP OF a road, like you see in the sample neighborhood.  Make sure to place it on one of the roads in your residential road loop, so it will be close to the houses it is to serve.   @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Adding a Food Vendor @L@LA Common Agora can hold up to three Vendors' stalls, but right now you'll need only one, a Food Vendors' stall.  To add a Food Vendors' stall to your Agora, click the Agora button, then select Food Vendor, and place the Stall somewhere on your Agora: @G10 The food vendor will procure fish from your Granary, and once the Stall has a supply of food, a peddler will begin distributing it to your Huts.   @L@LUse roadblocks if necessary to ensure the peddler does not stray outside the residential road loop, but make sure roadblocks don't prevent him from reaching your Huts. @LWhen the residents of a Hut have a supply of food, they'll upgrade their dwelling to a Shack, which can hold more people than a Hut.   @L@LClick with your right mouse button on houses, to see a list of what items its residents currently have.  When you have some Shacks in your neighborhood, return here and click Next Tutorial to continue.
text: 市場 @L商販會定期去糧倉收購糧食，然後挨家挨戶地販賣。 @L@L@L第一步 - 建造糧倉 @L在右邊的村莊建造糧倉。在儲存與銷售標籤中點擊'糧倉'： @G11 等糧倉中有魚後返回這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第二步 - 建造市場 @L選擇儲存與銷售標籤，點擊'市場'，選擇'普通市場'：   @G10 把市場建在道路上方，就像畫面上這樣。儘量把市場建在居住區附近。   @L@L@L第三步 - 增加食物貨攤 @L@L普通市場可以有三個貨攤，我們現在只需要食物貨攤。點擊市場，然後選擇'食物貨攤'，接着把它放進市場裏。 @G10 食物商販會從糧倉裏得到食物，然後分發到各間民房。   @L@L你可以用路障控制商販的行進路線。 @L當茅屋得到食物後就會變成棚屋，可以支持更多的人口。   @L@L在棚屋上點擊右鍵可以看到屋子裏有多少資源。建成一些棚屋後，可以進入下一個教程。
