original: Culture @LAs houses develop, they can generally hold more people.  Developing the housing you already have is a better way to grow your population than simply building more houses.  For houses to develop beyond mere Shacks, residents need access to some cultural diversions.  In the sample neighborhood, a College trains philosophers, who then proceed to a Podium to speak.  Roaming philosophers then emerge from the Podium, teaching philosophy to any houses they pass.   @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Philosophy @LBuild a College and Podium in your neighborhood by selecting the Culture tab, then clicking the philosophy button:   @G07 To see which houses have access to philosophy, click 'see philosophers' on the top of the Culture tab.  A Shack with access to some Culture becomes a Hovel. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Athletics @LExercise is important to your citizens.  Give some of your city's households access to athletics by selecting the Culture tab, clicking the Gymnasium button, and placing a Gymnasium: @G52 Soon athletes will roam the streets, serving as personal trainers to each household they pass.  @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Appeal @LNo one wants to live in an unattractive area.  To see how appealing an area is, select the Aesthetics tab, then click 'see appeal' at the top.   @LVery appealing areas appear light, while unappealing areas, such as those near industrial buildings, appear dark.   @L@LYou can increase the appeal of an area by clicking the Beautification or Recreational areas buttons on the Aesthetics tab, and placing some of the items you see available: @G08 @G09 Of course you can also increase the appeal of an area by relocating particularly unattractive structures to a more appropriate location.   @L@L@LCommemorative Monuments @LSometimes, when you achieve something truly spectacular, you'll see a third button on the Aesthetics tab for a Commemorative Monument you can build! @LWhen you've brought Culture to your neighborhood, and made it more appealing, return here and click Next Tutorial to continue. @L @L
text: 知識 @L要讓房屋升級到棚屋以上，你必須建造文化設施。你可以建造大學，然後讓學者們去講壇上臺演說，或者挨家挨戶傳播知識。  @L@L@L第一步 - 知識 @L在文化標籤裏點擊'知識'按鈕，然後建造大學和講壇：   @G07 你可以點擊文化標籤上方的'查看學者'查看文化情況，擁有文化設施後棚屋會變成小屋。 @L@L@L第二步 - 運動 @L你的人民還需要擁有運動設施，你可以建造文化標籤中的'體育館'： @G52 建成之後運動員會四處走動，向居民傳授運動知識。  @L@L@L第三步 - 環境 @L要查看環境，點擊環境標籤中的'查看環境'。   @L環境好的地區顏色較淺，環境差的地方顏色較暗。   @L@L你可以進入環境標籤中的'美化'，增加一些美化設施： @G08 @G09 你可以放棄一些環境差的建築以提高某個地區的環境指標。   @L@L@L紀念碑 @L有時你可以建造紀念碑以改善環境。 @L當你建造了一些文化設施後，可以進入下一個教程。 @L @L

original: Unrest and Plague @LThings aren't always going to be fine and dandy in your city.  Many of the things you'll need to do as a leader can make you unpopular, and create unrest among your people.  Also, as a city becomes crowded, plague is more likely to strike - and it can strike anywhere.   @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Assessing unrest @LThe former leader of this city paid low wages, generating a lot of unrest here. To assess unrest in the city's houses, click 'see unrest' at the top of the Hygiene and Safety tab: @G02 When unrest is really high in a particular household, its disgruntled residents may loiter in the streets, and even become outlaws! @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Dealing with unrest @LIt's best to prevent unrest by treating your people fairly.  Sometimes, as in the sample city, you'll find yourself in need of a more immediate solution, namely, a little muscle in the form of some watchmen. Place some Watchposts by selecting the Hygiene and Safety tab, and clicking the Watchpost button: @G53 Observe as a watchman emerges from each Watchpost and roams the city's streets, quelling unrest in the houses he passes, and subduing any outlaws he encounters.  When unrest is under control, return here to learn about Hygiene and plague. @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Assessing Hygiene @LTo prevent widespread plague, maintain good city hygiene by ensuring that food, and the services of a healer are available to as many of your citizens as possible.  Select the Hygiene and Safety tab and you'll see that in the sample city hygiene is not good, and is getting worse, because there are few Food Vendors, and no Infirmaries: @G02 Click 'see hygiene' at the top of the tab to see which houses have access to a healer, and ate good meals last month. @L@L@LSTEP FOUR - Infirmaries and healers @LThe services of a healer from an Infirmary are important for maintaining good hygiene.  Provide this troubled city with healers, by selecting the Hygiene and Safety tab, and placing some Infirmaries: @G21 Infirmaries are very unappealing to live near, so consider their placement carefully, and add some Aesthetic structures if necessary to beautify the surrounding area.  @L@L@LSTEP FIVE - Providing food @LThere is plenty of food in the city's Granaries, so just add Food Vendors to the Agoras to supply the city with much needed food: @G10 As the people of this city begin to eat regular meals, and see the healer, city hygiene will gradually improve.  If a plague does break out, you can identify infected houses by the green haze hovering over them.  When hygiene in the sample city is 'Excellent', you'll know your city is out of danger, and you can continue to the next tutorial.
text: 治安和瘟疫 @L如果人民對你不滿，就會影響治安狀況。隨着城市人口的增加，發生瘟疫的可能性也會增加。   @L@L@L第一步 - 查看治安 @L點擊衛生與安全標籤中的'查看治安'： @G02 治安出現問題後，居民會不服管教，甚至可能變成罪犯！ @L@L@L第二步 - 維護治安 @L如果你對人民比較和善，治安狀況就會得到控制。當然，你也可以招募一些督察官去鎮壓暴民。點擊衛生與安全標籤中的瞭望塔： @G53 督察官會四處走動，鎮壓暴民。治安得到控制後請回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第三步 - 查看衛生 @L爲了防止瘟疫，你要爲居民提供足夠的食物，而且要建造診所。 @G02 點擊'查看衛生'查看醫師的工作情況以及食物供應狀況。 @L@L@L第四步 - 診所和醫師 @L選擇衛生與安全標籤，建造一些診所： @G21 診所會大大影響環境，所以請仔細考慮建造地點。有必要的話可以在附近建造一些美化建築。  @L@L@L第五步 - 提供食物 @L糧倉裏已經有足夠的食物，你只需要建造一個食物貨攤： @G10 發生瘟疫的民房上會出現綠色的煙霧。只要你確保食物的供應和醫師的數量，衛生狀況就會很快好轉。當衛生狀況達到'很好'時，你可以進入下一個教程。

original: Distributing goods @LIn addition to food, households need other goods from the Agora, such as fleece for clothing.  The sample neighborhood has a working fleece industry, where shepherds tend the flock, shear sheep, and return to the Carding Shed with fleece.  Fleece is then delivered to the nearest Storehouse - only food can be stored in a Granary.  @LObserve this process, then return to learn how to provide the residents of your neighborhood with fleece. @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Producing Fleece @LFirst, place a Carding Shed next to a road in your neighborhood by selecting the Husbandry tab, and clicking the Herding button:  @G06 Then select 'sheep', and place some sheep in the meadow.  You can identify meadowland by the purple tufts of vegetation, which the sheep need to eat.   @G40 The closer your Carding Shed is to the sheep pasture, the less distance the shepherds will need to travel to tend the flock. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Storing Fleece and other goods @LBuild a Storehouse to store fleece by selecting the Distribution Tab, and clicking the Storehouse button: @G12 You can see how much fleece is stored in the city at the top of the Distribution Tab. @L@L@LStockpiling @LWhen you set a commodity be 'stockpiled', no one in the city can use it.  Commodities so designated are shown in yellow, in parenthesis, on the Distribution Tab.  Later on you may need to give this instruction, but right now you don't, so make sure none of your goods are set this way.   @L@LTo stockpile an item, click on its name.  To use the item freely, click on it again. @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Distributing fleece @LTo distribute fleece to your neighborhood's houses, you'll need another kind of vendor, a fleece vendor.  Place a Fleece Vendors' stall on your Agora by selecting the Distribution Tab, and clicking the Agora button: @G10 The fleece vendor will head for the nearest Storehouse to fetch some fleece, which is then distributed by the Agora's peddler, along with food. @L@L@LFood and Goods in houses @LRight-click on any house to see what food and goods its residents have stored inside.  When the residents of a Shack receive some fleece from the peddler, they'll upgrade their dwelling to a Homestead, or even to a Tenement, if its residents have access to two types of Culture.   @L@LMake sure you're not stockpiling your fleece, or the fleece vendor won't be able to procure any.  When you have a few Homesteads or Tenements in your neighborhood, you're ready to move on!
text: 分配物資 @L除了食物，房屋裏的居民還需要羊毛來做衣服。在本章提供的城市中已經有了羊羣和割羊毛的羊毛場。羊毛會被送進貨棧儲存。  @L請觀察一下整個過程，然後回到這個屏幕學習生產羊毛的知識。 @L@L@L第一步 - 生產羊毛 @L進入農業標籤，點擊'牧場'，建造一個羊毛場：  @G06 選擇'綿羊'，然後把一些綿羊放到草地上(草地上有紫色的植物)。   @G40 儘量讓羊毛場靠近羊羣，這樣可以提高效率。 @L@L@L第二步 - 儲存羊毛和其它物品 @L在儲存與銷售標籤中選擇貨棧： @G12 在儲存與銷售標籤的上方可以看到城裏儲存了多少羊毛。 @L@L@L儲存 @L如果你選擇'囤積'一種物資，它會以黃色顯示在括號裏。目前你還不需要囤積物資。   @L@L要囤積一種物品，點擊它的名字即可。要使用時就再點擊一下。 @L@L@L第三步 - 銷售羊毛 @L在市場裏建造羊毛貨攤： @G10 羊毛被送到貨棧後由商販四處銷售。 @L@L@L房屋裏的食物和物資 @L右鍵點擊房屋後可以看到裏面有多少食物和物資。如果棚屋得到了羊毛，就會變成簡屋。如果附近有兩種文化設施，還能變成合院。   @L@L請確保不要囤積羊毛，否則商販將無法得到羊毛去銷售。當你的城市裏出現簡屋和合院後，可以進入下一個教程。

original: Olive oil is needed by your city's households, and is produced by a two step process.  In the sample neighborhood on the left side of the city, olives are harvested from olive orchards, then pressed at the Olive Press to produce oil.  Olive oil is then distributed to houses in the same manner as fleece.  Observe this, then return to learn how to grow olives for your neighborhood, on the right side of the city. @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Growing Olives @LSelect the Husbandry tab, then click the Orchards button, and plant some olive trees in a meadow: @G19 Olive trees must be grown in a meadow, because this is the only land fertile enough to support crops.  Now place a Growers' Lodge, next to a road, so you'll have growers to tend the olive trees. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Pressing the olives @LSelect the Industry tab, then click the Workshops button to place one or two Olive Presses next to a road: @G20 When olives are harvested, they'll be prepared at the Growers' Lodge then delivered directly to an Olive Press for processing.  Surplus olives will be delivered to a Storehouse.   @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Distributing olive oil @LAdd an Oil Vendor to your Agora, and the vendor will procure oil from a Storehouse, for the peddler to deliver to your neighborhood.  Make sure you're not stockpiling olive oil, or no one will be able to get it!   With a supply of olive oil, the Tenements in your neighborhood will become Apartments! @L@L@LLabor, Workers and Wages @LRight click on any working building, such as an Olive Press to see how many employees work there.  Without enough population to staff all the working buildings in the city, production will suffer.  Make sure not to build too many industries until you have the workforce to support them.  On the Industry tab, you can change how much you pay your workers.  If you pay too low a wage, you may become unpopular. @L@LWhen you have some Apartments in your neighborhood, you're ready to proceed to the next tutorial.
text: 要生產橄欖油，首先要從橄欖樹上採摘橄欖，然後送進油坊加工。銷售橄欖油的過程和羊毛一樣。參見地圖左面的區域，之後回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第一步 - 種植橄欖 @L在農業標籤中點擊'橄欖樹'，然後在草地上種植： @G19 橄欖樹必須建在草地上。在路邊建造一個園丁小屋，這樣園丁就會看護橄欖樹。 @L@L@L第二步 - 榨油 @L在農業標籤中選擇建造油坊： @G20 橄欖收割後被送往園丁小屋，然後送往油坊榨油。多餘的橄欖將被送往貨棧。   @L@L@L第三步 - 銷售橄欖油 @L橄欖油貨攤出現後，商販會帶着橄欖油到處販賣。記住不要選擇囤積橄欖油，否則商販將無法得到橄欖油。得到橄欖油後合院會變成公寓。 @L@L@L工人和工資 @L你可以右鍵點擊建築物看看有多少工人在那裏工作。如果工人數量不夠，生產效率就會下降。在工業標籤裏你可以設置工資，如果給的工資太少，你會變得不受歡迎。 @L@L出現公寓後你就可以進入下一個教程了。

original: Now is your chance to build your first small city from scratch!   Also, while prior lessons have been 'open play', with no specific goals, here you'll need to achieve a very specific goal with your city. @L@L@LEpisode goals @LWhen you embark upon a full-fledged Adventure in Zeus, it will usually be divided into phases called 'episodes'.  To complete each episode you'll have to achieve specific goals, which are listed at the top of this panel: @G13 When you complete a mission goal, it is checked off in the list above.  To complete this episode you'll need to support at least 50 people in Apartments, by providing them with food, water, fleece, olive oil, and two types of culture! @L@LIf you think you're already familiar enough with the basic concepts of city building, you can skip ahead to the next tutorial, the first of the advanced tutorials. @L@L@LGetting started @LStart with a simple road network and some Common Housing, and soon workers will immigrate to the city: @G01 Make sure houses have access to the services of a superintendent from a Maintenance office, and to clean water from a Fountain: @G03 @G04 @L@L@LProviding food @LNext, provide your city's new households with fish to eat, by building some Fisheries, and Granaries to store the fish: @G05 @G11 Place a Common Agora to serve your houses, and add a Food Vendor's stall to procure fish from a Granary: @G10 The Agora's peddler will distribute the food to houses.  @L@L@LHygiene and Safety @LIn addition to providing food, keep plague in check by building Infirmaries, to provide households with the services of a healer: @G21 If unrest becomes a problem, place some Watchposts so watchmen can patrol the streets: @G53 @L@L@LAdd a little Culture @LGive your citizens access to some cultural diversions by building Colleges to train philosophers, and Podiums where the philosophers can preach: @G07 A few Gymnasiums will also give your citizens something to do in their spare time: @G52 @L@L@LFleece @LNext you'll need to provide your people with fleece for clothing.  Build a Carding Shed or two, and place some sheep in a meadow: @G06 Don't forget to build a storehouse to store the fleece: @G12 and add a Fleece Vendor's Stall to the Agora, to distribute the fleece to your city's households: @G10 @L@L@LOlive Oil @LBuild a Grower's Lodge, and plant some olive trees in a meadow: @G19 Remember to add an Oil Vendor's Stall to the Agora, so the oil can be distributed to your city's households. @L@L@LAesthetics and Appeal @LAs you build your city, improve the appeal of its neighborhoods by adding Recreational Areas, and Beautification structures: @G09 @G08 Before long, your city will prosper! Good Luck!  Remember to check back here if you need help. @L @L
text: 在本章裏你要開始學習建造一個小型城市了。 @L@L@L任務目標 @L遊戲裏的每一關都有要完成的任務，任務顯示在本屏幕的上方： @G13 本關的任務是建造50棟公寓，你要爲居民提供食物、水、羊毛、橄欖油和文化設施！ @L@L如果你覺得自己已經明白了建設的方法，可以直接進入高級教程。 @L@L@L開始 @L先建造道路和民房，等待移民的遷入： @G01 房屋要有管理員看護，而且附近要有噴泉： @G03 @G04 @L@L@L提供食物 @L接着建造一些漁場和糧倉： @G05 @G11 建造一個市場，添加一個食物貨攤： @G10 市場的商販開始販賣食物。  @L@L@L衛生與安全 @L爲了防止瘟疫，建造一些診所： @G21 如果治安出現問題，可以建造瞭望塔，讓督察官四處巡邏： @G53 @L@L@L建造文化設施 @L建造大學和講壇，讓學者傳播文化： @G07 建造體育館讓居民鍛鍊身體： @G52 @L@L@L羊毛 @L建造一兩個羊毛場，在草地上飼養一些綿羊，爲居民提供羊毛： @G06 建造貨棧儲存羊毛： @G12 在市場裏增加羊毛貨攤，讓商販販賣羊毛： @G10 @L@L@L橄欖油 @L建造一個園丁小屋，在草地上種植一些橄欖樹： @G19 在市場裏增加一個橄欖油貨攤，讓商販販賣橄欖油。 @L@L@L美化建築 @L建造一些能改善環境的建築： @G09 @G08 你的城市很快就會發展起來了，祝你成功！ @L @L

original: Welcome to the first advanced tutorial for Zeus.  If you've completed the beginning tutorials, or played one of our city-building games before, this is a good place to start.  For a refresher course in any of the basics, like housing, food production and agriculture, consult the beginning tutorials. @L@LIn this tutorial you'll have some fun while becoming familiar with the Zeus interface.  See what Zeus has to offer by exploring the thriving city we've provided, and don't worry about money or placing buildings - just try things out, have some fun!  If you encounter something you don't understand, return to this screen for more information by clicking the episode goals button: @G13 If you want to begin this lesson over again, click the 'start this tutorial over' button at the bottom of this panel.  @L@L@LCategory tabs @LThe Control Panel, which you can see to the right of this panel, contains several category 'tabs', each relating to a particular aspect of building and managing a city.  On each you'll find buttons for placing buildings, and summary information for the given category.  Some of the category tabs are not available in this lesson - you'll learn about them later. The tabs, from top to bottom, are: @L@LPOPULATION - This tab gives information on housing availability and migration.  Use this tab to build houses.  @L@LHUSBANDRY - This tab gives information on food availability, and lets you build structures for growing crops, and raising livestock, and harvesting wild creatures for food. @L @LINDUSTRY - Here you set your workers' wage rate, allocate labor, and even shut industries down when necessary.  Industrial buildings are used to harvest raw materials, and to manufacture most finished goods. @L @LDISTRIBUTION - This tab lists all the goods available to your city, and how much of each you have stored.  Use this tab to place structures which store, distribute, and trade these commodities.  @L @LHYGIENE AND SAFETY - This tab gives information on your city's hygiene, and unrest.  Use this tab to place structures that keep plague and unrest in check, and provide maintenance services to your city's buildings. @L@L ADMINISTRATION - You'll learn about this tab in a later lesson, 'The Palace'. @L@L CULTURE - This tab covers the Pan-Hellenic Games, and allows you to place buildings that enrich the lives of your people. @L@L MYTHOLOGY - You'll learn about this tab in a later lesson, 'Mythology'. @L@L MILITARY - You'll learn about this tab in a later lesson, 'The Warrior Society'. @L@L AESTHETICS - Use the buildings available on this tab to make your city's neighborhoods more appealing. @L@L OVERVIEW - This tab gives you an at-a-glance summary of what's going on in your city, and also shows you how popular (or unpopular!) you are among your people. @L@LTake some time to look at the information provided on the various tabs.  You can also use your mouse wheel to scroll between the tabs.  For in-depth information relating to the selected tab, click on the small magnifying glass button. Peruse the various tabs, then return here to continue by clicking on the Episode Goals button: @G13 @L@L@LSpecial city views @LClick the various 'see . . .' buttons at the top of any tab to change the view of the city so you only see certain buildings and walkers.  You can even place buildings while viewing the city this way.  Tap the spacebar to toggle special views on and off. @L@LFulfilling Requests @LRequests by other cities are listed on the Overview tab too.  A green light means you are capable of fulfilling the request.   At the start of this tutorial, Mantineia will request 10 slabs of marble.  When you have enough marble, a green light will appear next to the request.  Click on the request to dispatch it. @L@LThe Overview Map @LThe Overview tab contains a small map of the entire city.  Click on this map to jump around the city quickly.  To display the overview map in place of the information area on all tabs, click the overview map tab at the top of the control panel: @G22 To return all tabs to normal information display, click the info tab: @G23 You can also use the 'tab' key on your keyboard to switch between these two displays. @L@L@LMessages @LYou'll receive messages about important events concerning your city.  You can review your messages by clicking on the View Messages icon: @G24 Below this icon, an abbreviated version of each message is displayed when it arrives.  Use the up and down arrows to scroll through these messages, and click on any one to read its full version.  To control how messages are displayed when you receive them, choose Options: messages from the menu bar.   @L@L@L'Go To' buttons @LWhen an event such as a plague, the arrival of a visitor or an invasion occurs, a 'go to' button appears above the message box, which you can click on to jump to the site of the event.  @G25  During this tutorial, an earthquake will occur, which will give you a chance to try this out.  @L @L
text: 在進入高級教程前請先完成普通教程。 @L@L在我們爲你建好的這座城市裏，你可以首先隨便看看，不用去擔心建設的問題。如果你遇到問題，可以回到這個屏幕： @G13 如果你想重新開始教程，可以點擊'重新開始'。  @L@L@L標籤 @L在控制面板上有實現各類功能的標籤，有些標籤目前還無法使用。這些標籤從上到下分別爲： @L@L人口標籤 - 查看房屋和人口。建造房屋。  @L@L農業標籤 - 查看食物儲備，建造農業建築。 @L @L工業標籤 - 設置工資、分配勞力、關閉工場，建造各種工業設施。 @L @L儲存與銷售標籤 - 列出城裏所有的物資，決定銷售、儲存或進出口。  @L @L衛生與安全標籤 - 查看衛生和治安情況，對它們進行防範。維護城裏的建築。 @L@L 管理標籤 - 在'宮殿'這一章你會了解這個標籤的用途。 @L@L 文化標籤 - 查看泛希臘競賽的情況，建造文化設施。 @L@L 神話標籤 - 在'神話'這一章你會了解這個標籤的用途。 @L@L 軍事標籤 - 在'士兵'這一章你會了解這個標籤的用途。 @L@L 環境標籤 - 讓城市更美麗。 @L@L 總覽標籤 - 城市總覽，同時查看你的受歡迎程度。 @L@L請花點時間看看各個標籤的內容。如果有不懂的地方，可以按那個放大鏡的圖標觀看幫助文件，看完之後回到這個屏幕： @G13 @L@L@L城市特殊顯示方式 @L點擊各個標籤上方的'查看 . . .'按鈕，可以用各種特定的方式顯示城市。按空格鍵可以在特殊模式和普通模式之間轉換。 @L@L完成請求 @L總覽標籤中還會列出其它國家的請求，綠色的表示你有能力完成請求。在本關開始的時候門提尼會向你索要10塊大理石，當你得到10塊大理石後它會變成綠色，點擊後就可以送出了。 @L@L總覽地圖 @L你可以通過總覽地圖直接到達城市的各個角落。如果要在每個標籤裏都顯示小地圖，可以點擊右上方的標籤： @G22 要恢復正常顯示，點擊這個標籤： @G23 你也可以按TAB鍵進行模式轉換。 @L@L@L消息 @L你可以通過這個按鈕觀看收到的所有消息： @G24 點擊消息標題就可以觀看全文。你可以到選項菜單裏設置消息顯示方式。   @L@L@L查看按鈕 @L如果城裏發生什麼事情，會出現一個查看按鈕，點擊後可以直接到達事發地點。  @G25  本章中將出現一次地震，你可以使用一下查看按鈕。  @L @L

original: Trade @LYou can buy goods from other cities, and make money selling your city's products.  If you haven't maintained good relations with the leader of another city, or if he is an outright rival, he won't want to trade with you.  Click on the View World icon to see which cities will trade with you.  In this tutorial, you'll see that Mantineia, an ally, is connected to your city, Megara, by a land trade route (red), and that Cyprus, a distant city, is connected to your city by a sea trade route (blue): @G26 Click on these cities to see what they buy and sell, and in what quantities, then return here to learn about importing and exporting.   @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Importing @LMantineia sells bronze, which may be used to manufacture sculpture to sell to Cyprus for a profit!  To trade with Mantineia, add a Trading Post to the sample city.  On the Distribution Tab, click the Trade Buildings button, then Trading Post: Mantineia: @G27 The Trading Post is something like a large Storehouse.  Place it next to a road near the Granary.  Right click on the Post, then click the bronze 'not buying' button so it says, 'buying'.  Soon traders from Mantineia will visit the Post, and exchange bronze for some of your drachmas.  When you have some bronze in the Trading Post, return here to continue. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Making Sculpture @LWith a supply of bronze you can make sculpture to sell to Cyprus for a profit.  On the Industry tab, click the Workshops button, then place a Sculpture Studio in the city: @G20 Soon deliverymen from the Trading Post will start supplying the Studio with imported bronze, so sculptures may be cast.  When you have a working Sculpture Studio, return to learn how to export sculpture.   @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Exporting @LTo export sculpture to Cyprus, which trades by water, you'll need to build a Pier.  A Pier is like a Trading Post for ships.  Select the Distribution Tab, then click the Trade Buildings button, and select Pier: Cyprus: @G27 Place the Pier along a straight section of coast, and make sure it's connected by road to your Sculpture Studios.  Near one of the fisheries is a good spot.  Right click on the Pier, then click the sculpture 'not selling' button so it says 'selling'.  The Sculpture Studio will deliver its products to the Pier, where they'll be picked up by Cypriot trade ships for a hefty sum!  Export items in a trade building set to 'selling' are reserved for traders only, cannot be used for any other purpose, and are not counted on the Distribution Tab. @L@L@LAnnual Profit @LTo complete this episode, you need to turn a profit of 500 Drachmas in a single year.  This 'annual profit' goal is displayed at the top of this panel, on the left.  To its right you'll see an assessment of your progress toward achieving this goal.    @L@L@LStock Limits @LFor exports, the stock limit dictates how much of the item will be regularly kept on hand, and reserved, for traders to buy.  Each trader can carry only a limited amount.  If you set the limit too high, the trader may not be able to purchase all the reserved goods in a single visit, and your people may be deprived of some goods they need. @L@LFor imports, each time a trader visits he will drop off goods until the stock limit is reached, after which deliverymen will empty the trading facility.  Don't import more than you need, or you could go broke very quickly.  For importing bronze in this episode, 12 is a good stock limit. @L@L@LSell enough sculpture and you'll meet the annual profit goal needed to complete this episode, or click 'next tutorial' to move ahead when you think you're ready. @L @L
text: 貿易 @L你可以和其它城市進行貿易，不過敵對的城市不會和你展開貿易。你可以用'大地圖'按鈕查看周圍的城市。你可以看到門提尼和你的城市墨伽拉有陸地貿易線路(紅色)，塞浦路斯和你有海洋貿易路線(藍色)： @G26 點擊這些城市看看它們買進和賣出什麼貨物，然後回到這個屏幕。   @L@L@L第一步 - 進口 @L門提尼賣出青銅，你可以購買後製成雕像賣給塞浦路斯賺上一筆。要和門提尼展開貿易，你要進入儲存與銷售標籤,然後建立一個和門提尼貿易的貿易站： @G27 把貿易站中的青銅一項設定爲'進口'，不久門提尼的商人就會帶着青銅來交易。 @L@L@L第二步 - 製造雕像 @L選擇工業標籤中的'工場'，然後建造'鑄像場'： @G20 不久貿易站的送貨工就會把青銅送到鑄像場。建成鑄像場後請回到這個屏幕。   @L@L@L第三步 - 出口 @L要向塞浦路斯出口，你要建造一個貿易港。進入儲存與銷售標籤,然後建立一個和塞浦路斯貿易的貿易港： @G27 把貿易港建在平直的海岸邊，並且以道路和鑄像場連接。把雕像設置成'出口'後，就會有商船向塞浦路斯出口雕像。列爲要出口的物資不能再使用，統計物資時也不被計算在內。 @L@L@L年收入 @L要完成本章的任務，你必須在一年裏得到500銀幣。這個目標顯示在屏幕左上方，右邊是完成進度的預測。    @L@L@L進出口上限 @L你可以設定各種貨物的進出口上限。 @L@L對於要進口的青銅，上限設定爲12比較合適。 @L@L@L只要賣掉一些雕像就可以達到500銀幣的收入水平，然後進入下一個教程。 @L @L

original: Buying raw materials and selling finished goods is a great way to turn a profit in the Greek world.  If you've mastered this skill, you will surely become a wealthy and influential leader!
text: 買進原材料，加工後再出口，這是致富的良方！

original: This tutorial is comprised of two episodes.  In the first episode you'll learn how to worship Dionysus by building a Sanctuary in his honor.  In the second episode, you'll put this Sanctuary to use for your city.  @L@L@LThe Gods of Greece @LThe gods crave the worship of mortals like you, and can offer you many things in return for your devotion.  Gods will visit your city from time to time, extolling the many benefits they can provide for you should you choose to worship them.   @L@L@LSanctuaries @LTo worship a god you must construct a Sanctuary dedicated to him or her.  This is no mean feat; constructing a Sanctuary requires marble, wood and sculpture, and the services of artisans.  To complete this episode, the first part of the Mythology tutorial, you need to erect a Sanctuary dedicated to Dionysus, called the 'Grove of Dionysus'. @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Quarrying the Marble   @LTo build any Sanctuary, the first thing you'll need is marble.  Marble may be obtained from a quarry like the one behind the Maintenance Office.  To quarry marble, select the Industry tab, click the Raw Materials button, then select Masonry Shop:   @G28 Masonry Shops don't need to be right next to the quarry, but the closer they are, the faster their stonecutters can get to the site.  Make sure you have a Storehouse ready to accept the quarried marble. @L@LYou'll need eight slabs of marble just to place the base and steps for Dionysus' Sanctuary.   @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Placing the Sanctuary @LWhen you have enough marble, select the Mythology tab, click the Sanctuaries button, then select Grove of Dionysus:	 @G29 Place the Sanctuary wherever you'd like, then return here to continue.  Make sure you're not 'stockpiling' marble, or you'll never finish constructing the Sanctuary! @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Hiring Artisans @LArtisans perform all the work of constructing a Sanctuary.  On the Mythology tab, click the Artisans' Guild button to place some Guilds close to the construction site: @G30 Artisans will report to work at the construction site, and call for deliveries of marble, wood and sculpture when they need it.  @L@L@LSTEP FOUR - Harvesting Wood @LYou have marble and sculpture, but you'll also need wood to aid construction of the Sanctuary.  Lumberjacks from a Timber Mill harvest wood from trees.  Click the Raw Materials button, then place a Timber Mill along a road:  @G28 Soon the Timber Mill will start supplying Storehouses with wood, which the artisans will procure as needed. @L@LAs soon as the Sanctuary is finished, this episode will be complete, and you'll be shown the 'Victory Screen'.  From there you can proceed to the next episode of this tutorial, where you'll learn how to put this Sanctuary to use.   @L @L
text: 本章分兩部分，首先建造狄俄尼索斯聖所，然後掌握使用聖所的方法。  @L@L@L希臘的神明 @L如果你爲神明建造了聖所並定期祭祀，他們就會以各種形式幫助你。   @L@L@L聖所 @L要建造聖所，你需要大理石、木材和雕像，並且要招募工匠。在本章裏你要建造一座狄俄尼索斯聖所。 @L@L@L第一步 - 採集大理石   @L你首先要建造一個石料加工廠。選擇工業標籤中的'原材料'，然後建造石料加工廠：   @G28 石料加工廠離採石場越近，效率越高。附近要有貨棧準備儲存石料。 @L@L你需要8塊大理石來建造狄俄尼索斯聖所。   @L@L@L第二步 - 放置聖所 @L大理石夠了之後，選擇神話標籤，點擊'聖所'，選擇狄俄尼索斯聖所：	 @G29 放置好聖所後你可以回到這個屏幕。記住不要囤積大理石，否則就建不成聖所了。 @L@L@L第三步 - 招募工匠 @L在神話標籤中選擇建造工匠行，離建造場地越近越好： @G30 工匠負責建造聖所，協調各種物資。  @L@L@L第四步 - 伐木 @L點擊原材料按鈕，在道路邊建造一所伐木小屋：  @G28 伐木小屋會爲工匠們提供木材。 @L@L聖所建成後本章任務就完成了，在下一章教程中你可以掌握聖所的用法。   @L @L

original: Welcome to episode two of the Mythology tutorial.  You'll be shown an introductory screen like this whenever you proceed to another episode within the same Adventure, or when you begin a new Adventure altogether.  In this episode, the second and last of the Mythology tutorial, you're going to learn how to battle monsters, summon heroes, and pray to the gods. @L@L@LThe Olympian Gods @LThe gods of Greece have their own agenda, and rarely get along with one another.  Whatever adventure you undertake, some gods will support your efforts, while others will seek to thwart you.  Those on your side, like Dionysus, periodically appeal to you for worship, encouraging you to build a Sanctuary in their honor.  Those who oppose you may not make their presence known, until you do something to offend them. @L@L@LSacrifices and Sanctuary benefits @LA Sanctuary needs regular sacrifices to function, so that its god can appear in the city, walk the streets, and sanctify certain buildings.  Each god also provides other benefits.  For example at Dionysus' Sanctuary you can grow grapevines, which can be turned into wine at a Winery.  You can also pray to Dionysus for wine. @L@L@LTending Grapevines @LYou'll need some growers to tend the grapevines at Dionysus' Sanctuary.  Select the Husbandry tab, then click the Orchards button to place some Growers' Lodges along a road, preferably close to the Sanctuary: @G19 Growers from the lodge will tend, prune and harvest the grapes, then deliver them to a Winery or Storehouse. @L@L@LMaking Wine @LA Winery receives grapes from a Growers' Lodge, and presses them into wine.  Build a Winery with the Workshops button on the Industry tab: @G20 The Winery will deliver amphorae of wine to a Storehouse, where they may be procured by an Agora's wine vendor. @L@L@LMonsters and Heroes @LIf a Cyclops happens to show up, you can call upon the legendary hero, Odysseus, to deal with the matter. Once you get word that the one-eyed beast is on his way, build a Hero's Hall for Odysseus by clicking on the Hero's Hall button on the Mythology tab: @G31 Heroes are in high demand throughout Greece, so you can't build a Hall unless you really need the hero.  You won't be able to call Odysseus until you've prepared the city to meet his high standards.   @L@L@LCalling forth the hero @LRight click on the Hero's Hall to see what Odysseus expects of the city before he deems it worthy of his presence.  One thing you'll need to call the hero is wine, which you may obtain by praying to Dionysus at his Sanctuary. Don't worry if it takes you some time to get rid of the Cyclops - in this episode he's mostly interested in your sheep, and he'll occupy himself flattening them with his club for a while. @L@L@LRetaliation @LOf course you've got to rid your city of monsters, but don't be surprised if the Cyclops' father, the god Poseidon has something to say about this. @L@L@LGods vs. Gods @LIf a god like Poseidon feels the need to attack your city, only another, more powerful god may combat him.  Zeus is the only god strong enough to stand up to his brother Poseidon, but you can't build a Sanctuary for Zeus in this tutorial.  Stick around to experience Poseidon's rage, and when you've had enough, you're ready to move on. @L @L
text: 歡迎來到神話教程的第二部分。在本章裏你將掌握使用聖所的方法、召喚英雄以及祭祀。 @L@L@L奧林匹亞的神明 @L奧林匹亞的神明們憎惡分明，根據你的所作所爲，有些神明會幫助你，有些則會和你作對。 @L@L@L祭祀以及聖所的用處 @L要神明幫助你，你必須定期祭祀。每個神明會爲你做的事情都不同，例如狄俄尼索斯會爲你種植葡萄藤，你可以讓園丁小屋的園丁栽培葡萄。此外，城裏將會沒有罪犯。 @L@L@L栽培葡萄 @L要建造園丁小屋，選擇農業標籤，然後選擇'園丁小屋'，最好建在聖所附近： @G19 葡萄採摘後會被送往酒坊或貨棧。 @L@L@L釀酒 @L在工業標籤中選擇建造酒坊： @G20 葡萄酒會被送到貨棧，然後運到市場。 @L@L@L怪物和英雄 @L如果你得知獨眼巨人要來，就選擇神話標籤，然後建造奧德修斯府邸： @G31 英雄是非常忙碌的，如果你沒有需要，就無法召喚他們。   @L@L@L召喚英雄 @L要召喚英雄，你需要有足夠的葡萄酒。你可以向狄俄尼索斯祭祀來獲得葡萄酒。在本章裏你不必擔心獨眼巨人，他會花許多時間去對付綿羊。 @L@L@L報復 @L擊敗獨眼巨人後，他的主人海神波賽東就會和你結仇。 @L@L@L神明間的衝突 @L如果像波賽東這樣的神明要攻擊你，你只能要求宙斯來對付他。不過本章裏你無法建造宙斯聖所，所以只能看着波賽東搞破壞。你現在可以進入下一個教程。 @L @L

original: Excellent job!  You've completed the first episode of this tutorial. Adventures in Zeus normally consist of multiple episodes, in which you continue to develop a single city.  In the next episode you'll pick up where the previous episode left off, and you'll learn more about the gods, monsters and heroes you're likely to encounter in the Greek world.
text: 很好，你完成了這個任務。在本章的後半部分，你還要接着完成任務，同時掌握與神明、怪獸和英雄有關的知識。

original: Tutorial: Mythology: Building a Sanctuary Parent victory 2
text: 教程：神話與聖所建造，母城勝利二

original: Citizen Soldiers @LThough you cannot build a standing army, your ordinary citizens will fight to defend the city.  Those from the lowest strata of society fight as 'rabble', armed only with rocks to throw at the enemy.  In this lesson you're going to learn how to call your people to arms, and command them in battle.  To do this, you will first need a Palace from which to command them.  @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Building a Palace @LFrom the Administration tab, click the Palace button, and place a Palace on the long section of road near the Infirmary and Podium.  The Palace is a large, rectangular building, so before actually placing it, use the 'r' key to rotate it to the orientation you prefer:  @G34 Even when going about their daily lives, the people of your city automatically divide themselves into military companies, and place their standards around the Palace.  Rabble standards are capped by a fist clenching a rock.  To see standards located behind the Palace, you may need to rotate the city using the button at the bottom of the Control Panel.  Build the Palace, observe the standards, then return here to continue. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Moving Standards @LThe standard tells a company where you want it to go, when you call them to arms.  To move a company's standard, click on its base, then click again where you want to place it.  You may need to rotate the city to select standards located behind the Palace.  You can return standards to the Palace in the same way. @L@L@LCalling the Soldiers to Arms @LSimply moving a company's standard into the field is not the same as calling its soldiers to arms.  To call a company's soldiers from their homes or 'muster' them, click on the standard then click the Muster button: @G35 The same button is used to send the company's soldiers home when you don't need them.  This will not automatically return the standards to the Palace.  Keeping soldiers mustered when there's no fighting will make you unpopular, but it's often a good idea to leave standards at strategic locations in the field, as long as you send the soldiers home.   @L@LMorale  @LIf a company's morale falls too low as a result of combat, its standard will be returned to the Palace, and its men will flee to their homes until they regain their composure. @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Giving Orders to companies @LAfter selecting a company standard, use the buttons on the Control Panel to rotate the company's line, or to tell them to use defensive, offensive, or special tactics: @G37 @G38 @G39 Practice moving standards around and giving orders.   @L@L@LInvasions @LIn this lesson, the rival city of Nemea will invade, so that you may have the opportunity to apply your tactical skills to defend the city.  You may also bribe invaders to leave the city unharmed, if you don't want to risk the lives of your citizens.  @L@L@LAutomatically responding to invasions @LYou can use the Auto-defend button to instruct your military to automatically respond to invasions when they occur, and to stand down when the city is safely out of danger: @G36 This instruction must be given WELL in advance of an invasion, so if you don't intend to control your military forces manually, always leave Auto-defend 'on'. @L@L@LSaving the city @LIf you successfully save the city from invasion, by any means, you'll be able to build a Commemorative Monument from the Aesthetics tab, to celebrate your triumph! @G56 @L@LReturn here when you're ready to learn about the other functions of the Palace. @L@L@LCollecting Taxes @LWith a Palace in your city, you can also collect taxes.  On the Administration tab, click the Tax Office button to place some Tax Offices, and soon clerks will begin roaming the city's neighborhoods collecting taxes: @G54 Set the tax rate with the arrows on the Administration tab.  A high tax rate could reduce your popularity.  Click 'see tax income' to see which houses are visited by a clerk, and how much money their residents pay.  When you've collected some taxes, you're ready to move on to the next tutorial. @L@L @L
text: 民兵 @L你目前沒有正規軍，但是可以讓居民變成民兵，不過他們只能用石塊攻擊。在本章裏你將學習招募和指揮軍隊，不過首先你得建造一個宮殿。  @L@L@L第一步 - 建造宮殿 @L進入管理標籤，點擊宮殿按鈕，把宮殿建在路邊，靠近診所和講壇。宮殿非常大，所以在確認位置之前先按'r'鍵調整一下：  @G34 民兵駐紮的位置會有旗幟標出，上面有個手握着石頭的圖案。你可以用控制面板上的按鈕旋轉視角。看完之後回到這個屏幕。@L@L@L第二步 - 移動的旗幟 @L如果你想讓軍隊移動，可以點擊基地，然後點擊目的地。軍隊移動時會有個旗幟標明。 @L@L@L召集軍隊 @L點擊旗幟，再選擇'召集部隊'： @G35 再點擊同一個按鈕可以讓士兵復員。如果你長期不讓士兵復員，會影響自己的受歡迎程度。   @L@L士氣  @L如果士兵戰敗，士氣低落，可能會變成逃兵。 @L@L@L第三步 - 指揮部隊 @L用控制面板中的按鈕控制部隊： @G37 @G38 @G39 請練習一下指揮部隊的方法。   @L@L@L防禦 @L在本章里納米爾會向你進攻，你可以練習一下防禦技巧。如果你不想讓軍隊遭受損失，也可以賄賂對方，讓他們直接退兵。  @L@L@L自動防禦 @L你可以讓軍隊自動防禦任何進攻： @G36 這個命令必須在敵人入侵前下達。 @L@L@L保衛城市 @L如果你成功保衛了自己的城市，就可以建造紀念碑。紀念碑在環境標籤裏。 @G56 @L@L熟悉後請回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L收稅 @L在管理標籤中建造稅務所，很快稅務官就會開始收稅： @G54 在管理標籤中設置稅率。過高的稅率會讓你變得不受歡迎。點擊'查看稅收'後可以看到城裏的稅收情況。完成後進入下一個教程。 @L@L @L

original: Elite Warriors @LIn this tutorial you're going to learn how to create and command the most advanced types of fighting men.  Well-to-do citizens who can afford their own armor live in much finer housing than the 'rabble', and fight as foot soldiers called 'hoplites'.  The wealthiest individuals, those who can afford to keep their own horses as well as armor, fight as horsemen.  In this lesson you'll learn how to support hoplites; you'll learn how to support horsemen in a later tutorial.  @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Elite housing @LElite warriors must live in Elite Housing, and no amount of fine goods or culture is going to turn a common household into an elite household!   You need some food, fleece and oil just to place an Elite house, and each must be placed in an appealing area. Select the Population tab, click the Elite housing button, then place three Elite houses amongst the gardens near the Palace: @G32 After some people move in, right click on one of the Elite houses to see what its residents need in order to become more affluent.  After you do this, return here to continue. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Armor @LYour recently established Elite households need armor so the men of the family can equip themselves as hoplites.  The Grand Agora can hold up to six Vendors, and thus provide all the goods needed by elite households.  Add an Arms Vendor to the Grand Agora, by clicking the Agoras button on the Distribution Tab: @G10 Soon the arms vendor will procure armor from the Storehouse, so the Agora's peddler can distribute it to Elite households.  A household's supply of armor does not need to be replenished unless its wearer is killed in combat.  When some elite households obtain armor, additional 'hoplite' standards, capped with bronze helmets, will appear around the Palace!  It takes a few households to make up a single company of hoplites.  @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Assessing your Army @LAll your companies are represented at the top of the Military tab by a fist (rabble), a helmet (hoplites) or a horse (horsemen).  Click 'see security' at the top of this tab, to view only military buildings and walkers, and to see which Elite houses have armed hoplites living inside.  @L@L@LTriremes @LA Trireme Wharf needs wood and armor to produce a Trireme with a complement of marines.  To build a Trireme Wharf, click the Military Workshops button on the Military tab, then find a good place on the coast to place the Wharf: @G33 Trireme crews are summoned, and triremes are controlled, via a set of orders buttons similar to those of companies.  Operating a trireme requires a lot of manpower, so it's a good idea to send your crews home when they're not needed.   @L@L@L Defensive fortifications @LTowers and Walls are manned by citizens from the lowest ranks of society, and can be an effective way to protect your city from invasion.  Defensive structures are built from the Fortifications button on the Military tab: @G55 Place Walls at strategic locations to defend your city, or even to encircle your city.  You can make Walls as thick as you like by placing an additional wall along an existing one.   @L@LPlace Gatehouses at certain points along the Wall, to allow traders and other well-intentioned visitors access to the city. When placing a Gatehouse, use the 'r' key to orient it the way you like.   @L@LTowers may be placed onto Walls that are at least double thickness, using the Fortifications button.  Towers must be manned, and require a road connection to the Palace.   @L@LCalling soldiers en masse @LTo call all your foot soldiers to arms, or call all crews to their triremes, or man all towers, click the 'call all', 'crew all', or 'not manning' buttons on the Military tab.  Manning all your city's Towers and triremes, and mustering all your soldiers, will impact the available labor pool, often dramatically.  It's best not to call upon your military unless their services are truly needed.   @L@LWhen you've successfully defended your city from invasion by Nemea, you're ready to move on to the next tutorial. @L @L
text: 正規士兵 @L正規士兵包括步兵和騎兵，他們都來自高級住宅。  @L@L@L第一步 - 高級住宅 @L要建造高級住宅，你需要食物、羊毛和橄欖油，而且要建在環境好的對方。進入人口標籤，在宮殿旁的花園邊上建造三所高級住宅： @G32 建成後右鍵點擊高級住宅看看居民需要什麼物資，然後回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第二步 - 盔甲 @L步兵需要盔甲。你要建造大型市場，然後增加兵器貨攤： @G10 高級住宅得到盔甲後，就會出現步兵。步兵達到一定數量後宮殿邊上會出現他們的旗幟，上面有頭盔圖案。  @L@L@L第三步 - 管理軍隊 @L在軍事標籤中點擊'查看安全'可以看到城市裏的軍事狀況。  @L@L@L三層船 @L首先建造軍事標籤裏的三層船碼頭，等有了足夠的木材和盔甲就可以建造三層船。 @G33 三層船的指揮方式和步兵相同。操縱三層船需要大量人手，不航行時記得讓水手離開。   @L@L@L 防禦設施 @L塔樓和城牆是非常有效的防禦防禦設施，它們在軍事標籤的'防禦設施'下： @G55 你可以把城牆建成好幾層厚。   @L@L在城牆間建造門樓後，商人和訪客就可以從門樓出入城市。用'r'鍵可以轉動門樓的方向。   @L@L塔樓要建在至少兩層厚的城牆上，塔樓必須駐兵，而且需要有道路和宮殿相連。   @L@L召集部隊 @L你可以點擊'召集所有士兵'和'召集所有船員'讓士兵進入戰鬥崗位。由於這會影響工農業的人力資源，所以沒有必要時最好不要隨便召集部隊。   @L@L防禦住納米爾的進攻後，你可以進入下一個教程。 @L @L

original: Tutorial: The Warrior Society Parent victory 1
text: 教程：軍事社會，母城勝利一

original: In this tutorial you'll start with an already thriving city, and learn how to establish a colony to serve its needs.  There are three episodes in this tutorial.  In the second episode, you'll leave the parent-city, Megara, to actually build the colony. @L@LSetting goods aside for the Colony @LYou often have to set aside goods in preparation for starting a colony.  To complete this episode, and move on to establish the colony, you'll need to set aside 8 amphorae of wine. Wine is also craved by Elite households (and Centaurs, for that matter).  @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Planting Grapevines @LSelect the Husbandry tab, then click the Orchards button and plant several grapevines: @G19 @G40 Grapevines must be planted on meadowland, but do not need to be next to a road.  The more grapevines you plant, the more grapes will be harvested, provided you have enough growers to tend them. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Tending the Grapevines @LOlive trees and grapevines are tended by growers from the Growers' Lodge.  Select the Husbandry tab, then click the Orchards button to place some Growers' Lodges along a road, preferably close to the grapevines: @G19 Growers from the lodge will tend, prune and harvest the grapes, then deliver them to a Winery or Storehouse. @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Making Wine @LA Winery receives grapes from a Growers' Lodge, and presses them into wine.  Build a Winery with the Workshops button on the Industry tab: @G20 The Winery will deliver amphorae of wine to a Storehouse, where they may be procured by an Agora's wine vendor. @L@L@LSTEP FOUR - Setting aside wine for the Colony @LWhen you begin making wine, you'll see a 'set aside' button at the top of this panel, showing how much wine you have stored.  When you have at least 8 amphorae of wine in a Storehouse, click the 'set aside' button above, then right click to EXIT THIS PANEL.  Do NOT click the 'Next Tutorial' button if you want to continue to the colony episode.  When the month is over, the Victory Screen will announce your triumph, and you'll be able to continue to the colony episode. @L @L
text: 在本章裏你會擁有一個已經很繁榮的城市，本章分爲三個任務，在第二個任務中你將離開母城去建造殖民地。 @L@L要建立殖民地，你要準備一些物資。要完成任務，你需要準備8罐酒。  @L@L@L第一步 - 種植葡萄 @L通過農業標籤種植一些葡萄藤： @G19 @G40 葡萄藤必須種在草地上，不一定要靠着道路。 @L@L@L第二步 - 栽培葡萄 @L通過農業標籤建造一個園丁小屋。園丁小屋要建在道路旁，而且離葡萄藤越近越好： @G19 園丁會栽培並收割葡萄，然後送進酒坊或貨棧。 @L@L@L第三步 - 釀酒 @L通過工業標籤建造酒坊，酒坊會把葡萄釀成葡萄酒： @G20 釀好的葡萄酒會被送往貨棧。 @L@L@L第四步 - 爲殖民地準備酒 @L開始釀酒後，你會看到一個'撥出'按鈕，顯示出你有多少葡萄酒。當你得到8罐葡萄酒後，點擊'撥出'按鈕，然後退出這個面板。在當月結束的時候你會看到任務完成信息，此時你可以開始下一個任務。 @L @L

original: Putting the Colony to work @LSTEP ONE - Trading with Halicarnassos @LNow that you're back in Megara, place a Trading Post for Halicarnassos, to import wheat and bronze from the colony.  These goods will help you build a more powerful military: the bronze may be forged into armor, and the wheat may be used to raise horses for horsemen. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Making Armor @LElite households need armor so their occupants can equip themselves as warriors. Click the Military Workshops button on the Military tab, select Armory, then place an Armory: @G33 Soon the Trading Post will start delivering bronze to the Armory, where it will be pounded into armor, and delivered to the nearest Storehouse.  @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Raising Horses @LThe wealthiest residents of your city can afford to keep their own horses, which they will proudly ride into battle as horsemen.  Horses are raised on a Horse Ranch, and brought to elite houses by the Horse Trainer, an Agora Vendor.  To build a Horse Ranch, click the Military Workshops button on the Military tab: @G33 Make sure you're importing wheat from Halicarnassos, and it will be delivered to the Horse Ranch from the Trading Post.  @L@L@LSTEP FOUR - Horsemen @LHorsemen need armor, wine and of course horses.  Add vendors for these items to the Agora by clicking the Agoras button on the Distribution Tab: @G10 When a peddler delivers wine, armor and horses to some Elite houses, they'll transform into Estates, and their residents will become horsemen.  When you have four horsemen in the city, you will have completed this episode. @L @L
text: 讓殖民地開始運作 @L第一步 - 和哈力納展開貿易 @L回到墨伽拉後，建立一個對應於哈力納的貿易站。青銅可以打造盔甲，小麥可以餵養馬匹。 @L@L@L第二步 - 打造盔甲 @L戰士需要盔甲。在軍事標籤中選擇建造防具鋪： @G33 貿易站會把青銅送到防具鋪，打造出盔甲後送到附近的貨棧。  @L@L@L第三步 - 養馬 @L在軍事標籤中選擇建造馬場： @G33 貿易站會把小麥送到馬場。  @L@L@L第四步 - 騎兵 @L騎兵需要盔甲、葡萄酒和馬匹。你要建造市場，然後增加相應的貨攤： @G10 當高級住宅得到盔甲、葡萄酒和馬匹後，就會變成領地。得到四個騎兵後本章任務結束。 @L @L

original: Normally you'll have more than one site to choose from when establishing a colony, but here only Halicarnassos is available.  This site offers good soil for wheat farming, and has some deposits of silver and copper ore.
text: 一般你可以選擇好幾個地方建立殖民地，不過在本章裏你只能在哈力納建立殖民地。這個地方適合建造小麥農場，並且銀礦和銅礦資源豐富。

original: Getting Started @LEventually this colony will supply Megara with wheat, bronze, and annual tribute payments.  You already know the basics of setting up a city, but you'll need to learn about growing wheat to feed this colony, and how to mine silver to make some money. @L@L@LSTEP ONE - Farming @LSeveral different crops may be grown throughout the Pan-Hellenic world, but the soil of this area is only good for growing wheat.  To place some Wheat Farms, click the Farms button on the Husbandry tab: @G41 @G40 All Farms must be placed on meadowland, identified by purple tufts of vegetation.  Farms must also have access to a road.  You may have to build some Water Crossings, from the Administration tab, to access the meadowland. @L@LBuild some houses, and set up some wheat farming to be able to feed your people, then return here to continue. @L@L@LSTEP TWO - Mining Silver @LYou won't get far without a source of income.  Halicarnassos offers rich deposits of silver ore, which can be struck into coins.  You can see the silver ore in the rock to the north: @G43 To mine silver and strike coins, place a Mint by clicking the Raw Materials button on the Industry tab: @G28	 You don't need to place the Mint right next to silver ore.  Miners will travel as far as they have to, but the shorter their trip, the faster the Mint will be supplied.  Once the Mint is up and running, drachmas will start flowing into your treasury.   @L@LWhen you've struck some coins, return here to continue. @L@L@LSTEP THREE - Making Requests @LColonies often need to rely on their parent city for support.  To develop some of this colony's housing into Apartments, you'll need fleece and oil.  You can't import these items, but you can requisition them from the parent-city, Megara or request them from your ally, Mantineia. Click on the View World button, then click on one of the cities on the map, such as Megara:  @G46 When a city is selected like this on the World Map, the World Control Panel shows you information about it, and provides buttons for you to interact with the city. @L@LWith either Megara or Mantineia selected, click the Make Request button, and ask for what you need: @G44 Make sure you have space in a Storehouse to receive any goods you request. @L@LRequesting Military Aid @LWith only rabble at your disposal, you won't be able to defend the fledgling colony very well without some assistance.  If a rival seeks to take advantage of the colony's vulnerability, and launches an invasion, you can ask your allies, or the parent city to loan you military forces to defend the colony.  Of course, you can always bribe the invaders, if you can afford it. @L@L@LSTEP FOUR - Returning the Favor @LThe more you ask for, the more other leaders will expect in return, in the form of gifts and your fulfilling their requests.  Other leaders' requests and demands are displayed on the Overview tab. To fulfill a request, click on it, or select the requesting city on the World Map, then click the Fulfill Request button: @G47 Even if a request is overdue, it's still beneficial to make the effort, and send the items asked for before the request vanishes entirely. @L@L@LGiving Gifts @LTo give a gift, select a city on the World Map, then click the Give Gift button: @G48 Giving gifts and fulfilling requests makes allies and subjects more likely to help you, and makes rivals less likely to attack.      @L@LYour rival Nemea may occasionally demand wine during this episode.  You may acquire wine by asking Megara, or you may ask Megara to loan military forces to defend the colony, in case Nemea decides to attack.   @L@L@LHow other leaders regard you @LYou'll see how each leader feels about you on the World Control Panel, when you select his city.  Click on this descriptor for advice.   @LTo see how your relationship with this leader got this way, click on the small history scroll: @G45 A 'thumbs up' means the event was looked upon favorably by the leader; a 'thumbs down' means it was not.  @L@L@LSTEP FIVE - Mining Copper and Making Bronze @LCopper can be alloyed to make bronze.  Copper is mined in a manner similar to silver, but from a different kind of rock: @G42  To mine copper and make bronze, place a Foundry by clicking the Raw Materials button on the Industry tab: @G28 You don't need to place the Foundry right next to the source of copper ore. Miners will travel as far as they need to, but shortening their trip means the Foundry will work more efficiently.   @L@L@LSTEP SIX - Setting goods aside for the Parent City @LJust as you needed to set aside wine in Megara to prepare for establishing this colony, here you need to set aside some bronze and wheat for Megara, to prove the colony's viability.  When you have enough of these items stored up, click the appropriate 'set aside' button to satisfy the episode goal, and return to the parent city, Megara. @L @L
text: 開始 @L你已經知道如何建設城市了，不過現在你要掌握種植小麥以及採礦的方法。 @L@L@L第一步 - 種植小麥 @L從農業標籤中選擇小麥農場： @G41 @G40 農場必須建在草地上，而且要和道路相連。你可能還需要從管理標籤中選擇建造浮橋來連接草地。 @L@L建造一些房屋，再建造幾個小麥農場爲人們提供食物。完成後回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第二步 - 開採銀礦 @L銀礦可以用來鑄造銀幣，你可以在北面找到銀礦： @G43 在工業標籤中的'原材料'中建造鑄幣場： @G28	 鑄幣場離銀礦越近效率越高，建成後它就開始鑄造銀幣。   @L@L當你得到一些銀幣後，回到這個屏幕。 @L@L@L第三步 - 提出請求 @L殖民地的房屋發展需要羊毛和橄欖油，你無法進口，只能向母城或盟友請求。點擊'大地圖'按鈕，然後點擊一個城市，例如墨伽拉：  @G46 選中城市後，控制面板中會出現相應的按鈕。 @L@L點擊'請求'按鈕，然後選擇你的要求： @G44 你首先要有一個貨棧才能儲存這些物資。 @L@L請求軍事援助 @L如果有敵軍入侵，你可以向母城或盟友請求軍事援助。當然，如果錢夠多，你也可以賄賂敵軍讓他們退兵。 @L@L@L第四步 - 回報 @L其它城市給予你援助後也會要求回報，它們對你的請求列在總覽標籤中。要完成一個請求，可以直接點擊它，也可以在大地圖中選擇城市，然後點擊'滿足請求'： @G47 即使你沒有按時完成請求，只要在它消失之前完成，總是有好處的。 @L@L@L送出禮物 @L在大地圖上選擇一個城市，然後點擊'送出禮物'： @G48 送出禮物和完成請求可以讓盟友和你的關係更密切，這樣敵人也不敢貿然入侵。      @L@L你的敵城納米爾會經常向你要求葡萄酒，你可以請求墨伽拉給你葡萄酒，或者請求它派兵援助你。   @L@L@L其他領袖對你的看法 @L進入大地圖，選擇一個城市。   @L領袖的名字下面有一個按鈕，點擊後可以看到你和這個領袖之間所有的相關事件，如果你和其它城市的外交事件影響到這個城市的領袖對你的看法，那麼這些事件也會被列出來： @G45 @L@L@L第五步 - 開採銅礦以及鑄造青銅 @L銅礦可以用來鑄造青銅： @G42  在工業標籤的'原材料'中選擇'鑄造場'： @G28 鑄造場離銅礦越近效率越高。   @L@L@L第六步 - 爲母城提供物資 @L當你擁有足夠的青銅和小麥後，點擊'撥出'按鈕。當前任務完成了，請回到母城進入下一個任務。 @L @L

original: You're ready to leave Megara and establish a colony.  While doing so, your governor, Aristides, will administer Megara for you.  You're about to see a map of the Pan-Hellenic world, to choose a site on which to establish a colony.  In this tutorial, only one site is available: Halicarnassos.  When you see it, click on it.
text: 你現在要離開墨伽拉建造一個殖民地，墨伽拉暫時由一位總督代爲管理。在本章中，你只能選擇哈力納開闢殖民地。請在該處點擊鼠標。

original: Great job!  If you can run a city well enough to support elite warriors like hoplites and horsemen, you will truly be respected throughout the Greek world!
text: 幹得好！如果你能擁有步兵和騎兵，就會受到整個希臘的尊敬！

original: Well done! Now that you've established a thriving colony at Halicarnassos, your parent city, Megara, will have a source of wheat and bronze.  You will return to Megara now, while your trusted governor, Roka, administers the colony for you.
text: 幹得好！你建立了一個強大的殖民地，現在母城墨伽拉可以得到大量青銅和小麥了。你現在要回到墨伽拉，殖民地暫時由一位總督管理。

original: Politics and Diplomacy @LGreek politics can be both dangerous and lucrative.  You need to depend on your allies and subjects if you are to survive and prosper in this world, and find success on your many Adventures.  To complete this episode, you'll need to conquer your rival, the city of Nemea, and you may not be able to do this without some help.  @L@L@LDiplomatic status @LA city can be your ally, rival, or subject.  Subjects are colonies you've established, or vassals you've acquired through conquest. @L@LAllies are generally happy to help you, and will trade with you.  Be generous to an ally, and he may provide military support for one of your campaigns, or even conquer a rival on your behalf.  @L@LRivals, though not necessarily openly hostile, consider you a competitor, and do not want you to succeed.  They will not trade with you, and will not think twice about making unreasonable demands. @L@LSubjects always try to obey your wishes, must pay regular tribute to you, and will trade with you. @L@L@LInteracting with other cities @LWhen you select a city on the World Map, Action buttons appear on the World Control Panel, allowing you to interact with the city. Different actions are possible, depending on what type of city is selected. @L@LConquest @LYou may want to conquer a city because it has something you want, or has threatened or even attacked you . . . or maybe because you just feel like expanding your influence!  In this episode, you need to conquer Nemea. To try to conquer another city, select it, then click the Attack button, and enlist forces for the attack: @G50 If you are attacking a rival, any allies willing to join you on the attack will appear in the lower right corner of this screen.  If you successfully conquer the city, it will become your vassal.  Attacking allies can have disastrous ramifications, whether you win or lose, as your other allies won't easily trust you any more. @L@LSubjects and Tribute @LVassals and colonies have to fulfill all your requests, and pay regular tribute. If your own city is conquered by a rival, you'll have to pay tribute.  It is quite possible to find yourself paying tribute to a rival while simultaneously receiving it from a vassal!   @L@LConducting Raids @LIf you lack the forces to attempt conquest, you can simply raid a city for plunder.  Conducting a raid is not as risky as attempting conquest, but the rewards are not as great nor as permanent as with conquest.  To raid another city, select it, click the Raid button, and enlist forces for the raid:  @G51 Plunder @LTell your forces what you'd like them to procure as plunder.  Each survivor returns with plunder, so the bigger your forces, the more likely they are to survive, and the more plunder you'll receive.  Triremes can carry the most, followed by horsemen then hoplites @L@LMaking demands @LJust as you can peacefully request things from allies and subjects, so can you make demands of your rivals.  If a rival leader doesn't think you're powerful enough to back up the demand, he won't feel compelled to comply.  Sometimes even a rival may respond to a peaceful request, if his regard for you is really high.  @L@LOther cities on the World Map display small shield icons, roughly indicating their military capabilities.  Coins approximate their economic capabilities. @L@LHave fun conquering Nemea! @L @L
text: 政治和外交 @L通過外交手段獲得其它城市的援助是非常重要的，在本章中你要征服納米爾城，這光靠你自己的力量是很難成功的。  @L@L@L外交狀況 @L城市分為同盟、敵城、殖民地和附庸城。 @L@L盟友會樂於和你展開貿易，如果你和他們的關系不錯，他們會在關鍵時刻助你一臂之力。當然，如果你背叛了盟友，他們也會成為你的敵人。  @L@L敵城。敵城就是你的對手，他們一般不會主動幫助你，如果你需要敵城的物資，可以提出要求，或者搶劫甚至占領這座城市。敵城也經常會向你提出要求，如果你無法滿足這些要求，他們的領袖就會對你非常不滿。 @L@L殖民地和附庸城會樂於和你展開貿易，並且定期進貢。 @L@L@L外交 @L在大地圖上選中一座城市後，就可以看到一些外交按鈕： @G49 根據城市類型的不同，可以選擇的命令也不同。 @L@L占領城市 @L點擊這個按鈕可以讓你派出軍隊占領其它城市： @G50 你可以選擇要派出的部隊然後按'派遣'按鈕讓他們出發，民兵無法出國作戰。攻占敵城時你的盟友可能會來幫助你，不過一次只能有一個盟友能和你協同作戰。戰鬥結束後你會看到戰果報告，如果成功占領了敵城，它就會開始向你進貢。 @L@L進貢 @L附庸城和殖民地會向你定期進貢。但是如果你的城市被占領，也要向占領方進貢。   @L@L搶劫 @L搶劫。搶劫敵城可以讓你一下子獲得大量物資。點擊'搶劫'按鈕後你可以選擇要派出的部隊然後按'派遣'按鈕讓他們出發。 @G51 戰利品 @L搶劫後返回的士兵會帶回戰利品。三層船帶的最多，其次是騎兵，最少的是步兵。 @L@L提出要求 @L你可以向敵城提出各種要求。敵城一般不會滿足你的要求，但是如果你的軍事實力足夠強大，它們也可能會屈服。  @L@L城市上的盾牌圖標大致代表這個城市的軍事力量，而銀幣代表經濟實力。 @L@L征服納米爾城吧！ @L @L

original: The Wonders of Greece @LThis is the final tutorial for Zeus: Master of Olympus.  Here you'll find a large prosperous city for you to explore and study, complete with Sanctuaries dedicated to Apollo and Ares.  Ares will patrol the streets, accompanied by his fearsome dragon, and you may consult the Oracle of Apollo to see into the future. @L@LThere are no goals in this lesson, and no pressure to move on.  You may want to return to this tutorial often, to see how a certain industry works, or to peruse the interface.  You'll even find advice, below, based on the experience of other leaders who have come before you. @L@L@LHints and Tips @L@LSuck up to your neighbors @LGive other leaders gifts of goods or money now and then, especially if you have an excess of goods that you can afford to part with.  Pay attention to other leaders' requests and fulfill them when you can.  It always pays to have a few favors you can pull in when you're in a jam.   @L@LButter up your Rivals @LIf you are very nice to your rivals, even they may be willing to provide you with goods when you are in need of them.  @L@LSee into the future @LThe Oracle of Apollo and Zeus' Stronghold contain Oracles that can predict the future. @L@LPray to the Gods @LDon't forget to pray to the gods at their Sanctuaries when you need help.  Gods will do anything from filling your Storehouses with goods, to joining you on a military campaign or improving city hygiene.   @L@LListen to your people @LCitizens of your city will tell you what they think about living in the city.  Right click on them to hear what they have to say. @L@LLay out roads carefully @LThe fewer intersections walkers encounter, the more efficient they will be.  Try to plan your neighborhoods so that YOU are deciding where the walkers go and not leaving the decision up to them.  Roadblocks are very useful for this purpose. @L@LDecrease Walker Travel Distance @LThe closer workshops are to their sources of raw materials, the higher their annual production will be.  Also try to minimize the distance that workers such as Herders, Growers, and Miners have to travel. @L@LUse foresight in city planning @LKeep in mind that usable land is often limited.  When constructing new buildings, take care to leave appropriate space for structures you may need to build in the future.  Some o' them Sanctuaries is huge! @L@LPace yourself @LTake the time now and then to gauge your situation.  In some situations you'll have to build fast and furious to meet goals, requests, or demands.  In other instances you won't be able to do everything at once -  you'll have to bide your time until the right opportunity presents itself (a new city begins trading with you, a resource or new building becomes available, a gift, a quest, etc.). @L@LUsing Culture Venues @LThe Stadium, Theater, and Podium all act as 'magnets' for their respective walkers, coming from training facilities.  Walkers from the Gymnasium, Drama School, and College will head straight for these venues, ignoring roadblocks on their way.  Keep this in mind as you try to plan for culture in your city. @L@LWatch your money @LIf you find yourself in financial trouble, decrease imports or increase exports, reduce wages or increase taxes.  But remember these are only temporary fixes.  Also, don't be afraid to ask other cities for help. @L@LExport, export, export @LHarvest local raw materials or buy them if necessary.  Refine them into finished goods and sell them at a profit.  This is your best way to make money. @L@LShift labor @LLabor shortages are often unavoidable.  In these cases you might want to temporarily shift labor away from less-essential sectors of the workforce to concentrate on your city's immediate needs.  Raising wages will draw more workers from your existing population, but don't do this for too long, or you could wind up broke. @L@LSend your Trireme Workers Home @LTrireme Wharves require 100 employees to operate.  If you are experiencing a labor shortage, make sure that your triremes are unmanned. @L@LProtect your Palace @LAlways protect your Palace.  If enemy armies destroy your Palace, you will be defeated and forced to pay tribute to them. @L@LMoving Your Entire Military @LTo move multiple standards at once, click on one to bring up the orders interface, then drag a box around all of the standards that you want to select.  Scroll to the desired location, and click to place all of the standards.  This method of multiple selection can also be used to issue commands to several companies at once. @L@LLeave Standards in the field @LLeave company standards at the site of battle after you send your troops home.  Often enemies will approach from the same direction.  You can save time mustering your troops if you already have their standards at a spot where the enemy is likely to attack. @L@LWorking with Earthquake Cracks @LShort bridges can be built over straight sections of earthquake-cracked land. @L @L @L
text: 繁榮的城市 @L這是最後一個教程，沒有什麼任務，只是提供一個完整而繁榮的城市讓你從容瀏覽。你可能會有興趣看看阿波羅聖所裏的神諭。 @L@L這個城市可以作爲你的參考，你隨時可以回來看看各種建築的工作模式。 @L@L@L一些提示 @L@L搞好外交 @L如果手頭有富餘，可以向其它的城市送禮。此外，你要即時完成這些城市的請求。在你需要援助的時候，這些盟友會大力協助你。   @L@L敵城 @L如果你和敵城關係尚可，它們也可能會爲你提供一些物資。  @L@L神諭 @L阿波羅聖所和宙斯聖所都可以讓你看到未來。 @L@L向神明祈禱 @L神明會爲你提供各種幫助。   @L@L關心你的人民 @L右鍵點擊後可以看到人們對這城市有什麼看法。 @L@L小心建造道路 @L別建造太多的分叉路口，這會讓行人隨意亂走。你可以考慮使用一些路障規範他們的行進路線。 @L@L減少行人的行進路程 @L把有關聯的建築造在一起，這樣可以提高運送效率。 @L@L預先做好城市規劃 @L在建設時要爲將來的發展留有餘地。 @L@L注意速度 @L建設城市的速度越快越好，許多事件和任務都是有時間限制的。 @L@L文化設施 @L運動員、學者和演員分別要到露天運動場、講壇和劇場工作，請仔細規劃它們的位置，一路上千萬不要設路障。 @L@L注意經濟 @L如果錢不夠用，可以減少進口，增加出口，降低工資，提高稅率，還可以向其它城市要求援助。 @L@L出口，出口，再出口 @L把原材料加工後再出口是最好的賺錢方法。 @L@L靈活使用工人 @L在工人短缺的情況下，可以暫時讓次要建築的工人到重要的建築工作。 @L@L讓船員回家 @L三層船需要100個船員。在閒暇時記得讓他們回家。 @L@L保護你的宮殿 @L如果敵軍摧毀了你的宮殿，你就算戰敗了。 @L@L同時控制所有軍隊 @L你可以用鼠標拉一個框控制選中的所有軍隊。 @L@L把軍旗留在重要位置 @L把軍隊召回來的時候把軍旗留在重要位置，這樣發生緊急事件時可以讓軍隊直接到達該處。 @L@L地震 @L可以在地震造成的裂縫上建造小橋。 @L @L @L
